List of enquiries instituted by the Special Branch in
connection with the " Shooting of a Japanese sailor
on Darroch Road on Nov. 9, 1935 " and " Attack on
Hibino Yoko Shop on Nanking Road on Nov. 10, 1935 "

1) Enquiry re " Baretta " pistol used in the Darroch Rd. case.

2) " re Possible connection of students with the attack
on Hibino Yoko shop.

3) " re Pamphlets found outside the Hibino Yoko shop
after the attack.

4) " re Possibility of Waung Ching Wei's assailants being
responsible for the shooting of the Japanese
sailor on Darroch Road.

5) " re Prominent Chinese merchants being the instigators
of the attack on Hibino Yoko shop.

6) " re Organizations of Chinese deportees from Japan
being responsible for the attack on Hibino Yoko
shop.

7) " Exhibits ( Missiles & broken bottles ) found on scene
of attack on Hibino Yoko shop.

特务处就“1935年11月9日达罗克路（Darroch Road）一名日本水兵被枪击案”及“1935年11月10日南京路日比野洋行（Hibino Yoko Shop）遇袭案”所开展的调查清单

1) 关于达罗克路案件中所用“贝雷塔”（Baretta）手枪的调查。

2) 关于学生可能与日比野洋行遇袭案有关的调查。

3) 关于遇袭后在日比野洋行外发现的传单的调查。

4) 关于汪精卫（Waung Ching Wei，音译）的袭击者是否应对达罗克路日本水兵被枪击案负责的调查。

5) 关于著名中国商人是否为日比野洋行遇袭案幕后指使者的调查。

6) 关于被日本驱逐的中国侨民组织是否应对日比野洋行遇袭案负责的调查。

7) 关于在日比野洋行遇袭现场发现的证物（投掷物及碎玻璃瓶）。

With reference to the attached translation of an
anonymous letter received on the 22.1.36, addressed to
Dixwell Road Station, enquiries have been made by D.E.I.
Van Tuh Foo and the undersigned.

Li Zung Sung (黎润生 ), aged about 60 years, and
his son Li Te Nyoh (黎子玉 ), aged about 28 years,
Cantonese, reside at No.30 Yoong Tsong Li (永昌里 ), off
Arthur Road, and have always been residents of the
International Settlement.

Li Zung Sung is the proprietor of the Yoong Doong
Tehang (永同昌 ) Hardware Shop, No.51 Seward Road, his
son assists him in the business. Li Zung Sung also holds
the position as manager of the Hwa Tung Tobacco Co.,
902 Tongshan Road, formerly No.50 Seward Road.

There is nothing to suggest that they were concerned
in the murder of Hideo Nakayama.

It would appear that through business reasons
some person/s bear them malice.

兹提及附上的于1936年1月22日收到的致狄思威路巡捕房的匿名信译文，警探员范图福（Van Tuh Foo，音译）及本人已进行调查。

黎润生（Li Zung Sung），约60岁，及其子黎子玉（Li Te Nyoh），约28岁，广东人，居住于亚瑟路（Arthur Road）旁永昌里30号，一直为公共租界居民。

黎润生是西华德路51号永同昌五金店（Yoong Doong Tehang）的店主，其子协助其经营生意。黎润生还担任同山路902号（原西华德路50号）华通烟草公司（Hwa Tung Tobacco Co.）的经理。

没有任何迹象表明他们参与了中山秀雄（Hideo Nakayama）的谋杀案。

看来是由于商业原因，有人对他们怀恨在心。

March 26, 1936

Diary Number :- 16/1 Nature of Offence: Murder

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION

In connection with anonymous letter dated February
5, 1936, copy of translation attached, enquiries by D.S.I.s
Crowther, Tan Tuh Foo and C.D.S. 74 have ascertained the
following.

The chief tenant of No. 14 Eu Tuh Li (厚德里 ) Rue
Ratard, is one named Kyung Koh Liang (金国樑), aged 23
years, native of Fochun, an alleyway sweeper, employed by
the landlord of his house, has resided at the above
address for 4 years.

Kyung Koh Liang has a friend named Zung Hong Ts (陈洪志)
aged 19 years, native of Ningpo, a student in the Cheu Tan
(震旦 ) School, Rue Dubail, and resides at No. 15 Dah Lo
Li, Rue Dubail. The student answers to the description
given in the anonymous letter. He constantly visits Kyung
Koh Liang at No. 14 Eu Tuh Li, Rue Ratard.

Iung Sz Tsung (殷士振), the name mentioned in the
anonymous letter, is unknown to the aforesaid persons, nor
is anybody known by such name to persons residing in the
alleyways mentioned.

Kyung Koh Liang and Zung Hong Ts lead a quiet life,
and there is nothing to suggest that they were concerned
in the murder of H. Nakayama.

..........

Enquiries in connection with anonymous letter, dated
23 February, 1936, copy of translation attached.
Sung Zung Fah (孙顺发), alias Sung Siau Sz Ts

调查记录

就1936年2月5日的匿名信（附译文副本）一事，经警探员克劳瑟（Crowther）、谭图福（Tan Tuh Foo，音译）及华籍警探74号调查，查明如下情况。

拉塔德路（Rue Ratard）厚德里14号的主要租户名为金国樑（Kyung Koh Liang），23岁，福建人，巷道清洁工，受雇于其房东，已在上述地址居住4年。

金国樑有一位朋友名为陈洪志（Zung Hong Ts），19岁，宁波人，是杜百里路（Rue Dubail）震旦学校的学生，居住在杜百里路大乐里15号。该学生的体貌特征与匿名信中描述相符。他经常前往拉塔德路厚德里14号拜访金国樑。

匿名信中提到的殷士振（Iung Sz Tsung，音译），上述人员并不认识，居住在上述弄堂的人员中也没有人认识叫此名字的人。

金国樑和陈洪志生活安静，没有任何迹象表明他们参与了中山秀雄（H. Nakayama）的谋杀案。

..........

就1936年2月23日的匿名信（附译文副本）进行的调查。

imprisonment in the 2nd Branch Shanghai Special District
Court for being concerned in the murder of Dong Kya Bang
(唐嘉鹏), late manager of the Great World Amusement
Resort, Avenue Edward VII.
Sung Zung Fah is also known to have been convicted
in Chapel for Hwo-wei.
On afternoon of the 16.3.36, D.S.I.s Crowther and
Van Tuh Foo, with the assistance of the Heng Feng Road
Sub-Station, S.P.S. Bureau, visited 304 Heng Feng Road, but
Sung Zung Fah was basent, his wife was present. Nothing
to arouse suspicion was found.
On the morning of the 17.3.36 Sung Zung Fah attended
this station, the request having been left with his wife.
He was questioned by D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo and the
undersigned but no statement was forthcoming to suggest
he was concerned in the murder of H. Nakayama.
He readily admitted to having been convicted in 1932
for being an agent for Hwo-wei gambling, and knowing Wong

（孙小子），37岁，高邮人，已婚，无业，是恒丰路304号的主要租户，在此居住约10年。他将底层分租出去，过去曾用作热水店和食品店。
已知他与匿名信中提到的王兴高（Wong Hsing Kau），别名王小高子（Wong Siao Kau Ts）有往来，此人因参与爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）大世界游乐场前经理唐嘉鹏（Dong Kya Bang）谋杀案，被上海第二特区地方法院判处终身监禁。
已知孙顺发曾因作为花会赌博代理人而在教堂被捕定罪。
1936年3月16日下午，警探员克劳瑟和范图福在恒丰路分巡捕房及特务处的协助下，走访了恒丰路304号，但孙顺发不在家，其妻在家。未发现任何可疑之处。
1936年3月17日上午，孙顺发来到本巡捕房，此前已向其妻子留下要求。
警探员范图福及本人对其进行了讯问，但其未作出任何表明其参与中山秀雄（H. Nakayama）谋杀案的供述。
他 readily 承认曾于1932年因作为花会赌博代理人而被定罪，并认识王

One named Thaung Ah Kyung (湯阿京), aged 26 years,
native of Yangchow, employed as a cook by a Japanese at
No.312 Nanzing Road, was questioned on the 25/3/36 and it
was elicited that he introduced Nying Siau Pao to the
brothel at 228E. Paoshin Road.

During October 1935, the mistress instructed Nying
to change $450 in notes into silver dollars, however, he
absconded with the money. The Japanese female did not
make a report to the police. Nying Hoong Pau (楊宏保)
is the cousin of Nying Siau Pao, his age is 27 years,
native of Yangchow, and formerly resided at No.2 Tien
Tuh Li, Tien Tuh Road, Chapei. He was employed as a
packing coolie in a Japanese packing company situated at
312/13 Nanzing Road. Since October 1935 he has not been
seen and his present whereabouts are unknown.

Siau S Ts (小四子) is a brother of Nying Siau Pao,
his present whereabouts are also unknown.

With reference to anonymous letter, dated 21/3/36,
it will be noted on Sheet 2, paragraph 3, that D.S.Is.
Crowther and Van Tuh Foo, with the assistance of the

resulted in Sung Siau Ss Ts attending this station on

letter has close association with Sung Siau Ss Ts and saw
the police party when the visit was made.

一名名为汤阿京（Thaung Ah Kyung）的男子，26岁，扬州人，受雇于南京路312号的一名日本人担任厨师，于1936年3月25日接受讯问，据查是他将任小保介绍到宝山路228号东段的妓院。

1935年10月期间，女老板指示任小保将450元纸币兑换成银元，然而他携款潜逃。该日本女子未向警方报案。杨宏保（Nying Hoong Pau）是任小保的表亲，27岁，扬州人，以前居住在闸北天通庵路天通里2号。他受雇于位于南京路312/13号的一家日本打包公司担任打包苦力。自1935年10月以来无人见过他，目前下落不明。

小四子（Siau S Ts）是任小保的兄弟，目前下落也不明。

-----

就1936年3月21日的匿名信而言，见第2页第3段，警探员克劳瑟和范图福在特务处的协助下走访了恒丰路304号，导致孙小子（Sung Siau Ss Ts）于1936年3月17日到访本巡捕房。很明显，这封信的作者与孙小子关系密切，并在警方走访时看到了警方人员。

At 3.30 p.m. on the 20/4/36 D.S.I. Nakamura
and D.S. Tanaka brought to Dixwell Road Station the
3rd accused, Yih Hai-sung (葉海生), alias Siao Kwang
Tung (小廣東), aged 28 years, native of Canton, single
cabaret manager, residing No.22 Tsingkow Road (滄口路),
Tsingtao, whom they arrested at the afore-said address
at 11 p.m. on the 15/4/36 on the authority of a despatch
warrant No.27608, issued by the S.S.D.Court on the
14/4/36, the arrest was effected with the assistance of
Inspector Lu Sih Ts (呂錫智) of the Tsingtao Public
Safety Bureau.

Seized in his home were two letters, an
agreement paper, 1 piece of paper relating to the transfer
of a house, 4 name cards and 5 photographs.

Following this arrest in the morning of the
17/4/36 the 3rd accused's brother named Yih Ying Yong
(葉应容), aged 26 years was arrested at the same
address by Inspector Lu Sih Ts. On the morning of the
18/4/36 another suspect named Yong Ming Sung (容夢生)
aged 28 years was arrested at 55 Kweichow Road, Tsingtao,
by Inspector Lu Sih Ts.

The latter two persons are now detained by the
Tsingtao Public Safety Bureau for interrogation and
pending enquiries in Shanghai by the Municipal Police.

The 3rd accused Yih Hai Sung admits knowing

1936年4月20日下午3时30分，警探长（D.S.I.）中村（Nakamura）和副警探（D.S.）田中（Tanaka）将第三被告叶海生（Yih Hai-sung），别名小广东（Siao Kwang Tung），年龄28岁，籍贯广州，未婚，舞厅经理，住址青岛沧口路22号，带至狄思威路捕房。该犯于1936年4月15日晚11时在上述地址被捕，依据是特区地方法院于1936年4月14日签发的第27608号传票搜查令，逮捕行动得到了青岛公安局督察吕锡智（Lu Sih Ts）的协助。

在其家中搜获信件两封、协议文书一份、房屋转让相关文件一张、名片四张及照片五张。

继此次逮捕之后，于1936年4月17日上午，第三被告之兄叶应容（Yih Ying Yong），年龄26岁，在同一地址被督察吕锡智逮捕。1936年4月18日上午，另一名嫌疑犯容梦生（Yong Ming Sung，音译），年龄28岁，在青岛贵州路55号被督察吕锡智逮捕。

后两人现由青岛公安局羁押审讯，并等待工部局警务处在上海进行的调查。

第三被告叶海生承认认识

being concerned with the 1st accused Yang Vung Dao,
and 2nd accused Dzung Yong Sung, in the murder of
H. Nakayama which was perpetrated at about 9 p.m. on
the 9/11/35 on Darroch Road.

An application will be made in the S.S.D. Court
on the 21/4/36 for the 3rd accused to be detained on
a Writ of Detention.

第一被告杨文道（Yang Vung Dao），系通过在上海与“东宗会”（同仁会）的关系而结识。

第三被告叶海生涉嫌与第一被告杨文道及第二被告陈荣生（Dzung Yong Sung）共同参与了1935年11月9日晚9时许在达罗克路（Darroch Road）发生的中山秀雄（H. Nakayama）谋杀案。

将于1936年4月21日向特区地方法院申请对第三被告签发拘留令。

pages.en:
19/1

At about 9 p.m. on the 9/11/35 a Japanese Marine
named Hideo Nakayama aged 24 years, attached to the
Japanese Naval Landing Party whilst walking on
the Darroch Road near the Fung Loh Li (豐樂里) was
fatally wounded by being shot through the head with a
.32 bullet discharged from a Beretta .32 automatic
pistol, No.241146 of Italian make.

The crime was reported to Dixwell Road Police
Station at 9.05 p.m. on the 9/11/35.

Hideo Nakayama was removed to the Japanese Naval
Landing Party Hospital by members of the Naval Landing
Party where he succumbed to his injury at 1.10 a.m.
on 10/11/35.

At 11.40 p.m. on the 9/11/35 the Beretta .32
auto pistol was found by S.K. Kaneyasu behind a private
watchman's hut situated in the Fong Loh Li, 509 feet
from the scene of crime. It was found to contain one
magazine with five rounds of ammunition, and one round
in the breech.

8 feet
A .32 spent bullet was found/south of a pool
of blood on Darroch Road at the spot where H.
Nakayama was fatally wounded, and 4 feet 4 inches from
West Kerb of Darroch Road. A .32 empty cartridge case
was found 27 feet from this pool of blood on the East
side of Darroch Road practically opposite to the
pages.zh:
19/1

1935年11月9日晚9时许，一名隶属于日本海军陆战队的24岁日本水兵中山秀雄（Hideo Nakayama），在丰乐里附近的达罗克路行走时，头部被一发从意大利制造的贝雷塔.32口径自动手枪（编号241146）射出的.32口径子弹击中，受致命伤。

该案于1935年11月9日晚9时05分报告给狄思威路捕房。

中山秀雄由海军陆战队成员送往日本海军陆战队医院，于1935年11月10日凌晨1时10分因伤身亡。

1935年11月9日晚11时40分，金康保（S.K. Kaneyasu，音译）在距离犯罪现场509英尺的丰乐里内一处私人更夫棚屋后方发现了该把贝雷塔.32口径自动手枪。发现时枪内有一个弹夹，装有五发子弹，枪膛内有一发子弹。

在达罗克路上中山秀雄受致命伤处的血泊以南8英尺处，发现一枚.32口径已发射子弹，该处距离达罗克路西路边沿4英尺4英寸。在达罗克路东侧，几乎正对

position where the spent bullet was found

The following evidence is submitted to
pages.zh:
19/2

发现已发射子弹的位置，距离该血泊27英尺处，发现一枚.32口径空弹壳。
指纹局对该手枪进行了检验，但未提取到指纹。
枪械鉴定科对手枪、已发射子弹和空弹壳进行了检验，确定该手枪性能良好，近期曾发射过，且现场发现的子弹和弹壳确由该手枪发射并抛出。
第一被告杨文道、第二被告陈荣生（Dzung Yong Sung）于1936年4月19日被捕，第三被告黄海生（Yih Hai Sung）于1936年4月15日在青岛被捕并于1936年4月20日被带至上海，他们分别于1936年4月20日和21日出庭特区地方法院，期间成功申请了拘留令。
经查，没有证据表明第二被告陈荣生与此案有关，因此将在1936年4月27日三名被告出庭特区地方法院时，申请将其释放。
针对第一被告杨文道和第三被告黄海生，请求将拘留令延长一周，以便进一步调查。

证实此项请求。
第一被告杨云道（Yang Vung Dao）
1936年4月19日下午5时，依据特区法院签发的第39号搜查令（该搜查令于1936年4月20日呈交法院），一队警员对同安里18号敦山路 premises（此处指住宅/处所）进行了搜查，该处系第一被告杨云道的住所。参与行动的人员包括：警司克劳瑟（Crowther）、范图福（Van Tuh Foo）、施世坚（Shih Seu Chien），副警司克雷格（Craig），日籍侦探长83号小野（Osano），便衣华捕77号、164号、173号，以及便衣印捕119号。查获物品清单列于日志17的第7及8页。
在这些物品中，便衣华捕164号在该处所一楼前间的一张床脚处的衣架底部，发现了一本从英文翻译成中文、书中保留有英文技术术语的《实用物理学》一书。此床为第一被告的卧室。翻开该书后，发现书页被挖空，形状如同一把手枪。
当发现此书时，警司克劳瑟、施世坚，副警司克雷格，日籍侦探长小野，便衣华捕77号、173号，以及第一被告的妾室宋秀清（Soong Shiu Ching，陈秀金）均在房间内。该书随即移交给警司克劳瑟。在书的顶层和底层书页上可辨认出手枪的痕迹。此书随后由警司克劳瑟移交给负责指纹

pages.en:
Diary Number :- 19/4

Print Bureau by D.S.I. Crowther on the 20.4.36 for
examination and photographs were taken.
The photo maps show marks similar to those on
the Beretta .32 auto. pistol found by the Arms Iden-
tification Section to have fired the bullet and car-
tridge case found at the scene of crime.
The most significant marks being "FB" which are
on each side of the butt of the pistol, and the grooves
of the grip on the slide of the pistol.
The 1st accused claims in his statement that the
book was taken to his house by one of his children, he
cannot name which one, saying that as his wife Doong
Shui Tseng(唐秀珍) did not take it to the house one
of his children must have taken it then. This he
maintains was in October 1933.
On the 18th November 1933 the 1st accused Yang
Vung Dao applied to the Shanghai Municipal Council for
a licence to carry a firearm. This was later granted
and issued on 6th December 1933 in respect of a Demon
.32 auto pistol maker's No. 87558, S.M.P. No. Y2617.
He states he cut the hole in the leaves of the book so
that he could conceal his licenced pistol therein to
prevent his children from finding it.
On March 27, 1934 Mr. Paul Lee(李暮) Secretary
of the Bureau of Public Safety, Shanghai, Addressed a
letter to the Arms Licensing Section of the S.M. Police
pages.zh:
日志编号：19/4

鉴识科的警司迪克森（Dickson），时间为1936年4月20日，以便进行检查并拍摄照片。
照片图谱显示，其痕迹与武器鉴识科认定在犯罪现场发射了所发现的子弹和弹壳的那把贝雷塔（Beretta）.32口径自动手枪上的痕迹相似。
最显著的标记是位于手枪握把两侧的“FB”字样，以及手枪套筒上握把的纹路。
第一被告在其供词中声称，该书是由他的一个孩子带到他家的，但他无法指出是哪一个孩子，并称既然他的妻子唐秀珍（Doong Shui Tseng）没有把书带回家，那一定是他的某个孩子带回来的。他坚持称此事发生在1933年10月。
1933年11月18日，第一被告杨云道向上海公共租界工部局申请持枪许可证。该申请后来获得批准，并于1933年12月6日签发，许可持有的是一把制造商编号为87558、工部局警务处编号为Y2617的“Demon”牌.32口径自动手枪。
他声称他在书页上挖洞是为了将其合法持有的手枪藏匿其中，以防被他的孩子们发现。
1934年3月27日，上海市公安局秘书李暮（Paul Lee）先生致函工部局警务处枪支许可科，

pages.en:
10/5.

with the 1st accused's pistol licence requesting that
it be cancelled as the 1st accused had left Shanghai
and had handed the pistol over to him which he stated
he was going to keep for his own use.

The 1st accused states that he obtained this
pistol from Mr. Paul Lee before he applied for a
licence to carry firearms from the Shanghai Municipal
Council.

The size and type of a Demon pistol compared with
the Beretta pistol are quite different.

The 1st accused admits that prior to cutting the
leaves of the book he made an outline of his licensed
pistol on the leaves of the book with a blue pencil.

According to the 1st accused's statement he admits
having been the chairman of the Ong Zung Association
located in the Yung Ziang Si La, Point Road, which
position he obtained at the end of 1930 and held until
September or October 1933 when he resigned. The Dong
Zung Association (同众会) located at 56 Sung Tuh Tong,
Urga Road was inaugurated on February 27th 1935 and the
1st accused was elected Chairman. The Dong Zung Asso-
ciation and an association called the Dong Nyi (同义)
were formed by ex-members of the Ong Zung Association.
For many years the 1st accused was employed in the
godown of the Butterfield and Swire Shipping Co. until
the end of 1933 when he went to Canton, his last post
pages.zh:
10/5.

随函附上第一被告的持枪许可证，要求予以注销，理由是第一被告已离开上海，并将手枪交给了他，他称将留作自用。

第一被告称，他在向上海公共租界工部局申请持枪许可证之前，就从李暮（Paul Lee）先生那里获得了这把手枪。

“Demon”牌手枪与贝雷塔（Beretta）手枪在尺寸和类型上截然不同。

第一被告承认，在挖空书页之前，他曾先用蓝色铅笔在书页上描出了他合法持有手枪的轮廓。

根据第一被告的供词，他承认曾担任位于百老汇路永祥四里的翁众协会（Ong Zung Association）主席，该职位他于1930年底获得，并一直担任至1933年9月或10月辞职。位于峨嵋路松土通56号的同众会（Dong Zung Association）于1935年2月27日成立，第一被告当选为主席。同众会和另一个名为同义（Dong Nyi）的协会均由翁众协会的前成员组成。
多年来，第一被告受雇于太古轮船公司（Butterfield and Swire Shipping Co.）的仓库，直到1933年底前往广州，他最后的职位是1A号仓库的管理员。

being the godown keeper of No.1A godown.
3rd accused Yih Hai Sung (葉海生)
According to the statement of Tseng Nyoen
(曾元) the 3rd accused Yih Hai Sung went to the
home of this witness at Chi Peng Li (岐峰里), Kwang-
tung Ka (廣東街) Chapei on a day in September or
October 1935 and asked for a loan of $25.00. The wit-
ness at this time was a money lender and according to
his rules, persons who wanted to secure a loan had to
produce two guarantors. The 3rd accused was unable
to introduce two guarantors therefore his request for
a loan was refused. On the following day the 3rd
accused went again to his home and showed him a pistol
stating that he would give the pistol as security for
$25.00. The wife of the witness was present and forbid
him to take the pistol so the 3rd accused left. In
the night of the same day the 3rd accused visited the
house of the witness again with the pistol The wit-
ness asked him where he had obtained the pistol when the
3rd accused told him a Korean named Jack owned it.
The witness at this time examined the pistol carefully.
On the 5/1/36 at 38 Scott Road in the presence of Com-
mander Ohsugi, Lieut. Commander Okino, D.S.I. Nakamura,
D.S.s Iguchi and Tanaka, the witness identified the
.32 Beratta Pistol No.241146 from amongst 4 other
automatic pistols of different makes. This he repeated
pages.zh:
日志编号 19/6.

第三被告叶海生（Yih Hai Sung）
根据证人曾元（Tseng Nyoen）的供词，1935年9月或10月的某一天，第三被告叶海生前往闸北广东街岐峰里这位证人的家中，请求借款25.00元。当时证人是一名放债人，按照他的规矩，想要获得贷款的人必须提供两名担保人。第三被告无法介绍两名担保人，因此其借款请求被拒绝。次日，第三被告再次来到他家，出示了一把手枪，表示愿以该手枪作为25.00元借款的抵押。证人的妻子在场并禁止他接受手枪，于是第三被告离开。当晚深夜，第三被告再次携带手枪造访证人家。证人询问他从何处获得该手枪，第三被告告知是一名叫杰克（Jack）的韩国人拥有的。证人当时仔细检查了这把手枪。
1936年1月5日，在斯科特路38号，在大杉指挥官（Commander Ohsugi）、奥野少佐（Lieut. Commander Okino）、日籍警司中村（Nakamura）、日籍侦探井口（Iguchi）和田中（Tanaka）的见证下，证人从另外四把不同品牌的自动手枪中辨认出了编号为241146的.32口径贝雷塔手枪。这一辨认结果他重申于

pages.en:
19/7

on the 15/2/36.

The most particular point he could remember of
the pistol were the letters P.B. on the butt of the
pistol.

According to the statement of Tsang Zai Nyuen
(张财源), the witness between 8.30 and 8.45 p.m. on
the 9/11/35 emerged from the Yue Ching Yong, North
Szechuen Road practically opposite to Darroch Road,
he had walked 20 to 30 paces across the North Szechuen
Road proceeding South where he observed the 3rd accused
walking quickly Northwards on the West pavement of
North Szechuen Road, walking five or six paces behind
him in the same direction were two other men one he
recognized as a Korean named Jack, the other he did
not know. The 3rd accused was wearing a dark coloured
Sun Yat Sen uniform. This witness had seen the 3rd
accused and the Korean Jack many times before this
occasion in cabarets off the North Szechuen Road.

According to the statement of witness Lee Yan
(李雄) he with one witness named Wong Tsung (黄松)
went to room No.7 Moon Palace Hotel at a little past
8 p.m. on the 9/11/35 to play Mah Jongg. In the room
he saw the 3rd accused lying on an iron bed with a
light opium lamp besides him, Wong Tsung asked the
3rd accused if there would be a game of Mah Jongg that

1936年2月15日。

他能记起的关于这把手枪最特别的特征是握把上的字母“P.B.”。

根据证人张财源（Tsang Zai Nyuen）的供词，1935年11月9日晚上8点30分至8点45分之间，证人从位于北四川路、几乎正对达罗克路的 Yue Ching Yong（音译，原文不清）出来，他穿过北四川路向南走了20到30步，此时他观察到第三被告正沿着北四川路西侧人行道快速向北行走，在他身后同方向五六步远处跟着另外两个人，其中一人他认出是一名叫杰克的韩国人，另一人不认识。第三被告身穿深色中山装。在此事发生之前，这位证人曾在北四川路附近的几家舞厅里多次见过第三被告和韩国人杰克。

根据证人李雄（Lee Yan）的供词，1936年11月9日晚8点刚过，他与另一位名叫黄松（Wong Tsung）的证人前往月宫饭店7号房间打麻将。在房间里，他看见第三被告躺在一张铁床上，旁边放着一盏小鸦片灯，黄松问第三被告当晚是否有麻将局，

pages.en:
Diary Number 19/8

night and the 3rd accused told him no. Wong Tsung then
left letting the witness Lee Yau to wait in the
room for him. After Wang Tsung left a Korean whom
Lee Yau has identified in the Japanese Consulate
entered and called Siau Kwangtung in Shanghai
dialect. The 3rd accused rose from the bed and then
the Korean offered him a pistol which he refused to
accept, saying "Why give it to me, why don't you
give it to Pau Kyu (鮑琚 )" The witness saw a part of
the barrel of the pistol. The Korean asked
where Pao Kyu was and it is said by this witness
some one called from an adjoining bath room that Pao
Kyu was waiting at Waung Pang Jao, in Cantonese.
The Korean put the pistol into his trousers pocket
and left with the 3rd accused.

Wong Tsung returned to the room and this
witness told him that he had heard and seen. This
witness left Wong Tsung and on foot proceeded to
a Japanese Pharmacy located opposited the Foo Ming
Hospital on North Szechuen Road, and purchased 20
cents worth of sterilized cotton wool. Returning
on foot Southwards on the North Szechuen Road with
a view to returning to his home in the Tuh Shing Li,
Boone Road, and on reaching Wang Pang Jao he saw
the 3rd accused walking Northwards on the West pavement
of North Szechuen Road followed by the Korean

第三被告回答没有。随后黄松离开，让证人李尤（Lee Yau，注：此处原文名字拼写变为Lee Yau，前文为Lee Yan，依原文翻译）在房间里等他。黄松离开后，一名韩国人进入房间，李尤在日本领事馆已辨认出此人，并用上海话喊了一声“小广东”。第三被告从床上起身，随后那名韩国人递给他一把手枪，但他拒绝接受，说道：“为什么要给我，为什么不给鲍琚（Pau Kyu）？”证人看到了手枪的部分枪管。韩国人询问鲍琚在哪里，据这位证人说，有人从隔壁浴室喊道，鲍琚正在旺彭角（Waung Pang Jao，音译）等候，用的是粤语。韩国人将手枪放入裤袋，与第三被告一同离开。

黄松回到房间，这位证人告诉了他自己所闻所见。这位证人离开黄松，步行前往位于北四川路富明医院对面的一家日本药房，购买了价值20分的消毒棉球。随后沿北四川路向南步行回家，目的地是博恩路德成里。当到达旺彭角（Wang Pang Jao）时，他看见第三被告正沿着北四川路西侧人行道向北行走，后面跟着那名韩国人和

pages.en:
10/0

the other man. The foreman being the man
he has seen in room 7 of the Moon Palace. The
3rd accused was wearing the Sun Yat-sen uniform
as he had seen him wearing in room 7 of the Moon
Palace. He was also without a hat, further the
foreman and the other male Chinese were without hats.
Witness Lee You's statement regarding the 3rd
accused being in room 7 of the Moon Palace is
borne out by the statement of the witness Wong Tsung.
Wong Tsung in his statement states he asked
3rd accused if there was to be a game of Mah Jongg
that night, and that he saw him wearing a Sun Yat
sen uniform.

The witness Lee You's statement corrobo-
rates the statement of Tsang Zai Kyuen in-as-much
as that the 3rd accused was walking a little in
front of the foreman and the other man and that
they were not wearing hats.

The 3rd accused was a member of the Ung
Lung Association located in the 永祥四里 Yong Ziang Si Li,
Point road and later became a member of the Dong Lyi
Association (同義会). It was by being a member
of the Ung Lung Association and the influence of the
1st accused that the 3rd accused was able to stay in
No.11 Godown of Butterfield and Swire on the French
Bund, for one or two months from December 1933
during a period he was unemployed.
pages.zh:
10/0

另一名男子。这名领头的男子就是他在月宫饭店7号房间见过的那个人。第三被告穿着他在月宫饭店7号房间见过的那套中山装。他也没戴帽子，此外，那名领头的男子和另一名中国男子也没戴帽子。
证人李尤（Lee You）关于第三被告在月宫饭店7号房间的供词得到了证人黄松供词的佐证。
黄松在供词中称，他问第三被告当晚是否有麻将局，并看见他穿着中山装。

证人李尤的供词证实了张财源（Tsang Zai Kyuen，注：此处拼写与前文Tsang Zai Nyuen略有不同，依原文）的供词，即第三被告走在领头男子和另一名男子前面一点，且他们都没有戴帽子。

第三被告曾是位于百老汇路永祥四里的雍龙协会（Ung Lung Association）的成员，后来成为同义会（Dong Lyi Association）的成员。正是凭借雍龙协会成员的身份以及第一被告的影响力，第三被告才能在1933年12月期间失业的一两个月内，居住在法租界外滩太古轮船公司的11号仓库。

176/35.

The three accused (1) Yong Vung Dao, (2) Dzung
Yong Sung and (3) Yih Hai Sung appeared before Judge
Siao (肖) in No.1 Court, S.S.D. Court at 2 p.m. on
the 27/4/36. The evidence at present at hand was
outlined by A/L.A. Mr. Paul Y. Ru who requested the
Court to grant a two weeks' remand for further enquiries.
The hearing was in Camera. This request was
also made in Chambers prior to the case opening.
Witnesses Tseng Yuan (曾元) and Tsang Zai Nyuen (張財源)
were questioned by the Judge. The Judge only granted
a remand of the three prisoners until the 1/5/36.
Further to this case between 5 p.m. and 7 p.m.
on the 21/4/36 with the assistance of members of the
Public Safety Bureau, J.D.S. 151 Tanaka and S.I. Uasa
of the Japanese Consular Police visited No.27 Chi
Hsing Li (浙興里), In Ka Zah (殷家宅), Chapei, with
a view to locating one named Pao Kyu (鮑琚) mentioned
to be connected with this case, the house was found
vacated ---- no personal papers and nothing of an
incriminating nature were found.
Between the same times and date D.S.I. Nakamura
and S.I. Sato of the Japanese Consular Police with
members of the Public Safety Bureau including Supt.
Liang, Officer i/c of the North Station Branch Bureau,

三名被告（1）杨云道（Yong Vung Dao，注：此处拼写与前文Yang Vung Dao略有不同，依原文），（2）陈永生（Dzung Yong Sung，音译），（3）叶海生于1936年4月27日下午2时在特区法院第一法庭肖法官（Judge Siao）面前出庭。代理副检察官保罗·鲁（Paul Y. Ru）先生概述了目前掌握的证据，并请求法庭准予延期两周以便进一步调查。
审讯不公开进行。在案件开庭前，此项请求也在法官办公室提出。
法官讯问了证人曾元和张财源。法官仅批准将三名囚犯还押至1936年5月1日。
关于此案，1936年4月21日下午5时至7时之间，在公共安全局成员的协助下，日籍侦探副巡长151号田中（Tanaka）和日本领事馆警察的特别调查员宇佐（Uasa）前往闸北殷家宅浙兴里27号，旨在寻找据称与此案有关的一名名叫鲍琚的人，发现该房屋已空置——未找到任何个人文件，也未发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。
在同一时间和日期，日本领事馆警察的日籍警司中村和特别调查员佐藤（Sato），会同公共安全局成员，包括北站分局主管梁督察，

pages.en:
20/2

visited the Kweng Tung Junior Middle School (廣東初級中學),
Paoyuen Road (寶源路), Chapei to interview the
principal one Dzung Hong Pih (陳鴻璧), female.
Supt. Liang handed over to D.S.I. Nakamura one
petition dated February 5, 1936 addressed to Supt. Liang
by the Principal Dzung Hong Pih, complaining of a false
accusation and the activities of a certain three unknown
male Chinese.
One letter written in pencil obviously in a
disguised handwriting, post mark, General Post Office,
North Soochow Road, posted at 11 a.m. 19/4/36 and
delivered to the Principal Dzung Hong Pih at 12 m.d.
19/4/36.
Translation of letter is as follows :-
Comrade Hung Pih (鴻璧),
The situation has become serious. Yesterday I
received a letter from Zung Feng Yuen (陳鳳源) stating
that Bao Kyu (鮑玖) had been seen in Tientsin but
Yih Hai Sung (葉海生) had so far not arrived.
Following the arrest of "Zuh Ka" (直加), a
Korean, this party had ordered all the partisans to
hide away. You must abscond immediately after this
letter reaches you otherwise you will lose your life.
Please refund us the two loans, one about $3,000
and the other about $8,000 which two of our comrades
lent you after the January 28th incident. These two
pages.zh:
20/2

前往闸北宝源路的广东初级中学，会见该校校长陈鸿璧（Dzung Hong Pih，女）。
梁督察向日籍警司中村移交了一份由校长陈鸿璧于1936年2月5日写给梁督察的请愿书，投诉遭受诬告以及三名身份不明的中国男子的活动。
另有一封用铅笔书写、笔迹明显经过伪装的信件，邮戳显示为北苏州路总局，于1936年4月19日上午11点寄出，并于同日中午12点送达校长陈鸿璧手中。
信件译文如下：
鸿璧同志：
局势已变得严峻。昨日我收到陈凤源（Zung Feng Yuen）的来信，称在天津见到了鲍玖（Bao Kyu，注：此处中文名用字与前文鲍琚不同，依原文），但叶海生尚未到达。
随着一名叫“直加”（Zuh Ka，音译）的韩国人被捕，该党派已命令所有同党隐藏起来。你必须在收到此信后立即潜逃，否则你将性命不保。
请退还我们两笔贷款，一笔约3,000元，另一笔约8,000元，这两笔钱是我们两位同志在一·二八事变后借给你的。这两笔

pages.en:
20/3

comrades have to hide away now.
You should ignore summons served on you by any
Court otherwise you will lose your life, certain matter
having been exposed. This Association have

"C" Division
Maxwell Road
April 30, 1936.

176/35.

Diary No. 21/1.

During the period of remand the 1st accused,
Yan Yang Dao (楊文道) and 3rd accused, Yih Hai Sung
(葉海生) have been interrogated at length.
The 1st accused maintains silence as regards
this crime. He has not put up any alibi to rebut the
evidence in the hands of the Police.
In the case of the 3rd accused he has given many
stories centering round the 9/11/35, as regards his
movements, but failed to put any tangible story forward
as to his movements on the 9/11/35, although he could
recollect dates and movements prior to and after the
9/11/35.
The fact that he, the 3rd accused, avoided his
movements on the 9/11/35 gave strong ground to the
investigating officers as to his actual movements on
this date.
This was eventually met with a confession from
the 3rd accused which he wrote in his own handwriting,
which was witnessed by Assistant Commissioners Mr. T.
Robertson, Mr. Uyehara, D.S.I. Crowther, D.S. Ross,
D.S.I. Nakamura, D.S. Tanaka, & D.S.I.s Van Tah, Foo and
Shih Ssu-chien.
The main points of this confession are, that on
November 7th, 1935, the 3rd accused received a letter,
which he states he tore up, from the 1st accused through
the post, instructing the 3rd accused to go to the
pages.zh:
“C”巡捕房
麦克斯威尔路
1936年4月30日。

176/35号案件。

日志编号 21/1。

在还押候审期间，第一被告杨文道和第三被告叶海生接受了详细讯问。
第一被告对此罪行保持沉默。他未提出任何不在场证明以反驳警方掌握的证据。
至于第三被告，他就其行踪提供了许多围绕1935年11月9日的说法，但未能就其在1935年11月9日当天的行踪提出任何确凿的说法，尽管他能回忆起1935年11月9日之前和之后的日期及行踪。
第三被告回避提及他在1935年11月9日的行踪，这一事实为调查人员推断其当日的实际行踪提供了有力依据。
此事最终以第三被告的亲笔供词告终，该供词由助理警务处长T. Robertson先生、上原先生、刑事侦缉处长Crowther、刑事侦缉处警司Ross、刑事侦缉处长中村、刑事侦缉处警司Tanaka，以及刑事侦缉处长Van Tah、Foo和施思坚见证。
这份供词的主要要点是，1935年11月7日，第三被告收到第一被告通过邮局寄来的一封信，他称已将信撕毁，信中指示第三被告前往

pages.en:
21/2.

1st accused's house as he wished to talk with him.
The 3rd accused ignored this order.
At about 7.30 p.m. on the 9/11/35 the 3rd accused
was descending the stairway of the Moon Palace, North
Szechuen Road, when he observed the 1st accused, and a
Korean named Jack, at present detained by the Japanese
Consular Police, standing at the entrance of the Moon
Palace. The 1st accused then ordered the 3rd accused
to accompany the Korean and him, saying he wanted to
kill a Japanese. The 3rd accused asked for what reason
and was told by the 1st accused that he would tell him
later. The 3rd accused obeyed the 1st accused as he
was the chairman of the Dong Nyi Association and is
concurrently the chairman of the Dong Zung Association,
situated at 56/31 Urga Road. In their entirety these
associations are composed of Cantonese, and have a strong
hold over each member. The 3rd accused is a member of
the Dong Nyi Association.
The 1st accused, 3rd accused and the Korean on
foot wended their way to Barroch Road, the 3rd accused
preceding the 1st accused and the Korean by four or
five paces. The 1st accused was carrying a green
coloured book in his left hand. The 3rd accused identi-
fied the book entitled "Practical Physics" as the one
pages.zh:
21/2。

第一被告家中，因第一被告欲与其谈话。
第三被告无视了这一命令。
1935年11月9日晚上约7点30分，第三被告正走下北四川路月宫旅馆的楼梯，此时他看见第一被告和一名名叫Jack的朝鲜人（目前被日本领事馆警察拘留）站在月宫旅馆入口处。随后，第一被告命令第三被告陪同该朝鲜人和他一起行动，称他要杀一个日本人。第三被告询问原因，第一被告告知他稍后会解释。第三被告服从了第一被告的命令，因为第一被告是同义会的主席，同时也兼任位于厄尔古路56/31号的同仁会主席。这些协会完全由广东人组成，对每个成员都有很强的控制力。第三被告是同义会的成员。
第一被告、第三被告和该朝鲜人步行前往达罗克路，第三被告走在第一被告和该朝鲜人前方四五步处。第一被告左手拿着一本绿色的书。第三被告指认该书名为《实用物理学》，即他

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 21/3

he saw the 1st accused carrying.
On approaching Darroch Road and North Szechuen Road
corner, the 3rd accused observed a Japanese marine
proceeding West on Darroch Road, at this juncture the
1st accused and the Korean overtook the 3rd accused
and on the three persons, 1st accused, 3rd accused
and the Korean, turning West into Darroch Road, the
3rd accused was preceded by the 1st accused and the
Korean. The Japanese marine had reached a point about
three yards South of a cigarette shop, situated on the
West side of Darroch Road, and at the corner of Darroch
Terrace, when the 3rd accused observed the 1st accused
extract a pistol from the green book and take aim at
the Japanese marine and simultaneously he, the 3rd
accused, heard the report of the explosion of the pistol
and then he saw the marine staggering. At this juncture
the 3rd accused states he on the run returned via
Darroch Road, to North Szechuen Road, then Northwards
to Dixwell Road, along Dixwell Road to Kashing Road and
then by Chapei to his home, at Jukong Road.
The 3rd accused also remembers seeing two Chinese
females on the Darroch Road and they appeared to him to
be servants.
The 3rd accused admits that on the night of the
9.11.35 he was attired in a black foreign styled suit.
pages.zh:
日志编号:- 21/3

所见第一被告携带的那一本。
当接近达罗克路与北四川路的拐角时，第三被告看见一名日本海军陆战队员正沿达罗克路向西行进，此时第一被告和该朝鲜人赶上了第三被告，当这三人（第一被告、第三被告和该朝鲜人）向西转入达罗克路时，第一被告和该朝鲜人走在第三被告前面。当那名日本海军陆战队员到达达罗克路西侧一家香烟店以南约三码处，且位于达罗克台路口时，第三被告看见第一被告从那本绿色书中取出一把手枪，瞄准该日本海军陆战队员，与此同时，第三被告听到了手枪爆炸的声响，随后看见那名水兵踉跄倒下。此时，第三被告称他奔跑着经达罗克路返回北四川路，然后向北至狄思威路，沿狄思威路至嘉善路，再经由闸北回到他在菊康路（音译）的家。
第三被告还记得在达罗克路上看见两名中国女性，她们看起来像是佣人。
第三被告承认，在1935年11月9日晚，他身穿一套带白色条纹的黑色西式西装，

pages.en:
Diary No. 21/4

with while stripes and a felt hat.
A witness named Poo Chou Ying (潘巧雲) maid servant
to a Japanese, residing at 95 Wing On Terrace, whom
D.S.I. Crowther took a statement from on the 11/11/35
stated that she was near a hot water shop (70 feet South
of the scene of crime) walking South on Darroch Road,
she met a Japanese sailor walking North on Darroch Road,
on the west side, and walking parallel with the sailor
in the same direction on the East side of the road was
a man wearing dark foreign styled clothing and a felt
hat, colour of the hat she could not state. She had
reached a spot some 108 feet South of the scene of
the crime, this being some 38 feet beyond where she met
the Japanese sailor when she heard the sound of an ex-
plosion. She immediately turned round and saw a Japanese
sailor lying in the roadway, however, she did not see the
civilian. The witness Poo Chou Ying is at present in
Kau Yeu (高郵), Kompo, efforts are being made to get
her to come to Shanghai.
The positions of the 1st accused, Korean, 3rd
accused, and the sailor; also the route traversed by
the two accused and the Korean, were put into a sketch
drawn in pencil by the 3rd accused.
Further to this the 3rd accused whilst being
escorted from Tsingtao to Shanghai on board the S.S.

头戴一顶毡帽。
一位名叫潘巧云的证人，系居住在永安台95号的一名日本人的女佣，刑事侦缉处长Crowther于1935年11月11日向其录取了供词，她陈述称，当时她在一家热水店附近（案发地点以南70英尺）沿达罗克路向南行走，遇见一名日本水手沿达罗克路西侧向北行走，而在道路东侧与该名水手平行同向行走的是一名身穿深色西式服装、头戴毡帽的男子，她无法说明帽子的颜色。当她走到案发地点以南约108英尺处，即遇到那名日本水手后再往前38英尺的地方时，她听到了一声爆炸响。她立即转身，看见一名日本水手躺在马路上，然而，她并未看见那名平民男子。证人潘巧云目前在高邮，正在努力设法让她来上海。
第一被告、朝鲜人、第三被告以及那名水手的位置；以及两名被告和该朝鲜人所经过的路线，均由第三被告用铅笔绘制成草图。
此外，第三被告在由田中警司和其他官员陪同，乘坐

pages.en:
Diary Number 21/5

Hoten Maru by D.S. Tanaka and other officers asked D.S.
Tanaka without being prompted, whether or not he would
be detained at Dixwell Road Police Station. This point
is emphasized owing to the fact that the crime was
committed in the Dixwell Road District.

The 1st accused confronted with the 3rd accused
and his statement failed to make any statement, this
must also be borne in mind, as, if there was no truth
in the statement of the 3rd accused, the 1st accused
would naturally say that it was false.

In connection with the book "Practical Physics"
and the first statement of the 1st accused, which was
to the effect that he made the hole in the book for
his licensed pistol makers No. 87558, S.M.P. No. Y2617,
by placing this pistol on the leaves of the book and
with a blue pencil, which marks are still present, he
drew the shape of the said pistol. Through the medium
of Mr. Paul T. Lee, and the Arms Licensing Section,
"Demon" pistol Y. 2617 was traced to one Zee Ziang
Hsing (徐祥兴 ), 153 Woo Kya Pang off Balny Road, who
has it licensed with the Shanghai Municipal Council.
It is at present in the hands of the Police and will
be used as an exhibit in Court.

Lengthy investigation still has to be made.
pages.zh:
日志编号 21/5

“博多丸”号轮船从青岛前往上海途中，未经提示便主动询问田中警司，他是否会被拘押在狄思威路巡捕房。强调这一点是因为犯罪发生在狄思威路辖区。

将第一被告与第三被告及其供词对质后，第一被告未作任何陈述，这一点也必须予以考虑，因为如果第三被告的供词不实，第一被告自然会指出其为虚假。

关于《实用物理学》一书以及第一被告的首次陈述，其大意是他为了容纳其持照手枪（制造商编号87558，工部局编号Y2617），将该手枪放在书页上，并用一支蓝色铅笔画出手枪的形状，这些痕迹至今仍在。通过李保罗先生和枪械执照科的协助，追踪到“恶魔”牌Y.2617号手枪属于徐祥兴，住址为白利南路伍家浜153号，该枪已在上海公共租界工部局注册持照。该枪目前由警方保管，将作为法庭证物使用。

本案仍需进行 lengthy（冗长/大量）调查，

pages.en:
21/6.

in this case, as at present the motive for the crime
is not clear, and a further remand is imperative.
The 1st and 3rd accused are now charged and
appear in the S.S.D. Court at 2 p.m. on the 1/5/36.
1st accused
Charge: Murder Cont. to Art. 271(1) of the C.C.R.C.
For that you, Yang Vung Dao, at about 9 p.m.
on the 9th November 1935, on Darroch Road, Shanghai, did,
by means of .32 Auto Beretta Pistol, Maker's No.241146,
shoot one named Hideo Nakayama, and caused his death.
3rd accused
Charge: Aiding & Abetting in the commission of the
crime of murder, Cont. to Art. 271(1) & 28 of
C.C.R.C.
For that you Yih Hai Sung, at about 9 p.m.
on the 9th November 1935, on Darroch Road, Shanghai, and
prior to that time, concerned together with one, a
Korean named Kan Ki Ryo, now held in custody, did aid
and abet jointly in the commission of the crime of murder.
No evidence has been forthcoming in respect
of the 2nd accused Dzung Yong Sung ( ) therefore a
request will be made to the Court for his release.
Exhibits at the present are:-
(1). Medical and death certificate of Hideo Nakayama's
demise made by Medical Commander Junkichi Ogawa.

21/6。

因为目前犯罪动机尚不明确，且必须进一步还押候审。
第一和第三被告现已被起诉，并于1936年5月1日下午2点在特区地方法院出庭。
第一被告
指控：违反《中华民国刑法》第271条第(1)款之谋杀罪。
指控你，杨文道，于1935年11月9日晚上约9点，在上海达罗克路，使用.32口径贝雷塔自动手枪（制造商编号241146），射击一名叫中山秀夫的人，并致其死亡。

关于第二被告钟永松（音译），暂无证据提出，因此将向法院申请将其释放。

"C" Division
Dixwell Road
May 5, 1936.

Crime Register No. 176/35  D.R.
Diary No.22/1

The three accused, (1) Yang Vung Do, (2) Dzung
Yong San & (3) Yih Hoi Sung, appeared in the S.P.D. Court
at 2 p.m. on the 1/5/36.

The 2nd accused was released, whilst the charges
of murder and aiding and abetting in the commission of
murder were heard against the 1st and 3rd accused.

The 3rd accused made an admission in Open Court
similar in effect to his written statement.

The 1st accused denied the charge.

The case was remanded until 2 p.m. on the 6/5/36.

On the 2/5/36 the 3rd accused made a further state-
ment regarding the forming of the plan to commit the
crime, which is to the effect; four or five months prior
to the 1st accused returned to Canton, which would be
in the Summer of 1933, he joined the Ong Zung (洪順)
Mutual Aid Association which was then located in the
Yong Ziang Si Li (永祥西里) Point Road. The 1st
accused was then the Chairman of the Ong Zung Mutual Aid
Association.

In March 1934 the 1st accused went to Canton and
the Ong Zung Association was dissolved.

From the time the 3rd accused joined the Ong Zung
Mutual Aid Association he often met the 1st accused.

It will also be seen in the first written statement
of the 3rd accused that in October or November 1933
pages.zh:
“C”巡捕房
狄思威路
1936年5月5日。

犯罪登记号 176/35 D.R.
日志编号 22/1

三名被告，(1) 杨文道，(2) 钟永松（音译）及 (3) 叶海生，于1936年5月1日下午2点在特区地方法院出庭。

第二被告获释，同时审理了对第一和第三被告提出的谋杀及协助教唆谋杀罪的指控。

第三被告在公开法庭上作出了与其书面供词效力相似的承认。

第一被告否认指控。

案件延期至1936年5月6日下午2点再审。

1936年5月2日，第三被告就策划犯罪的过程作了进一步陈述，大意如下：在第一被告返回广州前的四五个月，即1933年夏季，他加入了当时位于Point Road（今四川中路）永祥西里的洪顺互助会。当时第一被告是洪顺互助会的主席。

1934年3月，第一被告前往广州，洪顺互助会解散。

自第三被告加入洪顺互助会以来，他经常与第一被告见面。

从第三被告的第一份书面供词中也可以看出，在1933年10月或11月

pages.en:
176/35 D.R.
22/√

whilst unemployed he stayed in thequarters of the
godown keepers of Butterfield & Swire Shipping Company,
the French Bund, for a period of one or two months.
At this time the1st accused was in charge of No.1
Godown. The 3rd accused in his first written statement
also states that it was through the1st accused's.
influence that he was able to stay in thegodown quarters.
Returning to the further written statement of
the 3rd accused, now numbered 3, the 3rd accused after
the Ung -ung Mutual Aid Association was dissolved went
to Tsingtao and returned to Shanghai some time afterwards,
when he was introduced to the Dong Nyi Association (同義协会)
by onenamed Lee Neng ( 李能 ). At that time the 1st
accused was concurrently the chairman of the Dong Nyi
and Dong Zung Association ( 同仁会 ), which were formed
by ex-members of the Ng Zung Mutual Aid Association.
The 3rd accused goes on to state at about 8 p.m.
on a certain day at the beginning of October 1935, the
1st accused ordered one named Tseu Shao Yoong (周社夢)
to summon the 3rd accused to the premises of the Dong
Nyi Association ( 同義会 ) which was then located on the
Range Road.
Tseu Shao Yoong met the 3rd accused in the Moon
Palace, North Szechuen Road, and took him to the premises
of the Association, where they met the 1st accused and
