176/35 D.R.
22/√

他失业期间，曾在法外滩太古轮船公司仓库管理员的宿舍居住了一两个月。
当时第一被告负责1号仓库。第三被告在其第一份书面供词中还陈述称，他是通过第一被告的关系才得以住在仓库宿舍的。
回到第三被告现已编号为3的进一步书面供词，第三被告在洪顺互助会解散后去了青岛，并在一段时间后返回上海，当时由一名叫李能的人介绍他加入了同义会。当时第一被告同时兼任同义会和同仁会的主席，这两个组织是由前洪顺互助会成员组建的。
第三被告继续陈述，在1935年10月初某日晚上约8点，第一被告命令一名叫周社梦（音译）的人传唤第三被告到当时位于Range Road（音译）的同义会会所。
周社梦在北四川路月宫旅馆遇见第三被告，并将他带到协会会所，他们在那里见到了第一被告和

pages.en:
CRIME REGISTER No. 1 - 176/35
Diary Number :- 22/3

two male Koreans -- one of the Koreans being known to
him as "Jack."

The 1st accused informed the 3rd accused that the
Koreans had been admitted as members to the Dong Nyi
Association, but their names would not appear in the
members' register - this being to avoid Police suspicion.

The 3rd accused states at this meeting which
consisted of himself, 1st accused, Tseu Shao Yoong and
two Koreans one called "Jack," one Korean whom he refers
to as the big Korean, stated that he hated the Japanese
and if an opportunity arose they would kill two Japanese
officials.

The 1st accused advised that this matter be discussed
later.

At about 9 p.m. on a day at the end of October, 1935,
by Tseu Shao Yoong he was again taken to premises of the
Dong Nyi Association where the 1st accused and the two
Koreans were holding a conversation.

The 1st accused ordered Tseu Shao Yoong to close the
main door. The 1st accused then spoke saying that the two
Koreans intended to assassinate Japanese official(s), and
asked the 3rd accused and Tseu Shao Yoong if they agreed,
they acquiesced. The big Korean stating he would be
responsible for the pistol etc. and would choose a suitable
place for the act. Before this meeting came to an end it
was arranged that the five should meet in the premises of
the association in the afternoon of the 2/11/35. The 3rd
accused states at 3 p.m. on this date, the five of them met
at the same place and proceeded to North Szechuen Road, and
Barroch Road towards Hongkew Park, when they took notice of
pages.zh:
罪案登记簿第1号 - 176/35
日志编号：- 22/3

两名朝鲜男子——其中一名朝鲜人被他称为“杰克”。

第一被告告知第三被告，这两名朝鲜人已被接纳为东义协会（Dong Nyi Association）会员，但他们的名字不会出现在会员名册中——此举旨在避免引起警方怀疑。

第三被告称，在这次会议上，与会者包括他自己、第一被告、周少荣（Tseu Shao Yoong，音译）以及两名朝鲜人，其中一人叫“杰克”，另一名朝鲜人他称之为“大个子朝鲜人”。该“大个子朝鲜人”表示他憎恨日本人，如果有机会，他们将杀害两名日本官员。

第一被告建议此事稍后再议。

在1935年10月底的某一天晚上约9点，周少荣再次将他带到东义协会的处所，当时第一被告和那两名朝鲜人正在交谈。

第一被告命令周少荣关上大门。随后第一被告发言称，这两名朝鲜人意图刺杀日本官员，并询问第三被告和周少荣是否同意，他们默许了。“大个子朝鲜人”表示他将负责手枪等事宜，并会选择适当的地点实施行动。在此次会议结束前，五人约定于1935年11月2日下午在协会会址见面。第三被告称，当天下午3点，他们五人在同一地点会面，随后前往北四川路（North Szechuen Road）和达罗克路（Barroch Road，现多译为达尔文路或类似，此处依原文音译保留或按当时习惯，注：Darroch Road即今溧阳路附近，旧译达罗克路），朝虹口公园方向走去，期间他们留意了

pages.en:
176/35.
22/4

the roads leading off North Szechuen Road and Darroch Road.
At 12.45 a.m. on the 3/5/36, the 3rd accused was
taken to North Szechuen Road, and in the presence of Mr.
Uyehara, A.C.P., D.S.I.s Crowther, Ross, Nakamura, Shih
Sau Chien, Van Tuh Foo, D.S. Bradley, he commenced to
walk from opposite the Foo Ming Hospital Northwards to
Darroch Road, stating prior to reaching Darroch Road the
1st accused and Jack (Korean) passed him and walked ahead
by 5 or 6 paces, also at same spot he observed a Japanese
marine walking West on the South side in Darroch Road.
From this spot the 3rd accused walked West on Darroch Road
near the centre of the road, stating he walked in the same
manner as the night of the crime. At East Wang Pang Road
and Darroch Road corner he turned North still on Darroch
Road until he came opposite a cigarette shop, which is
situated at the corner of Darroch Road and Darroch Terrace,
frontage in Darroch Terrace. Here he stopped stating as
on the night of the murder it was the position from where
he fled, and where he was when he saw the 1st accused take
the pistol from the book and aimed at the Japanese marine.
He described the 1st accused's position as about 10 to 15
paces in front of him on the West side of the roadway with
Jack the Korean a little to the left of the 1st accused.
From this spot the 3rd accused, re-enacted his
movements after hearing the explosion of the pistol and
seeing the marine staggering. He double back on the run on
the East side of Darroch Road for about 25 yards, when he
fell into a fast walking pace, along Darroch Road to North
Szechuen Road, proceeded North on North Szechuen Road to
Dixwell Road into which road he turned East.
pages.zh:
176/35.
22/4

从北四川路和达罗克路分岔出去的道路。
1936年5月3日凌晨12点45分，第三被告被带至北四川路，在上原先生（Mr. Uyehara，代理副督察）、刑事侦缉督察克劳瑟（Crowther）、罗斯（Ross）、中村（Nakamura）、施绍坚（Shih Sau Chien，音译）、范图福（Van Tuh Foo，音译）、侦探布拉德利（Bradley）在场的情况下，他开始从福明医院（Foo Ming Hospital，音译）对面由南向北行走至达罗克路，并称在到达达罗克路之前，第一被告和杰克（朝鲜人）从他身边经过，走在前面约5或6步远；同时在该地点，他观察到一名日本海军陆战队员在达罗克路南侧由东向西行走。从该地点起，第三被告在达罗克路靠近路中心的位置向西行走，并称其行走方式与案发当晚相同。在东旺邦路（East Wang Pang Road，音译，即今东长治路附近或相关路段，依原文音译）与达罗克路的拐角处，他转向北，仍沿达罗克路前行，直到来到一家香烟店对面，该店位于达罗克路与达罗克台（Darroch Terrace，音译）的拐角处，门面朝向达罗克台。他在此停下，并称正如谋杀案当晚一样，这里是他逃跑时的位置，也是他看到第一被告从书中取出手枪并瞄准日本海军陆战队员时他所处的位置。他描述第一被告的位置在他前方约10到15步处的道路西侧，而朝鲜人杰克则位于第一被告左侧稍偏的地方。从该地点起，第三被告重演了他在听到枪声爆炸并看到那名陆战队员踉跄后的行动。他在达罗克路东侧往回跑了约25码，随后改为快步走，沿达罗克路走到北四川路，再沿北四川路向北行至狄思威路（Dixwell Road，即今溧阳路），然后向东转入该路。

pages.en:
Diary No. 22/5

Asked why he took this route which necessitated
him passing Dixwell Road Police Station he stated, that
by passing the Police Station and if seen he would not
be suspected of anything.

At 10 p.m. on the 4/5/36 the 3rd accused was
again taken to Darroch Road when the witness Woo Ziang
Woo was present who stood in the same position as
he did on the night of the 9/11/35 that is 168 feet
South of the scene of crime, on the West side of
Darroch Road.

The 3rd accused again demonstrated his actions
as on the night of 9/11/35, this time however before
he ran from the position where he maintains he stood
after hearing the explosion of the pistol, he ran three
or four paces forward towards the mouth of the Fong Loh
Li (豐樂里). To make it more realistic a small Chinese
cracker which explodes when it strikes the ground,
and gives a similar report to a .32 pistol, was thrown
at the juncture the 3rd accused had reached the spot
from where he fled, immediately the explosion occurred
he ran three or four paces forward in the direction of
the Foh Loh Li, and stopped suddenly.

The witness Woo Ziang Woo stated at the scene that
the dress of the 3rd accused was similar to the person
he saw running into the Fong Loh Li, immediately after
pages.zh:
日志编号 22/5

当被问及为何选择这条必须经过狄思威路警察局的路线时，他称，经过警察局时如果被看到，反而不会引起任何嫌疑。

1936年5月4日晚上10点，第三被告再次被带至达罗克路，证人吴祥武（Woo Ziang Woo，音译）在场，其所站位置与1935年11月9日当晚相同，即位于犯罪现场以南168英尺处，达罗克路西侧。

第三被告再次演示了1935年11月9日当晚的行动，但这一次，在他从声称听到枪声爆炸后所站立的位置跑开之前，他先向丰乐里（Fong Loh Li）弄口方向向前跑了三四步。为了使演示更加逼真，在第三被告到达他逃跑的起点位置时，投掷了一枚落地即爆的小型中国爆竹，其声响与.32口径手枪相似；爆炸声一响，他立即向丰乐里方向向前跑了三四步，然后突然停下。

证人吴祥武在现场表示，第三被告的衣着与他在1935年11月9日晚上约9点听到爆炸声后立即看到跑进丰乐里的那个人相似。

pages.en:
22/6

he heard an explosion at about 9 p.m. on the 9/11/35.
The height of the person who he observed running away
on the 9/11/35 he stated was a little less than the
height of the 3rd accused and the waist of the person
was a little larger.
Woo Ziang Woo still maintains that he did not see
any person running South on Darroch Road, in the way
the 3rd accused maintains he did.
Woo Ziang Woo's position on the night of the
murder covered the retreat of any person running from
the scene.
On the night of the 4/5/36, those present were Lieut.
Commander Ohsugi, Mr. Uyehara, A.C.P., D.S.I.s Crowther,
Ross, Shih Sau Chien, Van Tah Foo, and C.D.C.119.
The 1st accused from 1914 until the 31st March 1934
was an employee of the Godown Department of the China
Navigation Company, Ltd.
From January 11th 1930 until his service were terminated
he was in charge of No.1A Godown. Enquiries by
D.S.I.s Crowther and Ross ascertained that the 1st
accused up till 1925 played a very small part in the
activities of the employees in the China Navigation Co.
and wharf coolies, but from 1925 until the time his
services were terminated he played a leading part and
had many followers, he and his followers being members.
pages.zh:
22/6

关于他在1935年11月9日观察到的逃跑者的身高，他称略低于第三被告的身高，而该人的腰围略大于第三被告。
吴祥武仍坚持称，他没有看到任何人像第三被告声称的那样沿达罗克路向南奔跑。
吴祥武在谋杀案当晚所处的位置，足以覆盖任何人从现场逃跑的撤退路线。
1936年5月4日晚，在场人员有大尉大杉（Lieut. Commander Ohsugi，音译）、上原先生（Mr. Uyehara，代理副督察）、刑事侦缉督察克劳瑟（Crowther）、罗斯（Ross）、施绍坚（Shih Sau Chien，音译）、范塔福（Van Tah Foo，音译）以及C.D.C.119（注：可能指某位警员代号或部门代码）。
第一被告自1914年至1934年3月31日受雇于英商中国轮船公司（China Navigation Company, Ltd.）的仓库部。
自1930年1月11日起至其服务终止止，他负责管理1A号仓库。经刑事侦缉督察克劳瑟和罗斯调查查明，第一被告在1925年之前在中国轮船公司职员及码头苦力的活动中扮演的角色微乎其微，但从1925年直至其服务终止，他扮演了领导角色，拥有许多追随者，他和他的追随者均为一个名为“翁帮”（Ong Paung，音译）的社团成员。

pages.en:
Diary Number : 22/7.

of a society called the Ong Paung which society was
always at loggerheads with a society called the "Ching
Paung."

Although the 1st accused never gave his employers
a chance to dismiss him, his work along with his
activities with the Ong Paung were not of a satisfactory
nature.

The 1st accused requested 3 months' leave on the
31st March which was granted and he immediately proceed-
ed to Canton, he failed to return at the end of his
leave, requesting extension of leave, with this
opportunity his services were terminated with a small
gratuity.

At 4 p.m. on the 3/5/36 D.S.I. Ross and Van Tuh
Foo served summons No. 6290 issued by the S.S.D.Court
on the 2/5/36 on Yih Ah Dao( 葉阿桃), coolie employed
in the Dong Dzung Association, No. 31/56 Urga Road.

Questioned by the officers serving the summons
Yih Ah Dao stated that the 1st accused visited the
club shortly after 2 p.m. daily and never left before
11 p.m.

The 3rd accused has denied ever visiting the Dong
Dzung Association but the witness Yih Ah Dao, summoned
by the lawyers for the defence, told D.S.I. Ross and
pages.zh:
日志编号：22/7.

该“翁帮”社团始终与另一个名为“青帮”（Ching Paung，音译）的社团不和。

虽然第一被告从未给雇主解雇他的机会，但他与其在“翁帮”的活动相结合的工作表现并不令人满意。

第一被告于3月31日申请三个月假期并获批准，他随即前往广州。假期结束时他未返回，而是申请延长假期。借此机会，公司终止了他的服务，并发放了一笔小额遣散费。

1936年5月3日下午4点，刑事侦缉督察罗斯和范图福向叶阿桃（Yih Ah Dao，音译，括号内原文注：葉阿桃）送达了特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court）于1936年5月2日签发的第6290号传票。叶阿桃是乌尔古路（Urga Road，即今长春路）31号56室东众协会（Dong Dzung Association，音译）雇佣的苦力。

在接受送达传票的警官问询时，叶阿桃称，第一被告每天下午2点后不久便来到该会所，且在晚上11点前从未离开。

第三被告否认曾去过东众协会，但辩方律师传唤的证人叶阿桃告诉刑事侦缉督察罗斯和

pages.en:
22/8

Van Tuh Foo that the 3rd accused has visited the
association on numerous occasions in company with the
1st accused.
The 1st accused has been questioned daily during
the remand but no material point has been forthcoming -
he maintained that he must have been at the Dong Dzung
Association, Lane 31, House No.56 Urga Road on the
night of the 9/11/35.
Every effort is being made to locate Tseu Shao
Yoong, and the big Korean, the latter in cooperation
with the Japanese Consular Police.
Two threatening letters have been received by
Tseng Yuen since giving testimony in the S.S.D. Court.
One has been received by Dr. Zung Wei Ming (陸修民),
informant. These will be shown to the Court on the
6/5/36 and then submitted for comparison of handwriting.
At the request of Mr. Bryan, Municipal Advocate,
the following has been compiled in English and Chinese
for the S.S.D. Court file.
(1) A long statement from D.S.I. Crowther in
English and Chinese containing a complete statement of
his investigations, from beginning xf to end; finding of
body; movements of deceased, and all facts inquired into.
(Investigation not completed).
(2) Statement in English and Chinese by Dickson,
relative to examination of pistol for finger prints and
pages.zh:
22/8

范图福，第三被告曾多次在第一被告的陪同下访问该协会。
第一被告在还押期间每天都接受讯问，但未获得任何实质性要点——他坚持称，1935年11月9日晚他一定是在乌尔古路31弄56号的东众协会。
目前正在全力寻找周少荣（Tseu Shao Yoong，音译）和那名“大个子朝鲜人”，后者正通过与日本领事馆警察合作进行查找。
曾元（Tseng Yuen，音译）自在地方法院作证以来，已收到两封恐吓信。
举报人陆修民博士（Dr. Zung Wei Ming，括号内原文注：陸修民，但下文注为鄭偉民，此处依原文括号内容翻译，需注意前后不一致，此处按p44原文括号译作陆修民，但结合p45/p46应为郑伟民，译者注：原文此处括号写的是陆修民，下文写的是郑伟民，照实翻译）也收到了一封。这些信件将于1936年5月6日向法庭出示，随后提交进行笔迹比对。
应市政检察官布莱恩先生（Mr. Bryan）的要求，以下材料已编译成中英文版本，存入特区地方法院档案。
(1) 刑事侦缉督察克劳瑟的一份长篇中英文陈述，包含其从头至尾的完整调查过程；发现尸体；死者的行动轨迹，以及所有已调查的事实。（调查尚未完成）。
(2) 迪克森（Dickson，音译）出具的中英文陈述，涉及对手枪进行指纹检验以及

pages.en:
CRIME REGISTER No:---176/35 D.R.  "C" Division.
Dixwell Road Police Station.
6th May 1936.
Diary Number:-23/1. Nature of Offence:-1.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Tsang Sun, accompanied by ex-Detective Sub-Inspector
Tang Sz, called at Police Headquarters at 3.30 p.m. May
5, and stated that he wished to make a voluntary state-
ment to the Police to assist in the investigation of
the case against Yih Hai Sung and Yang Wen Dao, who
have been charged with the murder of the Japanese sailor
Nakayama. Prior to commencing his statement, which he
claimed would show that Yih and Yang have been falsely
accused and that a certain Dr. Zung Wei Ming (鄭偉民)
is behind the whole plot to implicate the accused in
order to obtain the reward offered by the Police, he
emphasized that he did not wish to be either seen or
interviewed by any Japanese.

While at Police Headquarters, Tsang Sun received
a telephone call from Geo. R. Groves (葛肇基) attor-
ney-at-Law, who is defending one of the accused. As
they talked in the Cantonese dialect it was impossible
to follow the nature of the conversation.

Tsang Sun concluded by saying that it was his
intention to appear in the Court on May 6 when the case
against Yih Hai Sung and Yang Wen Dao will be heard.
Tsang left with the Police a set of brief notes used
by him to refresh his memory when making his statement.

The following is a translation of the statement
made by Tsang Sun (張琛) taken by D.S.I. Moore and
pages.zh:
罪案登记簿编号：---176/35 日志编号 “C”分区。
狄思威路警察局。
1936年5月6日。
日志编号：-23/1. 罪行性质：-1.
调查记录。

曾森（Tsang Sun，音译，下文注为張琛）在前探目唐司（Tang Sz，音译）的陪同下，于5月5日下午3点30分来到警察总局，并表示他希望向警方自愿作出陈述，以协助调查针对叶海生（Yih Hai Sung）和杨文道（Yang Wen Dao）的案件，此二人被控谋杀日本水兵中山（Nakayama）。在开始陈述之前，他声称该陈述将显示叶、杨二人是被诬告的，且某位郑伟民博士（Dr. Zung Wei Ming，括号内原文注：鄭偉民）是幕后策划整个阴谋以牵连被告从而获取警方悬赏的人，他强调他不希望被任何日本人看见或接受其问询。

在警察总局期间，曾森接到了律师乔治·R·格罗夫斯（Geo. R. Groves，括号内原文注：葛肇基）的电话，格罗夫斯是其中一名被告的辩护律师。由于他们使用粤语方言交谈，无法得知谈话的具体性质。

曾森最后表示，他打算在5月6日出庭，届时将审理针对叶海生和杨文道的案件。
曾森留给警方一套简要笔记，供他在作出陈述时刷新记忆之用。

以下是由刑事侦缉督察穆尔（Moore，音译）记录的曾森（张琛）所作陈述的译文，并由

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/2
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
interpreted by Clerk Chiang Ching Yoong:-
I am an ex-jockey and in 1929 used to ride at
Kiangwan and Ying Ziang Hsiang. During 1934 I was
attached to the staff of the Transport Office of the
Anti-Communist Army at Tsangchow, Fokien Province.
At present I am a dealer in tea and fans and reside
at No.8 Yih Zou Li (益寿里), Chuen Kung Road, Chapei.
I am acquainted with Yih Hai Sung (葉海生) and
I know that Dr. Zung Wei Ming (鄭偉民) instigated the
false accusation against Yih Hai Sung and Yang Wen Dao
(楊文道). I am only an acquaintance of Dr. Zung's
and during the course of conversations I gathered that
Zung is about 40 years of age, a native of Shang San
(香山), Kwantung Province. Born and bred in Japan,
where he studied medicine. After graduating at medical
school in Japan he went to Hongkong where he practised
medicine for five years. In consequence of certain ill-
egal practices he left Hongkong and came to Shanghai
about ten years ago. He usually resides at 693 Hoong Oen
Li (鴻安里), Haining Road. During my conversations with
Dr. Zung the subject of the murder of the Japanese
sailor on Darroch Road was not discussed. I came to
know Dr. Zung's plot as I had resided in Tsung Yuan
Cha's house for a period of three months. Dr. Zung
during this time was a frequent visitor and in company
pages.zh:
日志编号：- 23/2
调查记录。
书记员蒋景荣（Chiang Ching Yoong，音译）翻译：-
我是一名前骑师，1929年曾在江湾和引翔港（Ying Ziang Hsiang，音译）赛马场策马。1934年期间，我隶属于福建省漳州反共军运输处的工作人员。
目前我从事茶叶和扇子生意，居住在闸北川公路（Chuen Kung Road，音译，即今川公路）益寿里（Yih Zou Li，音译，括号内原文注：益寿里）8号。
我认识叶海生（Yih Hai Sung），我知道是郑伟民博士（Dr. Zung Wei Ming，括号内原文注：鄭偉民）唆使了对叶海生和杨文道（Yang Wen Dao）的诬告。我只是郑博士的熟人，在交谈过程中我了解到郑约40岁，广东香山（Shang San，即中山）人。他在日本出生长大，并在那里学医。在日本医学院毕业后，他去了香港，在那里行医五年。由于某些非法行为，他离开香港，约十年前来到上海。他通常居住在海宁路鸿安里（Hoong Oen Li，音译，括号内原文注：鴻安里）693号。在与郑博士的交谈中，并未讨论达罗克路日本水兵被杀一案。我之所以得知郑博士的阴谋，是因为我曾在宗元查（Tsung Yuan Cha，音译）家中居住了三个月。在此期间，郑博士经常来访，并与

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/3.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
with Tsung indulged in opium smoking in the loft.
During one of their opium smoking sessions I had
occasion to go up into the loft and saw them lying
on the floor; Dr. Zung was engaged in sketching on a
piece of paper. After Dr. Zung had left the house
I again went up into the loft and saw the same piece
of paper lying beside the opium tray. I scrutinized
the paper and saw that it had a drawing of a pistol,
with the initials P.E. marked on the butt.
On the last day of the last Chinese lunar
year, Tsung Yuan Cha asked me to accompany him to the
home of Dr. Zung to receive certain amounts of money.
As Dr. Zung was not there, Tsung Yuan Cha became very
much infuriated and told me that he would employ some
persons to assault him. When questioned as to why
he would do so, Tsung Yuan Cha told me that some time
ago he and Dr. Zung went to the residence of a Japanese
naval officer on Scott Road for the purpose of iden-
tifying a pistol used in the shooting of the Japanese
marine. He also told me that he had identified the
pistol from amongst several others and that Dr. Zung
had promised to pay him several hundred dollars for
this service. On the night of the same day (about
11 p.m.) Dr. Zung called at Tsung's residence and told
him that he had no money for the time being, but that
he would pay him in the following year. About the
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/3。
调查记录。
宗（Tsung）在阁楼里吸食鸦片。
在他们的一次吸食鸦片过程中，我
有机会走上阁楼，看见他们躺在
地板上；钟医生（Dr. Zung）正忙着在
一张纸上素描。钟医生离开这所房子后，
我再次走上阁楼，看见同一张纸
放在鸦片盘旁边。我仔细检查了
那张纸，看见上面画着一把手枪，
枪柄上标有 P.E. 的首字母。
在上一个中国农历年的最后一天，
宗元查（Tsung Yuan Cha）请我陪他去
钟医生家收取一定数额的钱款。
由于钟医生不在，宗元查变得非常
愤怒，并告诉我他将雇用一些人
去殴打他。当被问及为何要这样做时，
宗元查告诉我，前一段时间他和
钟医生曾去斯科特路（Scott Road）一名日本
海军军官的住所，目的是辨认
用于射击日本水兵的手枪。他还
告诉我，他从几支手枪中认出了
那支手枪，而钟医生曾承诺为此
服务支付给他几百美元。当天晚上
（约晚上11点），钟医生来到宗的
住所，告诉他目前没钱，但会在
来年支付给他。关于

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/4.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
3rd day of the first month of the New Year Dr. Zung
called at Tsung's home for the purpose of smoking
opium and was told by Tsung that the case was a
secret no longer as he had already informed me. Two
days later a letter was received by me from my brother
in Szechuen. Dr. Zung saw the letter and he told me
that there were somewhat similar envelopes in the
Japanese Naval Headquarters and asked me for the
envelope, for the purpose of comparison. I gave him
the envelope and on the following day Dr. Zung called
on me and informed me that I could earn four thousand
dollars if I would carry out certain work. I asked him
what work he wished me to carry out. He instructed me
to report to the Japanese Naval Headquarters and make
the following statement:-
"I am a member of the Doong Nyi Zou Club(同義會).
A few days ago I went there to gamble. There was no
gambling to be had. I saw Yih Hai Sung sitting in the
club, Sometime later a Korean named "Jack" came into
the club and took from his pocket a pistol which he
gave to Yih Hai Sung - but Yih Hai Sung said "You
need not give it to me but give it to Bao Chu (鮑琚).
The Korean and Yih Hai Sung then left the club, and as
there was no gambling taking place, I also left the club
intending to go to Waung Pang Jao Bridge (橫浜橋) to
purchase some medicine for a toothache. On my way
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/4。
调查记录。
新年第一个月的第3天，钟医生
来到宗家吸食鸦片，宗告诉他，
此事已不再是秘密，因为他已经
告诉了我。两天后，我收到了我在
四川的兄弟寄来的一封信。钟医生
看见了这封信，他告诉我，日本
海军司令部里有一些 somewhat similar（ somewhat similar，原文如此，意为“有些相似”）的信封，
并向我要那个信封，以便进行
比较。我把信封给了他，第二天
钟医生来找我，通知我，如果我
愿意执行某些工作，我可以赚取
四千美元。我问他希望我执行什么
工作。他指示我向日本海军司令部
报到，并作如下陈述：-
“我是同义会（Doong Nyi Zou Club）的成员。
几天前我去那里赌博。那里没有
赌局。我看见易海松（Yih Hai Sung）坐在
俱乐部里。过了一会儿，一个叫
‘杰克’（Jack）的朝鲜人走进俱乐部，
从口袋里掏出一把手枪递给
易海松——但易海松说：‘你
不必给我，把它交给鲍琚（Bao Chu）。’
随后朝鲜人和易海松离开了俱乐部，
由于没有赌博活动，我也离开了俱乐部，
打算去横浜桥（Waung Pang Jao Bridge）
买些治牙痛的药。在我去的路上

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/5.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
to Waung Pang Jao Bridge, I met Yih Hai Sung, the
Korean "Jack" and another Chinese unknown to me near
Dah Tuh Li (大德里) on North Szechuen Road. I
saw the Korean take something from his pocket and
give it to the unknown Chinese. Later I went to
a certain dispensary and bought the medicine after
which I returned home."
As I did not know the Korean or the unknown
Chinese, I refused to go to the Japanese Naval
Headquarters and make this statement. Dr. Zung then
told me that the Korean had already been arrested
by the Japanese authorities and was being detained at
the Japanese Consulate, and if I was willing to go
with him to the Japanese Consulate where he knew
several Japanese officers, he would arrange for me to
see the Korean from another room, so that when the
trial took place I could identify him. I then informed
Dr. Zung that I would consider the matter for a few
days. Two days later Dr. Zung came to my home and
asked me for my decision on the matter. I asked him
to take me to the Japanese Consulate. On our way to
the Japanese Consulate we stopped at a Japanese teashop
named Poh Chiao (芭蕉 ) on Boone Road and went
inside. Whilst having some refreshment Dr. Zung called
a waitress and handed her a name card and asked her to
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/5。
调查记录。
去横浜桥的路上，我在北四川路
的大德里（Dah Tuh Li）附近遇到了
易海松、朝鲜人‘杰克’和另一个
我不认识的中国人。我看见那个
朝鲜人从口袋里掏出某样东西
递给那个不认识的中国人。后来我去了
一家药房，买了药之后
便回家了。”
由于我不认识那个朝鲜人或那个
不认识的中国人，我拒绝去日本
海军司令部作此陈述。于是钟医生
告诉我，那个朝鲜人已经被日本
当局逮捕，并被拘留在日本领事馆，
如果我愿意跟他去日本领事馆，
他认识几位日本官员，他可以安排
我从另一个房间见那个朝鲜人，
以便在审判发生时我能指认他。
于是我通知钟医生，我会考虑
几天。两天后，钟医生来到我家，
询问我对这件事的决定。我请他
带我去日本领事馆。在去日本
领事馆的路上，我们在布恩路
（Boone Road）一家名为芭蕉（Poh Chiao）
的日本茶室停下并走了进去。在
吃点心的时候，钟医生叫来一名
女服务员，递给她一张名片，并请她

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/6.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
send a telephone message for him. When the waitress
had left Dr. Zung told me thathe had asked her to
phone for a Japanese detectives attached to the Hongkew
Station named Dien Tsong (田中 ) and that when
the detective came I was to give him t.e report which
I was to have made to the Japanese Naval Headquarters.
I objected to do this as I had not yet agreed on any
terms. As I had refused, Dr. Zung asked me to leave,
which I did. I returned to the Tsung's home and asked
Tsung to inform Dr. Zung that I did not want anything to
do with the matter. Later on in the day Dr. Zung came
to the Tsung's home and Tsung told him that I did not
wish to have anything to do in the matter. I then
asked Dr. Zung to return the envelope which I had
previously given to him, which he did. Two days later
Dr. Zung asked Tsung to find another person to do the
work. Two days later Tsung found a man named Tsang
Zai Yuan (張財源) and asked him if he would carry cut
the job for which he would receive the third part of
several thousand dollars. Tsang Zai Yuan agreed, and
Tsung Yuan Cha told him to make the same report to the
Japanese Naval Headquarters as Dr. Zung had asked me,
and in addition to state that he was employed as over-
seer in the Nan Yang Dance Hall (南洋 ), San Tu Li,
North Szechuen Road, and that on November 9, 1935 when
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/6。
调查记录。
为他打一个电话。女服务员离开后，
钟医生告诉我，他让她打电话给
隶属于虹口站的一名日本侦探田中
（Dien Tsong），并且当侦探到来时，
我要把原本准备向日本海军司令部
提交的报告交给他。我反对这样做，
因为我尚未就任何条款达成一致。
由于我拒绝了，钟医生让我离开，
我便照做了。我回到宗家，请宗
通知钟医生，我不想与此事有任何
牵连。当天晚些时候，钟医生来到
宗家，宗告诉他我不想参与此事。
随后我请钟医生归还我之前给他的
信封，他也照办了。两天后，钟医生
请宗另找一人来做这项工作。又过了
两天，宗找到一个名叫张财源
（Tsang Zai Yuan）的人，问他是否愿意
执行这项任务，为此他将获得几千
美元的三分之一。张财源同意了，
宗元查让他向日本海军司令部作
与钟医生要求我作的相同的报告，
此外还要声明他受雇为北四川路
三德里南洋舞厅（Nan Yang Dance Hall）的
监工，并且在1935年11月9日，当

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/7.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
the hall was opened he was told to secure some dancing
partners living in the Yue Ching Fong (餘慶坊) North
Szechuen Road, and that while engaged in this mission,
he saw Yih Hai Sung, the Korean named "Jack" and an
unknown Chinese on Darroch Road. Some few days later
Dr. Zung took Tsang Zai Yuan from Tsung's home to
meet the Japanese detective Dien Tsong. When Tsang Zai
Yuan returned to the Tsung's home he told me that he
had met the Japanese detective, but did not divulge where
they had met and what they had talked about. From then
on Dr. Zung, Tsang Zai Yuan and Tsung Yuan Cha often
met at Tsung's home where the two latter asked Dr.
Zung for money as a reward for their services. Dr.
Zung told Tsung Yuan Cha that he had no money but
advised Tsung to make a supposed wound on his breast so
that he could take him to the Japanese detective and
claim that he was attacked and injured because he had
carried out his work. This Tsung did, but the Japanese
detective offered to send him to the Fu Ming Hospital
for treatment. Tsung Yuan Cha informed him that he had
already been treated by a Chinese doctor and required
money to pay for his bill there. The Japanese detective
did not give Tsung Yuan Cha any money until one day he
and his wife went to Hongkew Station when they were
given $10.
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/7。
调查记录。
舞厅开业时，他被告知要去寻找
住在北四川路余庆坊（Yue Ching Fong）的
一些舞伴，而在执行这项任务期间，
他在达罗克路（Darroch Road）看见了
易海松、名叫‘杰克’的朝鲜人和
一个不知名的中国人。几天后，钟医生
将张财源从宗家带走，去见日本
侦探田中。当张财源回到宗家时，
他告诉我他见到了那名日本侦探，
但没有透露他们在哪里见面以及
谈了什么。从那以后，钟医生、张财源
和宗元查经常在宗家会面，后两人
向钟医生索要酬金作为服务的报酬。
钟医生告诉宗元查他没有钱，但
建议宗在胸部制造一处假伤口，
这样他就可以带宗去见日本侦探，
声称宗因执行工作而遭到袭击并
受伤。宗照做了，但日本侦探提出
送他去福民医院（Fu Ming Hospital）治疗。
宗元查告诉他，他已经由一位中医
诊治，需要钱支付那里的账单。
日本侦探一直没有给宗元查钱，
直到有一天，他和妻子去虹口站时，
得到了10美元。

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/3.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
At this time Tsung Yuan Cha told the Japanese
detective that one night when he and his dancing
partner were in the Moon Palace Dance Hall they saw
a number of people fighting inside the Moon Palace Dance
Hall and that among those fighting was the Korean named
"Jack". Tsung later called on the Japanese detective
at Hongkew Station when he was given a further sum of
$25 and asked to give it to hisdancing partner who was
to state that she saw the Korean "Jack" on the night of
the fighting inside the Moon Palace Dance Hall. Tsung
again called on the Japanese detective at Hongkew
Police Station when he was given $30 and told to bring
the dancing partner and meet him in a Japanese restaurant
near Haining and Woosung Road. Tsung procured a Chinese
prostitute named "Mabel" who resided at No.5 Chung Wei Li
Wuchang Road, as there was really no dancing partner in
the case, and told her to say that she with him had
witnessed the fighting inside the Moon Palace on the night
in question. Tsung Yuan Cha, his wife and sister, Kaung
Seu San (康秀山) a friend of Tsung's "Mabel" and myself
then went and met the Japanese detective in the Japanese
restaurant where we had food. After the meal, Tsung
Yuan Cha, the Japanese detective and "Mabel" removed to
another table to talk privately. I do not know what they
talked about. Some few days later Tsung Yuan Cha was
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/3。
调查记录。
这时，宗元查告诉日本侦探，
一天晚上，当他和他的舞伴在
月宫舞厅（Moon Palace Dance Hall）时，
他们看见里面有多人打架，其中
打架者包括名叫‘杰克’的朝鲜人。
后来宗去虹口站拜访日本侦探，
又得到了25美元，并被要求将钱
交给他的舞伴，让她声明在月宫
舞厅打架当晚看见了朝鲜人‘杰克’。
宗再次去虹口警察局拜访日本侦探，
得到了30美元，并被要求带上舞伴，
在海宁路和吴淞路附近的一家日本
餐馆与他见面。宗找来一名住在
武昌路众维里5号、名叫‘梅布尔’
（Mabel）的中国妓女，因为案中其实
并没有舞伴，并让她说在那晚
和他一起目睹了月宫内的打架事件。
随后，宗元查、他的妻子和妹妹、
宗的朋友康秀山（Kaung Seu San）、‘梅布尔’
和我一起去那家日本餐馆与日本
侦探见面，我们在那里吃了饭。
饭后，宗元查、日本侦探和‘梅布尔’
换到另一张桌子私下交谈。我不
知道他们谈了什么。几天后，宗元查被

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/9
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
told to remove as his rent was in arrears so he went
to see the Japanese detective on March 14, who gave
him $100. On receiving this money Tsung, his wife
and myself went to a furniture shop on Peking Road to
purchase furniture which cost $60. On the following
day Tsung removed to House 6 Fong Loh Li, Dixwell Road,
and I returned to No.8 Chuen Kung Road, Chapei. Some
days later Tsung read in the newspaper that a person
named Loo Zoong Sin (盧從信) had been stabbed. This
person was a friend of Tsung's so he sent Kaung Seu San
to call Loo to Tsung's home. Tsung told Loo to
inform the Japanese detective that one Zung Voong Pih,
Principal of the Kwangtung Middle School, had been
concerned in the murder of the Japanese marine and that
he had been stabbed by some persons engaged by Zung Voong
Pih, as Zung Voong Pih feared that his connection with
the murder would be disclosed, as he had a clerk named
Lieu Ching Hai (劉勁海) who often wrote letters in
connection with the murder. As Zung Voong Pih knew that
her clerk had disclosed her connection with the murder
she rent for Yih Hai Sung to kill Lieu Ching Hai, but
before Yih could carry this out, Lieu died in a ricsha
on Nanking Road.
Tsung went to see the Japanese detective and told
him that Loo knew the whole story of the murder of the
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/9
调查记录。
告知搬走，因为他的房租拖欠，
所以他于3月14日去见日本侦探，
后者给了他100美元。收到这笔钱后，
宗、他的妻子和我去了北京路的一家
家具店购买家具，花费了60美元。
第二天，宗搬到达克斯威尔路
（Dixwell Road）方乐里6号，而我
回到了闸北川公路8号。几天后，
宗在报纸上读到一名叫卢从信
（Loo Zoong Sin）的人被刺伤。此人
是宗的朋友，所以宗派康秀山去
叫卢到宗家。宗告诉卢去通知
日本侦探，广东中学校长钟永壁
（Zung Voong Pih，音译）参与了谋杀
日本水兵的案件，并且他被钟永壁
雇用的人刺伤，因为钟永壁担心
她与谋杀案的关联会被揭露，她
有一名职员叫刘劲海（Lieu Ching Hai），
经常书写与谋杀案有关的信件。
由于钟永壁知道她的职员已揭露
了她与谋杀案的关联，她雇佣
易海松去杀害刘劲海，但在易
执行之前，刘在南京路的一辆
人力车上死亡。
宗去见日本侦探，并告诉
他卢知道谋杀日本水兵的全部故事。

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/10.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Japanese marine. The Japanese detective asked Tsung
the address of Loo. Tsung told him that he was living in
Siccawei as he was afraid of living in the Hongkew
District and that he was very poor and sick and had to
smoke opium. The Japanese detective, through Tsung,
granted Loo, $10 per day for four days. Dr. Zung
learned of the grant by the Japanese detective and some
days later he and myself went to the Poh Chiao Tea Shop
where we met the Japanese detective. Dr. Zung spoke to
the detective in the Japanese language which I do not
understand. When we wereabout to leave the tea shop
the Japanese detective gave Dr. Zung $10, and asked
me if I knew the Shanghai dialect. I told him I did
and he then asked me to render him assistance. After
leaving the Japanese detective, Dr. Zung and myself
went to the Sin Ya Restaurant, North Szechuen- Jukong
Roads, where Dr. Zung gave me $3 for locomotion. Dr. Zung
then asked me to go to Tsung's home and to pay attention
to any conversation between Tsung and Loo. I felt dis-
satisfied with what Dr. Zung had done so in the afternoon
of the same day I went to see the Japanese detective
and asked him what Dr. Zung had to say about me. The
Japanese detective told me that Dr. Zung had informed
him that Dr. Zung was afraid that Loo Zoong Sin might
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/10。
调查记录。
日本侦探向宗询问卢的地址。宗
告诉他，卢住在徐家汇（Siccawei），
因为他害怕住在虹口区，而且卢
非常贫穷且生病，必须吸食鸦片。
日本侦探通过宗，向卢发放了
每天10美元，共四天。钟医生得知
了日本侦探的这笔拨款，几天后，
他和我也去了芭蕉茶室，在那里
我们见到了日本侦探。钟医生用
日语与侦探交谈，我听不懂。当
我们正要离开茶室时，日本侦探
给了钟医生10美元，并问我是否
懂上海话。我告诉他我懂，于是他
请我协助他。离开日本侦探后，
钟医生和我去了北四川路与朱恭路
（Jukong Roads，音译）交叉口的新雅
酒楼（Sin Ya Restaurant），在那里钟医生
给了我3美元作为交通费。随后钟医生
让我去宗家，留意宗和卢之间的
任何谈话。我对钟医生的所作所为
感到不满，因此在当天下午我去
见了日本侦探，问他钟医生关于
我说了什么。日本侦探告诉我，
钟医生向他通报说，钟医生担心
卢从信可能会

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/11.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
tell lies so he hoped that I would pay attention to
the conversation between Tsung and Loo. I told the
Japanese detective that I had something important to
tell through an interpreter who was living in the
Yangtszepoo District. The Japanese detective hired a
car for me from the Kung Dung Garage (工藤). The
interpreter who is a friend of mine named Ting, was
not at home as he had gone to House No.4 Jiu Ts Li, Dix-
well Road, so I proceeded in the car to this address,
where I found him. We went to Hongkew Police Station and
called on the Japanese detective, and all three went to
a Japanese bar on Ward Road where I told the Japanese
detective that what Dr. Zung told was untrue. I told
the Japanese detective the whole details of Dr. Zung's
workings. The Japanese detective then sent a telephone
message to Japanese Detective Sub-Inspector Tsong Chuen
of Dixwell Road Station asking him to come to the Japanese
bar. The Det. Sub-Inspector came and I told him the story
of the case after which he asked me to meet him at the
Yih Zo Teashop the following day. I met the Det. Sub-
Inspector in the tea shop on the following day and told
him that Tsung and Loo would soon come to see him and
report what they knew. The Japanese detective Sub-Inspector
made an appointment asking me to attend the bar on Ward
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/11。
调查记录。
说谎，所以他希望我注意宗（Tsung）和陆（Loo）之间的谈话。我告诉日本侦探，我有一些重要的事情要通过一位住在杨树浦区的翻译转达。日本侦探从工藤车库（Kung Dung Garage）为我租了一辆车。我的那位名叫丁（Ting）的翻译朋友不在家，因为他去了狄思威路（Dixwell Road）久子里4号，所以我乘车前往该地址，在那里找到了他。我们去了虹口警察局，拜访了那位日本侦探，随后三人一同前往华德路的一家日本酒吧，我在那里告诉日本侦探，郑博士（Dr. Zung）所说的话不属实。我向日本侦探详细讲述了郑博士的运作情况。随后，日本侦探向狄思威路警局的日本侦探副巡官钟泉（Tsong Chuen，音译）发送了一条电话留言，请他到这家日本酒吧来。这位侦探副巡官到来后，我向他讲述了案情，之后他约我第二天在益佐茶室（Yih Zo Teashop，音译）见面。第二天，我在茶室见到了这位侦探副巡官，并告诉他，宗和陆很快就会来见他，汇报他们所知道的情况。这位日本侦探副巡官又约我第二天去华德路的酒吧

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/12.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Road on the following day. I went there the following
morning but did not see the Japanese Detective Sub-
Inspector. On April 6 Tsung Yuan Cha, Dr. Zung and
Loo Zoong Sin went to the home of a Japanese officer
named Tshung Yah (沖野), who resided in Scott Road
where Japanese Det. Sub-Inspector Tsong Chuen and
Japanese Det, Dien Tsong were also present. After Loo
Zoong Sin had related his story, the Japanese Det.
Dien Tsong asked Dr. Zung to accompany him upstairs.
After 10 minutes conversation upstairs, the Japanese
Detective came down and informed Tsung Yuan Cha and
Loo Zoong Sin that their information was false as
Dr. Zung had told him so. Tsung Yuan Cha and Loo Zoong
Sin denied that their information was false, and they
were detained by the Japanese officer until 5.30 p.m.
when they were escorted by two Japanese to Tsung's home
to allow them to smoke opium. The Japanese kept a
watch at the entrance to the alleyway but Tsung and
Loo escaped from the house and went to a Chinese res-
taurant owned by a friend of Tsung's at Kiangwan/ The
Detective Dien Tsong visited the home of Tsung to see
Tsung Yuan Cha and Loo Zoong Sin but found that they
were not there. The Japanese detective left $10 with
Tsung's wife. The Japanese detective called again on
the following day when Tsung's wife informed him that
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/12。
调查记录。
见面。第二天早上我去了那里，但没有见到那位日本侦探副巡官。4月6日，宗元佳（Tsung Yuan Cha）、郑博士和陆宗信（Loo Zoong Sin）去了一位名叫冲野（Tshung Yah）的日本军官位于斯科特路（Scott Road）的住所，当时日本侦探副巡官钟泉（Tsong Chuen，音译）和日本侦探田中（Dien Tsong，音译）也在那里。在陆宗信讲述完他的故事后，日本侦探田中请郑博士随他上楼。在楼上交谈了10分钟后，日本侦探下楼通知宗元佳和陆宗信，他们的信息是虚假的，因为郑博士是这样告诉他的。宗元佳和陆宗信否认他们的信息是虚假的，他们被那位日本军官扣留至下午5点30分，随后由两名日本人护送至宗的家中，让他们吸食鸦片。日本人在巷口派人监视，但宗和陆从屋内逃脱，前往江湾一家由宗的朋友拥有的中餐馆。侦探田中前往宗的住所寻找宗元佳和陆宗信，但发现他们不在那里。日本侦探给宗的妻子留下了10美元。第二天日本侦探再次来访时，宗的妻子告诉他

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/13.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
they had fled because they feared some danger would befall
them. Tsung's wife then accompanied me to the restaurant
at Kiangwan to ask her husband and Loo Zoong Sin to return
home as the Japanese detective had assured her that no harm
would befall them. On April 11 the Japanese D.S.I. Tsong
Chuen came to Tsung's home and asked Tsung to accompany
him to Tsingtao to arrest Yih Hai Sung. The Japanese D.S.I.
gave Tsung $50 for family expenses during his absence. On
April 12 the Japanese D.S.I., the Japanese Detective,
Tsung Yuan Cha and an unknown Japanese left Shanghai for
Tsingtao by aeroplane. After they had left Dr. Zung asked
his friends Wong Ching Song (        ) and Lee Yao (        )
to make the following statement to a certain Japanese:-
"One day we went to Room No.7 Moon Palace Hotel,
North Szechuen Road where we met Yih Hai Sung, Yang Wen
Dao and the Korean named "Jack" who were discussing certain
arrangements" They made this statement to the Japanese
referred to who acting on it went to arrest Yang Wen Dao/
The Japanese Detective Sub-Inspector, the Japanese
Detective and the unknown Japanese returned to Shanghai
on April 21, and Tsung Yuan Cha returned on April 23.
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/13。
调查记录。
他们因担心遭遇危险而逃走了。随后，宗的妻子陪我前往江湾的那家餐馆，请求她的丈夫和陆宗信回家，因为日本侦探已向她保证他们不会受到伤害。4月11日，日本侦探副巡官钟泉（Tsong Chuen，音译）来到宗的家中，要求宗陪同他前往青岛逮捕叶海生（Yih Hai Sung）。日本侦探副巡官给了宗50美元，作为他离家期间的家庭开支。4月12日，日本侦探副巡官、日本侦探、宗元佳以及一名身份不明的日本人乘飞机离开上海前往青岛。他们离开后，郑博士请求他的朋友王景松（Wong Ching Song）和李尧（Lee Yao）向某位日本人作如下陈述：“有一天，我们去了北四川路月宫饭店7号房间，在那里遇到了叶海生、杨文道和一名叫‘杰克’的朝鲜人，他们正在商讨某些安排。”他们向上述那位日本人作了这一陈述，该日本人据此行动，去逮捕杨文道。日本侦探副巡官、日本侦探和那名身份不明的日本人于4月21日返回上海，宗元佳于4月23日返回。

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/14.
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
The following is the translation of the rough
notes made by Tsang Sung (張琛) left with the
Police used by him to refresh his memory when
he made his statement:-
" I wish to bring to your notice the following
facts which tend to prove that the evidence put forward
by Tsung Yuan Cha (曾元佳) and others in Court is
false:-
(1) With the intention of securing the reward offered
by the local authorities in connection with the murder
case and also to obtain money from the Japanese,
Dr. Zung Wei Ming (鄭偉民) conspired with Tsung Yuan
Cha to falsely accuse Yih Hai Sung (葉海生) to the
effect that Yih had asked him (Tsung ) for a loan
offering a pistol as pledge. Dr. Zung first drew a
sketch of the pistol and then showed it to Tsung Yuan
Cha, following which Dr. Zung took him (Tsung) to the
"Japanese Naval Officers' House" on Scott Road to
identify a pistol. Dr. Zung promised to pay Tsung
Yuan Cha $200 or $300 as a reward. However, Dr. Zung
failed to make good the payment and Tsung Yuan Cha
became greatly dissatisfied and disclosed this matter
to me. Subsequently Dr. Zung called on Tsung Yuan Cha
again to discuss this matter. I was present and
Tsung Yuan Cha told Dr. Zung that he did not need to
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/14。
调查记录。
以下是张琛（Tsang Sung）留下的粗略笔记的译文，警方使用这些笔记以便他在作证时唤起记忆：
“我想提请你们注意以下事实，这些事实倾向于证明宗元佳等人在法庭上提出的证据是虚假的：
(1) 为了获取地方当局就谋杀案提供的赏金，并从日本人那里获得钱财，郑伟民博士（Dr. Zung Wei Ming）与宗元佳合谋诬告叶海生（Yih Hai Sung），声称叶曾向他（宗）借款，并以一把手枪作为抵押。郑博士先画了一张手枪的草图，然后拿给宗元佳看，随后郑博士带他（宗）去斯科特路的‘日本海军军官寓所’辨认一把手枪。郑博士承诺支付宗元佳200或300美元作为报酬。然而，郑博士未能兑现付款，宗元佳变得非常不满，并将此事透露给我。随后，郑博士再次拜访宗元佳讨论此事。我当时在场，宗元佳告诉郑博士，他不必

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/15
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
mind me as I knew what had happened.
(2) Dr. Zung Wei Ming later suggested to me to
falsely accuse Yih Hai Sung (葉海生), "Jih Kuh"
(Korean 傑克) and Bao Chu (鮑), Chief of the
No.1 sub-station of the 5th District Police Station,
as being the murderers. He told me to make a false
statement to certain Japanese officers as follows:-
" I am a member of the Doong Nyi Wei Club
(同義會). One day I went to the club to gamble.
I saw Yih Hai Sung and others and also "Jih Kuh"
I saw "Jih Kuh" take a pistol from his pocket and
hand it to Yih Hai Sung, but Yih told "Jih Kuh"
to give it to Bao Chu. Later Yih and Jih Kuh
left together. As there was nobody to gamble
with I also left. Upon reaching the vicinity of
Dah Tuh Lee alleyway (大德里), I saw Yih Hai Sung
and Jih Kuh and a third person unknown to me
walking and conversing together. I also saw
Jih Kuh take out something from his pocket and
hand it over to the third man."
Dr. Zung said if I was willing to make the
above false statement, I would be given a reward.
I refused. Sometime afterwards Tsung Yuan Cha got
Tsang Zai Yuan (張財源) to do this. Tsang Zai Yuan's
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/15
调查记录。
介意我，因为我知道发生了什么事。
(2) 后来，郑伟民博士建议我诬告叶海生（Yih Hai Sung）、‘杰古’（Jih Kuh，朝鲜人杰克）以及第五区警察局第一分所所长鲍楚（Bao Chu，音译）为凶手。他让我向某些日本军官作如下虚假陈述：
‘我是同义会（Doong Nyi Wei Club）的成员。有一天我去俱乐部赌博。我看到了叶海生等人，还有‘杰古’。我看到‘杰古’从口袋里掏出一把手枪递给叶海生，但叶让‘杰古’把它交给鲍楚。后来叶和杰古一起离开了。因为没有人一起赌博，我也离开了。到达大德里（Dah Tuh Lee）附近时，我看到叶海生、杰古和第三个我不认识的人在一起边走边谈。我还看到杰古从口袋里掏出某样东西交给了第三个人。’
郑博士说，如果我愿意作上述虚假陈述，我将得到一笔报酬。我拒绝了。过了一段时间，宗元佳让张财源（Tsang Zai Yuan）做了这件事。张财源在

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/16
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
evidence in the Court during the previous hearing
is therefore false.
(3) With the object of obtaining the reward,
Dr. Zung carried out the following plan :-
Dr. Zung scratched the breast of Tsung Yuan Cha with
a piece of brass. He then escorted Tsung to the
Japanese and stated that since the pistol had been
identified by Tsung and since the Japanese
Authorities had arrested "Jih Kuh," Tsung had been
followed by a number of persons, that one evening
he had been attacked and injured by some unknown
assailants near the Wang Pang Bridge (North Szechuen
Road), that a Cantonese doctor had given medical
attention to Tsung for which he had charged $400,
and that Tsung had already paid a deposit of $200,
but was not able to pay the balance. This plan,
however, failed to obtain the reward.
(4) Tsung Yuan Cha, not having been paid for
his services, repeatedly went to Dr. Zung's house
asking for the reward, but Dr. Zung refused to see
him. Tsung finally went to see a Japanese officer
attached to Hongkew Station, named "Dien Tsoong"
(田中) and made a complaint. "Dien Tsoong" paid
Tsung the sums of $10., $25., or $30. on several
occasions and also asked Tsung to investigate an
assault case in which "Jih Kuh" was involved.
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/16
调查记录。
此前庭审中的证词因此是虚假的。
(3) 为了获取赏金，郑博士实施了以下计划：
郑博士用一块黄铜划伤了宗元佳的胸部。然后他陪同宗去见日本人，声称由于宗已经辨认出手枪，且日本当局逮捕了‘杰古’，宗被多人跟踪，某天晚上他在旺邦桥（Wang Pang Bridge，北四川路）附近遭到一些不明袭击者的攻击并受伤，一名广东医生为宗进行了治疗，收费400美元，宗已支付定金200美元，但无力支付余款。然而，这一计划未能获得赏金。
(4) 宗元佳因未获得服务报酬，多次前往郑博士家中索要赏金，但郑博士拒绝见他。宗最终去见了一位隶属于虹口警局、名为‘田中’（Dien Tsoong）的日本警官并提出投诉。‘田中’分几次支付给宗10美元、25美元或30美元不等，还要求宗调查一起涉及‘杰古’的袭击案件。

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/17
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
(5) Tsung Yuan Cha then coerced a dancing girl
named Ah Loh (阿六) alias Mei Foo Loo (美布路),
to give false evidence in the assault case. Tsung
Yuan Cha also instructed Ah Loh to say that one
evening she saw "Jih Kuh" fighting with another
person outside the Moon Cabaret and that he was in
the habit of carrying a pistol and in addition was
always ready to pick a quarrel. Tsung then brought
this girl to "Dien Tsoong" (the Japanese officer)
who paid Tsung $40 for his services.
(6) Tsung Yuan Cha also utilized a newspaper
report in order to obtain money from the Japanese.
One day he read in the newspaper that a Cantonese
named Loo Soong Sing (盧從信) was stabbed by an
unknown person. Tsung knew that Loo was a member
of the Sing Sung Woo Club (新勝和), so that he
obtained an interview with him through one named Kong
(康), and persuaded Loo to falsely accuse Zung
Voong Pih (陳鴻壁), the principal of the Kwangtung
Junior Middle School (廣東中學), as having been
concerned in the murder of the Japanese marine.
He also promised to give Loo a reward of several
hundred dollars if he would perform this service.
Subsequently he (Tsung) took Loo to "Dien Tsoong
(the Japanese officer)" and made the false report.
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/17
调查记录。
(5) 随后，宗元佳胁迫一名名叫阿六（Ah Loh），又名美布路（Mei Foo Loo）的舞女，在这起袭击案件中作伪证。宗元佳还指示阿六说，某天晚上她看到‘杰古’在月宫舞厅（Moon Cabaret）外与另一人打架，并且他有携带手枪的习惯，此外总是准备挑起争端。随后宗将这名女孩带给‘田中’（那位日本警官），后者支付给宗40美元作为服务费。
(6) 宗元佳还利用一篇新闻报道从日本人那里获取钱财。有一天，他在报纸上看到一名叫卢从信（Loo Soong Sing）的广东人被不明人士刺伤。宗知道卢是新胜和（Sing Sung Woo Club）的成员，因此通过一个叫康（Kong）的人安排与卢会面，并说服卢诬告广东中学校长陈鸿壁（Zung Voong Pih，音译）参与了杀害日本海军陆战队员的案件。他还承诺如果卢完成这项任务，将给予他数百美元的报酬。随后，他（宗）带卢去见‘田中’（那位日本警官）并作了虚假报告。

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/18
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Shortly afterwards the Kwangtung Junior Middle
School and Bao Chu's home (Chief of the No.1
sub-station of the 5th District Police Station)
were searched by the Japanese Consular Police
and P.S.B. detectives but without result. In
connection with this false report, Dr. Zung
approached the Japanese beforehand and stated that
the informer had demanded $500. and that an advance
of $200 should be paid. He failed to get an advance.
Prior to the raid, Tsung Yuan Cha asked me to
inform Zung Voong Pih (the falsely accused principal
of the Kwangtung Junior Middle School) that an unknown
person had made a report to the Japanese Authorities,
the result of which he would be arrested. Instead of
doing so, I told the truth to my cousin named Ying
( 应 ) who is employed in this school. I have a note
written to me by Tsung Yuan Cha instructing me what
to say when I met Zung Voong Pih, the school principal.
(7) On April 12 Tsung Yuan Cha and the Japanese
"Dien Tsoong" (田中) and "Tsoong Chuen" (中村) and
others went to Tsingtao by air to arrest Yih Hai Sung.
Dr. Zung in Shanghai bribed Lee Yao and Wong Ching
Soong (王景松) to falsely accuse Yang Wen Dao
(楊文道). The following is a statement which
Dr. Zung instructed Lee and the others to make :-
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/18
调查记录。
不久之后，日本领事警察和特别支部（P.S.B.）侦探搜查了广东中学和鲍楚（第五区警察局第一分所所长）的家，但一无所获。关于这份虚假报告，郑博士事先接触了日本人，声称线人索要500美元，并要求预付200美元。他未能拿到预付款。在突袭之前，宗元佳要求我通知陈鸿壁（被诬告的广东中学校长），有人向日本当局举报，结果他将遭到逮捕。我没有这样做，而是将真相告诉了我的表亲应（Ying，音译），他就职于这所学校。我有一张宗元佳写给我的纸条，指示我在见到校长陈鸿壁时该说什么。
(7) 4月12日，宗元佳与日本人‘田中’（Dien Tsoong）、‘中村’（Tsoong Chuen，音译）等人乘飞机前往青岛逮捕叶海生。郑博士在上海贿赂李尧和王景松（Wong Ching Soong）诬告杨文道（Yang Wen Dao）。以下是郑博士指示李等人所作的陈述：

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/19
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
(Briefly). "On a certain day in November, last year,
in room No.7 of the Moon Palace, I saw Yang Wen Dao,
Yih Hai Sung, and "Jih Kun" holding a secret
conference and also noticed that "Jih Kun" was in
possession of a pistol."
Dr. Zung promised to pay several hundred
dollars as a reward if they would make this
statement. Eventually one named Yang ( 楊 )
accompanied the police to arrest Yang Wen Dao.
......
All the above notes are true facts. Tsung
Yuan Cha and I were school mates and used to meet
often, thus I know all the particulars of this case.
Dr. Zung Wei Ming and Tsung Yuan Cha have tried to
persuade me to take a part in their plot, but I
have refused to do so for obvious reasons. On the
other hand I have advised them to give up the plot
but without success."
The following is the Morning Translation
dated May 6, 1936 of an article appearing in the
Ta Kung Pao ( 大公報 ) :
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/19
调查记录。
（简要内容）。“去年11月的某一天，在月宫饭店7号房间，我看到杨文道、叶海生和‘杰昆’（Jih Kun，音译）举行秘密会议，还注意到‘杰昆’持有一把手枪。”
郑博士承诺，如果他们作此陈述，将支付数百美元作为报酬。最终，一名姓杨（Yang）的人陪同警察逮捕了杨文道。
......
以上所有笔记均为事实。宗元佳和我是同学，经常见面，因此我知道此案的所有细节。郑伟民博士和宗元佳曾试图说服我参与他们的阴谋，但我出于显而易见的原因拒绝了。另一方面，我曾劝他们放弃阴谋，但未成功。”
以下是1936年5月6日《大公报》刊登的一篇文章的晨间译本：

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/20
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
The Nakayama Murder Case - Alleged False Accusations
Against the Accused
After Nakayama was murdered on the night of
November 9 last year on Darroch Road, the Chinese and
the Settlement authorities each offered a reward of
$4,000 for information leading to the arrest of the
murderer or the murderers.
Recently, the Japanese Consular Police arrested
a Korean named Chi Kuh (傑克), suspected of having
connection with the Nakayama case. During the middle
of last month, the Shanghai Municipal Police, acting
on secret information, arrested in Shanghai and
Tsingtao three other suspects named Yang Vung Tao
(楊文道), Chen Yung Sung (陳榮生) and Yih Hai Sung
(葉海生). Investigations have now been completed
and it has been found that Yang Vung Tao and Yih Hai
Sung are suspected of murdering Nakayama. On May 1,
the suspects were brought before the 1st Special
District Court and the S.M.P. charged them with
homicide according to Article 271 of the Chinese
Criminal Code. No charge, however, was brought
against Chen Yung Sung. A joint hearing of the case
was held by Chien Hung Yih (錢鴻業), Chief of the
Criminal Division, and Judges Feng ( ) and Siao
(蕭 ), which lasted three hours. During the hearing
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/20
调查记录。
中山谋杀案 - 针对被告的所谓诬告
去年11月9日晚，中山先生在达罗克路（Darroch Road）被谋杀后，中方和租界当局各自悬赏4,000元，以征集能导致逮捕凶手的情报。
近日，日本领事馆警察逮捕了一名涉嫌与中山案有关的朝鲜人，名为Chi Kuh（傑克）。上月月中旬，上海公共租界工部局警务处根据秘密情报，在上海和青岛逮捕了另外三名嫌疑人，分别为杨文道（Yang Vung Tao）、陈荣生（Chen Yung Sung）和叶海生（Yih Hai Sung）。目前调查已结束，查明杨文道和叶海生涉嫌谋杀中山。5月1日，嫌疑人被提解至第一特区地方法院，上海公共租界工部局警务处依据《中华民国刑法》第271条指控其犯杀人罪。然而，未对陈荣生提出任何指控。本案由刑事庭庭长钱鸿业以及法官冯（ ）和萧（ ）联合审理，历时三小时。在听证期间

pages.en:
Diary Number:-23/21
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
Yih Hai Sung confessed that he had participated in
the murder, while Yang Vung Tao denied having murdered
Nakayama. The Court then remanded the case to 2 p.m.
May 6 (today) for further hearing. Chen Vung Sung
was released.
According to information secured by our reporter,
Tseng Yuan (曾元), the informer, Zung Wei Min
(鄭偉民) alias Ping San (平山), a Japanese protege
of Chinese origin, residing at House No.639, Hung An
Li (鴻安里), Haining Road, and a Cantonese named
Yang Chien Chung (楊建忠), following the outbreak
of the murder case, invited Chang Tsun (張琛), a
Cantonese, to discuss measures to falsely accuse
Miss Chen Hung Pih (陳鴻璧), Principal of the
Kwangtung Primary School (廣東小學), Chapei, of being
connected with the Nakayama murder case, with the
intent of securing the reward of $12,000 offered by
the Shanghai City Government, the S.M.P.; and the
Japanese Consulate. The S.M.P.; with the assistance
of the North Station Branch of the Public Safety
Bureau, visited the school and carried out a search
on two occasions, but nothing was found. Afterwards,
Tseng and the others discussed measures to falsely
accuse Yang Vung Tao and Yih Hai Sung of being
connected with the murder case and Yang and Yih have
pages.zh:
日记编号：-23/21
调查记录。
叶海生供认参与了谋杀，而杨文道否认杀害中山。法院随后将案件延期至今日（5月6日）下午2点继续审理。陈荣生获释。
据本报记者获得的消息，线人曾元、郑伟民（别名平山，一名居住在海宁路鸿安里639号的日籍华人 protégé）以及一名广东人杨建忠，在谋杀案发生后，邀请另一名广东人张琛商议措施，企图诬陷闸北广东小学校长陈鸿璧女士与中山谋杀案有关，意图获取上海市政府、上海公共租界工部局警务处和日本领事馆提供的12,000元赏金。上海公共租界工部局警务处在公安局北站分局的协助下，两次前往该校进行搜查，但一无所获。此后，曾元等人又商议措施，诬陷杨文道和叶海生与谋杀案有关，而杨和叶现已

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/22
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
now been charged with homicide. Chang Tsun, his
conscience getting the better of him, called at the
N.M.P. at 2 p.m. yesterday and explained the ruse.
Chang Tsun has told his friends that when the Court
hears the case again, he has decided to appear at
the hearing and explain the particulars of the plot
of Tseng Yuan and the others in falsely accusing
Yang Vung Dao and Yih Hai Sung.
It is further learned that lawyers Kuh Chao Chi
(葛肇基) and Wong Sz Chung (王士宗), in the defence
of the accused Yang and Yih, are collecting evidence
to prove the charges against their clients to be false.
After Chang Tsun had felt it his duty to tell
the truth, somebody advised him to make a secret
petition to the Court. Chang was timid and dared not
do so, but he has, instead, surrendered himself to
the Police and has asked the Police for protection.
When the case comes up for hearing to-day,
Chang Tsun, under the protection of the Police, will
appear and gave particulars of the plot of Tseng Yuan
and others to falsely accuse Yang and Yih.
The above articles is also appeared in to-day's
issue of the "Sin Wan Pao," the "Min Pao", the
"Central China Daily News" and other newspapers.
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/22
调查记录。
被指控犯有杀人罪。张琛良心发现，于昨日下午2时前往法租界巡捕房（N.M.P.）说明了这一诡计。张琛告诉他的朋友，当法院再次审理此案时，他决定出庭说明曾元等人诬陷杨文道和叶海生的阴谋细节。
另悉，为被告杨和叶辩护的律师葛肇基和王士宗正在收集证据，以证明对其当事人的指控是虚假的。
张琛觉得有责任说出真相后，有人建议他向法院提交秘密诉状。张生性胆小，不敢这样做，但他转而向警方自首，并请求警方保护。
当今日案件开庭审理时，张琛将在警方的保护下出庭，详细说明曾元等人诬陷杨和叶的阴谋情节。
上述文章也刊登在今日的《新闻报》、《民报》、《华中日报》和其他报纸上。

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 23/28
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
The "China Times" states that the article in
question has been supplied to this paper by the
Yoo Kwong News Agency (滬光通訊社). Upon
receipt of this report, this paper detailed a
reporter to make enquiries at the Police Station.
However, the Police said that no man bearing the
name of Chang Tsun has called at the Police Station
to make any statement relating to the case.

D. S. I.
pages.zh:
日记编号：- 23/28
调查记录。
《字林西报》（China Times）称，相关文章由沪光通讯社提供给该报。收到此报告后，该报派遣一名记者前往警察局查询。然而，警方表示，没有名为张琛的人到警察局就本案做任何陈述。

9th May, 1936.
24/1.

At 10.30 p.m. on the 8/5/36, D.S.I.s Crowther
and Ross, acting on information received, quietly
effected the arrest of one 4th accused Tseu Shao Yoong
(周社榮) alias Tseu Yao Yoong (周耀榮) alias
Dah Tseu (大周) alias Ah Tseu (亞周) aged 30 years,
native of Canton, single cabaret inspector, at the
Continental Cabaret, 33 Ninpo Road.
He was immediately taken to Chengtu Road Police
Station where he was identified by the 3rd accused, Yih
Hai Sung (葉海生) as the person he implicated in written
statements and open Court.
The 3rd accused, Yih Hai Sung, implicates the
4th accused Tseu Shao Yoong as the person who participated
in several meetings in the Dong Nyi Association, 71 Yoong
Jih Li (永吉里), Range Road, in October and November
1935 prior to the murder of H. Nakayama, when they dis-
cussed how to carry out the assassination. The following
persons being present, 1st accused Yang Vung Dao (楊文道),
Yih Hai Sung (葉海生), Tseu Shao Yoong (周社榮), Kan Ri
Ryo (韓李良) alias Jack and oneother Korean, name
unknown.
These five persons at about 8 p.m, on the 9/11/35
met in Room No.9, Moon Palace, North Szechuen Road. Later
the 1st accused 3rd accused, and Kan Ri Ryo proceeded to
Darroch Road and North Szechuen Road corner, when the 3rd

1936年5月9日。
24/1.

1936年5月8日晚上10点30分，副督察长克劳瑟（Crowther）和罗斯（Ross）根据收到的情报，在宁波路33号大陆舞厅（Continental Cabaret）悄悄逮捕了第四被告周社荣（Tseu Shao Yoong），别名周耀荣（Tseu Yao Yoong），别名叫大周（Dah Tseu），别名亚周（Ah Tseu），30岁，广东籍，单身，舞厅稽查员。
他随即被带往成都路警察局，在那里，第三被告叶海生指认他就是其在书面供词和公开法庭上所牵连的人。
第三被告叶海生牵连第四被告周社荣，称其是在中山秀雄（H. Nakayama）被谋杀之前，于1935年10月和11月间，在兰路（Range Road）永吉里71号的同义协会参加了几次会议的人员之一，当时他们讨论了如何实施暗杀。在场人员包括：第一被告杨文道（Yang Vung Dao）、叶海生（Yih Hai Sung）、周社荣（Tseu Shao Yoong）、韩李良（Kan Ri Ryo，别名Jack）以及另一名姓名不详的朝鲜人。
这五个人于1935年11月9日晚上8点左右在北四川路月宫饭店9号房间会面。随后，第一被告、第三被告和韩李良前往达罗克路与北四川路路口，当时第三

pages.en:
24/2.

accused was given the pistol by 1st accused and
at 9 p.m. shot H. Nakayama on the Darroch Road near
Fong Loh Li.

The 3rd accused also states after committing the
crime he returned to the Moon Palace Room 9 where he
met the 4th accused who asked him how the matter turned
out, the 3rd accused replied that it was successful.

The 3rd accused made a verbal statement in the
presence of the 4th accused, Mr. Uyehara, A.C.P.,
D.S.I.s Crowther, Ross and Shih Ssu Chien. The
4th accused was taxed on the verbal statement but failed
to make a statement stating he was in the Dong Nyl
Association on the night of the 9/11/35.

The 4th accused being further questioned stated he
has been employed as an in-spector in the Continental
Cabaret since the end of 1935.- and never has left
Shanghai during the past 10 years.

The 4th accused admits knowing the 1st accused
Yang Vung Dao, 3rd accused Yih Hai Sung and Kan Ri
Ryo for several years.

The 4th accused will appear in the S.S.D. Court
onthe 9/5/36 when an application for a writ of Detention
will be made to allow for further enquiries.

D.S.I.

D.C. ( Crime )

被告从第一被告手中接过手枪，并于晚上9点在达罗克路近丰乐里处枪击了中山秀雄。

第三被告还陈述，作案后他返回月宫饭店9号房间，在那里遇到了第四被告，第四被告询问事情结果如何，第三被告回答说成功了。

第三被告在第四被告、助理副总巡官上原先生（Mr. Uyehara, A.C.P.）、副督察长克劳瑟、罗斯和施思谦（Shih Ssu Chien）面前做了口头陈述。第四被告就这一口头陈述受到质问，但未做陈述，声称1935年11月9日晚他在同义协会。

经进一步讯问，第四被告陈述他自1935年底以来一直受雇为大陆舞厅的稽查员，并且在过去10年中从未离开过上海。

第四被告承认认识第一被告杨文道、第三被告叶海生和韩李良已有数年。

第四被告将于1936年5月9日出庭于第二特区地方法院，届时将申请拘留令以便进行进一步调查。

副督察长

The 1st accused, Yang Vung Dao, and 3rd accused,
Yih Hai Sung, appeared in the S.S.D.Court on the 6/5/36
and were remanded to the 20/5/36. During the hearing
Judge Chien requested that the bullet found at the scene
of crime be subjected to test for blood. It was explained
to Judge Chien by Mr. P.Y. Ru A/M.A. that since the bullet
was found it had gone through tests in the Arms Identifi-
cation Section which entailed rolling and a great deal
of handling, however, the Judge still requested that if
there was a possibility for blood to be found on the
bullet it should be examined.

D.S. Oakley, Arms Identification Section submitted
a report stating the process the bullet had gone through
whilst in the A.I.S.

At 3.30 p.m. on the 14/5/36, D.S.I. Crowther
handed the bullet to Mr. Blackelock, Pathologist S.M.C.,
Public Health Department for examination. On the 16/5/36
a report was received of the examination which is to the
effect, "A bullet handed to me personally by D.S.I.
Crowther at 3.30 p.m. on the 14/5/36 was to-day examined
by me for the presence of blood by the Benzidine Test.
No evidence of the presence of blood could be
found.

The bullet was contained in an envelope super-
scribed: C.1109. Bullet .32 Auto found at the scene of

25/1.

第一被告杨文道和第三被告叶海生于1936年5月6日出庭于第二特区地方法院，并被延期至1936年5月20日。在听证期间，钱法官要求对犯罪现场发现的子弹进行血液测试。法医兼医务官P.Y. Ru先生向钱法官解释说，自从发现子弹以来，它已经在武器识别科经过了测试，这涉及滚动和大量 handling，然而，法官仍然要求如果有可能在子弹上发现血迹，应进行检查。

武器识别科的D.S. Oakley提交了一份报告，说明了子弹在武器识别科期间所经历的过程。

1936年5月14日下午3点30分，副督察长克劳瑟将子弹交给工部局公共卫生部病理学家布莱克洛克先生（Mr. Blackelock）进行检查。1936年5月16日收到检查报告，内容如下：“我于1936年5月14日下午3点30分亲自从副督察长克劳瑟手中接收的一颗子弹，今日由我通过联苯胺测试检查是否有血迹。
未能发现存在血迹的证据。

该子弹装在一个信封内，信封上注明：C.1109。在

the murder of Hideo Nakayama on Darroch Road at about
