The 4th accused, Tseu Shao Yoong, appeared
before the S.S. D.Court on the 9/5/36 when a Writ of
Detention was allowed, and remanded to the 20/5/36.

A lengthy statement has been taken from the 4th
accused--he strongly denies being concerned with the
1st accused, 3rd accused, and the two Koreans, in plann-
ing to murder any Japanese.

The 3rd accused still adheres to his statement
which he made in Open Court and in a written statement,
implicating the 4th accused as the person who, at the
beginning of October 1935, summoned him on the instruc-
tion of the 1st accused to attend the Dong Nyi (同義)
Association, No,71 Yung Chih Li (永吉里) Range Road,
where the 3rd accused met "Jack", another unknown Korean,
and the 1st accused. At that time in the presence of the
1st accused, 3rd accused, and 4th accused, the two
Koreans expressed their hatred for the Japanese, when
the 1st accused stayed the discussion.

At the end of October, 1935, the 3rd accused states,
the 4th accused met him in the Moon Palace, North Szechuen
Road and requested him to go to the Dong Nyi (同義)
pages.zh:
25/2.

1935年11月9日晚上约9点5分，在达罗克路发生的中山秀雄谋杀案现场发现的.32口径自动手枪子弹。

签名 T.H. Blakelock.
病理学家。

第四被告周社荣于1936年5月9日出庭于第二特区地方法院，获准签发拘留令，并延期至1936年5月20日。

已对第四被告录取了一份 lengthy 陈述——他强烈否认参与第一被告、第三被告和两名朝鲜人策划谋杀任何日本人的活动。

第三被告仍坚持其在公开法庭上和书面供词中所做的陈述，牵连第四被告，称其于1935年10月初，奉第一被告之指令传唤他前往兰路永吉里71号的同义协会，在那里第三被告会见了“Jack”、另一名身份不明的朝鲜人和第一被告。当时在第一被告、第三被告和第四被告在场的情况下，两名朝鲜人表达了他们对日本人的仇恨，随后第一被告停止了讨论。

第三被告陈述，1935年10月底，第四被告在北四川路月宫饭店与他见面，并要求他去同义

pages.en:
25/3.

Association where the 1st accused addressed the 3rd
accused, 4th accused and the two Koreans stating,
anything they discussed would have to be kept strictly
confidential. The 1st accused then spoke of killing
a Japanese officer, which he anticipated would preci-
pitate a disturbance in the Hongkew District, whereby
they would benefit and expand their influence---this
is taken either to expand the influence of the Dong
Nyi Association or the influence of the 1st accused's
and his followers---Ong Paung Society---which is
generally known to be composed of members who make a
living by acting as protection agents on the wharves
in Shanghai and boats on the Whangpoo River.

It was at this meeting as stated by the 3rd accused
that the 1st accused stated he had pistols as the Koreans
stated they had pistols, and they would have to become
acquainted with the roads in the Darroch Road area, which
according to the 3rd accused the five of them did on
the evening of the 3/11/35.

At 9.30 p.m. on the 5/1135 the 1st accused, 3rd
accused, 4th accused and the two Koreans again met in
the Dong Nyi Association, 71Yoong Chih Li, Ragee Road,
when the 1st accused stated he had prepared for lots to
be drawn, with four pieces of paper, formed in a
triangle, one of which bore the character"go" the person
pages.zh:
25/3.

协会，在那里第一被告对第三被告、第四被告和两名朝鲜人讲话，声明他们讨论的任何事情都必须严格保密。随后第一被告谈到杀死一名日本军官，他预计这将引发虹口区的骚乱，从而使他们受益并扩大影响力——这被理解为要么是为了扩大同义协会的影响力，要么是为了扩大第一被告及其追随者——翁邦社（Ong Paung Society）的影响力——该社团众所周知由在上海码头和黄浦江船只上充当保镖谋生的人员组成。

据第三被告陈述，正是在这次会议上，第一被告声称他有手枪，因为朝鲜人说他们有手枪，并且他们必须熟悉达罗克路地区的道路，据第三被告称，他们五人于1935年11月3日晚上进行了勘察。

1935年11月5日晚上9点30分，第一被告、第三被告、第四被告和两名朝鲜人再次在兰路永吉里71号的同义协会会面，当时第一被告声明他已准备好抽签，用四张纸折成三角形，其中一张写有“去”字，抽到写有该字纸条的人

pages.en:
25/4.

drawing the piece of paper bearing the character would
carry out the mission, (murder). The 1st accused did
not participate in the drawing as he was the chairman.
The 3rd accused drew the paper bearing the charac-
ter.
At about 8 p.m. on the 9/11/35 the 3rd accused,
4th accused and the two Koreans attended No. 71 Yoong
Chih Li (永吉里) Rang● Road to await the 1st accused--
he did not attend so the four of them proceeded to room
9 of the Moon Palace where they were joined by the 1st
accused, from which place the 1st accused, 3rd accused
and Jack set out for Darroch Road, leaving the 4th
accused and the other Korean to wait for them in the
Moon Palace or the Dong Nyi Association.
In the 4th statement of the 3rd accused, he states
when near the Azalea Terrace off North Szechuen Road,
which is situated South of the Darroch Road, the 1st
accused gave him the pistol, taking it from a green
covered book, instructing him to wait at corner of
Darroch Road and North Szechuen Road, at that time he
saw Jack, the Korean, crossing the roadway leaving the
1st accused. Later he the 3rd accused observed a
Japanese marine approaching with the 1st accused and
Jack to his rear, and when near him, the 1st accused
and Jack signalled with their lips for the 3rd accused
pages.zh:
25/4.

将执行任务（谋杀）。第一被告没有参与抽签，因为他是主持人。
第三被告抽到了写有该字的纸条。
1935年11月9日晚上8点左右，第三被告、第四被告和两名朝鲜人前往兰路●永吉里71号等待第一被告——他没有出席，所以他们四人前往月宫饭店9号房间，第一被告在那里与他们汇合，随后第一被告、第三被告和Jack出发前往达罗克路，留下第四被告和另一名朝鲜人在月宫饭店或同义协会等待他们。
在第三被告的第四份供词中，他陈述当靠近位于达罗克路以南的北四川路旁的杜鹃台（Azalea Terrace）时，第一被告从一本绿色封面的书中拿出交给他手枪，指示他在达罗克路和北四川路的路口等待，当时他看见朝鲜人Jack穿过马路离开第一被告。后来，第三被告观察到一名日本海军陆战队员走近，第一被告和Jack在他身后，当靠近他时，第一被告和Jack用嘴唇向第三被告发出信号

pages.en:
25/5.

to follow the marine, which he did, and as instructed
by the 1st accused fired at the sailor's head on Darroch
Road near the Fong Loh Li (豐樂里), into which alley-
way he ran after firing the shot--and turned left into
a branch alleyway, then East to a third branch alleyway
running off the Fong Loh Li, (North side) by which
alleyway he emerged into the Fong Loh Li (豐樂里) and
came upon the watchman's hut East of the third branch
alleyway, where he discarded the pistol. The 3rd
accused then proceeded East in Fong Loh Li, to North
Szechuen Road and returned via North Szechuen Road to
room 9 of the Moon Palace where he met the 4th accused
and told him the mission had been successful.
The 4th accused denies ever being in room No.9
of the Moon Palace.
The 4th accused puts up an alibi which is to the
effect that owing to straitened circumstances, he pawned
his shoes, suit and overcoat in the Zung Lee (承利)
Pawnshop, North Kiangse Road---the suit and shoes he was
wearing at time of arrest he states were the articles
pawned. The overcoat was pawned for $7.00 on October
22/23, 1935 and the suit and shoes also for $7.00 on the
October 28/29, 1935. These articles he avers were not
taken out of pawn until the middle of November 1935.
D.S.I.s Ross and Van Tuh Foo on the 11/5/36 made
pages.zh:
25/5.

跟随那名水兵，他照做了，并按照第一被告的指示，在靠近丰乐里（Fong Loh Li）的达罗克路（Darroch Road）向水兵的头部开枪——开枪后他跑进该弄堂——然后左转进入一条支弄，再向东转入从丰乐里（北侧）分出的第三条支弄，通过该支弄他重新回到丰乐里（豐樂里），并在第三条支弄东侧的更亭处出现，在那里他丢弃了手枪。随后，第三被告在丰乐里向东行进至四川北路，并经由四川北路返回月宫舞厅（Moon Palace）9号房间，在那里他会见了第四被告，并告知他任务已成功完成。
第四被告否认曾去过月宫舞厅9号房间。
第四被告提出不在场证明，大意是鉴于经济拮据，他将鞋子、西装和大衣典当在江西北路承利（Zung Lee）当铺——他说被捕时身穿的西装和鞋子就是那些典当物品。大衣于1935年10月22/23日以7.00元典当，西装和鞋子也于1935年10月28/29日以7.00元典当。他声称这些物品直到1935年11月中旬才赎回。
副巡官罗斯（Ross）和范土富（Van Tuh Foo）于1936年5月11日进行了

pages.en:
25/6.

enquiries at the Zung Lee ( 永利 ) pawnshop, 490 Range
Road. It was ascertained that the overcoat was pledged
for the sum of $7.00 on the 16th October 1935 and redeemed
on the 12th November 1935. No trace of the shoes or suit
being pledged could be found in the books of the pawnshop.
The Zung Lee ( 永利 ) Pawnshop No.445 North Kiangse
Road was also visited, no evidence of the shoes or suit
being pledged was found. Enquiries at the Nyuen Dah
( 元大 ) Pawnshop, No.516 Haining Road were also
proved fruitless.
The maker's name of the suit now worn by the 4th
accused is Tien Sing ( 天星 ) Tailor's Shop, No.140
Avenue Joffre, F.C. enquiries at this shop elicited
that the suit was made in the year 1932/3, no record of
the purchaser is kept. The 4th accused states he bought
the suit from a second-hand shop on Woosung Road about
2 years ago.
The 4th accused maintains that from the 20th
October to the 15th November 1935 he remained in the
Dong Nyi Association and not once did he leave. Further
questioned regarding his clothing at that period, he
admitted having a shabby suit with holes in the back of
the trousers, but owing to " face" he did not leave the
premises in this suit.
The enquiry at the pawnshop disproves the alibi of
the 4th accused, and has reason for not leaving the Dong
pages.zh:
25/6.

对兰路（Range Road）490号永利（Zung Lee）当铺的调查。经查实，大衣于1935年10月16日以7.00元典当，并于1935年11月12日赎回。在当铺账簿中未找到鞋子或西装典当的任何记录。
还走访了江西北路445号永利（Zung Lee）当铺，未发现鞋子或西装典当的证据。在海宁路516号元大（Nyuen Dah）当铺的调查也证明毫无结果。
第四被告目前所穿西装的制造商是法租界霞飞路140号天星（Tien Sing）裁缝店。对该店的查询获悉，该西装制作于1932/3年，没有保留购买者的记录。第四被告称，他大约两年前在吴淞路的一家旧货店购买了这套西装。
第四被告坚持称，从1935年10月20日至11月15日，他一直待在东义协会（Dong Nyi Association），从未离开过。当进一步询问他在那段时间的衣着情况时，他承认有一套背后裤腿破洞的破旧西装，但为了“面子”，他没有穿着这套西装外出。
当铺的调查推翻了第四被告的不在场证明，而在案发前后不离开东

pages.en:
25/7.

Nyi Association surrounding the time of the crime is
rather incredible.
    Enquiries by D. S.I.s Ross & Van Tuh Foo on the
11/5/36 at No. 71 Yung Chih Li (永吉里) Range Road
formerly occupied by the Dong Nyi Association. The
chief tenant Tsze Sung Foo (朱申甫) was interviewed
and stated that, on Sept. 8, 1935, one named Yang (楊 )
visited the house, and during his absence the downstairs
rooms of the house were rented to this person, by his
wife, at $20.00 per month. On the 8/1/36 a sum of rent
money was outstanding and this resulted in the chief
tenant calling upon the members of the association to
remove. He also stated a teaboy slept on the premises
and an occasional one or two members also slept in the
association. So far the teaboy's name or his present
whereabouts has not been learned.
    Enquiries by D. S.I.s Ross and Van Tuh Foo on
the 12/5/36 at the Moon Palace, No.479 North Szechuen
Road ascertained that on the 13th September 1935 one
named Au Tsun Kyi (夏春记), 37, Dance Hall Business,
native of Chekiang, engaged room No.9, at a rent of
$1.00 per day . He retained the room until November 22,
1935 when the sum of $12.00 was outstanding which
resulted in the management requesting him to leave.
pages.zh:
25/7.

义协会的理由相当令人难以置信。
    副巡官罗斯和范土富于1936年5月11日对兰路永吉里（Yung Chih Li）71号（前东义协会所在地）进行了调查。二房东朱申甫（Tsze Sung Foo）接受问询时表示，1935年9月8日，一名姓杨（Yang）的人来访，在他不在家期间，他的妻子以每月20.00元的价格将楼下房间租给了此人。1936年1月8日，因拖欠租金，二房东要求协会成员搬离。他还表示，有一名茶役住在该处，偶尔也有一两名会员在协会过夜。截至目前，尚未得知该茶役的姓名或其当前下落。
    副巡官罗斯和范土富于1936年5月12日对四川北路479号月宫舞厅（Moon Palace）进行了调查，查明1935年9月13日，一名叫夏春记（Au Tsun Kyi）的人，37岁，舞厅业者，浙江籍，以每天1.00元的租金租用了9号房间。他保留该房间直至1935年11月22日，当时欠款12.00元，导致管理方要求他离开。

pages.en:
25/8.

Au Tsun Kyi is known to the employees of the hotel to
be interested in cabaret business.
A room boy No.1 named Tsze Ching Piao (朱金標)
stated that during the period which Au Tsun Kyi
occupied the room it was frequented daily by different
persons of the loafer fraternity.
On a number of occasions these loafers paid
for the room.
No information was obtained regarding the present
whereabouts of Au Tsun Kyi.
The management of the Moon Palace Hotel handed
over to the Shanghai Municipal Police three hotel
registers against a receipt. They will be used as
exhibits in Court.
From a reliable source it has been learned that
one named Tsoh Zung Shiao (卓成曉) employed in the
Sun Co., Nanking Road, residing at No. 23 Tsin Chung Li
(新慶里), Tsai Kong Road (川公路), Chapei visited
room No.9 of the Moon Palace at about 9.30 p.m. on the
9/11/35, when he saw the 3rd accused and 4th accused
speaking together. This person is also mentioned by the
3rd accused in his 4th written statement as having
visited room No. 9, he also mentions others names of
persons as having visited the room later, none of them
have been located.
pages.zh:
25/8.

酒店员工知晓夏春记涉足歌舞厅业务。
一号服务员朱金標（Tsze Ching Piao）表示，在夏春记占用该房间期间，每天都有不同的游手好闲之徒光顾。
这些闲散人员曾多次支付房费。
未获得关于夏春记当前下落的信息。
月宫舞厅管理层向上海公共租界工部局警务处移交了三本酒店登记簿，并换取了收据。这些登记簿将作为法庭证物使用。
据可靠消息来源获悉，居住在闸北川公路新庆里（Tsin Chung Li）23号、在南京路太阳公司（Sun Co.）任职的卓成曉（Tsoh Zung Shiao），于1935年11月9日晚9点30分左右访问了月宫舞厅9号房间，当时他看见第三被告和第四被告在一起交谈。第三被告在其第四份书面供词中也提到此人曾访问9号房间，他还提到了其他后来访问该房间的人名，但均未找到这些人。

pages.en:
25/9.

Enquiries regarding Tsoh Zung Shiao (卓成曉)
by D.S. Bradley and D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo ascertained
from the manager of the Sun Co., Nanking Road, that
on the 9/5/36, Tsoh Zung Shiao reported ill and obtained
sick leave for an indefinite period, his present where-
abouts are unknown. Enquiries at his home No.23 Tsin
Chung Li (甄慶里), Tsai Kong Road (川宮路) Chapei,
shows that he left home on the morning of the 9/5/36
and since has not been seen or heard of. He did not
complain about his health and his absence cannot be
explained.

The 4th accused admits being a frequent visitor
to the Moon Palace, North Szechuen Road, but adds he
did not visit any special room and that he did not
visit there between October 20th & November 15th, 1935.

The 4th accused stated that the last time he met
the 3rd accused was on the 17th or 18th October 1935
in the Moon Palace. He also admits that he visited the
home of the 1st accused, after the 1st accused returned
from Canton in 1934.

The 4th accused states that Au Tsun Kyi was a
member of the Dong Nyi Association, he having introduced
him to the Association, which shows they were well
acquainted, and yet the 4th accused denies having
visited any special room in the Moon Palace.
pages.zh:
25/9.

警探布拉德利（Bradley）和副巡官范土富就卓成曉（Tsoh Zung Shiao）一事进行调查，从南京路太阳公司经理处获悉，1936年5月9日，卓成曉报病并获无限期病假，其当前下落不明。对其位于闸北川宮路（Tsai Kong Road）甄慶里（Tsin Chung Li）23号住所的调查表明，他于1936年5月9日上午离家，此后便杳无音信。他并未抱怨身体不适，其失踪原因无法解释。

第四被告承认经常光顾四川北路月宫舞厅，但补充说他并未去过任何特定房间，且在1935年10月20日至11月15日期间未曾去过那里。

第四被告称，他最后一次见到第三被告是在1935年10月17日或18日，地点在月宫舞厅。他还承认，在第一被告1934年从广州回来后，他曾去过第一被告的家。

第四被告称，夏春记是东义协会的成员，是他将夏介绍入会的，这表明他们关系熟稔，然而第四被告却否认去过月宫舞厅的任何特定房间。

pages.en:
25/10.

It is also a coincidence that after the murder
of H. Nakayama that the 4th accused obtained a job as a
so called inspector in a cabaret--which is actually what
is commonly known as a "thrower-out" whenever disturbances
arise in the cabaret, and that the 3rd accused should
become a cabaret manager.

At 3 a.m. on the 12/5/36 D.S. Tanaka met one Lee
Yoong Liu (李泳鎏) alias Niu Koong (牛公) aged 34 years,
native of Kwangtung, residing at 134 Tuh Hai ng Li (德興里)
Boone Road. It was thought that some useful information
could be obtained from this person and on request he
attended the station where he was questioned by D.S.T.s
Crowther and Shih Ssu-chien, and later he made a written
statement. Lee Yoong Liu was secretary and later acting
chairman of the Hung Zung Association (洪順) situated
at 3528 Yong Ziang Li, Point Road, (周家嘴路), which
association was dissolved in 1934. The ex-members of
these association formed the Dong Nyi and Dong Zung Asso-
ciations, appointing the 1st accused as chairman, he
having been the chairman of the Hung Zung Association.
Lee Yoong Liu did not join the Dong Nyi or Dong Zung
Association owing to his differences with the 1st accused.
Lee Yoong Liu in his written statement states that the 1st
accused had great influence on the wharves whilst in the
employ of Butterfield and Swire. At one time he states
pages.zh:
25/10.

同样巧合的是，在中山亨（H. Nakayama）被谋杀后，第四被告获得了一份所谓歌舞厅督察的工作——这实际上是俗称的“打手”，即在歌舞厅发生骚乱时负责驱逐闹事者——而第三被告则成为了一名歌舞厅经理。

1936年5月12日凌晨3点，警探田中（Tanaka）会见了李泳鎏（Lee Yoong Liu），别名牛公（Niu Koong），34岁，广东籍，居住在布恩路（Boone Road）德興里（Tuh Hai ng Li）134号。警方认为从此人处可能获得有用信息，应其请求，他来到警局，接受了副巡官克劳瑟（Crowther）和施思坚（Shih Ssu-chien）的讯问，随后提交了书面供词。李泳鎏曾任位于周家嘴路（Point Road）永祥里（Yong Ziang Li）3528号的洪顺协会（Hung Zung Association）秘书及后来的代理主席，该协会于1934年解散。该协会的前成员组建了东义协会和东忠协会（Dong Zung Associations），并任命第一被告为主席，因为他曾是洪顺协会的主席。由于与第一被告存在分歧，李泳鎏未加入东义或东忠协会。
李泳鎏在书面供词中称，第一被告在怡和洋行（Butterfield and Swire）任职期间，在码头上拥有很大影响力。他有一次称

pages.en:
25/11.

the 1st accused had two or three pistols, and once he
saw the 1st accused placing two or three pistols in a
wooden cabinet in the godown, but as he did not get a
good view of the pistols he cannot recollect the
descriptions. He also states that he saw a pistol in
the 1st accused's home, which the 1st accused told him
he had obtained from the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau
through the medium of a person named Loh Mung Fee (陸孟飛).
Lee Yoong Liu also states that the 1st accused
in September or October 1933 suddenly left Shanghai for
Canton by boat when he sent him a note from the ship.
He also heard that the 1st accused at that time was
wanted by the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.
Detectives have ascertained that the 1st accused
left Shanghai on board ship on the 13/12/33.
Lee Yoong Liu also states that the 1st accused
was introduced to one Hsiao Poo Yuen (蕭步雲) in 1932
when Hsiao Poo Yuen returned from America, and that he
and the 1st accused once visited Hsiao Poo Yuen, when he
was residing in Lane 1200 Route Pere Robert, adding that the
the 1st accused often visited Hsiao Poo Yuen.
The 1st accused still maintains his innocence.
Further questioning of the 1st accused by D.S.I.s
Crowther and Shih Ssu Chien elicited that he was in
possession of his Demon pistol one month prior to
pages.zh:
25/11.

第一被告拥有两三把手枪，并曾看见第一被告将两三把手枪放入仓库的一个木柜中，但由于未能看清手枪，他记不起具体描述。他还称，他在第一被告家中见过一把手枪，第一被告告诉他，这是通过一个叫陸孟飛（Loh Mung Fee）的人从上海公共安全局获得的。
李泳鎏还称，1933年9月或10月，第一被告突然乘船离开上海前往广州，并从船上给他寄了一张便条。他还听说，当时上海公共安全局正在通缉第一被告。
警探已查明，第一被告于1933年12月13日乘船离开上海。
李泳鎏还称，1932年蕭步雲（Hsiao Poo Yuen）从美国回来时，第一被告被介绍给他认识，他和第一被告曾一起去拜访过蕭步雲，当时蕭居住在罗伯特神父路（Route Pere Robert）1200弄，并补充说第一被告经常拜访蕭步雲。
第一被告仍坚持自己无罪。
副巡官克劳瑟和施思坚对第一被告的进一步讯问获悉，他在从工部局获得执照前一个月就已持有其Demion手枪。他是于1930年由岭南中学教师張松遠（Chang Song Yuen）介绍认识蕭步雲（Hsiao Poo Yuen）的。他结识蕭步雲的目的是为了从后者那里为龙忠协会的学校筹集资金，后来通过蕭步雲，他从美国获得了130.00美元。

pages.en:
25/12.

obtaining a licence from the S.M.C. He was introduced
to Hsiao Poo Yuen (蕭步雲) in 1930 by one named Chang
Song Yuen (張松遠) who was a teacher in the Ling Nan
(嶺南) Middle School. He made the acquaintance of
Hsiao Poo Yuen with a view to obtaining funds from him
for the school in the Lung Zung Association, and that
later through Hsiao Poo Yuen He obtained $130.00 from
America.

The 3rd accused in his 4th written statement stated
that the 1st accused in the year 1934 showed him the use
of a pistol in the 1st accused's home, in preparation for
a fight with a gang of loafers called the "Gang of 36"
who are members of the Ching Paung Society. The 3rd
accused states at that time Lee Yoong Liu (李泳鎏),
Wong Vung Chi (王文祺) Lao Dz Chiang (勞自強) and
Li Ling (黎林) were present, the latter three have
not been located. It is worthy of note Lee Yoong Liu
in his written statement admits seeing a pistol in the
1st accused's house and two or three pistols in Butter-
field & Swire Godown in the possession of the 1st accused,
and the 3rd accused states in his 4th written statement
that he saw four or five pistols in No.1A Godown, which
the 1st accused was in charge of, although those pistols
were of a different type than that used in the murder of
H. Nakayama.
pages.zh:
25/12.

第三被告在其第四份书面供词中称，1934年，第一被告在第一被告家中向他展示了如何使用手枪，以备与被称为“三十六股”的流氓团伙（青帮成员）打架之用。第三被告称，当时李泳鎏（Lee Yoong Liu）、王文祺（Wong Vung Chi）、勞自強（Lao Dz Chiang）和黎林（Li Ling）在场，后三人尚未找到。值得注意的是，李泳鎏在书面供词中承认在第一被告家中见过一把手枪，并在怡和洋行仓库见过第一被告拥有的两三把手枪；而第三被告在其第四份书面供词中称，他在第一被告负责的1A号仓库见过四五把手枪，尽管这些手枪的类型与用于谋杀中山亨的手枪不同。

pages.en:
25/13.

The 1st accused when taxed by D.S.I.s Crowther
and Shih Ssu-Chien on the statements of the 3rd accused
and Lee Yoong Liu regarding the pistols stated, the only
pistols that were in the godown were his own licensed
pistol and one owned by Hsiao Poo Yuen. He denied showing
the 3rd accused how to use a pistol. Asked, if at any
time Hsiao Poo Yuen visited the godown he failed to reply.
The 1st accused admits that on June 19th 1933,
through the introduction of Lee Chung Sung (李清森) chief
councillor of the 55th Route Army, which army was station-
ed in Paotao (包頭), Suiyuan Province (綏遠), he was
appointed a councillor to this army. The 1st accused
maintains this was an honorary rank so that he would have
more "face" among his acquaintances.
The 1st accused admits that "gang 36" is composed
of members of the Ching Paung Society and a rival gang
of the Ong Paang Society, of the latter society the 1st
accused takes a leading part.
Enquiries at the China Navigation Co. Ltd by D.S.I.s
Crowther and Ross elicited that tallymen are not allowed
to work for any of their boats unless they are employed
directly by the company. The 1st accused in his written
statement states after his return from Canton at the end
of 1934 he obtained a job as tallyman for the s.s.s. "Tai-
yuan and Tsinan". It was learned at the China Navigation
pages.zh:
25/13.

当副巡官克劳瑟和施思坚就第三被告和李泳鎏关于手枪的陈述质问第一被告时，第一被告称，仓库里只有他自己持照的手枪和蕭步雲拥有的一把手枪。他否认向第三被告展示过如何使用手枪。当被问及蕭步雲是否曾去过仓库时，他未能回答。
第一被告承认，1933年6月19日，通过驻扎在绥远省包头的第五十五军参谋长李清森（Lee Chung Sung）的介绍，他被任命为该军的参议。第一被告坚持称这是一个荣誉职衔，以便他在熟人中更有“面子”。
第一被告承认，“三十六股”由青帮成员以及翁帮（Ong Paang Society）的一个敌对帮派组成，第一被告在后一帮派中担任领导角色。
副巡官克劳瑟和罗斯在中国轮船公司（China Navigation Co. Ltd）的调查获悉，除非直接受雇于该公司，否则理货员不得为其任何船只工作。第一被告在书面供词中称，1934年底从广州回来后，他在“太原”号和“济南”号轮船上找到了一份理货员的工作。在中国轮船公司获悉

pages.en:
25/15.

that the 1st accused had gone to Foochow to assume the
post of Chief of the Public Safety Bureau. At present
there are no facts to prove this.

With reference to the financial status of the
1st accused enquiries have been made at the National
Industrial Bank of China 1300/1304 North Szechuen Road,
the Hongkong & Shanghai Banking Corporation and its
branch in the Hongkew District, as it was believed
certain drafts of money had been received by the 1st
accused through these banks, however, no trace of such
drafts were found,

The 1st accused has resided at 18 Dong An Li
(同安里), Tongshan Road for many years. The rental
for his house excluding taxes is $22.00 per month, at
present time he owes nine months rent---the last payment
of rent was for August 1935. This was learned from the
Central Trust Co. (中央信託公司), 270 Peking Road, Agents of
the property where the 1st accused resides.

During his services with the China Navigation Co.
Ltd, his wages averaged $25 per month.

Enquiries re the 1st accused's financial standing
are incompleted.

At 10 a.m. on the 18/4/36 the 1st accused made
a complaint at Kashing Road Station, a copy of his report
is attached. This was at the time when he was being
pages.zh:
25/15.

称第一被告已前往福州就任公安局局长一职。目前尚无事实能够证明这一点。

关于第一被告的财务状况，已向位于北四川路1300/1304号的中国国货银行、汇丰银行及其虹口区分行进行查询，因为据信第一被告曾通过这些银行接收某些汇票，然而，并未发现此类汇票的踪迹。

第一被告已在同山路同安里18号居住多年。其房屋租金不含税为每月22.00元，目前他拖欠九个月租金——上一次支付租金是在1935年8月。此情况是从北京路270号的中央信托公司得知的，该公司是第一被告所居物业的代理人。

在第一被告受雇于中国轮船公司（China Navigation Co. Ltd）期间，其平均月薪为25元。

关于第一被告财务状况的调查尚未完成。

1936年4月18日上午10时，第一被告在嘉善路站提出控告，其报告副本附后。当时他正被

pages.en:
25/16.

sought after by officers investigating the murder of
H. Nakayama. Officers attached to Kashing Road Station
were not aware of the fact that the 1st accused was
wanted by officers investigating this crime.
In the statement of the 3rd accused he states that
whilst staying in the Majestic Hotel, French Concession
he received sums of money from Tang Tih Ying (唐铁英)
alias Tang Tseh (唐植) through the Bank of China,
in December 1935. In February 1936 he stayed in room
336 Yangtsze Hotel, Yunnan Road, with Tang Tseh, when
the latter person received a sum of money through the
same bank. All the money being sent from Tsingtao.
On the 16/5/36 Court Order No. 2488 was obtained
from the S.S.D. Court in respect of the Bank of China.
On the 18/5/36 the bank on the authority of the Court
Order examined their books which show the following
transactions:-
(1). On the 14-12-35, the sum of $699.99 was transmitted
by Mail Transfer to Yih Hai Sung, Room 616, Majestic
Hotel, French Concession, from one Tang Tseh (唐植),
Chief Auditing Officer, The Kiaochow and Tsinan Railway
(膠濟鐵路), Tsingtau;
(2). On the 16-12-35, the sum of $200.00 Telegraphic
Transfer from Tsingtau, to Yih Hai Sung (益海生), Majestic
Hotel, French Concession. Cashed 17.12.35.
pages.zh:
25/16.

负责调查中岛（H. Nakayama）谋杀案的警员通缉。嘉善路站的警员并不知晓负责调查此罪的警员正在通缉第一被告。
在第三被告的供词中，他陈述在法租界华懋公寓（Majestic Hotel）住宿期间，于1935年12月通过中国银行从唐铁英（Tang Tih Ying），别名唐植（Tang Tseh）处收到款项。1936年2月，他与唐植一同住在云南路扬子饭店（Yangtsze Hotel）336号房间，当时后者通过同一家银行收到一笔款项。所有款项均从青岛汇出。
1936年5月16日，从特区地方法院（S.S.D. Court）获得针对中国银行的第2488号法院命令。
1936年5月18日，该银行依据法院命令查阅了其账簿，显示以下交易：-
(1). 1935年12月14日，一笔699.99元的款项通过邮汇从青岛胶济铁路（Kiaochow and Tsinan Railway）总审计师唐植（Tang Tseh）处，汇至法租界华懋公寓616室的益海生（Yih Hai Sung）；
(2). 1935年12月16日，一笔200.00元的电汇从青岛汇至法租界华懋公寓的益海生（Yih Hai Sung）。于1935年12月17日兑现。

pages.en:
25/17.

(3). On the 15-2-36, the sum of $400.00 Telegraphic
Transfer from Tsingtau, to Tong Tseh (唐植) Room
336, Yangtsze Hotel, Yunnan Road.
The 3rd accused states Tang Tseh apart from his
interest in the Vienna Cabaret he holds a position as
Chief Auditor in the Kiaochow and Tsinan Railway
(膠濟鐵路) Tsingtao. The 3rd accused states he was
introduced to Tang Tseh by a Chinese named Koo Eu Zung
(顧漢章), also known as "Darkie" in Tsingtao, at the
beginning of December 1935 when he was employed in the
Hollywood Cabaret. The 3rd accused admits that he
invested $300 in the Vienna Cabaret when it opened on the
22/23 in December 1935. This money he avers he obtained
from his paramour Zung Kwei Tseng (陳桂珍).
Regarding another part of the 3rd accused state-
ment where he states his sister named Yih Sai Mei (葉三妹)
got $3000 from Nyi Ziang Kwen (嚴祥官) in 1930. D.S.I.s
Crowther and Shih Ssu-chien made enquiries and interviewed
lawyer Tang Ying Nyi (唐行健), 1382 Avenue Edward
VII, who represented the 3rd accused's mother as the
complainant, when it was learned to be a fact that $3000
was paid by Nyi Ziang Kwen whom they charged in the S.S.D.
Court in May 1930 with abduction of Yih Sai Mei---the
case was settled out of Court on the payment of the
money and the charge was withdrawn.
pages.zh:
25/17.

(3). 1936年2月15日，一笔400.00元的电汇从青岛汇至云南路扬子饭店336室的唐植（Tong Tseh，原文如此，应为唐植）。
第三被告称，唐植除了对维也纳舞厅（Vienna Cabaret）拥有权益外，还在青岛胶济铁路（Kiaochow and Tsinan Railway）担任总审计师一职。第三被告称，他于1935年12月初在好莱坞舞厅（Hollywood Cabaret）任职时，由一名在青岛被称为“Darkie”的华人顾汉章（Koo Eu Zung）介绍认识唐植。第三被告承认，在1935年12月22/23日维也纳舞厅开业时，他投资了300元。他声称这笔钱来自他的情妇陈桂珍（Zung Kwei Tseng）。
关于第三被告供词的另一部分，他陈述其妹妹叶三妹（Yih Sai Mei）于1930年从严祥官（Nyi Ziang Kwen）处获得3000元。副督察长（D.S.I.s）克劳瑟（Crowther）和施士俭（Shih Ssu-chien）进行了查询并采访了爱德华七世路1382号的律师唐行健（Tang Ying Nyi），该律师代表第三被告的母亲作为原告人，经查实，严祥官确实支付了3000元，他们曾于1930年5月在特区地方法院指控严祥官绑架叶三妹——该案在支付款项后庭外和解，指控被撤销。

pages.en:
25/18.

The 3rd accused states he only received $300 from his
sister, half of which he lost in opening a skating
rink in the Golden Eagle Cabaret North Szechuen Road
in the winter of 1930, and the remainder he spent on
clothing.

At 3.30 p.m. on the 18/5/36 Tsze Sung Foo (柴申安)
chief tenant of No. 71 Yung Chih Li (永吉里), Range
Road attended the station and identified the 1st accused
as the person who rented two downstairs rooms on the
8th September 1935. He also identified the 4th accused
as one of the members who occasionally slept on the pre-
mises, and that he saw him frequenting the premises
during the months of October, November and December 1935.
He further stated that the 4th accused was then wearing
a navy blue foreign styled suit which was quite servi-
cable and not torn in anyway, this again goes to dis-
prove the 4th accused's statement regarding his clothing
being too shabby to leave the premises.

A statement was taken from Tsze Sung Foo, and he
will appear in Court as a witness on the 20/5/36.

Two summons No. 6290 issued by the S.S.D. Court on
the 18/5/36 is respect of Yang Kyi Tsung (楊健忠) and
Yang Kwei Mei (楊桂梅) were handed to D.S. Bradley
and D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo for serving at 5 p.m. on the
18/5/36. Two addresses were given, namely K.16 Lane
pages.zh:
25/18.

第三被告称他只从妹妹那里收到300元，其中一半在1930年冬天于北四川路金鹰舞厅（Golden Eagle Cabaret）开设溜冰场时亏损，其余部分用于购买衣物。

1936年5月18日下午3时30分，兰路永吉里71号的主租客柴申安（Tsze Sung Foo）来到警局，指认第一被告为1935年9月8日租用楼下两间房间的人。他还指认第四被告为偶尔在该处过夜的人员之一，并称他在1935年10月、11月和12月期间经常看到第四被告出入该处。他进一步陈述，当时第四被告身穿一套深蓝色西式西装，相当完好，没有任何破损，这再次驳斥了第四被告关于其衣物过于破旧而无法离开该处的说法。

已录取柴申安的供词，他将于1936年5月20日作为证人出庭。

特区地方法院于1936年5月18日签发的两张传票（编号6290），涉及杨健忠（Yang Kyi Tsung）和杨桂梅（Yang Kwei Mei），已于1936年5月18日下午5时交给副督察（D.S.）布拉德利（Bradley）和副督察长（D.S.I.）范图福（Van Tuh Foo）送达。提供了两个地址，即布恩路（Boone Road）德兴里572弄K.16号北省旅沪会，以及阜山路德康里49号，这两个地址均已走访，但未找到这两人。传票上给出的地址无人知晓杨桂梅，而获悉杨健忠已有两个月未露面。

副督察长迪克森（Dickson），指纹局负责人，提交了一份关于他对缴获的手枪和《实用物理学》一书继续检验的进一步报告。

在第一被告家中搜获的文件以及在同仁协会（Dong Zung Association）搜获的文件已核对，虽然有些信件性质奇怪，且有些文件具有反日性质，但目前未发现与中岛（H. Nakayama）谋杀案直接相关的内容。文件的翻译工作尚未完成。

应布莱恩先生（Mr. Bryan M. A.）的要求，已从证人曾元（Tseng Yuen）和曾再元（Tsang Zai Nyuen）处获得更多供词，副督察长中村（Nakamura）、副督察田中（Tanaka）和平山（M. Hirayama，线人）也作了供词，这些供词附后。

关于辩方证人张琛（Chang Sum），副督察长们又对其进行了讯问

pages.en:
25/19.

572 Tuh Shing Li (德興里) Boone Road, the Pei San
Fellow-countrymenIs Association (北省旅滬會) and
49 Tuh Kong Li (德康里) Fusan Road, both of the
addresses were visited but neither of the two persons
were located. Yang Kwei Mei is not known at the
addresses given on the summonses, whilst it was learned
Yang Kyi Tsung has not been seen for the last two
months.

D.S.I. Dickson i/c Finger Print Bureau has
submitted a further report of his continued examination
of the seized pistol and the book " Practical Physics ".

The documents seized in the home of the 1st accused
and those seized in the Dong Zung (同仁) Associa-
tion have been checked, and, although some letters are
of a strange nature, and some of the documents are of
an anti-Japanese nature, nothing directly bearing on
the murder of H. Nakayama at present can be found.
The translation of the documents is not completed.

At the request of Mr. Bryan M. A. further statements
have been obtained from the witnesses Tseng Yuen and
Tsang Zai Nyuen, and statements have been made by
D.S.I. Nakamura, D.S. Tanaka and M. Hirayama, (informant)
these are attached.

With reference to the witness for the defense,
Chang Sum (張琛), he was again questioned by D.S.I.s
pages.zh:
25/19.

已走访布恩路（Boone Road）德兴里57号北省旅沪会，以及福山路（Fusan Road）德康里49号，但上述两处均未找到相关人员。传票所列地址查无杨桂梅（Yang Kwei Mei），另获悉杨季宗（Yang Kyi Tsung）近两个月来未曾露面。

指纹局主管警佐狄克逊（D.S.I. Dickson）就其对缴获的手枪及《实用物理学》（Practical Physics）一书的持续检验工作，提交了进一步报告。

经核对，在第一被告家中搜获的文件以及在同仁协会（Dong Zung Association）搜获的文件，虽部分信件性质可疑，且部分文件带有反日色彩，但目前未发现与中山恒（H. Nakayama）谋杀案直接相关的证据。文件翻译工作尚未完成。

应布莱恩先生（Mr. Bryan M. A.）之要求，已取得证人曾元（Tseng Yuen）和曾再元（Tsang Zai Nyuen）的补充证词；警佐中村（D.S.I. Nakamura）、警司田中（D.S. Tanaka）及线人平山（M. Hirayama）亦提供了陈述，附后备查。

关于辩方证人张琛（Chang Sum），各警佐再次对其进行了讯问

pages.en:
25/20.

Crowther and Ross on the 8/5/36 when he was unable to
give the address of Yih Tsoh Chuen 葉焯君 whom he
mentioned in open Court as the person who wrote the
brief notes which he had to refresh his memory when
making his statement to the Police. Questions and
answers were put into writing in which he states the
brief notes were written by Yih Tsoh Chuen, in the
office of Mr. Grove.

The charge against the 3rd accused has been
amended to murder under Article 271 (1) of the C.C.R. C.
The 4th accused has been charged with making preparation
for the crime of murder under Article 271 (III) of the
C.C.R. C.

Witnesses for the hearing are:-
Tsze Sung Foo (朱申甫), Chief tenant of No.71 Yong
Chih Li, Range Road;
Ong Sing Tsoo (洪新祖), Accountant of Moon Palace;
Tsze Ching Piau (朱金標), No.1 boy of Moon Palace.

The three anonymous letters of a threatening
nature received by the witness Tseng Yuen and Dzung Wei
Ming (鄭偉民) (informant) have been examined by May
Yoh, T.L. Section, and he submitted a report stating
in his opinion the letters were written by one person.
On the 4/5/36 Dzung Wei Ming received another threaten-
ing letter.

D.S.I.
pages.zh:
25/20.

克劳瑟（Crowther）和罗斯（Ross）于1936年5月8日对其进行讯问，当时他无法提供叶焯君（Yih Tsoh Chuen）的地址，他曾当庭提及此人是撰写他在向警方作供时为刷新记忆所依赖的简要笔记的人。问答已记录在案，他在其中陈述简要笔记是由叶焯君在格罗夫先生（Mr. Grove）的办公室撰写的。

对第三被告的指控已修改为根据《中华民国刑法》第271条第(1)款规定的谋杀罪。
第四被告被控根据《中华民国刑法》第271条第(III)款规定为谋杀罪做准备。

听证会的证人如下：-
朱申甫（Tsze Sung Foo），兰路永吉里71号主租客；
洪新祖（Ong Sing Tsoo），月宫（Moon Palace）会计师；
朱金标（Tsze Ching Piau），月宫一号侍者。

证人曾元和线人郑伟民（Dzung Wei Ming）收到的三封匿名威胁信已由特务科（T.L. Section）的梅约（May Yoh）检查，他提交了一份报告，认为这些信件系同一人所写。
1936年5月4日，郑伟民收到另一封威胁信。

副督察长

pages.en:
CRIME REGISTER No:- 176/35          "C"     Division.
                                    Dixwell Rd. Police Station.
                                    May 26, 1936.
Diary Number:- 26/1

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

The three accused (1) Yang Vung Dao, (3) Yih
Hai Sung, (4) Tseu Shao Yoong, appeared in the S.S.D.
Court on the afternoon of the 20/5/36, after a lengthy
hearing they were remanded to the 27/5/36.

At 2.15 p.m. on the 22/5/36 Judge Siao, one of the
three judges trying the case, attended the scene of
crime and later visited Room No.9 Moon Palace, North
Szechuen Road and 71 Yoong Chih Li (永吉里) Range Road.
At each place Judge Siao questioned the 3rd accused
about the crime, which he again admitted in full.

In the afternoon of the 21/5/36 two lawyers
namely Wang Shi Chung (王士宗) appointed by the family
of the 3rd accused through a lawyer in Tsingtao, and
Tsang Ta Zang (張志讓) appointed by the S.S.D. Court
for the said accused, came to the station and requested
an interview with the 3rd accused. This request was
granted and in the presence of D.S.I.s Crowther, Ross
and Shih Sau Chien the lawyers asked the 3rd accused
about his movements on or about the 9/11/35/ The 3rd
accused gave them the following three points, and
ended by saying that he did not commit the murder, but
that if he were questioned in Court or any other place
he would plead guilty to the charge.

(1) Gave a dinner party in the Dah Chung Hwa
(大中華) Restaurant, 13 Paoshan Road, Chapei, in celebration
pages.zh:
犯罪登记号：- 176/35          "C"     分区。
                                    狄思威路警察局。
                                    1936年5月26日。
日志号：- 26/1

调查记录。

三名被告 (1) 杨云道（Yang Vung Dao），(3) 益海生（Yih Hai Sung），(4) 周少庸（Tseu Shao Yoong），于1936年5月20日下午出现在特区地方法院，经过长时间听证，他们被还押至1936年5月27日。

1936年5月22日下午2时15分，审理此案的三位法官之一的萧法官（Judge Siao）亲临犯罪现场，随后参观了北四川路月宫9号房间和兰路永吉里71号。在每个地方，萧法官就犯罪行为讯问了第三被告，第三被告再次完全承认。

1936年5月21日下午，两名律师，即由第三被告家属通过青岛一名律师委任的王士宗（Wang Shi Chung），以及由特区地方法院为该被告委任的张志让（Tsang Ta Zang），来到警局并要求会见第三被告。此请求获准，在副督察长克劳瑟、罗斯和施士俭在场的情况下，律师们询问了第三被告关于1935年11月9日前后的行踪。第三被告向他们提出了以下三点，最后表示他没有实施谋杀，但如果他在法庭或其他任何地方受到讯问，他将对指控认罪。

(1) 在闸北宝山路13号大中华（Dah Chung Hwa）餐馆举办晚宴，庆祝

pages.en:
Diary Number:- 26/2
RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.
of the birthday of his mother, had one or two tables.
(2) Grand opening of the Nanyang Cabaret, North
Szechuen Road on which date he spent the whole of the
evening there and assisted one named Yue (俞) in
assaulting a dancing girl when a disturbance ensued.
(3) On the 9/11/35 or days around that date I was
either in Room No.9 of the Moon Palace Hotel or in the
Ball Room of the Moon Palace. The following persons
may prove my statement:
(1) Au Tsung Kyi (夏春記)
(2) Dzung Keng Sung (莊根生)
(3) Wang Ah Kyung (黃阿琴)
The above three persons used to play "Woh Hwa" with me.
(4) Zee Ling Sung (徐林生), the chief tenant of No.4
Ngoh Ming Li (吳鳴里) Rue Veillemont, French Concession.
(5) Yuan Shon Shi (袁双喜), Proprietor of the Moon Palace.
(6) Mih Pao Sang (宓宝生), Inspector of the Moon Palace.
(7) Yoh Kong Tuh (郁康德), Sweet seller in the Moon
Palace.
(8) Sze Keng Dee (施根弟), Chief tea-boy.
With reference to point 1, D.S.I.s Crowther, Ross and
Shih Sau Chien at 10 a.m. on the 22/5/36 visited the
Dah Chung Hwa Restaurant, 15 Paoshan Road with the
assistance of the North Station Branch Bureau, and from

三名被告（1）杨云道（Yang Vung Dao），（3）叶海松（Yih Hai Sung），以及（4）周绍荣（Tseu Shao Yoong），于1936年5月27日下午再次出庭受审于特区地方法院，并被命令还押候审，至1936年6月3日下午继续审理。

在审讯过程中，第三名被告叶海松撤回了供词，并否认知晓谋杀案。

当主审法官丁恩法官（Judge Dzien）就其在先前听证会上承认谋杀而后又否认这一供述的原因进行讯问时，第三名被告声称，他是在遭受警察酷刑逼供后被迫认罪的。

为了证实这一所谓的酷刑，叶海松提请丁恩法官注意他上唇的一道疤痕，并告知法官这是侦探将点燃的香烟头按在他的肉上造成的。他还声称肋骨上有瘀伤，并称这是在警局遭受殴打期间留下的。

在随后的诉讼程序中，叶海松还告知丁恩法官，在被拘留于警局牢房期间，他曾试图吞下两把钥匙、一个铜扣和一条链子来结束生命，

At the conclusion of the examination Dr. Wei
expressed the verbal opinion that the scar on the pri-
soner's lip was from ten to fourteen days old, Dr.
Johnston estimated a similar age, and Dr. Tongu reckoned
it to be about ten days old.

As can be seen from the medical certificates
neither Dr. Johnston nor Dr. Tongu can definitely
establish the cause of the scar. It is also noteworthy
that both these physicians failed to find trace of the
bruise alleged to have been visible on the prisoner's
ribs.

In connection with the scar on the prisoner's
lip and his allegation that it was caused by detectives
placing the lighted end of a cigarette to his flesh,
the age of the scar assumes particular importance.
The Court physician, Dr. L. K. Wei, estimates
the scar to be from ten to fourteen days old, and his col-
leagues compute it to be about the same age. According to

检查结束时，魏博士口头表示，囚犯嘴唇上的疤痕约有十到十四天历史，约翰斯顿博士估计的时间相似，通古博士推算约为十天。

从医疗证明可以看出，约翰斯顿博士和通古博士均无法确定疤痕的确切成因。同样值得注意的是，这两位医生均未发现囚犯肋骨上有所称可见的瘀伤痕迹。

关于囚犯嘴唇上的疤痕及其声称是侦探将点燃的香烟头按在肉上造成的说法，疤痕的年限显得尤为重要。法庭医师L.K.魏博士估计疤痕约有十到十四天历史，他的同事也计算为大致相同的年限。根据

pages.en:
27/6.

the medical evidence the sore causing the scar must,
therefore, have been inflicted between the 14/5/36
and the 21/5/36.

In this respect it should be pointed out that
on the appearance of Yih Hai Sung before the S.S.D.
Court, on the 6/5/36 and the 9/5/36 ( on the latter
occasion to testify against the 4th accused Tseu Shao
Yoong ) he voluntary confessed in open court to having
assisted in the murder of the Japanese sailor.
According to medical evidence this was a period of
at least some few days before the injury causing the
scar could possibly have been inflicted.

Regarding the origin of this scar on the
prisoner's lip, it is thought best to again refer
to the interview granted to the legal representatives
of the 3rd accused Yih Hai Sung, at Chengtu Road
Station, on the afternoon of the 21/5/36 (Vide Diary
No. 26 Sheet No. 1 of this file) and amplify the report
referring to the interview to some extent.

These representatives, Messrs Wong Shi Chung
(王士宗) and Tsang Ts-zang (張志讓), were permitted
to interview the prisoner in the presence of D. S.I.
Crowther, D.S.I. Ross and D.S.I. Shih Szu Chien.

During the course of the interview the 3rd
accused Yih Hai Sung told his legal advisors that he
pages.zh:
27/6。

医疗证据，造成该疤痕的伤痛必然是在1936年5月14日至1936年5月21日之间造成的。

在这方面，应当指出的是，叶海松于1936年5月6日和5月9日出庭特区地方法院时（后一次是为指证第四名被告周绍荣），他在公开法庭上自愿承认协助谋杀了一名日本水手。根据医疗证据，这至少比可能造成疤痕的受伤时间早了几天。

关于囚犯嘴唇上这道疤痕的起因，认为最好再次提及1936年5月21日下午在成都路警局给予第三名被告叶海松的法律代表的会面（参见本卷日志第26号第1页），并在一定程度上充实有关该会面的报告。

这些代表，王士宗（Wong Shi Chung）先生和张志让（Tsang Ts-zang）先生，获准在副督察克劳瑟、副督察罗斯和副督察施思坚在场的情况下会见囚犯。

在会面过程中，第三名被告叶海松告诉他的法律顾问，他

pages.en:
27/7.

did not commit the murder ( This was the first
occasion on which he retrated his confession ) and
provided the lawyers with information regarding his
movements on the night of the crime. When asked by
legal advisers for his reason for confessing in open
court and written statement to a murder which he did
not commit, the prisoner stated that he felt compelled
to do so owing to the fact that he was so firmly
implicated by witnesses.

He was also questioned regarding the treatment
he had received at the hands of the police since the
date of his arrest, and informed his advisers that
this had been satisfactory.

The lawyers also questioned Yih regarding the
presence of the scar on his lip, and were informed
that this was due to his scratching the lip and thus
causing a sore to form on the spot (This is the same
scar which Yih Hai Sung alleged in open Court had
been inflicted by detectives with the end of a lighted
cigarette against his flesh ).

Written statements have been prepared by
officers assisting in the investigation of the
murder who were present when Yih Hai Sung confessed
to the crime. These are a direct denial to the
charges of torture.
pages.zh:
27/7。

并未实施谋杀（这是他第一次撤回供词），并向律师提供了关于案发当晚其行踪的信息。当法律顾问询问他为何在公开法庭和书面陈述中承认一项他并未实施的谋杀罪时，囚犯表示，由于证人对他牵连甚深，他感到被迫这样做。

他还被问及自被捕以来受到警方的对待情况，并告知其顾问，待遇令人满意。

律师们还就叶海松嘴唇上疤痕的存在向他提问，并被告知这是由于他抓挠嘴唇导致该处形成疮口所致（这正是叶海松在公开法庭上声称由侦探用点燃的香烟头烫在肉上造成的同一处疤痕）。

协助调查谋杀案并在叶海松认罪时在场的警官已准备了书面陈述。这些陈述直接否认了酷刑指控。

pages.en:
27/8.

In this connection copies of written statements
by Mr. T. Robertson, Mr. S. Uyehara, D.S.I. Ross,
D.S.I. Shih Szu Chien, D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo, D.S. Tanaka
and Clerical Assistant T. Kawashima, are attached
hereto. Statements by D.S.I. Crowther and D.S.I.
Nakamura will be prepared later.

During the course of the hearing of the case
Judge Dzien questioned the 3rd accused Yih Hai Sung
regarding his movements on the night of the murder
(9/11/36). The 3rd accused gave a reply very similar
to that made to his legal representatives, on the
21/5/36, at Chengtu Road Station (Please see Diary
No. 26 Sheet No.1 of this file), to the effect that
he was present at either one or the other of the
following three places:-
(1) Gave a dinner party at the Dah Chung Hwa (大中華)
Restaurant, 13 Paoshan Road, Chapei, in celebration
of the birthday of his mother, ordering one or two
tables of food.
(2) Attended the grand opening of the Nanyang Cabaret,
2 Kwangtung Ka (廣東街), North Szechuen Road, on
which date he spent the whole of the evening there
and assisted one named Yue (俞) in assaulting
a dancing girl, when a disturbance ensued.
pages.zh:
8月27日。

为此，附上T. Robertson先生、S. Uyehara先生、副巡官Ross、副巡官施子健（Shih Szu Chien）、副巡官范图福（Van Tuh Foo）、副巡佐Tanaka以及文书助理T. Kawashima的书面陈述副本。副巡官Crowther和副巡官Nakamura的陈述将稍后准备。

在案件审理过程中，Dzien法官就谋杀案发生当晚（1936年11月9日）的行踪讯问了第三被告易海松（Yih Hai Sung）。第三被告作出的答复与他在1936年5月21日于成都路捕房向其法律代表所作的供述非常相似（请参阅本案卷宗第26号日记第1页），大意是他当时身处以下三个地点中的某一个：
(1) 在闸北宝山路13号大中华餐厅（Dah Chung Hwa Restaurant）举办晚宴，庆祝其母亲寿辰，预订了一两桌酒席。
(2) 出席位于北四川路广东街2号的南洋舞厅（Nanyang Cabaret）盛大开业典礼，当晚他全程在场，并协助一名姓俞（Yue）的人殴打一名舞女，随后引发骚乱。

27/9.

(3) On the 9/11/35, or days around that date, was
either in Room No.9 of the Moon Palace Hotel,
North Szechuen Road, or in the Moon Palace
Ballroom situated in the same building. The
following persons may prove my statement that
I was present:-
(1) Au Tseng Kui (夏友記)
(2) Dzung Keng Sung (莊根生)
(3) Wang Ah Kyung (黃阿鈞)
The above three persons used to play

(4) Zee Ling Sung (徐林森), the chief tenant

Year of the Republic of China). Efforts are at

(1) 夏友记（Au Tseng Kui）
(2) 莊根生（Dzung Keng Sung）
(3) 黃阿鈞（Wang Ah Kyung）
以上三人常与我一起打“挖花”牌。
(4) 徐林森（Zee Ling Sung），法租界维尔蒙路（Rue Veillement）鹤鸣里4号的主租客。
(5) 袁双喜（Yuan Shou Shi），月宫老板。
(6) 宓寶生（Mih Pao Sung），月宫稽查员。
(7) 郁康德（Yoh Kong Tuh），月宫糖果小贩。
(8) 施根弟（Sze Keng Dee），首席茶房。

关于第1点（在大中华餐厅举办的晚宴），第26号日记第2页已提及，1936年5月22日对该餐厅的调查证实，确实举行过一场晚宴，但日期是1935年11月10日（中华民国二十四年农历十月十五）。目前正

present being made to locate the mother and paramour
of Yih Hai Sung, with a view to establishing if the
dinner party really was held to celebrate the former's
birthday.
    With reference to Point No.2 (His attendance at
the Nanyang Cabaret), enquiries at the Licensing
Section of the Bureau of Public Safety, Nantao,
ascertained that the permit for the grand opening
of the Nanyang Cabaret was issued to one named Tseu
Tai Ching (周岱青) on April 13, 1935. Further
enquiries elicited the fact that the cabaret has since
been opened and closed on a number of occasions.
    The witness Tsang Zai Yuen (张财源) was
formerly employed in this cabaret, and when questioned
he stated that it was not the grand opening of the
cabaret in April, 1935 to which Yih Hai Sung referred,
but to the re-opening of the cabaret under new
management and under the name of the Nanyang Kong
Kee Cabaret, on November 8th, 1935 ( The day prior to
the murder ). He, Tsang, recalls a scuffle having
occurred on this particular night, at about 7 p.m.,
between one known as Wei Ming (魏明) ( a follower of
Yih Hai Sung ) and a dancing partner, but it did not
assume any proportion and was soon amicably settled
with the assistance of employees. The witness, Tsang,
pages.zh:
10月27日。

努力寻找易海松的母亲及其情妇，以核实该晚宴是否确为庆祝前者生日而举办。
    关于第2点（他出席南洋舞厅的情况），经向南市公共安全局执照科查询，查明南洋舞厅的开业许可证于1935年4月13日颁发给一名叫周岱青（Tseu Tai Ching）的人。进一步查询得知，该舞厅此后曾多次开业和停业。
    证人张财源（Tsang Zai Yuen）曾受雇于该舞厅，受询时他表示，易海松所指的不是1935年4月的舞厅盛大开业，而是1935年11月8日（谋杀案前一天）在新管理层下以“南洋公记舞厅”（Nanyang Kong Kee Cabaret）之名重新开业。证人张回忆说，当晚约晚上7点，一名叫魏明（Wei Ming）的人（易海松的追随者）与一名舞伴之间发生过争执，但事态并未扩大，并在员工的协助下很快和平解决。证人张

pages.en:
27/11.

states that Yih Hai Sung was not present in the
cabaret when this trouble occurred, but a few minutes
later he saw the 3rd accused standing in the alleyway,
outside the entrance to the cabaret.
On the 31/5/36, detectives succeeded in tracing
another former employee of the Nanyang Cabaret, one
named Yao Soong Ding (姚松亭), who was employed in
the cabaret in the capacity of an inspector. He
states through the influence of the former owner of
the cabaret, Tseu Tai Ching, he was appointed
inspector at a wage of $30.00 per month, by the new
owners, Shing Ming Tai (忻明泰) and Woo Mei-shing
(吳美興), who opened the establishment on the 8th
November, 1935, as the Nanyang Kong Kee Cabaret.
He also recalls the trouble on the opening
night between a patron and a dance girl, but believes
that this took place at about 8 p.m., he, however, can-
not recall the exact time. The 3rd accused Yih Hai
Sung is known to Yao Soong Ding, and he states that
Yih was not present in the ballroom when the trouble
occured.
This witness, Yao Soong Ding was able to produce
a letter from the management of the Nanyang Kong Kee
Cabaret authorizing his appointment as inspector,
which was tendered him at about 10 p.m. on the opening

11月27日。

称，骚乱发生时易海松并不在舞厅内，但几分钟后，他看见第三被告站在舞厅入口外的小巷里。
1936年5月31日，侦探成功找到另一名南洋舞厅前雇员姚松亭（Yao Soong Ding），他在舞厅担任稽查员。他说，通过舞厅前业主周岱青的关系，他被新业主忻明泰（Shing Ming Tai）和吳美興（Woo Mei-shing）任命为稽查员，月薪30元，这两人于1935年11月8日以“南洋公记舞厅”之名开设该场所。
他也记得开业当晚一名顾客与一名舞女之间发生的纠纷，但他认为这发生在晚上8点左右，不过他不记得确切时间。姚松亭认识第三被告易海松，他说纠纷发生时易不在舞厅内。
证人姚松亭出示了一封由南洋公记舞厅管理层发出的信函，授权任命他为稽查员，该信是在开业

pages.en:
27/12.

night. This letter is dated November 8th, 1935,
which would tend to confirm that the cabaret was
opened on that date. This letter will be produced
as an exhibit in Court.

Written statements have been obtained from
these two witnesses, who have been warned to be present
in court at the next hearing of the case.

Detectives are still endeavouring to locate
some member of the management of the Nanyang Cabaret,
but owing to the fact that the establishment was
forced to shut its doors and declare bankruptcy, after
operating for a few days, some of the members of the
management have absconded and others changed their
address and it is proving a difficult proposition to
trace them.

With reference to Point No.3 ( In which Yih Hai
Sung contends that he was either present in Room No.9
of the Moon Palace Hotel, or the Moon Palace Ballroom,
on the night of the murder ), detectives have continued
their enquiries in search of the persons named by Yih
Hai Sung, as likely to vouch for his presence in
either the hotel or ballroom on the night of the murder.

On the 31/5/36, detectives succeeded in locating
the 5th mentioned person Yuan Shou Shi ( 袁雙喜 ),
sub-manager of the Moon Palace Ballroom. He when
questioned stated that he recalled the night of the

当晚约10点交给他的。这封信的日期是1935年11月8日，这倾向于证实舞厅是在该日开业的。此信将作为法庭证物提交。

已从这两名证人处获得书面陈述，并已警告他们在案件下次开庭时出庭。

侦探仍在努力寻找南洋舞厅管理层的某些成员，但由于该场所在营业几天后被迫关门并宣布破产，部分管理人员潜逃，其他人则更改了地址，因此追踪他们被证明是一项困难的任务。

关于第3点（易海松声称谋杀案当晚他要么在月宫酒店9号房间，要么在月宫舞厅），侦探继续调查，寻找易海松提到的、可能证明他在谋杀案当晚身在酒店或舞厅的人员。

1936年5月31日，侦探成功找到上述第5人袁雙喜（Yuan Shou Shi），月宫舞厅副经理。受询时，他表示清楚地记得日本水兵被杀的那晚，并肯定易海松当晚没有去过舞厅。他说易只是偶尔去舞厅。
1936年6月1日，侦探也找到了上述第6人宓宝生（Mih Pao Sung），他在月宫舞厅担任稽查员，他 corroborated（佐证）了袁双喜的陈述，即第三被告在谋杀案当晚没有去过舞厅。

murder of the Japanese sailor quite clearly and he

One named Dao Tsoo Zung (陶祖馴) at present
employed in the Entertainment Bureau of the Tsingtao
City Government, at the beginning of November 1935 met
Yang Tsoo Zung (楊祖繩) brother-in-law of the 3rd
accused Yih Hai Sung in Tsingtao and informed him that
he intended to proceed to Shanghai to engage dancing
girls for the "Hollywood Cabaret", Tsingtao. Yang Tsoo
Zung gave him a letter of introduction to the 3rd accused,
who was then residing at No.13 San Shing Li, (三新里)
Jukong Road. Dao Tsoo Zung left Tsingtao for Shanghai
on the 18/9/35 and later went to the 3rd accused's home.
About eight dancing girls and two boys were engaged by
Dao Tsoo Zung and they with the 3rd accused arrived in
Tsingtao on or about the 29/11/35. The "Hollywood
Cabaret" opened on the 1/12/35/ Dao Tsoe Zung returned
to Tsingtao on the 1st or 2nd December 1935.

The 3rd accused only remained in the Hollywood

这次引荐导致第三被告与唐铁英之间起草了一份协议。在协议中，唐铁英使用了他兄弟唐貽純（Tong Yee Zung）的名字，因为他不希望员工知道他在经营舞厅业务。

一家名为维也纳（Vienna）的舞厅资本分为两股，第三被告持有一股500美元，而唐氏持有2,000美元。

Junior Middle School (廣東中學), Paoyuen Road (寶源路),
Chapel, to interview Dzung Hong Pih in order to check
pages.zh:
29/3.

1936年5月18日下午3点30分（见日志第25卷第18页），同山路永吉里71号的大房东朱申甫 (Tsze Sung Foo) 指认第四被告为东益协会的成员之一，该成员偶尔在该处过夜，并且在10月、11月和12月期间，他看到第四被告经常出入该处，身穿一套深蓝色西装，相当完好，没有任何破损。
第四被告未透露其他不在场证明，在整个审讯过程中，他无法说出1935年11月9日可能见过的人的姓名。
关于第6点。这在日志第20卷第1-2和3页中已有提及。
1936年4月21日下午5点至7点间，在北站分局局长梁督察的配合下，日本领事馆警察的刑事侦缉督察 Nakamura 和侦探 Sato 访问了位于宝源路的广东中学礼拜堂，以面谈郑宏璧，以此核实

pages.en:
29/4.

upon certain information that had been received. It
was at this time that Supt. Liang handed to D.S.I.
Nakamura a petition addressed to him by Dzung Hong Pih,
and a letter she had received purporting to come from
Ying ( 英 ), Chief of the Women's Department, signed
on behalf of Yang Vung Dao.

Enquiries showed that the letter was posted at
11 a.m. on the 19/4/36 at the General Post Office,
North Soochow Road, and delivered at 12 m.d. on the
19/4/36. Further enquiries have failed to reveal the
origin of this letter.

With reference to point 7. There was no constable
of the Shanghai Municipal Police on duty at the place
where the pistol was found. The nearest constable to
this point was C.P.C. 3251, who was on point duty at
the intersection of North Szechuen and Dixwell Roads.
He was questioned by D.S.I. Crowther on the 9/11/35
when he stated at about 9 p.m. on the 9/11/35 he had
not seen any person leaving the Fong Loh Li in a hurried
manner, and that he had not heard the sound of a shot
being fired.

The approximate positions of the Shanghai Municipal
Police on duty at about 9 p.m. on the 9/11/35 were as
follows:-

C.P.C. 2864 and 2891 were at North Szechuen Road
pages.zh:
29/4.

收到的某些情报。就在此时，梁督察将郑宏璧写给他的请愿书，以及她收到的一封据称来自妇女部主任英 (Ying) 并以杨云道名义签署的信件，交给了刑事侦缉督察 Nakamura。

调查显示，该信件于1936年4月19日上午11点在苏州河北路邮政总局寄出，并于1936年4月19日中午12点送达。进一步的调查未能揭示这封信的来源。

关于第7点。发现手枪的地点没有上海公共租界工部局警务处的巡捕执勤。离该地点最近的巡捕是编号3251的中国巡捕，他当时正在北四川路与狄思威路路口执行定点执勤任务。刑事侦缉督察 Crowther 于1935年11月9日对他进行了讯问，他表示在1935年11月9日晚9点左右，他没有看到任何人匆忙离开丰乐里，也没有听到枪声。

1935年11月9日晚9点左右，上海公共租界工部局警务处执勤巡捕的大致位置如下：-

中国巡捕编号2864和2891在北四川路

pages.en:
29/5.

and Kiangwan Road junction opposite the Headquarters
of the Japanese Naval Landing Party.
C.P.C. 2760 was at North Szechuen Road and Darroch
Roads corner.
C.P.C. 213 was at North Szechuen Road and Dixwell
Roads corner.
J.P.C. 173 was at Darroch Road and North Szechuen
Road corner.
J.P.C. 92 was at north Szechuen Road and Scott
Road corner.
All these officers were questioned by D.S.I.
Crowther immediately after the crime was committed
but all of them were unable to impart any information
regarding any suspicious persons being seen before or
after the crime.
To rebut the statement of the 1st accused
made in the S.S.D. Court, to the effect that the
"Practical Physics" book was placed in his house
by Yang Kyi Tsoong (楊紀忠), the following points
are brought forward.
In addition to the 1st accused admitting in the
first instance, both in open Court and the Police
Station, that the book was his property, the 2nd
accused, Tsung Yong Sung (陳榮生) ( released ) in
his statement states, " I have been upstairs in Yang's
pages.zh:
29/5.

与江湾路交界处，正对日本海军陆战队总部。
中国巡捕编号2760在北四川路与达罗路转角。
中国巡捕编号213在北四川路与狄思威路转角。
日本巡捕编号173在达罗路与北四川路转角。
日本巡捕编号92在北四川路与斯科特路转角。
案发后，刑事侦缉督察 Crowther 立即讯问了所有这些警员，但他们均无法提供关于在案发前后看到任何可疑人员的信息。
为了反驳第一被告在特区法院所作的关于“《实用物理学》书籍是由楊紀忠 (Yang Kyi Tsoong) 放置在他家中”的陈述，现提出以下几点。
除了第一被告起初在公开法庭和警察局均承认该书为其所有物外，第二被告陳榮生 (Tsung Yong Sung)（已释放）在其陈述中表示，“我曾上过杨家的楼

pages.en:
29/6.

room only when I was instructed by Yang. Yang very
rarely reads books, and, if he does he generally
reads Chinese novels. When I first went to Yang's
house, 3 years ago, I did see a book of greenish
colour with hard cardboard cover. I have never opened
the book. It was left on a box in Yang's room. I saw
it when dusting the room. I have touched it but never
opened it."

In the presence of Mr. Uyehare, Assistant
Commissioner of Police, D.S.I. Crowther and Shih
Szu Chien, Dzung Yong Sung at the time he was making
his statement identified the seized book from among
five other books.

in the case of the 3rd accused, Yih Hai Sung,
after retracting his confession to the crime in the
S.S.D. Court, he stated that during the 8th, 9th and
10th November 1935, he was busily engaged writing
invitation cards for his mother's birthday.

Enquiries in this connection show that the
invitation cards were written by the 3rd accused's
brother-in-law, Yang Tsoo-zung (楊祖繩) and one
named Tsang Kung Sung (張根生) at the beginning

7/11/35/. Tsang Sai Yuen received an invitation card

6月29日。

只有在杨指示我的时候，我才进入那个房间。杨很少读书，如果读的话，他通常读中国小说。三年前我第一次去杨家时，确实看到一本封面为硬纸板、颜色发绿的书。我从未打开过那本书。它被放在杨房间的一个箱子上。我在打扫房间时看到了它。我摸过它，但从未打开过。”

在警务处助理总监上原先生（Mr. Uyehare）、警探长克劳瑟（D.S.I. Crowther）和施士杰（Shih Szu Chien）在场的情况下，钟永松（Dzung Yong Sung）在作供时从另外五本书中指认出了被查获的那本书。

关于第三被告叶海松（Yih Hai Sung），他在特别巡捕房法庭（S.S.D. Court）撤回认罪供词后称，在1935年11月8日、9日和10日期间，他正忙于为其母亲生日撰写请柬。

对此事的调查显示，这些请柬是由第三被告的姐夫杨祖绳（Yang Tsoo-zung）和一名叫张根生（Tsang Kung Sung）的人在1935年11月初撰写的，并于1935年11月7日之前分发。张赛元（Tsang Sai Yuen）于1935年11月2日或3日收到了一张请柬。

29/7.

It is also learned that the 3rd accused during
the year 1934 held two parties in honour of his
mother's birthday, one in April and the other in
December 1934.
It is known these parties are given by persons
of the loafer class on such a pretext in order to make
pecuniary gain.
A summons was served on Lee Hoong Ping on
the 12/6/36 by D.S.I. Van Tuh Foo.
A summons has also been issued for Yao Goong
Ding (姚松亭) - he is at present absent from

The case is set for hearing at 2 p.m. on
the 16/6/36.

另获悉，第三被告在1934年期间曾为其母亲生日举办过两次聚会，一次在4月，另一次在1934年12月。
众所周知，这类游手好闲之徒常以此为借口举办聚会，以谋取钱财利益。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

During the hearing in the S.S.D.Court on the

Court that one named Liang Shuen Ling (梁華令)
alias Liang Chih ( 梁傑 ) employed in No.13A
Godown of the China Navigation Co., Ltd. had told
him that the pistols he saw in the godown were the
property of the 1st accused, Yang Vung Dao.

Enquiries by D.S.I.s Crowther and Shih Sau
Chien ascertained that Liang Chih on the 17/6/36
left his employment without permission.

On the afternoon of the 20/6/36 Mr. Grove,
counsel for the 1st accused, informed the undersigned
by telephone that Liang Chih had approached him for
advice as he had learned the Police wished to interview
him. Mr. Grove stated that he would bring the witness
to the Police on the 22/6/36, however, this did not
materialize.

On the 24/6/36 the undersigned communicated by
telephone with Mr. Grove when he stated the witness had
refused to attend the Police Station and that he had
left Shanghai for Canton.

A letter dated the 27/6/36 has been obtained
from the Godown Superintendent of the China Navigation
Co., Ltd. which is to the effect that Liang Shuen Ling
has been absent without leave from the 17/6/36.

在1936年6月16日特别巡捕房法庭的聆讯中，第三被告叶海松告诉法庭，一名叫梁华令（Liang Shuen Ling），别名梁杰（Liang Chih）的人，受雇于中国轮船公司（China Navigation Co., Ltd.）第13A号仓库，曾告诉他，他在仓库里看到的手枪是第一被告杨云道的财产。

1936年6月20日下午，第一被告的辩护律师格罗夫先生（Mr. Grove）通过电话通知本人，梁杰因得知警方希望约谈他而前来寻求建议。格罗夫先生表示，他将于1936年6月22日带该证人到警局，然而此事并未发生。

1936年6月24日，本人与格罗夫先生通电话，他表示证人拒绝前往警察局，并已离开上海前往广州。

已收到中国轮船公司仓库主管 dated 1936年6月27日的来信，信中称梁华令自1936年6月17日起无故缺勤。

July 29, 1936.
Murder

On the 20-7-36, a despatch summons was received
from the S.S.D. Court through the M.A.'s Office in
respect of the witness, Poo Chau Ying (潘巧英). On
the 21-7l36, C.D.C. 119 left Shanghai for Kau-yeu,
Kompo, and returned on the 26-7-36 with the witness and
her father.

On the morning of the 28-7-36, the three accused
appeared before Judge Siao in the S.S. D. Court, and the
testimony of Poo Chau-ying was taken.

The case was remanded sine-die.

At 9.30 p.m. on the 28-7-36, in the presence of
Judge Siao, Mr. Ru, A/M.A., Mr. Uyehara, A.C.P., and
D.S.I.s Crowther and Van Tuh Foo, Poo Chau Ying recon-
structed her movements as on the night of the 9-11-35.

It will be recalled in a statement of Poo Chau
Ying taken by D.S.I. Crowther on the 11-11-35, she
stated when proceeding South on Darroch Road, returning
from the Ming Tuh Fong (敏德坊), North Szechuen Road
Extension, carrying a Japanese baby, near a hot water
shop situated on the East side of Darroch Road ( 70 feet
South of the scene of crime ), she met two men, one a
Japanese sailor walking North on Darroch Road on the
West side and the other, walking parallel with the
sailor in the same direction on the East side, who wore
dark foreign styled clothing. She passed between the
two men, being nearest to the civilian. She had

176/35。

1月24日。

狄思威路
1936年7月29日。
谋杀案

1936年7月20日，通过市公署检察官办公室收到来自特别巡捕房法庭的移送传票，涉及证人潘巧英（Poo Chau Ying）。1936年7月21日，华籍侦探主任119号（C.D.C. 119）离开上海前往高邮（Kau-yeu）、甘泉（Kompo），并于1936年7月26日带着证人及其父亲返回。

1936年7月28日上午，三名被告在特别巡捕房法庭萧法官面前出庭，并记录了潘巧英的证词。

案件无限期延期。

1936年7月28日晚上9点30分，在萧法官、代理市公署检察官鲁先生（Mr. Ru）、助理警务总监上原先生（Mr. Uyehara, A.C.P.）以及警探长克劳瑟和范土福在场的情况下，潘巧英重现了她1935年11月9日晚上的行动轨迹。

回顾警探长克劳瑟于1935年11月11日记录的潘巧英供词，她陈述道，当她抱着一个日本婴儿，从四川北路延伸段的敏德坊（Ming Tuh Fong）回来，沿达罗克路（Darroch Road）向南行走时，在达罗克路东侧的一家热水店附近（距犯罪现场以南70英尺），她遇到了两名男子，一名是日本水手，正沿达罗克路西侧向北行走，另一名男子穿着深色西式服装，与水手平行且在东侧同向行走。她从两人之间穿过，离那名平民更近。她曾

pages.en:
34/2.
 reached a spot ( 38 feet beyond where she met the men )
where she heard the sound of an explosion.
 She immediately turned round and saw a Japanese
sailor lying on the West side of the roadway, but did
not see the civilian. She then ran through the hot
water shop into Wing On Terrace and returned to her
employer's address.
 She reiterated the foregoing to Judge Siao at the
scene of the crime, with the exception that she did not
completely turn round, but made a half turn which only
allowed for her seeing the sailor lying on the west
side of the road.
 Judge Siao ordered his chauffeur to don the navy
blue pin striped suit seized in Tsingtao, and which the
3rd accused Yih Hai Sung stated he wore when he commit-
ted the crime. Poo Chau Ying stated the colour was
similar but that she could not remember the exact style.
 The suit is a double breasted one and the jacket
when buttoned fits closely to the body.
 This completed the reconstruction and Judge Siao
stated through the medium of Mr. Ru that the witness
would not be required again and that she could return
to the country.
 In perusal of the translation of the documents
seized in this case there is a letter numbered B 36-9-18,
addressed to Yang Yung Dao, 1st accused, by the 3rd
pages.zh:
34/2。
到达一个地点（在她遇到那两人的地方再往前38英尺），在那里她听到了爆炸声。
她立即转身，看到一名日本水手躺在道路西侧，但没有看到那名平民。随后她跑过热水店进入永安里（Wing On Terrace），并返回雇主住址。
她在犯罪现场向萧法官重申了上述内容，不同的是她并没有完全转身，而是转了半圈，这使她只能看到躺在路西的水手。
萧法官命令他的司机穿上在青岛查获的海军蓝细条纹西装，第三被告叶海松曾称他在作案时穿着这套西装。潘巧英表示颜色相似，但她记不清确切的款式。
这套西装是双排扣的，上衣扣上时紧贴身体。
重现过程至此结束，萧法官通过鲁先生表示，不再需要该证人作证，她可以返回乡下。
在查阅本案查获文件的译文时，有一封编号为 B 36-9-18 的信件，由第三

pages.en:
24/3.
accused, Yih Hai Sung , signed by him and giving his
address, Vienna Cabaret, 22 Chang Kow Road, Tsingtao.
Although not dated, this letter was obviously sent
after the 3rd accused entered into the business of the
Vienna Cabaret, 7-12-35, and before he come to Shanghai
to engage dancing girls which was the 9-12-35 or 10-22-
35.
The letter intimated that the 3rd accused went to
Tsingtao with a view to establishing the Vienna Cabaret,
and as he had been busy he was unable to write to his
sworn brothers, but that he was still concerned with
the affairs of the association, and that when he came
to Shanghai to obtain more girls he would call on the
1st accused Yang Vung Dao.
The 3rd accused denied having any connection with
the 1st accused after the crime, but this letter goes
to prove otherwise.

虽然没有注明日期，但这封信显然是在第三被告于1935年12月7日接手维也纳歌舞厅生意之后，以及他于1935年12月9日或1935年10月22日（原文如此）来上海招募舞女之前寄出的。
信中提到，第三被告前往青岛是为了创办维也纳歌舞厅，由于忙碌，他未能给他的结拜兄弟写信，但他仍然关心帮会的事务，并且当他来上海招募更多女孩时，会拜访第一被告杨云道。
第三被告否认在犯罪后与第一被告有任何联系，但这封信证明了事实并非如此。

D.S.I. Nakamura (Special Branch):- On the 9.11.35 on Darreek
Road, a Japanese Marine by the name of Nakayama was murdered, hav-
ing been shot dead with a pistol. A bullet was found 90 yards from
the scene of the murder and has been duly examined by experts, as
has this pistol (produced). The bullet was fired from this pistol.
Since the commission of the crime, the Police have continued in mak-
ing exhaustive enquiries. One named Hirayama (A Japanese) informed

回上海，昨日抵达，并根据《引渡协定》尽快被带至法庭。
我这里有青岛警察局的一封复函，确认本庭签发的移送令在其辖区内已执行。（呈堂）。关于昨天的案件，展示了一把枪和一本挖空页面以容纳枪支的书（呈堂）。手枪就藏在书里（呈堂）。这支手枪已经过检验，在距离谋杀现场90码处发现的子弹也是如此。经鉴定，该子弹确由这支手枪发射。我这里还有一份名为曾元 (Tsang Ynan) 的证人的陈述书（呈堂）。他正从青岛前往上海。根据这位证人的陈述，该被告与用于谋杀的手枪（物证）有关联。一名侦探在场，他将提供关于逮捕、移交的证据，以及本庭要求的其他证据，以支持根据申请所依据条款对其进行的拘留。第一和第二被告的案件已延期至1936年4月27日。我请求将该被告拘留至该日期，以待调查完成，届时可进行联合审判。

分区督察 中村 (特别支部):- 1935年11月9日，在达里克路（Darreek Road），一名名叫中山 (Nakayama) 的日本海军陆战队员被用手枪射杀身亡。在距离谋杀现场90码处发现了一颗子弹，专家和这支手枪（呈堂）都经过了适当检验。子弹是从这支手枪射出的。自犯罪发生以来，警方持续进行详尽调查。一名叫平山 (Hirayama)（日本人）的人告诉我，该被告和其他三人，其中两名是中国人，另一人是名叫 Jaak 的朝鲜人，参与了谋杀。此后不久，我从同一来源收到进一步情报，称第三名被告萧光东 (Siao Kwangtung) 和前述朝鲜人

ed walked North to South on Darrock Road, and two others followed.

(particular Bureau not mentioned). The rd accused received the
pistol (produced) from the Korean named Jack, and at this time
the victim was seen to make his approach on Darrock Road. At a
given signal, the 3rd accused fired the fatal shot. They all de-
camped in the direction of the Foong Loh Li off Darrock Road.
Later I received further information from the same person Hirayama
that this accused and his confederates were members of an associat-
ion styled the San Huh Wei. The 1st accused is said to be the
head of the Doong Zung Association. I have here an organization
table of the organisation I speak of. (handed to Judge). I was
introduced by my informant to a Cantonese named Tsung Yuan, he
also is a member of the Doong Zung Society mentioned. This was
in November 1935. He stated that sometime in 1935, the 3rd accus-
ed went to his premises, and took this pistol (produced) and that
he asked for some money, and placed the pistol as security. When
Tsung Yuan asked the 3rd accused who owned the pistol, he stated
that it was not his property, but belonged to the Korean referred
to as Jack. In the meantime, Tsung Yuan's wife appeared on the
scene, and she told her husband Tsung Yuan, that he must not give
money to the 3rd accused under any circumstances, and her request
was obeyed. It is in this instance, that Tsung Yuan remembers the
pistol and that is this exhibit. He stated that he could identify
the pistol, because it had a round mark on the handle, and two
foreign characters. He could not remember the number of the pistol
In view of the statement of Tsung Yuan, we took him to Japanese
premises at 38 Scott Road, Shanghai, where I had four pistols, the
exhibit being one of them. Tsung Yuan immediately picked out the
exhibit, as the pistol, brought by the 3rd accused to his premises.

Jack 确实参与其中。包括该被告在内的三人沿达罗克路从北向南行走，另外两人跟随。
据说后者中的一人是 P.3.Bureau 的官员（未提及具体部门）。第三被告从名叫 Jack 的朝鲜人手中接过手枪（呈堂），此时受害者被看到正沿达罗克路走近。接到信号后，第三被告开枪射出致命一枪。随后他们全部朝达罗克路旁的凤乐里（Foong Loh Li）方向逃窜。
后来我从同一人平山那里收到进一步情报，称该被告及其同伙是一个名为“三合会”（San Huh Wei）的协会的成员。据说第一被告是“东宗会”（Doong Zung Association）的头目。我这里有我所谈组织的组织结构表。（递交给法官）。我的线人向我介绍了一位名叫宗元 (Tsung Yuan) 的广东人，他也是上述东宗社的成员。那是1935年11月。他说，1935年的某个时候，第三被告来到他的住所，拿走了这支手枪（呈堂），并向他要钱，将手枪作为抵押。当宗元问第三被告手枪是谁的时，他说那不是他的财产，而是属于那个被称为 Jack 的朝鲜人。与此同时，宗元的妻子出现在现场，她告诉丈夫宗元，无论如何都不能给钱给第三被告，她的要求得到了遵从。正是在这种情况下，宗元记住了这支手枪，也就是这件物证。他说他能认出这支手枪，因为手柄上有一个圆形标记和两个外国字符。他不记得手枪的号码
鉴于宗元的陈述，我们带他去了上海斯科特路38号的日本机构所在地，那里我有四支手枪，物证是其中之一。宗元立即挑出了物证，即第三被告带到他住所的那支手枪。

Mr. Fu:- The pistol (produced) has been examined and it is
found that it fired the fatal shot on the night of the 9.11.35.
The bullet found at the scene of the murder, was fired from the
exhibit.

Witness continuing:- The pistol (produced) was identified in
another room, where I took the witness. After this, I received
information, that the 3rd accused had gone to Tsingtao on the 20th
or 22nd of December. Prior to the murder, enquiries have proved
that the 3rd accused was a very poor man, now he has been squander-
ing hundreds of dollars. He lost $200 in gambling and spent $500
or $600 in taking Chinese Dancing Girls to Tsingtao, where he sub-
sequently managed a cabaret there, holding a $500 share of the
business. One named Tong is the other partner and invested $2,000
in the business. In February of this year, the accused returned
to Shanghai and spent a lot of money at the Yangtze Hotel, on
girls and other forms of amusement. He subsequently returned to
Tsingtao. My informant again informed me that the 3rd accused was
ordered to murder the sailor by the 1st accused. Having received
all this information, the 3rd accused was strongly suspected, and
a Dispatch Warrant was applied for. Meantime I had another detect-
ive J.D.S.151 Tanaka at Tsingtao, and he sent a telegram of the
accused's whereabouts. However the Extradition Dispatch was issued
and I proceeded to Tsingtao by Airplane on the 12.4.36. I found
that the accused was operating the cabaret at 22 Tsingtao Road and
we attended as guests in the first instance, when I found out the
partnership already mentioned. On the 15th of April the Dispatch
Warrant arrived from Shanghai and we attended at the Headquarters of
the P.S.Bureau, where we saw a Mr. Tong and a Mr. Liu. Their assist-

傅先生：- 经检验，（呈堂的）手枪确系在1935年11月9日晚发射了致命子弹。在谋杀现场发现的子弹，正是由该证物射出的。

证人继续陈述：- （呈堂的）手枪是在另一个房间里被指认的，当时我带证人去了那里。此后，我收到情报，称第三被告已于12月20日或22日前往青岛。在谋杀案发生前，调查已证实第三被告曾是一名非常贫穷的人，而现在他却在挥霍数百美元。他在赌博中输掉了200美元，并花费500或600美元带中国舞女去青岛，随后他在那里经营一家歌舞厅，持有价值500美元的股份。另一位名为唐（Tong）的人是合伙人，在该业务中投资了2,000美元。今年二月，被告返回上海，在扬子饭店（Yangtze Hotel）在舞女及其他娱乐活动上花费了大量金钱。随后他又返回青岛。我的线人再次向我通报，第三被告是受第一被告指使去谋杀那名水手的。在掌握所有这些情报后，第三被告受到强烈怀疑，于是申请了逮捕令。与此同时，我在青岛还有另一名侦探，编号J.D.S.151的田中（Tanaka），他发来电报报告了被告的行踪。然而，引渡逮捕令已经签发，我于1936年4月12日乘飞机前往青岛。我发现被告正在青岛路22号经营歌舞厅，我们起初以客人身份前往，从而查明了前述的合伙关系。4月15日，逮捕令从上海送达，我们前往警察局总部，在那里见到了唐先生和刘先生。寻求他们的协助——

ance was sought, and the accused was duly arrested at his carbarat.

him to Shanghai on the 20.4.36 by the Kobe Maru.

IN REPLY TO THE JUDGE:- I was not in Tsingtao when the Ex-
tradition Dispatch was applied for. A telegram was sent to me by
J.D.S.151 Tanaka. He did not mention on the telegram that the
accused had been arrested. He merely reported his presence at the
carbarat. I did not state that the 3rd accused had already been
arrested when the Extradition Dispatch was applied for.

Mr. Rai:- If Your Honour pleases, the witness is only a Detect-
ive Sub Inspector, and must take orders from A.C. Police Mr. Ro-
binson, to whom all information in the case was conveyed. The
latter officer informed the Legal Department of the S.M.Council,
and the Municipal Advocate applied for the Extradition Dispatch,
when the 3rd accused had been definitely located in Tsingtao. If
any mistake has been made in the matter of the Extradition Dispat-
ch, it has been made by Police Headquarters and not by the wit-
ness.

Witness:- I took the Extradition Dispatch to Tsingtao myself.
Judge:- Did the Dispatch stipulate that the 3rd accused had to
be handed over to you or that he had yet to be arrested.
Witness:- Mr. Wong head of the P.S.Bureau asked me if the ac-
cused had been arrested, I replied in the negative, he did not offer
any comment, and immediately agreed to assist in the arrest of the
3rd accused. I personally thought that the 3rd accused had been
arrested.

Judge:- Since you found out that the 3rd accused had not been
arrested, did it not occur to you that you must apply for another
Dispatch Warrant stipulating that the accused had to be arrested
with the assistance of the authorities at Tsingtao?

并在其歌舞厅内正式逮捕了被告。这发生在1936年4月15日晚上11点。他被拘留在警察局总部，随后移交给本人。我于1936年4月20日通过“神户丸”（Kobe Maru）将他带回上海。

回答法官提问：- 在申请引渡逮捕令时，我并不在青岛。田中（J.D.S.151 Tanaka）给我发了一封电报。他在电报中并未提及被告已被逮捕。他只是报告了被告出现在歌舞厅的情况。我并没有声称在申请引渡逮捕令时第三被告已经被捕。

雷先生：- 如果法庭允许，证人仅是一名副巡官，必须听从警务处助理处长罗宾逊（Robinson）先生的命令，案件的所有情报均汇报给了后者。该官员将情况通报给工部局法律处，市政律师在第三被告被明确锁定位于青岛后，申请了引渡逮捕令。如果在引渡逮捕令事宜上有任何错误，那是警察总局犯下的，而非证人之过。

证人：- 我亲自将引渡逮捕令带到了青岛。
法官：- 逮捕令是否规定必须将第三被告移交给您，还是规定他尚待逮捕？
证人：- 警察局局长黄先生问我被告是否已被逮捕，我回答没有，他没有发表任何评论，并立即同意协助逮捕第三被告。我个人认为第三被告已经被捕。

法官：- 既然你发现第三被告并未被捕，难道你没有想到必须申请另一份逮捕令，明确规定需在青岛当局的协助下逮捕被告吗？

At the moment they are detained by the local authorities.

3rd accused:- My alias is Siao Kwang Tung. I am a carberet manager at Tsingtao. I did not shoot the Japanese Marine. I know nothing about the matter. How do I know who shot him? I know nothing about it. I never had a pistol, I do not even know how to hold one. I know a Korean named Jack, I had a fight with him last year in Shanghai. One named Lee introduced me to this man. 第三被告：- 我的别名是萧光东（Siao Kwang Tung，音译）。我是青岛的一名歌舞厅经理。我没有射击那名日本海军陆战队员。我对这件事一无所知。我怎么知道是谁开枪打的他？我对此一无所知。我从未拥有过手枪，我甚至不知道如何持枪。我认识一个叫杰克（Jack）的韩国人，去年我在上海和他打过架。一个姓李的人把我介绍给这个人。他向我要2美元，我拒绝给他。我从未去过证人宗元（Tsung Yuan，音译）的家。我从未借过钱，也没有用手枪或任何其他手枪作为抵押。我的妻子是一名舞女，每月收入200至300美元，所以我为什么要借钱呢？她做舞女已经七年了。我对证人宗元一无所知。我不知道他是怎么认识我的。如果他是广东人，我仍然不认识他。

就本案而言，事实上，警方本可以在今天对被告提出指控，但由于在此类案件中必须进行最充分的调查，警方恳请进一步还押候审。如果法庭允许，为了支持我关于进一步还押的请求，我将提及本案的要点，并特别说明某些事实，这些事实使警方强烈怀疑被告参与了谋杀。法庭相信发生了一起谋杀案，并且有一具尸体，即日本水手中山（Nakayama）的尸体，于1935年11月9日下午9点后不久在达罗克路（Darroch Road）被发现。

自那以后，警方继续进行全面调查，结果查明了一些事实，我稍后将提及，据此他们有非常充分的理由怀疑被告。

证物 (a)。 (1) 在离犯罪现场几码的地方，发现了一把手枪（呈堂），枪托上有一个圆圈，内有外文符号（P.B.）。

(2) 还发现了一颗子弹和一个空弹壳，工部局警务处武器专家对这些证物进行的检验无可辩驳地证明，该手枪（呈堂）被用于谋杀，且该子弹是由同一把手枪射出的。关于后者，警方不再提交更多证据，因为法庭会相信警方已经陈述的内容。然而，关于这把手枪，我将向法庭说明被告是如何与之产生关联的。

关于这把“Demon”手枪，上述提到的Lee Mah于1934年3月27日致信工部局警务处枪械科，声明他曾赠予朋友的“Demon”手枪87558号，工部局编号2617，已归还给他，因为他已离开上海。Lee Mah随即请求工部局警务处枪械科注销该把“Demon”手枪的记录。我即将向法庭陈述的这一证据点，或许是警方案件中最关键的要点之一。

编号为87558、工部局编号2617的“Demon”手枪未被警方找到，但警方此处有一把尺寸、口径及“等”特征相同的“Demon”手枪。所有.32口径的“Demon”手枪，其尺寸、外观“等”均相同。然而，如果尊敬的法官尝试将警方获得的这把“Demon”手枪插入证物C书的凹槽中，法官大人会发现，该手枪太大，无法放入凹槽。因此，这一证据点确凿地证实了第一被告的陈述是不实的。他显然在隐瞒某些事情，出于这个原因，警方对他高度怀疑。

(2) 2nd accused :-    The 2nd accused was living with
the 1st accused, and also belongs to the same association. The
2nd accused knows all about the book, having seen it on

The Police therefore consider that he is in some way connected
with the 1st accused, and for this reason his detention was
asked for.

(3) 3rd accused :-    I am about to relate some connection
between the 3rd accused and the pistol found at the scene of the
murder.
    (1)    The 3rd accused is unable to state his whereabouts
on the night of the 9.21.35, especially about 9.p.m. and there-
after. He does state however that he was in Shanghai. We have
a witness in court named Tsung Yuan, who can give testimony,
that sometime in September 1935, the 3rd accused went to his
the witnesses premises, and asked for the loan of $25. The
witness was well known to the 3rd accused, because they had
been together on several occasions, and also because the witness
is a money lender.    However when the 3rd accused asked for
the loan of the sum mentioned, the witness asked the 3rd accused
to supply two guarantors.    The 3rd accused being unable to
do this, caused the witness to refuse the loan.    The
following day in the Month of September 1935, the 3rd accused
is said to have again visited the premises of the witness in
connection with the loan.

(3) 第三被告：我即将陈述第三被告与在谋杀案现场发现的手枪之间的一些关联。

    Another important point in the case against the 3rd accused,
I would mention that a witness named Tsang Sam Yuen, can give
testimony in this court, that he knows the 3rd accused very well,
having been associated in the cabaret business together. This
witness also knows the Korean referred to as JACK, under similar
circumstances.    This witness states that on the evening
of the 9.11.35, shortly before the hour of 9.p.m., he was present
at the Moon Palace Cabaret, North Szechuen Road.    In a room
therein, he states that he saw the 3rd accused and the Korean
Jack.    He avers that he saw the Korean Jack, hand a pistol to
the 3rd accused, who appeared to refuse to take it, stating that
it should be given to one named PING.    This I would point out,
happened some minutes prior to the murder.    Later before the
murder, the witness states that he saw the Korean Jack, the 3rd
accused, and another man he does not know, about the same height
as Jack, but much leaner, making their way towards Darreck Road
towards the scene of the murder. The 3rd accused he avers was
wearing a Dr Sun's uniform.    After the murder had been
committed, this witness states that he saw the 3rd accused,
with the Korean Jack, and the other man unknown referred to,
hurrying from the scene of the murder on Darreck Road.    If the
statement of this witness be true, then the 3rd accused must
be able to state where he was on the night of the murder, yet
he states he cannot remember.    The witness Tsang Sam Yuen
states that he remembers the incident very well, because after the
murder was committed, there was some trouble in Chapel, and
having heard of the murder, his mind at once turned to the
3rd accused and his confederates, on three reasons.

at the Moon Palace.

    针对第三被告的案件中另一个重要要点，我要提及的是，一位名为Tsang Sam Yuen（音译）的证人可以在本庭作证，他非常了解第三被告，两人曾共同从事舞厅生意。这位证人在类似情况下也认识上述被称为JACK的朝鲜人。该证人陈述，1935年9月11日晚上，接近晚上9点时，他在北四川路的月宫舞厅（Moon Palace Cabaret）。他陈述在那里的一间房间里，他看到了第三被告和朝鲜人Jack。他声称看到朝鲜人Jack递了一把手枪给第三被告，第三被告似乎拒绝接受，并表示应该把它交给一个叫PING的人。我要指出，这发生在谋杀案发生前几分钟。后来，在谋杀案发生前，证人陈述他看到朝鲜人Jack、第三被告以及另一名他不认识的男人，身高与Jack相仿，但瘦得多，正朝达雷克路（Darreck Road）方向，即谋杀案现场方向走去。他声称第三被告当时身穿中山装。谋杀案发生后，该证人陈述他看到第三被告与朝鲜人Jack以及上述提到的另一名不明身份的男子，匆忙从达雷克路的谋杀案现场离开。如果该证人的陈述属实，那么第三被告必须能够说明他在谋杀案当晚的行踪，然而他却声称记不起来了。证人Tsang Sam Yuen陈述他对此事记忆犹新，因为在谋杀案发生后，教堂区（Chapel）发生了一些骚乱，他在得知谋杀案后，立刻因三个原因想到了第三被告及其同伙。

    Your Honour, with all these facts in mind, the
Police consider that they have a case against the accused,
therefore we press for a remand of two weeks, and that the
accused be detained in custody during that period.    The
Police will then decide if all the accused will be charged or
not.    As a matter of fact I have stated that the Police
could have charged the accused today, but since that the
case is considered serious, the utmost care must be taken
when making enquiries, and also to have same completed. I
ask therefore that the case be remanded for two weeks. On the
other hand should the court consider two weeks too long, then
I leave it to Your Honour to remand it to a suitable date.
I have here the statements of the witnesses Tsang Yuen, and
Tsang Zon Yuen, and also that of the accused (pro).    I do not
propose however to introduce the witnesses into the proceedings
today.

    Mr Kuh Sau Kyi for the 1st and 2nd accused :-
Since the 1st and 2nd accused have not been charged, I consider

谋杀案，并在犯罪发生后看到他们匆忙离开谋杀现场。
鉴于这些情况，他怀疑第三被告、朝鲜人Jack以及另一名身份不明者共谋参与谋杀。

法官阁下，考虑到所有这些事实，警方认为已掌握针对被告的证据，因此我们申请将案件延期两周审理，并在此期间将被告羁押候审。警方随后将决定是否对所有被告提起公诉。事实上，我曾表示警方本可于今日对被告提出指控，但鉴于本案性质严重，在进行讯问时必须极其谨慎，并确保调查工作完成。因此，我请求将案件延期两周。另一方面，如果法庭认为两周时间过长，则由法官阁下决定延至合适的日期。我此处有证人曾元（Tsang Yuen）和曾宗元（Tsang Zon Yuen）的供词，以及被告（物证）的供词。然而，我不打算在今日的诉讼程序中传唤证人出庭。

代表第一和第二被告的顾守基（Kuh Sau Kyi）先生：
由于第一和第二被告尚未被正式起诉，我认为为了维护我方当事人的利益，有必要在今日对证人曾元和曾宗元进行质询。

西姆斯（Sims）法官：
警方仅申请进一步羁押被告，本庭需决定警方提交的证据是否足以证明进一步羁押被告是正当的。不过，我将对证人进行讯问。

Sheet 18.

I am a moneylender. The 3rd accused asked me to lend him some
money, this was in September 1935. He wanted the loan of
$25. I did not lend him the money as he could not produce
two guarantors. I do not accept security for loans, I must
have guarantors. The 3rd accused brought a pistol (rev)
to me, and offered it as security for the loan. I have
identified the pistol produced by the 3rd accused at the time,
to be the one and same pistol as that pistol now before your
honour. I remembered the pistol, because of the round
circle on the butt, and the foreign characters (P.B). The 3rd
accused came to my premises on two occasions, on the second
occasion, he brought the pistol. I remember the pistol very
well. I could not have made a mistake. I identified the pistol
amongst six or seven other pistols, of different sizes and shapes.
This was at premises 38 Scott Road. The 3rd accused told me
that the pistol belonged to a Korean named Jack. I have
nothing further to say.

Judge :- to witness , The Police will require you
to give further testimony in this case, therefore you must
inform the Police, should you wish to leave Shanghai.

Witness in reply to Mr Kuh Zau Kyi :- I do not belong
to any association, but the 3rd accused is a member of the
association. (name not mentioned).

Judge to Mr Kuh Zai Kyi :- What association do you mean?
Mr Kuh :- The San Mah Wei association.

Witness Tsang Sen Yuan :- age 35. Singpo, No 3
Kwanning Road. I am a Lawyers runner. I was formerly
in the cabaret business, and that is how I knew the 3rd accused.
I frequently met the 3rd accused at the Moon Palace, when at this
time I was the proprietor of a Dancing School, named the
International Dance Studio.

第18页。

我是一名放债人。第三被告曾向我借钱，那是1935年9月的事。他想借款25元。我没有借给他，因为他无法提供两名担保人。我不接受抵押品作为贷款担保，我必须要有担保人。第三被告曾带一把手枪（左轮）给我，并提出将其作为贷款担保。我已辨认出当时第三被告出示的手枪，与现在呈堂的手枪为同一把。我记得那把手枪，因为枪柄上有一个圆圈，还有外文刻字（P.B）。第三被告来过我的处所两次，第二次来时他带了那把手枪。我对那把手枪印象非常深刻。我不可能搞错。我在另外六七把大小形状各异的手枪中认出了它。此事发生在斯科特路（Scott Road）38号。第三被告告诉我，那把手枪属于一个叫Jack的朝鲜人。我没有其他要说的了。

法官对证人说：警方将要求你在本案中提供进一步的证词，因此如果你打算离开上海，必须通知警方。

证人回答顾兆基（Kuh Zau Kyi）先生问：我不属于任何帮会，但第三被告是该帮会的成员。（未提及名称）。

法官问顾载基（Kuh Zai Kyi）先生：你指的是哪个帮会？
顾先生：三马威（San Mah Wei）帮会。

证人曾森元（Tsang Sen Yuan）：35岁。新加坡人，住广宁路3号。我是一名律师跑腿。我以前从事舞厅生意，因此认识了第三被告。我当时是一家名为“国际舞蹈学校”（International Dance Studio）的舞校老板，经常在月宫（Moon Palace）见到第三被告。

Sheet 19.

On the 9.11.36, I went to the Nanyang Carbarets Later about
8.p.m., I had to see a dancing girl named San Yung who resided
in the Yun Ching Faung Alleyway off North Szechuen Road. I
went there to offer her a job as a dancing girl.    I did not
see her, so I made my way back.    I was proceeding North,
and I saw the 3rd accused, walking ahead in a hurry, the
Korean named Jack whom I know, and another man whom I do not
know, were also hurrying behind the 3rd accused.    I saw them
proceed North, and about to turn to a vacant piece of ground.
20 or thirty minutes later,    I heard that a Japanese Sailor
had been shot on Darrah Road. I suspected the 3rd accused
and the others, because I saw them hurrying back from the scene
of the crime.    I know that the 3rd accused and the Korean
named Jack, are always fighting with others.    I was walking
South on North Szechuen Road, and not North.    When I first
saw them, the time would be between .30.p.m and 8.40.p.m.
9.11.36.    The second time I saw them, would be after 9.p.m.,
I was returning to my studio.    I saw them opposite the
Yun Ching Lee alley way on North Szechuen Road, South of
Darrah Road.    10 days after the murder, I again saw the
3rd accused, but I did not see him to talk to after 9.p.m.
on the night of the murder.    In June or July 1936, I heard that
the Korean was involved in a serious fight. I heard that the
Korean had used a pistol in this instance.    After this at the
Mason Palace Hotel, I saw the Korean Jack, putting his hand in
and out of his pocket, as if he had a pistol.    On the night
of 9.11.36, I did not see anything in the hands of the 3rd accused,
the Korean named Jack, or the other person unknown.

Judge to witness :- You will be required to give
further testimony in this case, so you cannot leave Shanghai,
without the permission of the Police.    At this stage,
the statement of each witness, is read over to them.

第19页。

1936年11月9日，我去了南洋舞厅（Nanyang Carbarets）。后来大约晚上8点，我要去见一位名叫三英（San Yung）的舞女，她住在北四川路旁的云庆坊弄堂里。我去那里是想给她提供一份舞女的工作。我没见到她，所以就折返了。我正往北走，看见第三被告在前面匆忙行走，我认识的朝鲜人Jack和另一个我不认识的人也在第三被告后面匆匆赶路。我看见他们向北走，快要转到一块空地上。二三十分钟后，我听说达拉路（Darrah Road）上有一名日本水手被枪击。我怀疑第三被告和其他人，因为我看见他们匆忙从犯罪现场返回。我知道第三被告和朝鲜人Jack总是与人打架。我当时是在北四川路上向南走，而不是向北。我第一次看见他们时，时间大约在下午7:30到8:40之间。1936年11月9日。第二次看见他们时，是在晚上9点以后，我当时正回我的舞校。我在北四川路上、达拉路以南的云庆里弄堂对面看见了他们。谋杀案发生10天后，我又见到了第三被告，但在谋杀案当晚9点之后，我没有再与他交谈过。1936年6月或7月，我听说那个朝鲜人卷入了一场严重的斗殴。我听说那个朝鲜人在那次事件中使用了手枪。此后在美臣酒店（Mason Palace Hotel），我看见朝鲜人Jack把手伸进口袋又拿出来，好像口袋里有一把手枪。1936年11月9日晚，我没有看见第三被告、朝鲜人Jack或另一名身份不明者手中持有任何物品。

法官对证人说：你将需要在本案中提供进一步的证词，因此未经警方许可，你不得离开上海。在此阶段，向每位证人宣读其供词。
