on Dorroch Road to the south that night, she saw a Japanese marine and a man wearing black foreign clothing, walking in the northern direction one on the eastern side and the other on the western side of the road. Afterwards she heard a pistol report. This statement corresponds with the confession made by Yih Hai Sung in the Court of First Instance, that on November 9, 10 and 11 last year, he wore the black foreign clothing which is on record.
When Yih Hai Sung was on the way to the place of the murder, he was seen by witness Chang Zay Yuan (張財源). This witness testified:- "At about 8 p.m. November 9, I visited No. 14 Yu Ching Li (餘慶里) to look for a dance girl named Seu Yin (秀英). I came out and found many motor cars parked at the entrance to Yu Ching Li. I made a detour to the pavement on the western side and walked in a southern direction to return to the Nanyang Dance Hall (南洋舞場). At this time, I saw Siao Kwangtung in front of me about five or six houses away. He was followed in the rear by two men, one of whom was Jack. I do not know the other man. They were walking in the northern direction and passed by me. I did not pay attention to them. As soon as I arrived at the dance hall, I heard about the shooting case".
Witness Hai Lo Ya (海羅亞) made the following statement regarding Yih Hai Sung's return to the Moon Palace Hotel :- "At about 10 p.m. that day, I visited the Moon Palace Hotel to look for friends. When I reached the door of Room No. 9 with Ah Cha (阿查), the latter pushed the door half open and asked Yih Hai Sung why he was in such an extraordinary state. Yih replied that he had just returned from a fight". This may be used as evidence.
In the Court of First Instance, Yih Hai Sung confessed that he occupied Room No. 9 in the Moon Palace Hotel under the name of Hsia Tsung Kee and that he ran back to the hotel after the shooting. Yih Hai Sung stated that the pistol that was handed to him by Yang Wen Dao was taken out from a book, and the book was seized by the Police at the home of Yang Wen Dao. Yih Hai Sung's statements correspond with the facts and this may be adopted as evidence to prove the crime committed by the appellants. Yih Hai Sung later retracted his statement, stating that his confession was made under torture, that he had swallowed buttons, keys etc. in order to kill himself quickly and that he felt pain in his two sides, the more painful on the left side. The Court of First Instance sent him to the S.M.C. Hospital for an examination at which the Court doctor assisted. As a result of the examination, no metal articles were found in his stomach nor any injury could be found to his ribs. The report of the Court doctor Wei Lih Kung (魏立功) may be used as reference. (Vide page 147, Volume 2, the Court of First Instance.) The scar on his upper lip below the nose was caused by Yih Hai Sung himself by scraping. This information was given by Yih Hai Sung to his lawyer Chang Tse Niang during an interview at the Police Station on May 21 this year. The Court of First Instance questioned the lawyer about this point and the lawyer admitted this. According to Yih Hai Sung's statement, he was tortured two weeks after the remand ordered by the Court of First Instance on May 6

当晚在杜乐路（Dorroch Road）以南，她看见一名日本海军陆战队员和一名身穿黑色西式服装的男子，一人在路东侧，一人在路西侧，向北行走。随后她听到一声枪响。此陈述与易海松（Yih Hai Sung）在初审法庭上的供词相符，即在去年11月9日、10日和11日，他穿着记录在案的那套黑色西式服装。
易海松在前往谋杀地点的途中，被证人张财源（Chang Zay Yuan）看见。该证人作证称：“11月9日晚8时许，我前往余庆里14号寻找一名名叫秀英（Seu Yin）的舞女。我出来时发现余庆里门口停着许多汽车。我绕到西侧的人行道上，向南走回南洋舞场。这时，我看见前面大约五六幢房子远处有小广东（Siao Kwangtung）。他身后跟着两个人，其中一个是杰克（Jack）。我不认识另一个人。他们向北走，从我身边经过。我没有注意他们。我刚到舞厅，就听说了枪击案”。
证人海罗亚（Hai Lo Ya）就易海松返回月宫饭店一事作了如下陈述：“当晚10时许，我去月宫饭店找朋友。当我和阿查（Ah Cha）走到9号房间门口时，后者把门推开一半，问易海松为何状态如此异常。易回答说刚打架回来”。这可作为证据。
在初审法庭上，易海松供认他以夏宗基（Hsia Tsung Kee）的名义住在月宫饭店9号房间，并在枪击后跑回饭店。易海松称，杨文道（Yang Wen Dao）交给他的手枪是从一本书中取出的，该书是在杨文道家中被警方查获的。易海松的陈述与事实相符，可作为证明上诉人犯罪的证据。易海松后来翻供，称其供词是在刑讯逼供下作出的，他曾吞下纽扣、钥匙等物以求速死，并感到两侧疼痛，左侧更甚。初审法庭将其送往工部局医院进行检查，法庭医生协助进行了检查。检查结果发现，其胃内无金属物品，肋骨也无任何损伤。法庭医生魏立功（Wei Lih Kung）的报告可供参考。（见初审法庭第二卷第147页。）他鼻子上方嘴唇上的疤痕是易海松自己抓挠造成的。这一信息是易海松在今年5月21日于警察局会见其律师张子良（Chang Tse Niang）时提供的。初审法庭就此点询问了律师，律师予以承认。据易海松称，他在5月6日被初审法庭下令还押两周后遭受刑讯

according to the record of the Court of First Instance. As Yih Hai Sung's confession was already on record prior to May 6, his statement that his confession was made through torture is obviously a fabrication.
The present appeals are based on five points. With the exception of Point (3) on the motive of murder, Point (4) on the counter-evidence given by the accused, and Point (5) on the various facts, etc., the rest is all speculation and lacks concrete proof to support the contentions.
Point (1) criticises the material evidence produced by the Police. It asserts that as the bullet had entered the back of Nakayama's head and emerged through the forehead, it should have dropped in front of the marine and not at a spot about 8 feet away behind the marine where it was actually found. After an examination of the diagram drawn up by the Court of First Instance at the time of the reconstruction of the crime, we find that the spot (marked red) where Nakayama was shot and the spot where he collapsed are three paces apart, while the bullet dropped between these two spots (marked green). The spot where the bullet dropped is in front of the spot where Nakayama was shot. According to a report by Japanese Medical Office Ogawa, when Nakayama was removed to the Japanese Naval Landing Party Headquarters, his temperature was 36.5 degrees, his pulse was 90 and his breathing 22. His condition was like that of a man in normal conditions and it was possible that he had walked a few steps even after he had been shot. As Nakayama was a man of strong physique, it is reasonable to surmise that for a short space of time after he was shot he had made three paces forward and then collapsed. One cannot ignore the diagram drawn up at the time of the reconstruction of the crime by steadfastly sticking to the point that the bullet had dropped behind the spot where the victim had collapsed to the ground.
Again, a bullet penetrating a living being may not gather blood stains. This has been found conclusive by the various experts of the Medico-Legal Laboratory and of the Arms Identification Section of the S.M.C. Such evidence cannot be attacked by the appellants by using empty words alone.
The appeals further state: "Witness Chang Tsun(張琛) in his statement stated that when Tseng Yuan (曾元) and Zung Wei Ming(鄭惠民) were smoking opium on a bed, he drew a sketch of a pistol with a pencil. Later Tseng Yuan introduced him to Zung Wei Ming who said that if he (Chang Tsun) would call at the Japanese Naval Landing Party Headquarters and make a report to the effect that the marine Nakayama had been murdered by Yih Hai Sung, Yang 'en Dao and a Korean named Jack, he could claim the $4,000 reward. Questioned about this statement at a hearing in the Court of First Instance, Tseng Yuan replied, 'Quite right, quite right.' At a hearing in the Court of First Instance, Yang Chien Chung (楊建中) also admitted that he knew Zung Wei Ming and that he had supplied Yang Wen Dao's address to Zung Wei Ming from whom he had sought a loan. It is not altogether an impossibility that the book containing an excavation in the shape of a pistol had been planted by Yang Chien Chung as part of the conspiracy between Zung Wei Ming and Tseng Yuan."

根据初审法庭的记录。由于易海松的供词在5月6日之前已记录在案，他声称供词是通过刑讯获得的，显然是捏造。
目前的上诉基于五点。除第(3)点关于杀人动机、第(4)点关于被告提出的反证以及第(5)点关于各种事实等外，其余均为推测，缺乏具体证据支持其主张。
第(1)点批评警方提出的物证。它声称，由于子弹从中山（Nakayama）的后脑射入并从额头穿出，子弹应落在该海军陆战队员的前方，而不是实际发现的位于该海军陆战队员后方约8英尺处。经查阅初审法庭在重建犯罪现场时绘制的图表，我们发现中山被射击的地点（标红）与他倒下的地点相距三步，而子弹落在这两个地点之间（标绿）。子弹落地点位于中山被射击地点的前方。根据日本医务官小川（Ogawa）的报告，中山被送往日本海军陆战队总部时，体温为36.5度，脉搏90，呼吸22。他的状况如同正常人，即使在中枪后也有可能走了几步。鉴于中山体格强壮，合理推测他在中枪后的短时间内向前走了三步然后倒下。不能固执地坚持子弹落在受害者倒地位置的后方这一观点，而无视犯罪现场重建时绘制的图表。
此外，穿透活体的子弹可能不会沾染血迹。工部局法医实验室和枪械鉴定科的各位专家已证实这一点。上诉人仅凭空言无法驳斥此类证据。
上诉书进一步称：“证人张琛（Chang Tsun）在陈述中说，当曾元（Tseng Yuan）和郑惠民（Zung Wei Ming）在床上吸鸦片时，他用铅笔画了一把手枪的草图。后来曾元将他介绍给郑惠民，郑惠民说，如果他（张琛）去日本海军陆战队总部报案，称海军陆战队员中山是被易海松、杨文道和一名叫杰克的韩国人谋杀的，他就可以领取4,000美元奖金。在初审法庭听证会上就此陈述进行质询时，曾元回答‘完全正确，完全正确’。在初审法庭听证会上，杨建中（Yang Chien Chung）也承认他认识郑惠民，并且因为郑惠民向他借款，他将杨文道的地址提供给了郑惠民。那本挖有手枪形状空洞的书由杨建中作为郑惠民和曾元阴谋的一部分而栽赃，这并非完全不可能。”

Chang Tsun was formerly on friendly terms with
Tseng Yuan, Zung 'ei Ming and others and was one of the party
to claim the reward. Later, there was a rupture over
conflicting interests and he called at the office of lawyer
Kuh Chao Chi, the lawyer of Yang Wen Dao, to give his evidence.
His petition which is in favour of Yang 'en Dao was drawn up
by a man named Yih( Yi ) and submitted to the Court. It is
doubtful whether his words are reliable. Assuming, as
contended by appellants, that Zung Wei Ming and others had
actually conspired to give information in order to secure the
reward, this is a totally different matter from the planting
of evidence and the making of a malicious accusation. The
evidence given by Chang Tsun merely proves that Zung Wei Ming
and others are suspected of having conspired to give the
information. No proof was produced to show how Zung 'ei
Ming had planted the false evidence. The ruling of the
Court of First Instance in rejecting the evidence given by
Chang Tsun, Zung Wei Ming and Tseng Yuan cannot, therefore,
be said to be without reason. It is alleged that according
to the report of the Medico-Legal Laboratory, none of the
finger-prints and blood stains found in the book were similar
to the finger-prints or palm-prints of Yang Wen Dao; that the
paper had been broken at two places at a spot directly
opposite the safety catch of the pistol; that the edges of
the breaks had curled and bore rust marks and grease stains;
that the rust had been caused by grease; that the deep
impressions and breaks in the pages of the book could not
have been made without strong pressure from the outside,
showing that the impressions and breaks had been deliberately
and extemporarily made by applying exterior pressure on the
book; that the marks of excavating the hole in the book were
very fresh, especially at the two bends on the lower left
side and at the short left-hand edge on the upper left side
of the book, showing that the book had been manufactured
extemporarily and planted in the house of Yang Wen Dao. The
accused had failed to note that the finger-prints left in the
book were few and mostly incomplete, as pointed out in Report
No. 100, Character "Chien"( 签 ), made by the Medico-Legal
Laboratory, and it was for this reason that the Laboratory
had been unable to find any of Yang Wen Dao's finger-prints
in the book. At the most, we can only say that the
result of the examination failed to prove that the book
bore the finger-prints of Yang Wen Dao, but it cannot be
taken as evidence in favour of the accused. Rust is caused
by the oxidation of iron in the air. The speed of the process
of rusting is according to the humidity of the air at the
place where the pistol is kept and by the presence of grease
on the surface of the pistol; therefore it is impossible to
determine from the rust marks the period of time in which
the pistol had been kept. As to the deep impressions
and breaks in the pages, they could not have been made if
there had been no external pressure or if the pistol had not
moved to and fro inside the book because the weight of the
pistol was only 600 grams. Any heavy book or other article
placed on the book containing the pistol would have provided
the pressure required to make the impressions and breaks.
The marks of excavation were inside the book and did not come
into contact with light or dust; the period of their existence
cannot therefore be determined according to freshness. All
this has been explained in Report No. 99 of the Medico-Legal
Laboratory. If a pistol is put in dry place and coated

张琛以前与曾元、郑惠民等人关系友好，曾是索取奖金的一方。后来因利益冲突发生破裂，他前往杨文道的律师顾兆基（Kuh Chao Chi）律师办事处提供证词。有利于杨文道的请愿书是由一名姓易（Yi）的人起草并提交给法庭的。他的话是否可靠值得怀疑。假设如上诉人所主张，郑惠民等人确实合谋提供信息以获取奖金，这与栽赃证据和恶意指控是完全不同的两回事。张琛提供的证据仅证明郑惠民等人涉嫌合谋提供信息。没有提出证据证明郑惠民是如何栽赃假证据的。因此，不能说初审法庭驳回张琛、郑惠民和曾元证词的裁决是没有理由的。有人声称，根据法医实验室的报告，在书中发现的指纹和血迹均与杨文道的指纹或掌纹不符；纸张在与手枪保险栓正对的位置有两处断裂；断裂边缘卷曲并带有锈迹和油渍；锈迹是由油脂引起的；书页上的深痕和断裂若无外部强力压迫是不可能形成的，表明这些痕迹和断裂是通过对书本施加外部压力而故意且临时制造的；书中挖洞的痕迹非常新鲜，特别是在书的左下角的两个弯曲处和左上角的短左边缘处，表明这本书是临时制造并栽赃在杨文道家中的。被告未能注意到，正如法医实验室在第100号“签”字报告中所指出的那样，留在书中的指纹很少且大多不完整，正因如此，实验室未能在书中找到杨文道的任何指纹。我们最多只能说，检查结果未能证明书上有杨文道的指纹，但这不能作为有利于被告的证据。生锈是铁在空气中氧化造成的。生锈过程的速度取决于存放手枪地点的空气湿度以及手枪表面的油脂存在情况；因此，不可能根据锈迹确定手枪存放的时间长短。至于书页上的深痕和断裂，如果没有外部压力或手枪没有在书中来回移动，是不可能形成的，因为手枪的重量仅为600克。任何放在装有手枪的书上的重书或其他物品都会提供造成痕迹和断裂所需的压力。挖掘痕迹在书内部，未接触光线或灰尘；因此，不能根据其新鲜程度确定其存在的时间。所有这些已在法医实验室第99号报告中予以解释。如果将手枪放在干燥的地方并涂上

cember 12, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

with grease, oxidation will take place more slowly. Now the pistol in this case was greased on the surface and this grease should have had an anti-rust effect upon the pistol. Yet the appellant alleges that the grease had accelerated the rusting. This is not in accordance with the statement made in the report of the Medico-Legal Laboratory. Furthermore, the breaks in the pages can also be caused by the pistol moving to and fro inside the book, external pressure is not the only cause. Therefore, the appellants cannot attack the original judgment on this point,
The second point stressed that the statements and reconstructions made by Yih Hai Sung had not been made voluntarily. This Court has examined the record of the Court of First Instance and found that although the various confessions of Yih Hai Sung did not totally correspond with one another, they had not been made under torture; they corresponded with the facts. The Court record regarding the reconstruction made at the scene of the crime by Yih Hai Sung and and the witness Hu Ziang Wu in the presence of the Judge of the Court of First Instance contains nothing to show that Yih Hai Sung had been prevented from making his reconstruction freely by threats or inducements or by some forcible or fraudulent or other unlawful means. The lawyers of the appellants were present at the reconstruction and had accepted the record as correct and signed it. They had not said anything about Yih Hai Sung not having been allowed to reconstruct the crime freely. How can the appellants now say this after they have filed the appeal? Yih Hai Sung had both of his hands handcuffed to two Japanese policemen only as a measure of safeguard; he cannot be said to have lost his freedom because of being thus handcuffed.
According to a reconstruction given by accused Yih Hai Sung, the distance between the spot where he fired the pistol and the spot where Nakayama stood was about five or six ordinary paces. The distance was found incorrect because an examination by the Medico-Legal Laboratory of the powder marks on the wound of entry showed that the distance must have been about 5 centimetres. When a person commits a murder, he is usually over-excited. It is true that he will not lose valuable time in considering the distance of the shooting and to keep the fact carefully in mind. We cannot overlook the facts entirely because of the slight differences about the distance of the shooting during the reconstruction.
According to a statement made by witness Pan Chiao Yin, she saw a marine and another person walking in the same direction one behind the other. The statement made by accused Yih Hai Sung to the effect that he followed the marine is therefore not absolutely unsupported.
During the reconstruction given by witness Hu Ziang Wu, the latter pointed out that accused Yih Hai Sung escaped by the side of an electric pole and that the clothing worn by the escaping man was similar to that worn by a marine. This point has been explained by this Court as well as by the Court of First Instance in its judgment as being due to a mistake of judgment.
Besides, witnesses Chu Sun Fu (朱森甫) and Chi Ah Keng (紀阿根) stated during the hearings at the Court of First Instance that Yang Wen Dao seldom went to the Dong Nyi

涂有油脂，氧化过程会较慢。本案中的手枪表面涂有油脂，该油脂本应对手枪起到防锈作用。然而，上诉人声称油脂加速了生锈。这与法医实验室报告中的陈述不符。此外，书页的破损也可能是由手枪在书内来回移动造成的，外部压力并非唯一原因。因此，上诉人不能以此点攻击原判，

第二点强调义海松（Yih Hai Sung）所作的供述和现场重建并非自愿作出。本院审查了一审法院的记录，发现虽然义海松的各项供词并不完全一致，但并非在酷刑下作出；且与事实相符。关于义海松和证人胡祥武（Hu Ziang Wu）在初审法官面前进行的犯罪现场重建的法庭记录中，没有任何内容显示义海松受到威胁、利诱、暴力、欺诈或其他非法手段的阻碍而无法自由进行重建。上诉人的律师在场见证了重建过程，并认可记录正确且签了字。他们当时并未提及义海松未被允许自由重建犯罪现场一事。上诉人在提起上诉后，如今怎能再提出此说法？义海松双手被铐在两名日本警察身上，这仅是一种安全措施；不能说他因此被铐而失去了自由。

根据被告义海松所作的重建描述，他开枪地点与中山（Nakayama）站立地点之间的距离约为五六步普通步幅。经法医实验室对入口伤口处的火药痕迹进行检查，发现该距离有误，实际距离必须约为5厘米。当一个人实施谋杀时，通常处于极度兴奋状态。确实，他不会浪费宝贵时间去考虑射击距离并牢记这一事实。我们不能仅仅因为重建过程中关于射击距离的细微差异而完全忽视事实。

根据证人潘巧英（Pan Chiao Yin）的陈述，她看到一名海军陆战队员和另一人朝同一方向一前一后行走。因此，被告义海松所称他跟随该海军陆战队员的说法并非完全没有佐证。

在证人胡祥武（Hu Ziang Wu）进行的重建过程中，后者指出被告义海松是从一根电线杆旁逃跑的，且逃跑者所穿衣物与海军陆战队员的服装相似。本院及一审法院在判决中已解释这一点是由于判断失误所致。

此外，证人朱森甫（Chu Sun Fu）和纪阿根（Chi Ah Keng）在一审庭审期间陈述，杨文道（Yang Wen Dao）很少去东亚

Federation as he had been there only one or two times in all
and that they had never seen accused Yih Hai Sung nor the
Korean. Some differences were found when these statements
were compared with that of accused Yang Wen Dao to the effect
that he attended to his duties at the Federation everyday
or with that of Hung Wen Wei (洪文蔚) who presented himself
as a witness in the course of a hearing in this Court and
stated that Yang Wen Dao was always at the Federation.
According to a statement made by witness Hung Wen Wei, between
7 and 11 p.m. November 9 last year, he was in the Federation
with Yang Wen Dao. After he (Hung) reached home, he was
informed by some boys that a Japanese marine had been murdered.
Next day, he told Yang Wen Dao of the matter.
Witness Hung Wen Wei and accused Yang Wen Dao
also stated that they learned of the murder three or four days
later from the newspapers. As there are likewise some
contradictory points in these statements, the evidence presented
by the witness Hung Wei Wei cannot be adopted.
In conclusion, with the exception of the case
against Chow Shou Yong (周守庸), which has been concluded
and requires no further discussion, the Court of First Instance
has regarded the murder of the Japanese marine Hideo Nakayama
by the appellants as a matter of great importance because the
murder was liable to give rise to trouble between China
and foreign nations. There is no possibility of granting
a pardon to the accused. Yih Hai Sung is the principal
culprit, while Yang Wen Dao was responsible for having planned
the murder. It is only reasonable that under Article 26,
Article 271, Section 1, Article 37, Section 1, Article 36,
Section 1, Paragraph 1 and 2, of the Criminal Code, the
accused are sentenced to death and deprived of civil rights
for life, while the pistol, the six rounds of ammunition,
the empty cartridge, the bullet and the book on Practical
Physics which was used to conceal a pistol were ordered to be
confiscated. As the reasons given in the appeal can hardly
be considered as logical, the case should therefore be dealt
with as above in accordance with Article 360 of the Code
of the Criminal Procedure. Procurator Ling Ngoo Min of
this Court has attended Court to deliver his views in this
case.

同盟会（Dong Nyi Federation），因为他总共只去过一两次，

与被告杨文道所称他每天在同盟会履行职责，
或与洪文蔚（Hung Wen Wei）在本院庭审过程中作为证人出庭

根据证人洪文蔚的陈述，去年11月9日晚7点至11点之间，
他与杨文道一同在同盟会。他（洪）回家后，
从一些男孩处得知一名日本海军陆战队员被杀。
次日，他将此事告知杨文道。
证人洪文蔚和被告杨文道
还称，他们是三四个天后从报纸上得知谋杀案的。由于这些
陈述中也存在一些矛盾之处，证人洪文蔚（原文误作Hung Wei Wei）提供的证据

综上所述，除周守庸（Chow Shou Yong）一案已结案且无需进一步讨论外，
一审法院将上诉人谋杀日本海军陆战队员中山秀雄（Hideo Nakayama）一案视为重大案件，
因为该谋杀案可能引发中外之间的纠纷。不可能对被告予以赦免。
义海松是主犯，而杨文道负责策划谋杀。
根据《刑法》第26条、第271条第1款、第37条第1款、
第36条第1款第1项和第2项，判处被告死刑并终身剥夺公权，
同时没收用于藏匿手枪的《实用物理学》书籍、手枪、六发子弹、
空弹壳和子弹，这是合乎情理的。鉴于上诉理由难以被视为符合逻辑，
因此应根据《刑事诉讼法》第360条按上述方式处理本案。
本院检察官凌吴民（Ling Ngoo Min，音译）出庭就本案发表意见。

S.M.C. (RESPONDENTS)
VERSUS
YANG WEN DAO AND YIH HAI SUNG (APPELLANTS)
------
The following written argument is submitted in
answer to the appeals filed by Yang Wen Dao and Yih Hai Sung
against the sentence of death imposed on them by the Shanghai
First Special District Court for the murder of a Japanese
marine named Hideo Nakayama.
I. The material evidence produced by the Police.
The proofs produced by the Police were articles
which were actually used by the accused in the commission of
the crime and consisted of a "Beretta" pistol of Italian make,
No. 241146, .32 calibre, six rounds of .32 calibre ammunition
in the pistol, one bullet of .32 calibre, one spent cartridge
No. C 1109 of .32 calibre, and a book on Practical Physics
published by the Commercial Press, Ltd. It is generally
agreed by the various Chinese and foreign experts, after an
examination, that the spent cartridge produced in Court belonged
to the bullet and that the bullet had been fired from the pistol
No. 241146 and that the book on Practical Physics with an
excavation in it is the book that held the pistol No.241146.
The respondents hereunder deal point by point with the reasons
set forth by the appellants in their appeals attacking the
above-mentioned proofs and the evidence given by the experts.
(1) The appellants submitted that the circumstances
surrounding the finding of the pistol No. 241146 and the six
rounds of ammunition it contained (such as the delay of about
one and half hours after the murder and the distance of 509
feet away from the scene of crime) were insufficient to prove
that the said pistol had been used in the murder.
The immediate measure which this question calls
for is to ascertain whether or not the said pistol was the one
that had fired the said bullet and the possibility as to whether
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局（被上诉人）
诉
杨文道和义海松（上诉人）
------
现提交以下书面辩词，以回应杨文道和义海松
针对上海第一特区地方法院因谋杀名为中山秀雄（Hideo Nakayama）的日本海军陆战队员
而对他们判处的死刑所提出的上诉。

一、警方提供的物证。
警方提供的证据是被告在实施犯罪时实际使用的物品，
包括一支意大利制造的“伯莱塔”（Beretta）手枪，
编号241146，口径.32，手枪内有六发.32口径子弹，
一发.32口径子弹，一枚.32口径的空弹壳（编号C 1109），
以及一本由商务印书馆出版的《实用物理学》。
经过检查，中外专家普遍认同，庭上出示的空弹壳属于该子弹，
且该子弹系从编号241146的手枪射出，
而那本中间有挖孔的《实用物理学》就是藏匿编号241146手枪的那本书。
被上诉人兹针对上诉人在上诉中攻击上述证据及专家证词的理由，逐点进行反驳。

(1) 上诉人提出，发现编号241146手枪及其内含的六发子弹时的相关情况
（例如谋杀发生后约一个半小时的时间延迟，以及距离犯罪现场509英尺）
不足以证明该手枪曾用于谋杀。

对此问题亟需采取的即时措施是查明该手枪是否为射出该子弹的手枪，
以及

pages.en:
- 2 -

the said bullet could not have been fired from the said pistol.
These questions can only be answered by experts on the basis of
scientific facts, for this is a technical matter and cannot be
guessed at or talked about recklessly by lay men.

The examination made by D.S. Oakley, ballistics
expert of the S.M.P., has proved conclusively that the bullet of
.32 calibre and the spent cartridge No. C 1109 were fired from
the pistol No. 241146 and that it was impossible for them not to
have been fired from the said pistol. (See Chapter 1 of the
record of enquiries made by D.S.I. Crowther dated November 10,
1935, regarding the examination conducted at that time by the
Arms Identification Section of the said pistol, the bullet and
the spent cartridge and also the evidence given by the ballistics
expert, D.S. Oakley, together with photographs produced in Court
at the hearing held on May 1, 1936). At that session of the
trial the accused did not produce any proof to the contrary or
to prove that the findings of the said expert were wrong; they
simply declared that the time of the finding of the pistol should
not have been so long, that it should not have been found so far
away from the spot, that it was not reasonable that a culprit
would have left the pistol behind upon taking to flight after
committing a crime, that the finding of the pistol beneath a
wooden box by means of a stick was unbelievable, that owing to
the large number of spectators having assembled at the spot at
that time it was probable that the pistol had been planted there.

(2) The bullet of .32 calibre and the spent
cartridge No. C 1109 were actually fired from the seized pistol
No. 241146.

The arguments submitted by the appellants may
be put under the following three heads :-

(a) The bullet and the spent cartridge should not have been
found where they were.

(b) There was no trace of blood on the bullet.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

该子弹是否不可能由该手枪射出。
这些问题只能由专家基于科学事实来回答，因为这是一个技术问题，
外行人士不能随意猜测或妄加议论。

上海公共租界警务处弹道专家D.S. Oakley的检查已确凿证明，
.32口径子弹和编号C 1109的空弹壳系从编号241146的手枪射出，
且不可能不是由该手枪射出。（参见1935年11月10日副巡官Crowther的调查记录第一章，
关于当时对该手枪、子弹和空弹壳进行的武器识别部门检查，
以及弹道专家D.S. Oakley在1936年5月1日举行的庭审中提供的证词，
连同庭上出示的照片）。在那次庭审中，被告未提供任何反证
或证明该专家的发现是错误的；他们 merely 宣称发现手枪的时间不应如此之久，
发现地点不应离现场如此之远，罪犯在犯罪后逃跑时留下手枪是不合理的，
用棍子从木箱下找出手枪是不可信的，由于当时现场聚集了大量围观者，
手枪很可能是被栽赃在那里的。

(2) .32口径子弹和编号C 1109的空弹壳
确实是从缴获的编号241146手枪中射出的。

上诉人提出的论点可归纳为以下三点：

(a) 子弹和空弹壳不应在它们被发现的地方找到。

(b) 子弹上没有血迹。

pages.en:
- 3 -
fixed
(c) There was a possibility of the bullet having been/from a pistol
of similar size.

Such an apparently true but actually wrong argument
is liable to give rise to misunderstanding that would make it
difficult for the truth to be discovered. However, the argument
can be of no benefit to the appellants.

The respondents submit the following detailed argument
against the three aforementioned contentions set forth by the
appellants :-

(a) Besides a knowledge of law and logic, a person
handling a criminal case requires wide common knowledge. In a
metropolis, are to be found idlers who are fond of listening to
gossip and looking on at occurrences that do not concern them.
Many persons will assemble and listen to a quarrel between two
women; many persons will collect together and watch a fight
between drunkards; a greater number of persons will assemble
to witness a fire, a shooting or any other serious incident.
This is a fact; it is human weakness.

Hideo Nakayama was fatally shot on Darroch Road at
9 p.m. Several minutes afterwards, it is possible that a crowd
of several hundred persons had assembled at the spot. Chinese
Policeman No. 2864 arrived on the scene at 9.05 p.m., Foreign
Policeman No. 230 and Japanese Policeman No. 61 arrived at
9.10 p.m. Prior to the arrival of these officers, there had
already been a number of on-lookers around the deceased. (See
Chapter 1 of the record of enquiries made by D.S.I. Crowther dated
November 10, 1935). The bullet and the spent cartridge were
found at about 10 p.m. the same evening, that is about one hour
after the crime, (vide the written reports made by Japanese
Policemen Nos. 51 and 61 dated May 2 and 3 this year which have
been produced in Court and also the statements made by the said
Japanese policemen at the hearing held on May 1 this year). The
bullet and the spent cartridge had probably been unintentionally

fixed
(c) 子弹有可能是/来自一支类似尺寸的手枪。

这种看似真实实则错误的论点容易引起误解，从而使得真相难以被发现。
然而，该论点并不能给上诉人带来任何益处。

被上诉人针对上诉人提出的上述三项主张，提交如下详细辩词：

(a) 除了法律和逻辑知识外，处理刑事案件的人还需要广泛的常识。
在大都市中，存在着喜欢听八卦和围观与自己无关事件的闲人。
许多人会聚集起来聆听两个女人的争吵；许多人会凑在一起观看醉汉之间的打斗；
更多的人会聚集见证火灾、枪击或其他严重事件。
这是一个事实；是人性的弱点。

中山秀雄于晚上9点在达罗克路（Darroch Road）被枪击致死。
几分钟后，可能有数百人聚集在现场。
华捕2864号于晚上9:05到达现场，西捕230号和日捕61号于
9:10到达。在这些警官到达之前，死者周围已经有一些围观者。（参见
1935年11月10日副巡官Crowther的调查记录第一章）。
子弹和空弹壳是在当晚约10点发现的，即案发后约一小时，（见
今年5月2日和3日日捕51号和61号提交的书面报告，已呈堂，
以及上述日本警察在今年5月1日庭审中所作的陈述）。
子弹和空弹壳可能是无意中

moved by the feet of the crowd from the original spots where they
had dropped. The fact that the bullet and the spent cartridge
were not found at the places where they "should have dropped"
supports this theory. This is not surprising and should not
be regarded as untenable.

The fact that Hideo Nakayama was fatally shot in the
head is not refuted by the accused. Unfortunately, the bullet
that caused the mortal wound dropped to the ground after penetrating
the head because it was fired at too close range, otherwise it
would have had to be extracted from the deceased's head by a
doctor and then examined by a ballistics expert to ascertain
whether it had been fired from the said pistol. This would
have settled the issue. It was fortunate that according to the
doctor's certificate the wound suffered by the deceased was
inflicted by a pistol bullet and the wound was caused by
one bullet. Now at the scene of the crime, only one man was
killed and only one pistol, one bullet and one spent cartridge
were found. Witnesses Hu Xiang He and Pan Chiao Ying stated
that they heard only one pistol shot. After making an
examination that evening, the ballistics expert declared that
the said bullet and the spent cartridge had been fired from the
said pistol. If the accused suggest that the bullet was not
the one that had killed a man, let us ask: where had this bullet
come from? Who had been struck by it? And Where is the bullet that
had caused the death?

(b) The respondents have not suggested that there was
no blood stain on the bullet. In his statement made in Court
during the trial held on May 1 and his written report, now on
file, dated May 3, Japanese Policeman No. 61 stated: "At the
time of its discovery, there were blood stains and some sticky
substance on the bullet." Judging by the circumstances existing
at that time, the Police concluded that the said bullet was the
one that was responsible for the death and subsequent examination

被人群的脚步从原本掉落的位置移开。子弹和弹壳并未在它们“本应掉落”的地方被发现，这一事实支持了上述理论。这并不令人惊讶，也不应被视为站不住脚。

被告并未否认中山秀雄（Hideo Nakayama）头部中弹身亡的事实。不幸的是，由于射击距离过近，造成致命伤的子弹在穿透头部后掉落在地上；否则，本应由医生从死者头部取出，再交由弹道专家检验，以确定是否由所述手枪发射。这样便可定案。幸运的是，根据医生的证明，死者所受创伤系由手枪子弹造成，且仅由一颗子弹所致。而在犯罪现场，仅有一人死亡，并仅发现一支手枪、一颗子弹和一个弹壳。证人胡祥和（Hu Xiang He）和潘巧英（Pan Chiao Ying）陈述称，他们只听到一声枪响。当晚经检验后，弹道专家宣布，所述子弹和弹壳确系由所述手枪发射。如果被告声称该子弹并非致人死亡的那颗子弹，那么我们要问：这颗子弹从何而来？谁被它击中？以及那颗致死的子弹在哪里？

(b) 答辩人并未提出子弹上没有血迹的说法。日本警察第61号在5月1日庭审期间的法庭陈述中，以及在现存档案中日期为5月3日的书面报告中 stated：“在发现时，子弹上有血迹和一些粘性物质。”根据当时的情况，警方认定所述子弹即为导致死亡的子弹，随后在手枪被发现后进行的专家进一步检验证实了这一判断。在这种情况下，子弹上保留血迹并非必要条件，且在六个月后被告被捕及受审时，子弹上不再发现血迹也是意料之中的事。上诉人怎能仅因目前子弹上没有血迹，就断言该子弹并非导致海军陆战队员死亡的那颗子弹呢？

by an expert after the discovery of the pistol further confirmed
this belief. Under the circumstances, it is not necessary that
the blood stains should be retained on the bullet, and it was to
be expected that the blood stains would no longer be found on the
bullet by the time the accused were arrested and during the trial
which took place six months later. How can the appellants assert
that the bullet is not the one that had caused the death of the
marine simply because of the absence of blood stains on it at
present?

Supposing the appellants have actually rebutted the
statements of Japanese Policeman No. 61 and proved that there
were no blood stains on the bullet when it was found, let us refer
to Report No. 101, Character Chien(检), drawn up by the Chenju
Medico-Legal Laboratory of the Ministry of Justice. The report
says: "A bullet passing through a living being at a close range
may not gather any blood stains." That being so, then the
question as to whether or not there had been blood stains on
the bullet will not prove in favour of the appellants.

(C) When a shot is fired, both the spent bullet
and the empty cartridge will bear on their surface the special
marks of the pistol from which the shot had been fired. Every
pistol has its own special marks which are never the same as
those of other pistols. A spent bullet and an empty cartridge
have each on their surface the peculiar marks of the pistol
from which the bullet had been fired. There has never happened
such a case where such marks are so complicated that they
cannot be distinguished from those of other pistols. This is
the same principle followed in the identification of finger
prints. This modern, scientific development in the identification
of firearms is probably unknown and inexplicable to the
appellants, and this is why they have regarded such an identi-
fication as being so wonderful and beyond their power to

假设上诉人确实反驳了日本警察第61号的陈述，并证明在发现子弹时上面没有血迹，让我们参考司法部陈居法医实验室出具的第101号“检”字报告。该报告称：“近距离穿过活体的子弹可能不会沾染任何血迹。”既然如此，那么子弹上是否有血迹的问题并不能证明对上诉人有利。

(C) 当开枪时，射出的子弹和空弹壳表面都会留下发射该子弹的手枪的特殊痕迹。每支手枪都有其独特的痕迹，与其他手枪的痕迹绝不相同。射出的子弹和空弹壳表面各自留有发射该子弹的手枪的独特痕迹。从未发生过此类痕迹复杂到无法与其他手枪痕迹区分开来的情况。这与指纹识别的原理相同。这种现代科学的枪械识别技术，上诉人可能既不了解也无法解释，因此他们认为这种鉴定如此奇妙，超出了他们的理解能力。

(3) The book on Practical Physics, published
by the Commercial Press, in which a hole in the shape of
a pistol had been excavated, was discovered by the Japanese
Constable No. 164 of the Dixwell Road Police Station at the
home of Yang Wen Dao, one of the appellants, at House No. 18,
Dong An Lee (同安里) off Tengshan Road at about 5 p.m.
on April 19 this year. It must be noted that at the time of
the search, not only the foreign and Chinese Detective
Sub-Inspectors of the Police Station, but also Chen Sui Chin
(陳秀金), the concubine of Yang Wen Dao, was present.
The book in question was handed over for safe custody to
D.S.I. Crowther, who was then in charge of the case, immediately
after its discovery by the Japanese Constable. On the
following day, it was passed to Mr. Dickson, an expert in the
identification of finger prints, for examination, as a result
of which it was established that the book was actually the
one which was used for the purpose of concealing the pistol,
No. 241146, that was used in the murder. (Vide the reports
Nos. 17 and 19 of D.S.I. Crowther as well as the verbal
reports made in Court by all the police officers above mentioned
on May 1 when this case was heard.) It is not likely that the
appellant (Yang Wen Dao) will deny knowledge of all the facts
mentioned above. The point that requires consideration at
present is whether the appellant is able to produce counter-
evidence to substantiate his allegation that the book in
question was not the one which belonged to him but had been
planted by some person or persons to implicate him with the
intention of earning the rewards.

(3) 今年4月19日下午5时许，狄思威路（Dixwell Road）巡捕房的日本巡捕第164号在上诉人之一杨文道位于同安里18号（邓山路旁）的家中，发现了一本《实用物理学》（商务印书馆出版），书中挖有一个手枪形状的洞。必须指出的是，在搜查时，不仅该巡捕房的外籍和华籍侦探副督察在场，杨文道的妾室陈秀金也在场。该书在日本巡捕发现后立即移交给当时负责此案的侦探副督察克劳瑟（Crowther）保管。次日，该书被转交给指纹鉴定专家迪克森（Dickson）先生进行检验，结果确定该书确实是用于藏匿编号为241146的手枪的工具，而这支手枪正是谋杀案中使用的凶器。（参见克劳瑟侦探副督察的第17号和第19号报告，以及上述所有警务人员在5月1日审理此案时在法庭上所作的口头报告。）上诉人（杨文道）不太可能否认对上述所有事实的了解。目前需要考虑的问题是，上诉人能否提供反证，以证实他的指控，即该书不属于他，而是由某人或某些人栽赃陷害，意图获取赏金。

Leaving aside the various statements made
by Yang Wen Dao at the Police Station, in all of which he
admitted that the book belonged to him, when Yang Wen Dao on
April 20 was arraigned before the Court for trial the first
time this year, he likewise stated that the book was his
property. Such a statement made in the presence of a Judge
should, of course, be taken as reliable and cannot be
retracted afterwards under the excuse that he could not see
the book clearly. The trial of a case is not a trivial
matter, nor should it be regarded as a joke. Moreover, the
accused Yang Wen Dao is a man of mature age Was it likely that
the accused would have recklessly admitted the ownership
of a piece of important material evidence if he could not
see it clearly at the time? The object of the accused in
confessing to the ownership of the book at that time was
quite obvious. He knew full well that he could not deny
ownership of the book seized at his home; at the same time
he had hoped that by alleging that the book had been kept
by him for the purpose of concealing another pistol, he
would be able to conceal the real facts, thereby enabling
him to escape punishment. On April 27 when the case was
again heard, the Municipal Advocate declared that the statement
made by the accused to the effect that the book in question
was used for concealing another pistol was incredible and
unreliable. An examination of the book was therefore made
in Court and it was ascertained that the book could not have
been used for concealing another pistol. Moreover, it was
established by means of photographic examination and a
theoretical explanation by Mr. Dickson, an expert in the
identification of finger prints, that the book in question had
actually been used to conceal the pistol used in the murder.
As a result of this established fact which proves that his
allegation was unfounded, the accused, being helpless, had

撇开杨文道在巡捕房所作的所有承认该书属于他的陈述不谈，当杨文道于今年4月20日首次被提堂受审时，他也同样声明该书是他的财产。在法官面前作出的此类陈述，当然应被视为可靠，事后不能以没看清书为借口予以撤回。案件审判绝非儿戏，也不应被视为玩笑。此外，被告杨文道是一个成熟稳重的人。如果当时他没看清，怎么可能轻率地承认拥有这一重要物证呢？被告当时承认拥有该书的目的显而易见。他深知无法否认在其家中搜获的书的所有权；同时，他希望声称该书是用来藏匿另一支手枪的，从而掩盖真实情况，以此逃避惩罚。4月27日再次开庭时，公诉人声明，被告关于该书用于藏匿另一支手枪的说法不可信且不可靠。因此，在法庭上对该书进行了检验，确定该书不可能用于藏匿另一支手枪。此外，通过照片检验以及指纹鉴定专家迪克森先生的理论解释，确定该书确实被用于藏匿谋杀案中使用的手枪。由于这一既定事实证明其指控毫无根据，被告无可奈何，

no alternative but to retract his former statement under the
excuse that he did not see the book clearly, in the hope of
nullifying all his former statements so as to enable him to
avert the consequences of his criminal act. The Court of
First Instance was definitely of the opinion that both the
book and the pistol in question were the property of the
accused Yang Wen Dao and that the book had been exclusively
used by Yang Wen Dao for the purpose of concealing the said
pistol, because the Court regarded the statement in which he
admitted the ownership of the book made by him (Yang Wen Dao)
on April 20 as well as the result of the examination of the
book and the pistol made by the police expert as believable
and reliable. Such a conclusion reached on the basis of
evidence and theoretical knowledge is not one that can be
easily refuted by unsupported allegations and vague assertions.
The above is the reason why the Court of
First Instance came to the definite opinion that the book
in question was the property of Yang Wen Dao. The matter
that deserves consideration and attention at present is to
ascertain, from a reverse point of view, whether or not the
book in question was one that had been planted to implicate
the accused by some person or persons in a conspiracy to
obtain the rewards. The point can be decided by a chronological
inference from the facts and reasons set forth in the written
appeal drawn up by the counsel for the defence of the accused,
Yih Hai Sung.
(A) Whether or not the informer or informers
who reported the affair to the police, were moved by an
intention to obtain the rewards and whether or not the arrested
person was guilty and should be held responsible for the
consequences of his criminal act are two different questions
that have no subsequent connection with each other whatever.

别无选择，只能以没看清书为借口撤回之前的陈述，希望以此推翻他之前的所有陈述，从而避免其犯罪行为带来的后果。初审法院明确认为，涉案书籍和手枪均为被告杨文道的财产，且该书专被杨文道用于藏匿所述手枪，因为法院认为杨文道于4月20日承认拥有该书的陈述，以及警方专家对书籍和手枪的检验结果，都是可信和可靠的。基于证据和理论知识得出的这一结论，不是凭无根据的指控和模糊的断言就能轻易驳倒的。

以上就是初审法院明确认定涉案书籍为杨文道财产的原因。目前值得考虑和关注的是，从相反的角度查明，涉案书籍是否由某人或某些人阴谋栽赃给被告，以获取赏金。这一点可以通过对被告辩护律师易海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）撰写的书面上诉状中列出的事实和理由进行时间顺序推断来决定。

(A) 向警方举报此事的线人是否出于获取赏金的意图，以及被捕者是否有罪并应为其犯罪行为的后果承担责任，这是两个截然不同的问题，彼此之间没有任何后续关联。

The prosecution was not based entirely upon the information
supplied by the informer. Moreover, the sentence delivered
by the Court was based entirely upon proper and reliable
evidence. If it be said that an informer who supplies the
information to the Police must be a perjurer and that the
evidence thus obtained must be planted evidence, then the
offering of rewards is tantamount to an act of inducing
persons to commit crime. In this respect, strict legislative
measures should be immediately adopted to prohibit the
offering of rewards, while the Court should refuse to deal
with any case in which a reward has been offered, nor is it
necessary for the Court to study the evidence in such cases;
all that it need do is to return a verdict of "not guilty".
Furthermore, the Court of First Instance did
not even use the statements made by Zung Wei Min (鄭偉民)
and Tseng Yuan (曾元) as a basis for its judgment in
connection with this case, nor were the names of these two
witnesses ever mentioned in the written judgment. All this
shows that the Court was very strict and careful in accepting
the evidence. It is, therefore, too unreasonable for the
appellants to criticise the judgment on the basis of evidence
that had not been taken down by the Court.
This is the reason why the Court of First
Instance did not take into consideration the evidence given
by Zung Wei Min and Tseng Yuan. It is the duty of the
appellants to prove how these two witnesses had manufactured
the evidence and how it was planted by Yang Chien Chung (楊建忠).
The witness Chang Tan (張琛) was also one
of those who desired to obtain the rewards. At first, he
was even on quite good terms with Zung Wei Min, Tseng Yuan
and others, but later, owing to some dispute over benefits
and rights amongst themselves, he began to give hostile
evidence. Judging from his psychology and personality, he
appears in every respect to be a person of a mean and low
mind. It was, therefore, only natural that his evidence was

起诉并非完全基于线人提供的信息。此外，法院的判决完全基于适当且可靠的证据。如果说向警方提供信息的线人必然是伪证者，由此获得的证据必然是栽赃的证据，那么提供赏金就等于诱使人们犯罪的行为。在这方面，应立即采取严格的立法措施禁止提供赏金，而法院应拒绝处理任何涉及提供赏金的案件，也无须研究此类案件中的证据；只需作出“无罪”判决即可。

此外，初审法院甚至未将郑伟民（Zung Wei Min）和曾元（Tseng Yuan）的陈述作为本案判决的依据，判决书中也从未提及这两名证人的名字。所有这些表明，法院在采信证据方面非常严格和谨慎。因此，上诉人基于法院未记录的证据来批评判决，是极不合理的。

这就是初审法院未考虑郑伟民和曾元所供证据的原因。上诉人的责任是证明这两名证人如何伪造证据，以及这些证据是如何由杨建忠（Yang Chien Chung）栽赃的。证人张琛（Chang Tan）也是希望获得赏金的人之一。起初，他与郑伟民、曾元等人关系甚好，但后来，由于彼此之间在利益和权利上发生争执，他开始提供敌对证词。从他的心理和性格来看，他在各方面都显得心胸狭隘、品格低劣。因此，他的证词自然

not given consideration by the Court of First Instance.
Even if his evidence could have been relied upon, yet there
was still lacking sufficient and reliable evidence to prove

It was, therefore, quite proper for the Court of First

initial
The allegation that the evidence was planted
not
by Yang Chien Chung was first made by Yang Wen Dae himself.
This can be proved by the fact that although he did make
several contradictory statements and illogical explanations
as regards the book and pistol in question during the
hearings on April 20 and 27, May 1 and 6, he never mentioned
the name of Yang Chien Chung. It was during the hearing
of May 6, about 30 minutes before the Court rose, that
lawyer Kuh Chao Chi (葛肇基), counsel for the defence of
the accused Yang Wen Dae, suddenly rose and stated on behalf
of his client that there were reasons to believe that Yang
Chien Chung was the person who had planted the evidence
against his client, and requested the Court to interrogate
the witness Chang Tsun. When the latter was asked to give
his evidence, he simply read out a draft drawn up beforehand
by a certain person named Yih (叶) at the office of the
aforementioned lawyer. On May 20 Yang Wen Dae made a
similar statement in Court when the case was further heard;
he alleged that Yang Chien Chung had planted the evidence
against him. It was as a result of this allegation that
Yang Chien Chung became connected with this case. This
allegation was regarded by the Court of First Instance as
extraordinary and mysterious and as one which would create

初审法院未予考虑。
即使可以采信其证词，仍然缺乏充分且可靠的证据来证明其他证人是如何制造并栽赃这一关键证据的事实和情节。
因此，初审法院不采纳张尊（Chang Tsun）提供的反证是完全恰当的，因为该反证被认为不足以证明其可靠性。
最初
关于证据系被栽赃的指控，并非
由杨建中（Yang Chien Chung）首先提出，而是由杨文达（Yang Wen Dae）本人首先提出的。
这一点可由以下事实证实：尽管在4月20日、27日以及5月1日、6日的聆讯中，他就涉案书籍和手枪作出了若干相互矛盾的陈述和不合逻辑的解释，但他从未提及杨建中的名字。直到5月6日的聆讯中，大约在法庭休庭前30分钟，被告杨文达的辩护律师葛肇基（Kuh Chao Chi）突然起立，代表其当事人声明有理由相信杨建中是栽赃陷害其当事人的人，并请求法庭讯问证人张尊。当后者被要求提供证词时，他只是宣读了前述律师办公室内一位姓叶（Yih）的人事先起草的一份草稿。5月20日，在案件进一步审理时，杨文达在法庭上作了类似陈述；他声称杨建中栽赃陷害他。正是由于这一指控，杨建中才与此案产生关联。初审法院认为这一指控离奇且神秘，足以在听众心中造成

pages.en:
- 11 -
a doubt in the minds of the listeners and make them regard
it as vague and incredible, to say nothing of the fact that
Yang Chien Chung later presented himself in Court and made
a denial of this unfounded allegation. His denial was supported
by reasonable and matter-of-fact explanations, which alone
were sufficient to refute this allegation. Now even if
Yang Chien Chung had not been located or if had refused to
give any explanation, such a statement would have been
untenable. It would never have been taken into consideration
by the Court of First Instance which has been so strict and
careful in sorting out evidence.
(B) There was absolutely no need to examine
the book for finger prints. This point has already been
clearly defined in the report, No. 100, Character "Chien",
of the Medico-Legal Laboratory on the result of its
examination. Roughly speaking, the marks of the finger
prints that remained in the book were either too short or
too insufficient for examination. It is just the same as if
a hand-writing expert is unable to rely upon one or two
characters to justify his decision as to whether or not
it is the hand-writing of a certain person. Now, the
appellants, taking advantage of the fact that it was practically
impossible to find out the finger prints, alleged that the
book was not the property of Yang Wen Dae and that it was
the book that had been planted to implicate him. We regret
to state that we are unable to understand how they came to
reach such a wonderful conclusion.
(C) The report, No. 99, Character "Chien" of
the Medico-Legal Laboratory indicates that there were oil
stains on the pistol and on the pages of the book. This
point corroborates the statement made in Court on May 1 by
Mr. Dickson, the finger print expert of the S.M.P: "The pistol
pages.zh:

疑虑，使其认为该指控模糊且不可信，更不用说杨建中后来出庭并否认了这一毫无根据的指控。他的否认得到了合理且实事求是的解释的支持，仅凭这些解释就足以驳斥这一指控。现在，即使没有找到杨建中，或者他拒绝作出任何解释，这样的陈述也是站不住脚的。它在证据甄别方面如此严格和谨慎的初审法院那里，绝不会被纳入考虑范围。
(B) 完全没有必要对该书进行指纹检验。法医实验室在第100号“建”字报告中已明确说明了检验结果。大致而言，书中残留的指纹印记要么太短，要么残缺不全，无法进行检验。这就好比笔迹专家无法仅凭一两个字来判断是否某人的笔迹。现在，上诉人利用实际上无法提取指纹这一情况，声称该书并非杨文达所有，而是被人栽赃以陷害他的书。我们要遗憾地表示，我们无法理解他们是如何得出如此奇妙的结论的。
(C) 法医实验室第99号“建”字报告指出，手枪上和书页上均有油渍。这一点佐证了工部局警务处指纹专家迪克森（Dickson）先生于5月1日在法庭上的陈述：“手枪

pages.en:
- 12 -

having been oiled, there were no finger prints, therefore,
it is impossible to examine or to form an opinion".
The book and the pistol became rusty owing to the presence
of oil; it cannot be proved that the rust had been
manufactured by the conspirators. Although the marks on
the pages "can hardly be formed without strong exterior
pressure", the appellant has not proved that after the
seizure of the pistol and while it was in the custody of
the Police, some person had hollowed out the shape of
the pistol and placed the pistol in the book; furthermore,
the exterior pressure was applied so as to keep the rust
marks on the pages preparatory to planting the evidence later.
The expression "it can hardly be formed" means a comparison
between difficulty and ease; it does not mean that it
actually "cannot be formed". The report does not mean
that "it is sufficient to prove that the book was made
at that very time". The appellant drew a wrongful
inference from the report and argued that it was improper
that this point was not referred to during the hearing
by the Court of First Instance. This is due to a
misunderstanding.

(D) If we read the whole paragraph of
Section 4 of the report, No. 99, Character "Chien", of the
Medico-Legal Laboratory, it is very easy to understand it.
As to the reason why "it is rather difficult to judge how
long it was made", the report says: "The four sides of
the shape of the pistol cut out in the book and the marks
of the excavation are regular except that the left side
is slightly rough and the colour is shining. This colour
has no remarkable difference from the sheen of the paper".
A study of this shows that the report contains no perverted
argument that "there could never be such marks unless they

因上过油，没有指纹，因此无法检验或形成意见”。
书籍和手枪因有油而生锈；无法证明这些锈迹是阴谋者人为制造的。虽然书页上的痕迹“若无强烈外力压迫几乎无法形成”，但上诉人并未证明在手枪被扣押并由警方保管期间，有人挖出了手枪形状的凹槽并将手枪放入书中；此外，施加外力是为了在书页上保留锈迹标记，以便日后栽赃证据。“几乎无法形成”这一表述意味着难易程度的比较；并不意味着实际上“无法形成”。该报告并不意味着“足以证明该书是在当时制作的”。上诉人从报告中得出了错误的推论，并辩称初审法院在聆讯期间未提及此点是不当的。这是由于误解所致。

(D) 如果我们阅读法医实验室第99号“建”字报告第4节的整段内容，就很容易理解。关于“很难判断制作时间有多久”的原因，报告称：“书中挖出的手枪形状的四边及挖掘痕迹均很规整，只是左侧略显粗糙且色泽光亮。这种颜色与纸张的光泽没有显著差异”。对此进行研究可知，报告中并没有歪曲论点称“除非是当时制作的，否则绝不会有此类痕迹”。法医实验室在不知情的情况下坦承其无知，称“很难判断制作时间有多久”。实验室这种坦诚诚实的态度值得称赞。上诉人声称他知道，而实际上他并不知道；他却大胆地突然做出断言：“除非是当时制作的，否则绝不会有此类痕迹”。

(E) 藏有手枪的那本书是否为杨文道（Yang Wen Dao）所拥有，以及杨文道是否在法庭上承认该书为其所有，在前几段中已详细提及和研究。上诉人再次试图像在审判期间那样掩盖其不当行为。此处无需再予答复。

(F) 初审法庭记录在案并经辨认的那本书，事实上就是藏有手枪的那本书。不仅手枪的形状、尺寸和标记与书中挖出的孔洞周围的特征相似，而且手枪表面的锈迹与孔洞内的锈迹有多达40个相似点。（参见存档的照片和报告。）法医实验室的报告称：“可能存在偶然对应的点。但锈迹的位置和状况很难指望在每一点上都相似”。书中与手枪上相对应的锈迹点多达40个。上诉人是否仍认为这不足够？如果是这样，那么在上诉人看来，需要有多少个这样的相似点才能让他满意，并使他相信初审法院没有“误解”？

pages.en:
- 13 -

were made at that very time". The Medico-Legal Laboratory
has frankly confessed its ignorance when it does not know
so it says "it is rather difficult to judge how long it
was made". The frank and honest attitude of the Laboratory
is praiseworthy. The appellant declares that he knows
when, in reality, he does not know; he is so bold as to come
suddenly to a decision word: "There could never be such
marks unless they were made at that very time".

(E) Whether or not the book, in which a pistol
was concealed, was possessed by Yang Wen Dao and whether
or not it was a fact that Yang Wen Dao had acknowledged
the book to be his property in Court has been mentioned
and studied in detail in previous paragraphs. The appellant
is again attempting to hide his wrong doings as he did
during the trial. It is not here necessary to reply to him.

(F) The book on record identified in the
Court of First Instance is, in fact, the book in which the
pistol was concealed. Not only are the shape, the size
and the marks of the pistol similar to those around the
hole hollowed out in the book, but there are as many as
40 points of similarity between the rust marks on the
surface of the pistol and those in the hole. (Vide the
photos and reports on file.) The report made by the
Medico-Legal Laboratory says: "It is possible that there
are points that correspond accidentally. But the positions
and the condition of the rust marks can hardly be expected
to be similar at every point". There are as many as 40
points in which the rust in the book corresponds to that
on the pistol. Does the appellant still hold the view
that this is insufficient? If so, then how many such
similar points, in the opinion of the appellant, will
satisfy him and convince him that the Court of First Instance
had no "misunderstanding"?

(G) 杨文道的仆人陈荣生（Chen Yung Sung）最初关于那本书的陈述，可见于记录在案并存档的4月26日的供词。该供词称，一本绿色硬封面的书确实是杨文道的财产；该书放在卧室里，他在洒水扫地时经常看到它。陈荣生从五本类似的书中间认出了记录在案的那本书是杨家的书。所有这些细节均已书面记录，不得随意更改。上诉人声称该书是他人阴谋获取或制作的，而杨家的书是一本英文书，这些说法均无根据。如果杨家的书确实是一本英文书，而记录在案的那本书确实是由他人阴谋制作的，那么栽赃证据的人为何要留下这一线索？为何不使用一本类似的英文书，从而使被诬陷的杨文达更容易“看不清楚”，且不给他留下争辩的口实？

(H) 初审法院判定杨文道有罪。其判决并非仅基于那本书，而是基于属于杨文道的物品，例如用于谋杀案的手枪，该手枪实际上被发现秘密藏在那本书中。同时，初审法院认为同伙叶海松（Yih Hai Sung）的陈述是真实的。此外，法院采用了该同伙虽不利于自己但仍被视为可接受的陈述。因此，法院认定杨文道是同伙，必须承担责任。这一结论在法律和逻辑上都是正确的。然而，上诉人曲解了其含义，声称书籍和手枪

pages.en:
- 14 -

(G) What Chen Yung Sung (陳榮生), the servant
of Yang Wen Dao, stated at the very beginning regarding the
book can be seen from his statement made on April 26 which is
on record and file. This statement says that a book with
a hard green cover was actually the property of Yang Wen Dao;
that the book was placed in the bedroom and that he frequently
saw it when he sprinkled water and swept the floor. The
book on record was identified by Chen Yung Sung as Yang's book
from among five books of a similar kind. All these
particulars have been made in writing and cannot be altered
arbitrarily. The contention of the appellant that the book
had been obtained or made in conspiracy by others and that
Yang's book was an English book are all without basis. If
it is true that Yang's book was an English book and if the book
on record had really been made by others in conspiracy, then
why should the person, who had planted the evidence, leave this
clue and why should did he not use a similar English book so
that Yang Wen Dao, who was to be falsely accused, would more
easily "be unable to see it clearly" and it would have been given him
no ground for argument.

(H) The Court of First Instance found Yang
Wen Dao guilty. Its judgment was not based only on the book,
but according to things belonging to Yang Wen Dao, such as
his pistol used in the murder case and which was actually
found to have been secretly concealed in the book. At the
same time, the Court of First Instance regarded the statement
of Yih Hai Sung, an accomplice, as being true. Furthermore,
the Court used the statement of the accomplice, though it
was unfavourable to himself, and regarded it as acceptable.
Therefore, the Court came to the decision that Yang Wen Dao
is an accomplice and must be held responsible. This conclusion
is correct in law and logic. The appellant, however,
misinterpreted the meaning, declaring that the book and pistol

- 14 -

不足以证明杨有罪。如果一个人仔细阅读判决书，而不是故意误导自己或过分强调“叶海松关于用于过失杀人的手枪是由杨文道交给他的陈述备受采信并得到证实”这一表述，那么内心就能清晰理解并同意法院的裁决。

2. 叶海松的陈述。

由于法院在得出结论时使用了叶海松的陈述和现场重建，上诉人攻击该陈述和重建，理由是它们并非自愿作出，且与实际发生的情况不符。上诉人进一步声称，法院不应采纳此类证据。被上诉人将单独讨论此事。

(1) 被告作出供认主要基于以下原因：-

(A) 他真诚悔悟自己的罪行，并愿意披露所有事实以减轻良心负担。

(B) 被捕后，他害怕受到惩罚。因此，他供认事实，希望获得轻判。

(C) 在审判期间，他知道证据充分，无法否认，最好揭露真实情况，将自己的命运交由天意安排。

根据法律，陈述必须是自由作出的。这一原则众所周知。如果被告狡猾，拒绝供认，并通过声称其陈述是在酷刑下作出的来攻击调查机构，他可能会引起人们对其案件的关注。被告在许多

pages.en:
- 15 -

were insufficient evidence to prove Yang guilty. If one would
read the verdict carefully and not purposely mislead oneself
or overstress the expression "the statement of Yih Hai Sung,
that the pistol used in the manslaughter was given to him by
Yang Wen Dao, is much believed and proved", then one can have
a clear understanding at heart and agree with the findings of the
Court.

2. Yih Hai Sung's Statement.

As the Court had used Yih Hai Sung's statement
and reconstruction in coming to its conclusion, the appellant
attacks this statement and reconstruction on the ground that
they were not made voluntarily and did not correspond with what
actually occurred. The appellant further declares that the
Court should not have adopted such evidence. The appellee
will discuss the matter separately.

(1) The accused made a confession mostly on the
following grounds:-

(A) He sincerely repented having committed the
crime and was willing to disclose all the facts in order to
ease his conscience.

(B) After being arrested, he was afraid of
punishment. He therefore confessed the facts in the hope of
receiving a light punishment.

(C) During the trial, he knew that there was
adequate evidence and that he could not deny it and that it
would be better for him to reveal the real facts, leaving his
fate in the hands of Providence.

According to law, a statement must be made
freely. This principle is known to everybody. If an accused
is cunning and refuses to confess and attacks the investigation
organization by saying that his statement was made under torture,
he may draw attention to his case. The accused, on many
pages.zh:
- 15 -

证据不足以证明杨有罪。如果仔细研读判决书，不故意误导自己或过分强调“易海松关于过失杀人所用枪支系由杨文道提供之陈述，甚为可信且经证实”这一表述，人们便能心中了然，并认同法院的裁决。

2. 易海松的陈述。

由于法院在作出裁决时采用了易海松的陈述及案情重构，上诉人以该陈述及重构并非自愿作出且与实际情况不符为由，对其提出攻击。上诉人进一步宣称，法院本不应采纳此类证据。被上诉人将对此事另行讨论。

(1) 被告作出供认，主要基于以下理由：-

(A) 他对自己犯罪真诚悔过，并愿意披露全部事实，以求良心安宁。

(B) 被捕后，他因害怕受罚而供认事实，希望借此获得轻判。

(C) 在审判期间，他知悉证据确凿，无法抵赖，认为不如如实交代事实，将命运交由天意安排。

依照法律，陈述必须出于自愿。此原则众所周知。若被告狡黠，拒绝供认，并以遭受刑讯逼供为由攻击调查机构，可能会引起对其案件的关注。被告在许多

pages.en:
- 16 -

occasions, confessed his crime in Court and gave full
particulars. Nevertheless, the accused later declared that
after he had made his confessions, he was tortured to obtain
a statement from him. He has thus refuted his statement
under a pretext but it is not reasonable. Officers who
undertake investigations are not so mad or foolish as to
resort to torture after an accused has already confessed in
Court on several occasions. What could be their motive?
At six hearings of the case on April 21 and 27, May 1, 6, 9
and 20, Yih Hai Sung did not say anything about his being
tortured. Even during the trial on May 27, after the lawyer
for his defence had been designated, when he alleged the
torture, he also declared that the period of his torture was
"during the several days after the case was remanded for
two weeks." It will be remembered that the period of the
remand for two weeks was between May 6 and 20, but before
May 6, Yih Hai Sung had already, on many occasions, given all
the real facts in Court. Owing to these confessions made by
the accused, the investigators, the prosecutors and the triers
had already known all that they wanted to know. Then what
was the reason of employing torture and was it absolutely
necessary to do so?

As to the source of the allegation of Yih Hai
Sung's being tortured, there are points worthy of attention.
As the appellant holds the view that the period of torture
was between May 6 and 20, then why did he still make confessions
and did not mention the torture at the hearing on May 20?
On the afternoon of May 21, lawyers Chang Ts Hsiang (張志讓)
and Wong Sz Chung (王士宗) called at Chengtu Road Police
Station and interviewed the appellant Yih Hai Sung. Besides
the Japanese policemen of the detention house (cell), there
were also senior officers D.S.I. Crowther, D.S.I. Ross,
pages.zh:
- 16 -

多次在法庭上供认其罪行，并提供了详尽的细节。然而，被告后来声称，在他作出供认之后，为了获取口供而对他施以酷刑。他因此借故推翻了自己的供词，但这并不合理。负责调查的警官不至于如此疯狂或愚蠢，在被告已多次在法庭上供认之后还诉诸酷刑。他们的动机何在？在4月21日、27日，5月1日、6日、9日和20日对该案进行的六次聆讯中，叶海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）并未提及自己遭受酷刑一事。甚至在5月27日的审判中，在其辩护律师被指定后，当他指控遭受酷刑时，他也声称受刑期间是“在案件还押候审两周后的几天内”。须记得，这两周的还押期是在5月6日至20日之间，但在5月6日之前，叶海松已多次在法庭上陈述了所有真实情况。鉴于被告的这些供认，调查人员、检察官和审判人员已经知道了他们想知道的一切。那么，动用酷刑的理由是什么？这样做绝对有必要吗？

关于叶海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）指控遭受酷刑的来源，有几点值得注意。既然上诉人认为受刑期间是在5月6日至20日之间，那么为何他在5月20日的聆讯中仍然作出供认且未提及酷刑？5月21日下午，张志让（Chang Ts Hsiang）和王士宗（Wong Sz Chung）两位律师前往成都路警察局，会见了上诉人叶海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）。除了拘留所（牢房）的日本警察外，高级警官警探长克劳瑟（D.S.I. Crowther）、警探长罗斯（D.S.I. Ross）、

pages.en:
- 17 -

Chinese Detective Inspector Sih ( 薛 ) and others, who were
present during the interview. Not only did Yih Hai Sung
fail to make any complaint of torture, but he stated that he
was quite satisfied with the treatment accorded him by the
Police. Furthermore, when lawyer Chang voluntarily asked
Yih Hai Sung about the scar on his upper lip, the accused
replied that it was caused when he accidentally bit it with his
teeth. The accused made no allegation that he had been
tortured with burning cigarettes or with water being poured
into his nostrils (vide the interviews mentioned in Chapters
26 and 27 of the Police Investigation Record as well as the
written reports on interviews submitted by the officers of
various Police Stations).

On May 27 when a hearing took place, lawyer
Chang contested the genuineness of the material evidence produced
in Court and it was he who, before the accused said anything,
made allegations of torture and injury. He used all kinds
of illustrations to support his statement so much so that he
imagined them to be actual facts. His statement lasted one
hour (vide record of the hearing of May 27).

The appellee has no knowledge whether the
accused had received any hints at that time. But since then,
Yih Hai Sung immediately retracted his statements and alleged
that he had been tortured by the Police. The mind of a
criminal is fickle; whenever he sees a chance to avert
punishment or an opportunity to shift the responsibility, he
will try by all means to make use of it no matter whether his
statement is illogical or unbelievable. Therefore, the
accused's allegations of torture should likewise be dealt in
this light. The Court of First Instance was not misled
by the statements of the accused because these allegations of
torture and their particulars were too extraordinary and
incredible. The Court therefore came to the conclusion
pages.zh:
- 17 -

华人警探长薛（Sih）等人也在会见现场。叶海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）不仅没有提出任何关于遭受酷刑的投诉，反而表示他对警方给予他的待遇相当满意。此外，当张律师主动询问叶海松上唇的疤痕时，被告回答说那是他不小心用牙齿咬伤所致。被告并未指控有人用燃烧的香烟烫他或往他的鼻孔里灌水（参见《警务调查记录》第26和27章中提到的访谈，以及各警察局警官提交的书面访谈报告）。

5月27日举行聆讯时，张律师对法庭出示的物证的真实性提出质疑，并且在被告开口之前，由他提出了关于酷刑和伤害的指控。他使用了各种例证来支持其陈述，以至于将这些例证想象为既定事实。他的陈述持续了一个小时（参见5月27日聆讯记录）。

被上诉人不知晓被告当时是否收到了任何暗示。但自那以后，叶海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）立即翻供，并指控遭到警方酷刑。罪犯的心思多变；每当看到逃避惩罚的机会或推卸责任的契机，无论其陈述多么不合逻辑或令人难以置信，他都会千方百计加以利用。因此，对于被告关于酷刑的指控，也应从这个角度来看待。初审法院并未被被告的陈述所误导，因为这些关于酷刑的指控及其细节过于离奇且不可信。因此，法院得出结论

pages.en:
- 18 -

that "it was quite obvious that the accused, in making use
of these pretexts, had the intention of retracting his
statements."

(2) The reconstruction of the crime was
carried out under the direction of the Presiding Judge in
accordance with his legal authority. All the lawyers for the
defence were present. These facts cannot be denied by the
appellant. The accused was held by Police officers and his
two hands were handcuffed during the reconstruction of the
crime. This was necessary as a matter of Police precaution.
As the reconstruction was conducted in full view of the public,
the Police could not have forced Yih Hai Sung to move on if
he did not want to nor could the Police have forced him to
stop if he did not want to. If there had been Police direction
during the reconstruction (no complaint was lodged at that time
by the lawyers for the defence who were present in the interests
of the accused), such direction was due to the negligence of
duty on the part of the lawyers for the appellant. Yet, they
are now making use of these allegations to criticize the
judgment of the Court. Why are they now less indulgent than
before?

(3) As regards the statement and the
reconstruction which are alleged in the written appeal as being
contrary to facts, the following points should be noted:-

(A) It is a psychological fact that a
person in the act of committing a murder is likely to become
over-excited and full of fear. Furthermore, the murder took
place at a late hour at night and at a place which was not
familiar to all. In a flash a bullet has been shot out from
a pistol, in another flash the murderer has made good his escape.
Can it be believed that the murderer would still remain there
long enough to make a close examination and to ascertain the
actual distance of the shooting so as to make use of this
pages.zh:
- 18 -

认为，“显而易见，被告利用这些借口，意在推翻其供词。”

(2) 犯罪现场重建是在主审法官依据其法定职权指导下进行的。所有辩护律师均在场。这些事实上诉人无法否认。在犯罪现场重建过程中，被告由警察控制，双手戴着手铐。这是出于警务预防措施的必要之举。由于重建过程是在公众视野下公开进行的，如果叶海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）不愿意移动，警方不可能强迫他移动；如果他不愿意停下，警方也不可能强迫他停下。如果在重建过程中存在警方的指挥（当时在场的辩护律师为了被告的利益并未提出投诉），那么这种指挥是由于上诉人辩护律师的失职所致。然而，他们现在却利用这些指控来批评法院的判决。为何他们现在不如以前宽容？

(3) 关于书面上诉中指控与事实不符的供词和现场重建，应注意以下几点：-

(A) 一个人在实施谋杀行为时，往往会变得过度兴奋和充满恐惧，这是一个心理学事实。此外，谋杀发生在深夜，地点并非人人熟悉。刹那间手枪射出一颗子弹，又一刹那间凶手已逃脱。能否相信凶手还会在那里停留足够长的时间，以便仔细检查并确定射击的实际距离，从而在日后需要供词或重建犯罪现场时利用这一信息？此外，警方枪械鉴定专家已经证实，射击距离非常近。从理论上讲，警方不指望被告能够回忆起确切的距离。由于每个人在评判他人的善意或智慧时都有自己的标准，警方为了得出准确的结论，忽略了叶海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）在供词中提到的“五六步的距离”这一说法。

(B) 证人潘巧英（Pan Chiao Ying，音译）也进行了现场重建，因为认为有必要让她提供基于实际重建的证词。由于她的重建结果与事实相符，上诉人找不到反驳的依据。

(C) 在叶海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）的重建与证人胡祥河（Hu Ziang Ho，音译）的重建中，关于逃跑男子经过电线杆这一点存在一些差异，但叶海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）在重建时通过合乎逻辑的解释澄清了这一点。

(D) 从背后看，海军制服的样式与普通外国服装之间没有显著差异。诚然，人们乍一看可能会注意到一个人跑步时的身高与他直立站立时的身高之间存在一些差异。如果外国服装扣好扣子，此人的腰部会显得窄小。凭借常识即可理解所有这些事项。

3. 谋杀动机。

不能凭想象来判断一个人犯罪的动机。因饥饿而盗窃的案件

pages.en:
- 19 -

information in future when a statement or a reconstruction
of the crime was required? In addition, the Police firearms
identification expert has already established the fact that
the distance of the shooting was very small. Theoretically,
the Police do not entertain any hope that the accused would
be able to recollect the exact distance. As each one has
his own standard when judging another's kindness or wisdom,
the Police, in order to form an accurate conclusion, has
ignored the phrase "a distance of five or six steps" as
mentioned in the statement by Yih Hai Sung.

(B) Witness Pan Chiao Ying also gave a
reconstruction because it was deemed necessary to have her
evidence which must be based on an actual reconstruction.
As the result of her reconstruction corresponded with the
actual facts, the appellant could find no grounds of rebuttal.

(C) There were some differences during the
reconstruction made by Yih Hai Sung and the reconstruction by
the witness Hu Ziang Ho regarding the point about the fleeing
man passing by the electric pole, but this point was made
clear by Yih Hai Sung at the time of the reconstruction as
a result of the logical explanations given by him.

(D) There are no remarkable differences
between the style of a marine uniform and that of foreign
clothing when seen from behind. It is true that one may,
at a casual glance, notice some differences between the height
of a person whilst running and his height when he is standing
upright. If the foreign clothing is buttoned up, the
waist of the person would appear narrow and small. An
understanding of all such matters can be obtained by common
sense.

3. Motive of the Murder.

One cannot judge the motive of a person
who commits a crime on the basis of one's imagination. Cases
pages.zh:
- 19 -

日后若需供词或重建犯罪现场时，如何获取信息？此外，警方枪械鉴定专家已证实射击距离极近。理论上，警方不指望被告能够回忆起确切的距离。由于每个人在评判他人的善意或智慧时各有标准，警方为得出准确结论，对易海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）供词中提到的“五六步的距离”这一说法未予采信。

(B) 证人潘巧英（Pan Chiao Ying，音译）也进行了现场重建，因为认为有必要让她提供基于实际重建的证词。由于她的重建结果与事实相符，上诉人找不到反驳的依据。

(C) 易海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）与证人胡祥河（Hu Ziang Ho，音译）在进行现场重建时，关于逃跑男子经过电线杆这一点存在一些差异，但易海松通过合乎逻辑的解释，在现场重建时澄清了这一点。

(D) 从背后看，水手制服的样式与西式服装并无显著差异。诚然，人们乍一看可能会注意到一个人跑步时的身高与其直立站立时的身高之间存在一些差异。如果西式服装扣好扣子，人的腰部会显得窄小。凭借常识即可理解所有此类情况。

3. 谋杀动机。

不能凭想象来判断犯罪者的动机。案件

pages.en:
- 20 -
of larceny by persons moved by hunger are of frequent
occurrence. It may be argued that not all who are hungry
will commit larceny nor is larceny a good way to solve the
hunger question, therefore such a motive was regarded as
unreasonable. This is stupid argument and cannot be relied
upon. In judging the mind of a low-minded person by the
standard of a saint, the appellant has exposed his narrow-
mindedness and vileness as well as his ignorance of social
conditions.
4. The Counter-Evidence of the Defense.
The counter-evidence of the defense consists
of two points; namely,
(1) that on November 8 he was participating
in the inaugural ceremony of the Nanyang Dance Hall.
(2) that he was giving a party at the Dah
Chung Hwa Restaurant on the 10th on the occasion of his
mother's birthday.
But he could produce no counter-evidence
about November 9 on which date the Japanese marine was murdered.
According to the appeal, the accused was
busily engaged in other matters on the day prior to the murder
as well as on the day after the murder; therefore it was not
possible for the accused to have committed a murder on the day
between these days.
The appellee is at a loss to see why the plot
of a murder, which had been previously planned, could not have
been carried out on the day between these two days when the
inauguration ceremony and the birthday celebration took place.
5.
According to the appellant, the deductions
from the evidence produced in this case are not logical. It
is true that jealousy over women may have been the cause of
pages.zh:
- 20 -

屡见不鲜。有人可能会争辩说，并非所有饥饿的人都会行窃，而且盗窃也不是解决饥饿问题的好办法，因此这种动机被认为是不合理的。这是一种愚蠢的论点，不足为信。上诉人用圣人的标准来评判卑鄙之人的心理，暴露了其心胸狭隘、卑劣以及对社会状况的无知。

4. 辩方的反证。
辩方的反证包括两点；即，
(1) 11月8日，他参加了南洋舞厅的开幕典礼。
(2) 10日，他在大华饭店（Dah Chung Hwa Restaurant）举办宴会，庆祝其母亲生日。
但他无法提供关于11月9日（即日本水兵被杀之日）的任何反证。
根据上诉状，被告在谋杀前一天和后一天都忙于其他事务；因此，被告不可能在这两天中间的那一天实施谋杀。
被上诉人不明白，既然谋杀是预谋的，为何不能在举行开幕典礼和生日庆祝活动的这两天中间的那一天实施。

5.
上诉人认为，从本案提出的证据中得出的推论不合逻辑。确实，因女人而产生的嫉妒可能是

pages.en:
- 21 -

the murder, but the appellant could give no names of any
persons who were rivals of the victim over women. It is
indeed unreasonable for the appellant to use his imagination
to pervert the facts so strongly in trying to enable the
accused to avoid the consequences of his criminal acts.
The 2nd Branch of the Kiangsu High Court is therefore requested
to regard the appeal as illogical and to dismiss the appeal.

Filed by Messrs. Bryan and Paul Ru, Municipal
Advocates of the S.M.C. on November 18, 1936.
pages.zh:
- 21 -

谋杀的原因，但上诉人未能提供任何与受害者在女人问题上存在竞争关系的人员姓名。上诉人试图通过想象如此强烈地歪曲事实，以使被告逃避其犯罪行为的后果，这确实是不合理的。
因此，请求江苏高等法院第二分院认定该上诉不合逻辑，并驳回上诉。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
October 3, 1936. Morning Translation.
No. D
Date / /
Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-
THE NAKAYAMA CASE : TWO ACCUSED SENTENCED TO DEATH.
The Nakayama murder case which has attracted the attention of the foreign and Chinese public came up for final hearing at the Shanghai First Special District Court yesterday afternoon when Yang Vung Tao (楊文道) and Yih Hai Sung (叶海生) alias Siao Kwangtung (小廣東) were both sentenced to death, while the third accused Tseu Shou Yong (周守庸) was found not guilty.
Precautionary measures were adopted within and without the buildings of the Shanghai First Special District Court from 1 p.m. yesterday. All the persons attending the hearing were subjected to careful search by the judicial police before being allowed to enter the Court room on the third floor.
At 1.30 p.m. the accused Yih Hai Sung was brought into Court under an escort of Japanese detectives. He was still dressed in a suit of blue foreign clothing and looked very pale. Later, Yang Vung Tao and Tseu Shou Yong were brought in. The three accused were seated together on a long bench in the middle of the room, while four Japanese detectives stood on guard beside them.
At 2 p.m. Presiding Judge Chien Hung Nieh (錢鴻業) and Judges Siao Sin Feng (蕭新豐) and Peng Shih Tun (馮士敦), Procurator Tong Pei Yu (唐沛玉) and Court Clerk Ting Zoong Nan (丁重南) entered the Court.
After a brief interrogation of the three accused, Chien Hung Nieh, the Presiding Judge, announced that the decision was about to be delivered.
Taking up the written judgment, he announced the following verdict:-
"Yang Vung Tao and Yih Hai Sung are each sentenced to death and permanently deprived of civil rights for conspiracy to commit murder. The pistol, the six rounds of ammunition, the cartridge shell, the spent bullet, and the book that was used for concealing the pistol are to be confiscated. Tseu Shou Yong is discharged. All the accused are to be taken back for detention at the Police Station during the period of appeal."
Upon hearing the verdict, Yang Vung Tao though excited was silent. When the Judge announced that they could file an appeal, Yih Hai Sung, with tears in his eyes, clenched his fists and bit his lips. He then said: "Death to a man like me is nothing. What is the use of filing an appeal?"
As Tseu Shou Yong, the third accused, did not understand what the Judge had said, he was unaware of his good fortune. He was later informed by his lawyer of the good news.
When being taken away from the Court room, Yih Hai Sung repeatedly shouted out: "Injustice! Injustice!"
Both Yih Hai Sung and Yang Vung Tao were then escorted to the Ward Road Gaol for detention pending an appeal. Tseu Shou Yong was taken back to Central Police

1936年10月3日。晨间译件。
编号 D
日期 / /
《新闻报》、《申报》及其他本地报纸：
中山案：两名被告被判死刑。
备受中外公众关注的中山谋杀案，于昨日下午在上海第一特区地方法院进行终审听证，杨文道（Yang Vung Tao）和叶海生（Yih Hai Sung），别名小广东（Siao Kwangtung），均被判处死刑，而第三名被告周守庸（Tseu Shou Yong）被判无罪。
自昨日下午1时起，上海第一特区地方法院内外均采取了预防措施。所有出席听证的人员在进入三楼法庭前，均须接受司法警察的仔细搜查。
下午1时30分，被告叶海生在日本侦探的押解下被带入法庭。他仍身穿一套蓝色西装，面色十分苍白。随后，杨文道和周守庸也被带入。三名被告并排坐在房间中间的一条长凳上，四名日本侦探在他们身旁站岗警戒。
下午2时，审判长钱鸿业（Chien Hung Nieh）法官，以及萧新丰（Siao Sin Feng）法官和冯士敦（Peng Shih Tun）法官，检察官唐沛玉（Tong Pei Yu）和书记员丁重南（Ting Zoong Nan）进入法庭。
在对三名被告进行简短讯问后，审判长钱鸿业宣布即将宣判。
他拿起判决书，宣读如下判决：
“杨文道和叶海生因共谋杀人罪，各被判处死刑，并永久剥夺公民权利。用于藏匿手枪的手枪、六发子弹、弹壳、射出的子弹以及书籍予以没收。周守庸当庭释放。所有被告在上诉期间将被还押至警察局拘留。”
听到判决后，杨文道虽然激动但保持沉默。当法官宣布他们可以提出上诉时，叶海生眼含泪水，紧握双拳，咬住嘴唇。随后他说：“像我这样的人，死不足惜。上诉有什么用？”
由于第三名被告周守庸听不懂法官的话，他并未意识到自己的幸运。后来由他的律师告知了这一好消息。
在被带离法庭时，叶海生反复高喊：“冤枉！冤枉！”
随后，叶海生和杨文道均被押往华德路监狱拘留，等候上诉。周守庸被带回中央警

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
October 3, 1936. Morning Translation D
Date / /
Station for detention.
The lawyers for the defence are determined to file an appeal. It is learned that the Police are dissatisfied with the decision regarding Tseu Shou Yong and will likewise make an appeal.

Full Text of Judgment

The full text of the judgment was not completed by the Court until yesterday afternoon and was handed to the Legal Department of the S.M.C., the various accused and their respective lawyers after 6 p.m.

Sentence

Yang Vung Tao and Yih Hai Sung are each sentenced to death and are permanently deprived of their civil rights for conspiracy to commit murder. The pistol, the six rounds of ammunition, the empty cartridge, the spent bullet and the book that was used for concealing the pistol are to be confiscated. Tseu Shou Yong is discharged.

The Facts

Yang Vung Tao was formerly the chairman of the Hung Zung Mutual Aid Association, while Yih Hai Sung alias Siao Kwangtung was a member of the Association. This Association, which was formerly known as the "Axe Party", gradually broke up following Yang Vung Tao's departure from Shanghai sometime in the middle of November of the 23rd Year of the Chinese Republic (1934), because of certain affairs. After his return to Shanghai in the same month, he, with the collaboration of Yih Hai Sung and others, organized the Dong Zung and Dong Nyi Co-operative Associations and was the chairman of both, while Yih Hai Sung was a member. However, as the two Associations had only a few members, the influence of the two Associations was below that of the Hung Zung Mutual Aid Association. At the end of October in the 24th Year of the Chinese Republic (1935), Yang Vung Tao, Yih Hai Sung and others secretly conspired to assassinate some Japanese military officers or soldiers with the object of stirring up disturbances, thereby enabling them to seize the opportunity of extending their influence in Hongkew district. Having thus decided, they, at 3 p.m. November 3 the same year, proceeded to Darroch Road for the purpose of first conducting a survey of the district. On the night of November 5, they drew lots at the Dong Nyi Co-operative Association, No. 71 Yung Chi Lee ( 永吉里 ) alleyway off Range Road, to decide who was to undertake the deed. Yih Hai Sung drew the lot on which was written the word "Go", and was therefore given a pistol by Yang Vung Tao sometime after 8 p.m. on November 9. Immediately after receiving the pistol, Yih Hai Sung proceeded to the intersection of Darroch Road and waited there until about 9 p.m. when he noticed a Japanese marine (Nakayama) walking along the road. Yih Hai Sung at once followed the marine and

察局拘留。
辩护律师决心提出上诉。据悉，警方对关于周守庸的判决表示不满，也将提出上诉。

判决书全文

法院直至昨日下午才完成判决书全文，并于下午6点后移交给工部局法律处、各被告及其各自的律师。

判决

杨文道和叶海生因共谋杀人罪，各被判处死刑，并永久剥夺公民权利。用于藏匿手枪的手枪、六发子弹、空弹壳、射出的子弹以及书籍予以没收。周守庸当庭释放。

事实

杨文道曾任洪忠互助会主席，而叶海生，别名小广东，是该会成员。该会前身名为“斧头党”，在民国二十三年（1934年）11月中旬某时，杨文道因某些事务离开上海后，该会逐渐解散。同年同月他返回上海后，与叶海生等人合作组织了东忠和东义合作社，并担任两会主席，叶海生为会员。然而，由于这两个协会成员寥寥无几，其影响力不及洪忠互助会。民国二十四年（1935年）10月底，杨文道、叶海生等人秘密策划刺杀几名日本军官或士兵，目的是制造骚乱，从而让他们有机会扩大在虹口区的影响力。既定计划后，他们于同年11月3日下午3时前往达罗克路（Darroch Road），旨在首先对该地区进行勘察。11月5日晚，他们在兰路（Range Road）永吉里71号的东义合作社抽签，决定由谁执行此行动。叶海生抽中了写有“去”字的签，因此杨文道于11月9日晚8时后交给他一把手枪。叶海生接过手枪后，立即前往达罗克路的交叉路口，在那里等到晚上9点左右，这时他注意到一名日本海军陆战队员（中山）沿路走来。叶海生立即尾随该陆战队员，并

5
October 3, 1936. Morning Translation.

on reaching a spot in the vicinity of the entrance of Foong Loh Lee (豐樂里) on Darroch Road, when it was 9 p.m., he drew out the pistol and fired from the side at the head of the Japanese marine who immediately collapsed and died shortly afterwards. Immediately after the shooting, Yih Hai Sung ran into Foong Loh Lee alleyway and discarded the pistol, No. 241146, under a wooden hut (police box) of the watchman of the alleyway in question, which was then unoccupied, and returned to the Moon Palace Hotel (月宮飯店). Sometime in April this year, the Police discovered these facts and detailed officials to Tsingtao where Yih Hai Sung was arrested. On April 19, Yang Vung Tao was arrested at his home, No. 18 Dung An Lee (同安里) alleyway off Tongshan Road. In his bed room was found a green book on practical physics in which a hole had been excavated for the purpose of concealing the pistol. In company with Tseu Shou Yong, who had been arrested on suspicion, the other two arrested persons were charged before this Court.

The Reasons

The late Japanese marine Nakayama was fatally shot in the head at 9 p.m. November 9, 1935 at the entrance to Foong Loh Lee on Darroch Road. Death was due to injuries and haemorrhage of the brain. At 1.10 a.m. November 10, Japanese military doctor Ogawa examined the deceased and issued a certificate. According to a report made by Japanese Sub-Inspector "Kai Ye Ya So" (酒伊雅索) attached to Kashing Road Police Station, he found a pistol (No. 241146) and 6 rounds of ammunition beneath the watchman's hut in Foong Loh Lee at 11.40 p.m. November 9. Japanese policeman No. 61 of Dixwell Road Police Station reported that following the shooting which took place at 9 p.m. November 9, he found a round of ammunition at a place about 8 feet south of the blood stain at the scene of the crime. Japanese detective No. 51 of Dixwell Road Station reported that at about 10 p.m. November 9 he discovered an empty cartridge at the scene of the murder on Darroch Road. Foreign Detective Sergeant "Karly" (卡雷) of the Arms Identification Section of the S.M.P. reported:- "At 12.15 p.m. November 10 last year, a pistol No. 241146 was handed to me for examination. I found the machinery of the pistol complete. The pistol had been recently fired. An empty cartridge and a round of ammunition found respectively by Japanese detective No. 51 and Japanese policeman No. 61 were handed to me for examination. I have now come to the conclusion that the ammunition and the empty cartridge had been discharged from this pistol". The Police presented the pistol, the ammunition and the empty cartridge in Court as evidence. There is no doubt that the pistol with the ammunition submitted by the Police is the weapon used in the killing of Nakayama. What required investigations was whether or not the accused are the assassins.

1936年10月3日。晨间译件。

在到达达罗克路丰乐里（Foong Loh Lee）入口附近的一处地点时，时间是晚上9点，他拔出手枪，从侧面朝该日本陆战队员的头部开枪，后者随即倒地，不久后死亡。枪击发生后，叶海生立即跑进丰乐里弄堂，将编号为241146的手枪丢弃在该弄堂看守的一个木制岗亭（警察岗亭）下，当时岗亭内无人，随后他返回月宫饭店（Moon Palace Hotel）。今年4月的某个时候，警方发现了这些事实，并派遣人员前往青岛，在那里逮捕了叶海生。4月19日，杨文道在其位于同山路同安里18号的家中被捕。在他的卧室里发现了一本绿色封面的实用物理学书籍，书中被挖出一个洞以藏匿手枪。连同因涉嫌被捕的周守庸，另外两名被捕者被指控并提交至本庭受审。

理由

已故日本陆战队员中山于1935年11月9日晚9时在达罗克路丰乐里入口处头部中弹身亡。死因是脑部损伤和出血。11月10日凌晨1时10分，日本军医小川（Ogawa）检查了死者并出具了证明。根据附属于嘉兴路警察局的日本巡佐“酒伊雅索”（Kai Ye Ya So）的报告，他于11月9日晚11时40分在丰乐里的看守岗亭下发现了一把手枪（编号241146）和6发子弹。狄思威路（Dixwell Road）警察局的日本警察第61号报告称，在11月9日晚9时发生的枪击案之后，他在犯罪现场血迹以南约8英尺的地方发现了一发子弹。狄思威路警察局的日本侦探第51号报告称，他在11月9日晚10点左右在达罗克路的谋杀现场发现了一个空弹壳。上海公共租界警务处武器鉴定科的外籍侦探警长“卡雷”（Karly）报告称：“去年11月10日中午12时15分，一把编号为241146的手枪移交给我进行检查。我发现该手枪机械装置完好。该手枪近期曾发射过。分别由日本侦探第51号和日本警察第61号发现的空弹壳和一发子弹移交给我进行检查。我现在得出结论，子弹和空弹壳是从这把手枪中发射出来的”。警方将手枪、子弹和空弹壳作为证据提交法庭。毫无疑问，警方提交的手枪及子弹是杀害中山的凶器。需要调查的是被告是否为刺客。
