pages.en:
Translations of statement of Katsuzo Fukushima, age 42,
proprietor of the Komu Restaurant, 27 Mai Mei Lee, North Szechuen
Road, taken by Japanese Consular Police.
----------------------------------------
Tayeko returned to her original home at Takaeze Nagayo-mura,
Nishisonoki-gun, Nagasaki-Prefecture, on the 30th.September 1935,
quitting business.

Seaman Nakayama who was shot dead on the 9th.November 1935
used to visit her three to five times a month during the past one
year prior to her departure.

Tayeko was a wise girl and never made any trouble with custom-
ers in entertaining them. She was not a girl of the sort who gets
into trouble by making a promise to marry half in joke.

She never promised Seaman Nakayama to marry. I should say he
was simply a regular customer of long standing. She had a goodly
number of customers, amongst whom there was no particular one who
was so deeply acquainted with.

After my arrival in Shanghai, I made acquaintance with one
named Chugoro Shimada, age 39, native of Fukui-Prefecture, who was
the manager of the "Tai Sho Yoko" (Pharmacy) on Cheo Tung Road. He
visited my restaurant from time to time and chatted with Tayeko and
others.

In May or June 1935, I suggested Shimada and Tayeko to get mar-
ried after Tayeko quitted business. I acted as a go-between, and
they made a verbal engagement of marriage.

In the end of July or early in August 1935, Shimada returned
to the Purchase Department of the "Tai Sho Yoko" at No.491 Higashi-
sakamachi, Higashi-ku, Osaka.

After Tayeko had returned to Japan, I received a letter from
her in the middle of October 1935, by which I learned that she was
leading a married life with Shimada.

Shimada did not drink at all, and was a mild-mannered gentle-
man. He was not like those who dare to pick up a quarrel. He was
always honestly devoted to his business. As regards the engage-
ment, there was no question of money at all. He did not pay her
pages.zh:
福岛胜三供词译文，42岁，北四川路麦美里27号“公武”餐厅老板，由日本领事警察采集。
----------------------------------------
妙子于1935年9月30日停止营业，返回其位于长崎县西彼杵郡长与村高江的原籍。

在妙子离开前的一年时间里，于1935年11月9日被枪杀的水兵中山每月来访三到五次。

妙子是个聪明的女孩，在招待客人时从未与顾客发生过任何纠纷。她不是那种半开玩笑地许诺结婚而惹上麻烦的女孩。

她从未答应嫁给水兵中山。应该说，他只是个长期的老主顾。她有很多顾客，其中并没有与她交情特别深的人。

我来到上海后，结识了一位名叫岛田忠五郎（Chugoro Shimada）的人，39岁，福井县人，是乍浦路“大正洋行”（药店）的经理。他不时光顾我的餐厅，并与妙子等人聊天。

1935年5月或6月，我建议岛田和妙子在妙子停业后结婚。我充当了媒人，他们达成了口头婚约。

1935年7月底或8月初，岛田返回大阪东区东阪町491号“大正洋行”的采购部。

妙子返回日本后，我于1935年10月中旬收到她的一封信，从中得知她已与岛田过上了婚姻生活。

岛田完全不喝酒，是一位温和的绅士。他不像那些敢于挑起争端的人。他总是诚实地致力于自己的工作。关于婚约，完全没有金钱问题。他没有支付她的

pages.en:
debt to enable her to quit business.
Shimada, on returning to Japan, told me to send her
back to Japan at any time that would suit my convenience.
Tayeko used to say she would work until the end of September
1935.

Katsuzo Fukushima.

December 3rd.1935
pages.zh:
债务以让她停业。
岛田返回日本时，告诉我可以在我方便的时候随时送她回日本。
妙子常说她会工作到1935年9月底。

福岛胜三。

1935年12月3日

pages.en:
Translation of further statement of Miyoko, age 21,
Waitress at the "Komu" Restaurant, 27 Mai Mei Lee, North
Szechuen Road,

I have been employed at the "Komu" Restaurant as a
waitress since December 1935.

Seaman Nakayama who was shot dead on Darroch Road on
the 9th.November 1935 used to come and see a waitress, Chito
Sakae, alias Tayeko, who was employed together with me, so I
knew Seaman Nakayama by name and sight after about May 1935,
but I did not exchange words with him so often.

Tayeko returned to her native country in Nagasaki on
the 30th.September 1935. I do not know her exact address.

Shortly after 10 p.m.on the 8th.November 1935, Seaman
Nakayama came to the "Komu" Restaurant alone and, spending the
night with me, left the restaurant at about 9 a.m.on the follow-
ing day.

At about 8.30 p.m.on the 9th.November 1935 (I can not
mention the exact time as I did not see the watch.) Seaman Naka-
yama came to the "Komu" Restaurant.I made a bow to him but I did
not accost him. He did not speak to me either, and about five
minutes later he left the restaurant saying "Sayonara" (good-
bye), not addressing particularly to any one there. He was
not drunk at that time.

On the night of the 8th. he told me not to tell to any
of the other girls that he slept with me. This, I think, he
said for fear of being pointed out and whispered about by other
girls if it became known to them that he slept with a different
girl soon after his intimate girl, Tayeko.

It is generally said so by sailors who come to Mai Mei
Lee.

Question    How often did Nakayama come and see Tayeko ?
Answer      He used to come three or four times a month.
Q.          Was there any other seaman besides Nakayama
            who was closely acquainted with Tayeko ?
A.          I did not know whether or not there was any
pages.zh:
原盐（别名美代子）的补充供词译文，21岁，北四川路麦美里27号“公武”餐厅侍女，

我自1935年12月起受雇于“公武”餐厅担任侍女。

1935年11月9日在达罗路被枪杀的水兵中山，过去常来探望与我一同受雇的侍女坂井千荣（Chito Sakae），别名妙子，因此我在1935年5月左右通过姓名和相貌认识了水兵中山，但我与他交谈并不多。

妙子于1935年9月30日返回长崎的祖国。我不知道她的确切地址。

1935年11月8日晚上10点后不久，水兵中山独自来到“公武”餐厅，与我共度一夜，并于次日早上9点左右离开餐厅。

1935年11月9日晚上8点30分左右（我看表了，所以无法提及确切时间），水兵中山来到“公武”餐厅。我向他鞠躬，但没有与他搭话。他也没有对我说话，大约五分钟后，他说了一声“萨约纳拉”（再见/Goodbye）便离开了餐厅，并没有特别针对在场的任何人。当时他没有喝醉。

8日晚上，他告诉我不要告诉其他女孩他和我睡在一起。我想，他这么说是因为害怕如果其他女孩知道他刚离开亲密女友妙子就睡了另一个女孩，会被她们指指点点和闲言碎语。

来到麦美里的水手们通常都这么说。

问    中山多久来看望妙子一次？
答    他过去每月来三四次。
问    除了中山之外，还有其他与妙子熟识的水兵吗？
答    我不知道除了中山之外是否还有

pages.en:
sailor who was closely acquainted with her other than
Nakayama.
Q. Was there any civilian who used to come and see Tayeko ?
A. As no civilians are allowed to come to Hai Uni Inn I do
not think there was such a civilian.
Q. Have you any regular customer ?
A. I have not any regular customer other than 1st.class
Seaman Mori of the 2nd.Battalion of the Naval Landing
Party who has come to me twice or three times a month
since May 1945. I have no other customer who comes to
me continuously. Seaman Mori is a well-mannered man who
never drinks.
Q. Do you know anything else about Seaman Nakayama ?
A. I do not know anything particular.

Shio Hara
alias Miyako
3415-35
pages.zh:
与她熟识的水手。
问    有没有平民常来看望妙子？
答    由于不允许平民进入海韵旅馆（Hai Uni Inn），我认为没有这样的平民。
问    你有固定的顾客吗？
答    除了海军陆战队第二营的一等水兵森（Mori）以外，我没有其他固定顾客，他自1945年5月以来每月来找我两三次。（注：原文年份1945疑为OCR错误或笔误，结合上下文应为1935）我没有其他持续来找我的顾客。森水兵是个有礼貌的人，从不喝酒。
问    关于水兵中山你还知道些什么吗？
答    我不知道什么特别的事情。

原盐
别名美代子（Miyako）
3415-35

pages.en:
Revised Statement of Shio Hara, alias Miyoko, age 21, native of
Japan, taken by D.S. Mac Adie and interpreted by Mr. T. Kawashima,
in the presence of Mr. Uyehara, A.C.P., and Mr. Robertson, S.P.O.
on November 27, 1935.

My name is Shio Hara, alias Miyoko, age 21, native of Nagasaki
Prefecture Japan, S/waitress, employed and residing at the Komu Cafe,
27 Mei Me Li, off North Szechuen Road. I arrived in Shanghai from
Nagasaki on board the "Shanghai Maru" on 21st April, 1932, accompanied
by 7 or 8 other girls, under the care of a Mrs. Fukushima who is at
present accountant in the Komu Cafe. On our arrival in Shanghai,
Mrs. Fukushima took us to a house situated in an alleyway off Jukong
Road, O.O.I., where we all lived together for about one month.

On or about the 22nd May, 1932, Mrs. Fukushima took me from the
address in Jukong Road to the Komu Cafe where I was employed in the
capacity of a maid-servant until December, 1933, when I started
entertaining customers. I have resided at this Cafe since the
aforementioned date in 1932.

Nakayama, I was told, was seen frequently in this establishment
from March this year. As he was a frequent visitor I began to take
notice of him and recognize his face in May.

On every occasion that he visited the cafe he slept with a girl
named Tayeko Sakai, her real name being Chito Sakai, but she was
known to the customers by the former name.

About this time I learned that his name was Nakayama. From then
on I observed that Nakayama visited the Cafe three or four times a
month, invariably alone, and he used to confine his attentions to
Tayeko Sakai. When Nakayama visited the Cafe he invariably appeared
to be sober, but on several occasions I have observed that he was
slightly under the influence of drink.

Tayeko Sakai having fulfilled her contract with the Komu Cafe
on the 30th September, 1935, left for her home in Nagasaki Prefecture
Japan.

Between 8 p.m. and 9 p.m. on the 8/11/35, I was sitting in the
Cafe together with five or six other girls also employed in the
Cafe when Nakayama and another Japanese sailor, unknown to me,
entered the Cafe. I noticed that he, Nakayama, was slightly
under the influence of drink, his movements whilst walking not
pages.zh:
原盐（别名美代子）的修订供词，21岁，日本人，由D.S. Mac Adie采集，T. Kawashima先生翻译，Uyehara先生（助理警务处长 A.C.P.）和Robertson先生（高级警务官员 S.P.O.）在场，时间为1935年11月27日。

我叫原盐，别名美代子，21岁，日本长崎县人，侍女，受雇并居住在北四川路麦美里27号的公武咖啡馆（Komu Cafe）。我于1932年4月21日乘坐“上海丸”号从长崎抵达上海，同行的还有其他七八名女孩，由目前担任公武咖啡馆会计的福岛夫人照顾。我们抵达上海后，福岛夫人带我们去了欧战纪念路（O.O.I.）久耕路旁的一条弄堂里的房子，我们在那里一起住了大约一个月。

1932年5月22日左右，福岛夫人把我从久耕路的地址带到公武咖啡馆，我在那里以女仆的身份工作，直到1933年12月开始招待顾客。自1932年的上述日期以来，我一直住在这家咖啡馆。

有人告诉我，中山从今年三月起经常出现在这家场所。由于他是常客，我从五月开始注意他并认出了他的脸。

每次他光顾咖啡馆，他都和一个名叫坂井妙子（Tayeko Sakai）的女孩睡觉，她的真名是坂井千代（Chito Sakai），但顾客们以前者的名字称呼她。

大约在这个时候，我得知他的名字叫中山。从那时起，我观察到中山每月来访咖啡馆三四次，总是独自一人，并且只关注坂井妙子。当中山光顾咖啡馆时，他看起来总是清醒的，但有几次我观察到他略有醉意。

坂井妙子于1935年9月30日履行完与公武咖啡馆的合同后，前往日本长崎县的家中。

1935年11月8日晚上8点到9点之间，我和其他五六名也在咖啡馆工作的女孩正坐在咖啡馆里，这时中山和另一名我不认识的日本水手进入了咖啡馆。我注意到他，即中山，略有醉意，走路时的动作不

pages.en:
-2-
being quite normal. On this occasion Nakayama stayed on the premises
approximately five minutes and held a short conversation with the
other Japanese sailor and then Nakayama exchanged conversation with
the girls present addressing no particular girls. When they left
the premises the unknown Japanese sailor had his arm around Nakayama's
shoulder, but their direction after leaving the cafe is unknown to me.

Between 10 p.m. and 10.30 p.m. the same evening 8/11/35,
Nakayama returned to the cafe alone and as I was the only girl sitting
downstairs (all the other girls being engaged) Nakayama suggested
that I accompany him to the Senyu (戰友) Restaurant and partake
of tea and cakes. I replied that as I had no customer for the night
I would not go, whereupon Nakayama stated that he would engage me
for the night.

On this promise being made I then accompanied Nakayama to the
Senyu Restaurant directly opposite the Koon Cafe where we partook of
tea and cakes to the value of 30 cents.

We remained in the Senyu Restaurant for about two or three
minutes then returned to the Koon Cafe, where Nakayama accompanied
me to my room on the second floor.

Nakayama slept with me that night and whilst he was dressing
in the morning of 9/11/35 he told me that he was going to Woosung
Road to have a new glass put in his wrist watch, as he had broken
same the previous night. He left my room at about 9 a.m. 9/11/35.

During the night whilst Nakayama was in bed with me he did not
converse with me on any particular subject, but informed me that he
had one day's special leave from 12 noon 8/11/35 until 11 a.m. 9/11/35.
Nakayama also informed me that since the departure of Toyoko Sakai
on 30th Sept. 1935 he had never spent the night with any girls.

During the night Nakayama asked me not to mention to the other
girls that he had slept the night with me, for if they had known
Nakayama stated he would remain a laughing stock. Between 8.30 p.m.
and 9 p.m. 9/11/35 (I am not quite sure about the time) Nakayama
again visited the cafe alone, he was quite sober, and was carrying
a small square shaped bundle wrapped in a dark coloured cloth. He
pages.zh:
-2-
表现完全正常。此次中山（Nakayama）在店内停留约五分钟，与另一名日本水手进行了简短交谈，随后中山与在场的女孩们交谈，并未特别针对某一位女孩。他们离开店铺时，那名身份不明的日本水手搂着中山的肩膀，但他们离开咖啡馆后的去向我不清楚。

同日（1935年11月8日）晚上10点至10点半之间，中山独自返回咖啡馆。由于我是楼下唯一坐着的女孩（其他女孩均有客相伴），中山建议我陪他去“战友”（Senyu）餐馆喝茶吃点心。我回答说，因为我当晚没有客人，所以不去。于是中山表示他会包我过夜。

作出此承诺后，我便陪同中山前往正对坤咖啡馆（Koon Cafe）的“战友”餐馆，我们在那里喝了茶、吃了点心，共计价值30分。

我们在“战友”餐馆待了大约两三分钟，然后返回坤咖啡馆，中山陪我到了二楼我的房间。

当晚中山与我同宿。1935年11月9日早上他穿衣时告诉我，他要去吴淞路给手表换一块新玻璃，因为前一天晚上他把表玻璃摔碎了。他于1935年11月9日上午9点左右离开我的房间。

夜间中山与我同床时，并未与我深谈任何特定话题，但他告知我，他从1935年11月8日中午12点至1935年11月9日上午11点有一天的特别假期。中山还告诉我，自酒井丰子（Toyoko Sakai）于1935年9月30日离开后，他从未在任何女孩处过夜。

夜间，中山要求我不要向其他女孩提及他与我过夜之事，因为中山称如果她们知道了，他会成为笑柄。1935年11月9日晚上8点半至9点之间（我对时间不太确定），中山再次独自来到咖啡馆。他十分清醒，携带一个用深色布包裹的小方形包裹。他

pages.en:
- 3 -

Cafe for about five minutes without speaking
and then got up and walked out by himself saying "good night"
without addressing anyone in particular, taking his bundle with
him.

When Nakayama emerged from the door of the cafe he
turned left in the Mei Ho Li, after that I cannot state where
he went.

I am unable to form any opinion as to his temperamental
disposition as I have only been on intimate terms with him for
one night.

----------

Mr. Graham : Have you any particular man of whom you are fond ?
Hirata : I have no particular sweetheart but there is a sailor
named Mori who calls on me rather regularly about two
or three times a month.

Mr. Graham : When did Mori visit you last ?
Hirata : Mori visited me on the 8th of this month and he was with
me last night (30th) and four days ago (23rd), but he
never visited me in the interval because the Landing
Party has been mobilized since the 9th.

Mr. Graham : Did Mori and Nakayama meet in the same cafe at any
previous time?
Hirata : I have not seen Mori and Nakayama together because I think
they are on different duties.

Mr. Graham : When Nakayama visited your restaurant, did Mori happen to
be
there?
Hirata : No.

Mr. Graham : At any time have you ever heard Mori speak of Nakayama?
Hirata : No.

Mr. Graham : How long have you known Mori approximately?
Hirata : Since May 1944.

Mr. Graham : Has Mori since he met you been a regular customer of yours?
Hirata : Mori calls on me two or three times a month regularly.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

在咖啡馆待了约五分钟，未发一言，随后起身独自走出，说了一声“晚安”，并未特别向任何人道别，并带走了他的包裹。

中山走出咖啡馆门口后，在美华里（Mei Ho Li）向左转，此后我便不知他去了何处。

由于我只与他有过一夜的亲密关系，我无法对他的性情气质形成任何看法。

----------

格雷厄姆先生（Mr. Graham）：你有特别喜欢的男人吗？
平田（Hirata）：我没有特别的情人，但有一位名叫森（Mori）的水手，每月定期来找我两三次。

格雷厄姆先生：森上次是什么时候来看你的？
平田：森本月8日来看过我，昨晚（30日）和四天前（23日）也和我在一起，但这期间他没来过，因为登陆部队自9日起已动员。

格雷厄姆先生：森和中山以前曾在同一家咖啡馆见过面吗？
平田：我没见过森和中山在一起，因为我想他们执行的任务不同。

格雷厄姆先生：当中山来你这家店时，森碰巧在场吗？
平田：不在。

格雷厄姆先生：你曾听过森提起中山吗？
平田：没有。

格雷厄姆先生：你认识森大概多久了？
平田：从1944年5月起。

格雷厄姆先生：森自从认识你以来，一直是你的常客吗？
平田：森每月定期来找我两三次。

pages.en:
- 4 -

Mr. Urehara : Have you any particular person other than a sailor?
Miyake : No.
Mr. Urehara : Were you and Chito (Tayeko Sakai) on good friendly terms ?
Miyake : All the girls in the Cafe are friends and get on well together.
Mr. Urehara : Is Chito a nice looking girl or very popular?
Miyake : Chito was a very nice looking girl and was the most popular girl in the house - she had most business.
Mr. Urehara : Do you know any other sailor or other man friendly with Chito before she left Shanghai?
Miyake : Chito used to get many regular visitors but I cannot remember the name of any particular one except Nakayama.
Mr. Urehara : Was Nakayama with Chito more than any other man?
Miyake : I cannot say whether Nakayama was Chito's favourite or whether he called more than any other man.
Mr. Urehara : Did you ever hear anything Chito said about Nakayama ?
Miyake : No.
Mr. Urehara : Do you know if Nakayama and Chito were on more friendly terms than custom demanded.
Miyake : I cannot say that for certain.
Mr. Urehara : Have you ever heard Chito and Nakayama quarrel at any time?
Miyake : I cannot say what took place in Chito's room but I have not seen her quarrel with Nakayama or anyone?
Mr. Urehara : Do you remember the Japanese sailor who came together with Nakayama between 8 p.m. and 9 p.m. on November 8, 1938.
Miyake : I only saw the sailor with Nakayama on that one occasion and I had not seen him before.
Mr. Urehara : When Nakayama told you that since the departure of Chito on September 30, 1938, he had never spent the night with any girls did he say anything else.
Miyake : No, he did not say anything else.
pages.zh:
- 4 -

浦原先生（Mr. Urehara）：除了水手之外，你有特别的人吗？
三宅（Miyake）：没有。
浦原先生：你和千代（Chito，即酒井多惠子 Tayeko Sakai）关系友好吗？
三宅：咖啡馆里的女孩们都是朋友，相处融洽。
浦原先生：千代是个漂亮的女孩吗？还是很受欢迎？
三宅：千代是个非常漂亮的女孩，也是店里最受欢迎的女孩——她的生意最多。
浦原先生：在千代离开上海之前，你知道还有其他水手或男人与她交好吗？
三宅：千代以前有很多常客，但除了中山外，我记不起任何特定的名字。
浦原先生：中山和其他男人相比，是否更常与千代在一起？
三宅：我说不上中山是否是千代的最爱，或者他是否比其他男人来得更勤。
浦原先生：你曾听千代说过关于中山的任何事吗？
三宅：没有。
浦原先生：你是否知道中山和千代的关系比通常要求的更为亲密？
三宅：这一点我不能肯定。
浦原先生：你曾听到千代和中山在任何时候争吵过吗？
三宅：我说不上千代房间里发生了什么，但我没见她与中山或任何人争吵过。
浦原先生：你还记得1938年11月8日晚上8点到9点之间与中山一起来的那位日本水手吗？
三宅：我只在那一次见过那位水手和中山在一起，此前我没见过他。
浦原先生：当中山告诉你，自千多于1938年9月30日离开后，他从未在任何女孩处过夜时，他还说了别的什么吗？
三宅：没有，他没再说别的。

pages.en:
Mr. Urehara : During the night Nakayama asked you not to mention
to the other girls that he had slept the night with
you for if they knew he would lose face - how did you
take it - ordinarily or otherwise - or did you think
there was a special meaning attached to it.

Miyake : As Nakayama was a regular visitor to Chito, it was not
very nice of him to call on another girl in the
same establishment a month from her departure and it
was probably due to his fearing being teased that Naka-
yama told me not to mention his visit to the other
girls.

Mr. Urehara : When Nakayama came again on November 9 about 8.30 p.m.
how did he look - normal or upset about anything, as
you said he only remained about 5 minutes.

Miyake : Nakayama did not speak to the girls but there were
one or two sailors in the house and I heard him speak
to one of them. His attitude was quite normal
when he came in and I did not find anything strange,
in his manner.

Mr. Urehara : What do you think of Mori - his character ?

Miyake : He is a very quiet and sober individual - he is moderate.

Mr. Urehara : Would Mori have been upset if he had known Nakayama
had slept with you ?

Miyake : No, he would not get angry because he knew we had
our business to attend to.

Mr. Robertson Do you know any of the sailors who were present on the
night of November 9, when Nakayama called?

Miyake : No, I don't.

Mr. Robertson As far as you could see was the conversation between
Nakayama and the others on the night of the 9th in
the house, normal or excited in any way ?
pages.zh:
浦原先生：夜间，中山要求你不要向其他女孩提及他与你过夜之事，因为如果她们知道了，他会丢面子——你是怎么看待这一点的——是当作平常事，还是觉得另有深意？

三宅：由于中山是千多的常客，在她离开仅一个月后就光顾同一店里的另一位女孩，这对他来说不太光彩，中山让我不要告诉其他女孩他来访的事，可能是因为他害怕被取笑。

浦原先生：11月9日晚上8点半左右中山再次到来时，他看起来怎么样——是正常的，还是因什么事心烦意乱？正如你所说，他只待了大约5分钟。

三宅：中山没有和女孩们说话，但店里有一两个水手，我听见他和其中一人说了话。他进来时的态度完全正常，我在他的举止中没发现任何奇怪之处。

浦原先生：你怎么看森——他的性格如何？

三宅：他是一个非常安静且清醒的人——他很节制。

浦原先生：如果森知道中山和你过夜，他会心烦意乱吗？

三宅：不会，他不会生气，因为他知道我们有生意要做。

罗伯逊先生（Mr. Robertson）：11月9日晚中山来访时，你在场的任何水手你认识吗？

三宅：不认识。

罗伯逊先生：就你所见，9日晚在店内中山与其他人的谈话，是正常的，还是在某种程度上显得激动？

pages.en:
- 6 -

Miyake : I did not listen, so I cannot tell what they were
talking about. They were speaking rather loudly
but no signs of quarreling.

Mr.Robertson: You know that Nakayama paid a lot of attention to Chito
was there any other man who paid her equal attention?

Miyake : I don't know because Chito did not discuss
her affairs with the other girls.

Mr. Robertson : During all the time you have seen Nakayama coming
to the place, have you ever seen him quarrelsome or
other than an ordinary young fellow ?

Miyake : I have not seen him drunk and disorderly or misbehave.
pages.zh:
- 6 -

三宅：我没有偷听，所以不知道他们在谈论什么。他们说话声音较大，但没有争吵的迹象。

罗伯逊先生：你知道中山很关注千代，还有其他男人给予她同样的关注吗？

三宅：我不知道，因为千代不与其他女孩讨论她的私事。

罗伯逊先生：在你看到中山来这里的整个期间，你曾见他好斗或表现得不同于普通年轻人吗？

三宅：我没见他醉酒闹事或行为不端。

pages.en:
Statement of Shujo Haru, alias Mayoko, age 21, native of Japan,
taken by D.S. Craig and interpreted by Mr. T. Kawashima.
------------------------------------------------------------

My name is Shujo Haru, alias Mayoko, age 21, native of Nagasaki
Prefecture Japan, W/Waitress, employed and residing at the Koxm Cafe,
No.37 Mei Mo Li off North Szechuen Road. I arrived in Shanghai from
Nagasaki on board the "Shanghai Maru" on 2nd April 1935, accompanied by
7 or 8 other girls, under the care of a Mrs. Fukushima who is at present
accountant in the Koxm Cafe. On our arrival in Shanghai Mrs. Fukushima
took us to a house situated in an alleyway off Jukong Road, O.O.L., where
we all lived together for about one month.

On or about the 22nd May 1935 Mrs. Fukushima took me from the
address in Jukong Road to the Koxm Cafe where I have been employed and
resided since the aforementioned date.

During the month of May 1935 I saw Nakayama when he came into the
cafe and as he had paid several visits prior to that, I formed an opinion
that he was a regular customer.

On every occasion that he visited the cafe he slept with a girl
named Tayoko Sakai, her real name being Chito Sakai, but she was known
to the customers by the former name.

About this time I learned that his name was Nakayama. From then
on I observed that Nakayama visited the Cafe three or four times a month,
invariably alone, and he used to confine his attentions to Tayoko Sakai.
When Nakayama visited the Cafe he invariably appeared to be sober, but
on several occasions I have observed that he was slightly under the
influence of drink.

Tayoko Sakai having fulfilled her contract with the Koxm Cafe
on the 30th September 1935, left for her home in Nagasaki Prefecture
Japan.

Between 8 p.m. and 9 p.m. on the 8/11/35 I was sitting in the
Cafe together with five or six other girls also employed in the Cafe
when Nakayama and another Japanese sailor, unknown to me, entered the
Cafe. I noticed that he, Nakayama, was slightly under the influence of
drink, his movements whilst walking not being quite normal. On this
occasion Nakayama stayed on the premises approximately five minutes and
held a short conversation with the other Japanese sailor and then
pages.zh:
春珠（Shujo Haru，别名 Mayoko）的供词，21岁，日本人，由警探克雷格（D.S. Craig）录取，川岛先生（Mr. T. Kawashima）翻译。
------------------------------------------------------------

我叫春珠，别名 Mayoko，21岁，籍贯日本长崎县，职业女招待，受雇并居住于北四川路美华里（Mei Mo Li）37号 Koxm 咖啡馆。我于1935年4月2日乘坐“上海丸”号从长崎抵达上海，同行的还有其他七八名女孩，由福岛夫人（Mrs. Fukushima）照顾，她目前是 Koxm 咖啡馆的会计。我们抵达上海后，福岛夫人将我们带到位于老闸路（Jukong Road, O.O.L.）一条弄堂内的一处房屋，我们在那里共同生活了约一个月。

1935年5月22日左右，福岛夫人将我从老闸路的住址带到 Koxm 咖啡馆，自上述日期起，我便在此受雇并居住。

1935年5月期间，我看到中山进入咖啡馆，鉴于他此前已来过几次，我认为他是一位常客。

每次他来咖啡馆，都与一名名叫酒井多惠子（Tayoko Sakai）的女孩同宿，她的真名是酒井千代（Chito Sakai），但顾客们以前者的名字称呼她。

大约在这个时候，我得知他的名字叫中山。从那以后，我观察到中山每月来访咖啡馆三四次，总是独自一人，且只专注于酒井多惠子。中山来访咖啡馆时，通常看起来很清醒，但有几次我观察到他略有醉意。

酒井多惠子于1935年9月30日履行完与 Koxm 咖啡馆的合同后，返回日本长崎县的家中。

1935年11月8日晚上8点至9点之间，我与另外五六名同样受雇于该咖啡馆的女孩坐在店里，这时中山和另一名我不认识的日本水手进入了咖啡馆。我注意到中山略有醉意，走路动作不太正常。此次中山在店内停留约五分钟，与另一名日本水手进行了简短交谈，随后

pages.en:
-2-

Nakayama exchanged conversation with the girls present addressing no
particular girls. When they left the premises the unknown Japanese
sailor had his arm around Nakayama's shoulder, but their direction after
leaving the cafe is unknown to me.

Between 10 p.m. and 10.30 p.m. the same evening 8/11/35, Nakayama
returned to the cafe alone and as I was the only girl sitting downstairs
(all the other girls being engaged) Nakayama suggested that I accompany
him to the Senyu Restaurant and partake of tea and cakes. I replied
that as I had no customer for the night I would not go, whereupon
Nakayama stated that he would engage me for the night.

On this promise being made I then accompanied Nakayama to the
Senyu Restaurant directly opposite the Kemi Cafe where we partook of
tea and cakes to the value of 30 cents.

We remained in the Senyu Restaurant for about two or three minutes
then returned to the Kemi Cafe, where Nakayama accompanied me to my
room on the second floor.

Nakayama slept with me that night and whilst he was dressing in
the morning of 9/11/35 he told me that he was going to Woosung Road
to have a new glass put in his wrist watch, as he had broken same the
previous night. He left my room at about 9 a.m. 9/11/35.

During the night whilst Nakayama was in bed with me he did not
converse with me on any particular subject, but informed me that he
had one day's special leave from 12 noon 8/11/35 until 11 a.m. 9/11/35.
Nakayama also informed me that since the departure of Tayoko Sakai on
30th Sept. 1935, he had never spent the night with any girls.

During the night Nakayama asked me not to mention to the other
girls that he had slept the night with me, for if they knew Nakayama
stated he would lose face. Between 8.30 p.m. and 9 p.m. 9/11/35 ( I am
quite sure about the time) Nakayama again visited the cafe alone, he was
quite sober, and was carrying a small square shaped bundle wrapped in a
dark coloured cloth. He remained in the Cafe for about five minutes
without speaking and then got up and walked out himself saying
"goodnight" without addressing anyone in particular, taking his bundle
with him.
pages.zh:
-2-

中山与在场的女孩们交谈，并未特别针对某一位女孩。他们离开店铺时，那名身份不明的日本水手搂着中山的肩膀，但他们离开咖啡馆后的去向我不清楚。

同日（1935年11月8日）晚上10点至10点半之间，中山独自返回咖啡馆。由于我是楼下唯一坐着的女孩（其他女孩均有客相伴），中山建议我陪他去“战友”（Senyu）餐馆喝茶吃点心。我回答说，因为我当晚没有客人，所以不去。于是中山表示他会包我过夜。

作出此承诺后，我便陪同中山前往正对 Kemi 咖啡馆的“战友”餐馆，我们在那里喝了茶、吃了点心，共计价值30分。

我们在“战友”餐馆待了大约两三分钟，然后返回 Kemi 咖啡馆，中山陪我到了二楼我的房间。

当晚中山与我同宿。1935年11月9日早上他穿衣时告诉我，他要去吴淞路给手表换一块新玻璃，因为前一天晚上他把表玻璃摔碎了。他于1935年11月9日上午9点左右离开我的房间。

夜间中山与我同床时，并未与我深谈任何特定话题，但他告知我，他从1935年11月8日中午12点至1935年11月9日上午11点有一天的特别假期。中山还告诉我，自酒井多惠子（Tayoko Sakai）于1935年9月30日离开后，他从未在任何女孩处过夜。

夜间，中山要求我不要向其他女孩提及他与我过夜之事，因为中山称如果她们知道了，他会丢面子。1935年11月9日晚上8点半至9点之间（我对时间很确定），中山再次独自来到咖啡馆。他十分清醒，携带一个用深色布包裹的小方形包裹。他在咖啡馆待了约五分钟，未发一言，随后起身独自走出，说了一声“晚安”，并未特别向任何人道别，并带走了他的包裹。

pages.en:
-3-

When Nakayama emerged from the door of the cafe he turned
left in the Mei Me Li, after that I cannot state where he went.
I am unable to form any opinion as to his temperamental disposition
as I have only been on intimate terms with him for one night.

Signed: Shujo Hara.
pages.zh:
-3-

当中山（Nakayama）从咖啡馆门口出来时，他在美美里向左转，此后我无法说明他去了哪里。由于我只与他有过一夜的亲密交往，我无法对他的性格倾向形成任何看法。

签名：原舒乔（Shujo Hara）。

pages.en:
Statement of Moyo Sasaki alias Umegiku, age 27,
taken by D.S.I. McPhee, interpreted by J.D.S.Iguchi.
----------------------------------------------------

My name is Moyo Sasaki alias Umegiku, age 27, S.Waitress employed
at the Daigetsu Restaurant No.33 Mei Me Li alleyway, near Wang Pang Jan,
off North Szechuen Road, and residing at the same address.

I am a native of Nagasaki Prefecture, and arrived in Shanghai
from Nagasaki on 18th April 1932 and since my arrival. I have been
employed and resided at the Daigetsu Restaurant.

The deceased sailor Hideo Nakayama has been observed by me to
visit the Daigetsu Restaurant on several occasions in the company of
other sailors, and whilst in the restaurant I have seen him drinking
beer.

I never spoke to Nakayama prior to 8/11/35, and his name was
also unknown to me until 8/11/35.

Between 8.30 p.m. and 9 p.m. 8/11/35 Hideo Nakayama visited the
Daigetsu Restaurant, accompanied by a sailor known to me as Aoki.

Aoki visited the Restaurant for the first time on 11/10/35, when
we became acquainted and since that time he has visited the restaurant
on two or three occasions.

When Aoki and Nakayama visited the restaurant on the evening of
8/11/35 they were both slightly under the influence of drink.

Aoki introduced me to Nakayama, Aoki stating that Nakayama was
his friend, and had joined the service the same year.

After talking with Aoki and Nakayama for about 5 minutes inside
the front door of the premises, Aoki proceeded upstairs to my room which
is situated on the first floor, whereupon Nakayama left the premises by
the front door.

When Nakayama left the premises I proceeded upstairs to my room
where I joined Aoki, and we spent the night together.

At about 6.30 a.m. 9/11/35 I awoke and knowing that Aoki must
report at the Naval Landing Party Headquarters before 7 a.m. 9/11/35
I immediately awoke him and told him to hurry or he would be late.
Aoki was angry when I awoke him, stating that I should have awakened
him early and not late.

Aoki immediately arose and dressed himself leaving the premises
pages.zh:
佐佐木茂代（Moyo Sasaki），别名梅菊（Umegiku），27岁之陈述，由副巡官麦克菲（D.S.I. McPhee）录取，井口（J.D. Iguchi）翻译。
----------------------------------------------------

我叫佐佐木茂代，别名梅菊，现年27岁，系大月餐厅女侍应生，该餐厅位于北四川路旁旺盘仁（Wang Pang Jan）附近的美美里弄33号，我亦居住于此地址。

我是长崎县人，于1932年4月18日从长崎抵达上海，自抵达以来，我一直受雇并居住在大月餐厅。

我已故的水兵中山秀夫（Hideo Nakayama）曾多次在其他水兵的陪同下来到大月餐厅，我在餐厅内曾见他饮用啤酒。

在1935年11月8日之前，我从未与中山交谈过，直到1935年11月8日我才知道他的名字。

1935年11月8日晚上8点30分至9点之间，中山秀夫在一位我认识名为青木（Aoki）的水兵陪同下，来到了大月餐厅。

青木于1935年10月11日首次光顾该餐厅，当时我们相识，此后他又来过两三次。

1935年11月8日晚，当青木和中山来到餐厅时，两人均略带醉意。

青木将我介绍给中山，称中山是他的朋友，并于同年入伍。

在店铺前门内与青木和中山交谈了约5分钟后，青木上楼去了位于二楼我的房间，随后中山从前门离开了店铺。

当中山离开店铺时，我上楼回到我的房间与青木会合，我们共度了一夜。

1935年11月9日早上约6点30分，我醒来，因知道青木必须在1935年11月9日早上7点前向海军陆战队总部报到，我立即叫醒他，告诉他快点，否则要迟到了。青木被我叫醒时很生气，说我应该早点叫醒他，而不是这么晚。

青木立即起身穿衣，离开店铺

pages.en:
-2-

without making any further or angry remarks.

At about 6 p.m. 9/11/35 I wrote a letter to Aoki, as I was anxious to ascertain if he had arrived back at the N.L.P. Headquarters before 7 a.m. 9/11/35.

I decided to give the letter to any sailor who would visit the restaurant on the evening of 9/11/35 and request the sailor to deliver the letter to Aoki, but before I carried out my plans. Hideo Nakayama visited the restaurant at about 8 p.m. 9/11/35 and asked for me.

At the time Nakayama visited the restaurant I was in the Senyu Restaurant next door talking with the Proprietress name unknown.

One of the waitresses where I am employed visited the Senyu Restaurant and informed me that a sailor had visited the Daigetsu Restaurant and wanted to see me, whereupon I immediately returned to the restaurant where I learned that Nakayama was the person asking for me.

Nakayama handed me a letter stating that he was requested by Aoki to deliver the letter to me.

The contents of the letter was to the effect that he had arrived back at the Naval Landing Party Headquarters before 7 a.m. 9/11/35 and requested me not to worry.

Aoki also requested in the letter that I should send a reply to him by Nakayama.

I cannot remember if I destroyed the letter I received from Aoki, through Nakayama, or if the letter is still in my room.

I handed the letter over to Nakayama which I had written at 6 p.m 9/11/35, requesting him to deliver same to Aoki.

Nakayama did not appear under the influence of drink when he visited the restaurant at 8 p.m. 9/11/35, and whilst in the restaurant he never had anything to drink.

I talked with Nakayama for about 30 minutes, and then we both left the premises, whereupon I proceeded to a Japanese Food Shop situated in the Mei Ho Id alleyway where I purchased rice cakes to the value of 50 cents, and handed same over to Nakayama requesting him to give the cakes to Aoki, to which he agreed.
pages.zh:
-2-

未再发表任何言论或愤怒之语。

1935年11月9日下午约6点，我给青木写了一封信，因为我急于确认他是否在1935年11月9日早上7点前回到了海军陆战队（N.L.P.）总部。

我决定将这封信交给1935年11月9日晚来访的任何一名水兵，并请该水兵将信转交给青木，但在实施此计划之前，中山秀夫于1935年11月9日晚约8点来到餐厅找我。

当中山来到餐厅时，我正在隔壁的仙友餐厅（Senyu Restaurant）与老板娘（姓名不详）谈话。

我所在餐厅的一名女侍应生来到仙友餐厅，告知我有一名水兵来到大月餐厅想见我，于是我立即返回餐厅，得知找我的人正是中山。

中山递给我一封信，称是受青木之托将信转交给我。

信的大意是他已在1935年11月9日早上7点前回到海军陆战队总部，请我不要担心。

青木还在信中要求我通过中山给他回信。

我不记得我是销毁了通过中山收到的青木的来信，还是那封信仍在我房间里。

我将自己于1935年11月9日下午6点写的信交给中山，请他转交给青木。

1935年11月9日晚8点中山来到餐厅时，并未表现出醉态，且在餐厅期间未饮用任何东西。

我与中山交谈了约30分钟，随后我们一起离开店铺，接着我前往位于美和里（Mei Ho Id）弄堂的一家日本食品店，购买了价值50分的年糕，并将其交给中山，请他转交给青木，他答应了。

pages.en:
-3-

I cannot remember if Nakayama entered the Japanese Food Shop
with me, or if he remained in the alleyway.

Nakayama then proceeded West along the Mei Me Li alleyway towards
North Szechuen Road, whilst I returned to my place of employment.

I am unable to give any information as to Nakayama's whereabouts
from the time he left me, to the time he was shot on Darroch Road.

Signed: Koyo Sasaki.

(批：Matters of smart type they
pointed out may might be
helpful.
JWS)

(批：See next
statement
JWS)
pages.zh:
-3-

我不记得中山是否随我进入了日本食品店，还是留在了弄堂里。

随后，中山沿着美美里弄堂向西朝北四川路方向走去，而我则返回工作地点。

对于中山离开我之后到他在达罗克路（Darroch Road）被枪杀之前的行踪，我无法提供任何信息。

签名：佐佐木光代（Koyo Sasaki）。

(批注：他们指出的斜体字事项可能有所帮助。JWS)

(批注：见下一份陈述 JWS)

pages.en:
Statement of Mrs. Matsubara wife of the proprietor
of the Matsubara Yoko Bicycle Shop, situated at
No. 16 North Feng Loh Li. Taken by D.S.I. Crowther,
interpreted by C.A. Mr. T. Kawashima at 11 a.m. on
the 14/11/38.
- - - - - - -

My full name is Mrs. Toshiye Matsubara aged 39 years. I have
resided at No. 16 North Feng Loh Li, since July 1935. I know a
person named Koh Ah Liang, employed in the Feng Loh Li. I came
acquainted with him by meeting him in a fruit and grocery shop
in the alleyway. He has done errands for me and I know he supervises
the artesian well which supplies water to the Feng Loh Li.

On the night of the 9/11/38, exact time I am not certain of,
but I think round about 10 p.m. Koh Ah Liang knocked on the window
of the bath room situated on the ground floor at the back of my
house. I saw him through the glass of the window.

I was in the bath room undressed, and taking burning coals
from a stove which heats the bath water, which coals I was extinguishing
with water. This was prior to my entering the bath wherein was my
male Japanese shop assistant whose name is Kuwamoto. As the back
door was within my reach I opened it and allowed Koh Ah Liang to enter.

Whilst I was still pouring water on the burning coals and my male
Japanese shop assistant was telling me in a loud voice that if the
coals were left in the stove it might cause the wooden bath to set on
fire; at this moment Koh Ah Liang told me that whilst he was counting
coppers, which action he demonstrated with his hands, he had heard
the sound of an explosion which he had taken to be the bursting of a
tyre, and after hearing the explosion he had met 3 or 4 Chinese amahs
who had told him that a Japanese soldier had been killed on the
Barrack Road. I asked him if he had witnessed the killing and he said
he had not. He said he was very afraid. He did not seem to me to be
unduly excited, as when he entered through the door, his arms were
folded in front of his body with his hands in the sleeves of his jacket.

After he had said he was very afraid he told me to be careful
with the fire, and as he was leaving by the back door, he said he was
going home to sleep.

Owing to the fact that I was attending to the stove and my shop-
assistant was speaking to me in a loud voice, and that Koh Ah Liang
pages.zh:
松原横滨自行车店（Matsubara Yoko Bicycle Shop）店主夫人松原氏之陈述，该店位于北丰乐里16号。由副巡官克劳瑟（D.S.I. Crowther）于1938年11月14日上午11点录取，川岛先生（Mr. T. Kawashima）担任翻译。
- - - - - - -

我全名为松原敏枝（Toshiye Matsubara），现年39岁。自1935年7月以来，我一直居住在北丰乐里16号。我认识一位名叫郭阿良（Koh Ah Liang）的人，他在丰乐里工作。我是在弄堂里的一家水果杂货店遇见他而相识的。他曾为我跑腿，我知道他负责管理供应丰乐里用水的自流井。

1938年11月9日晚，确切时间我不确定，但我想大约在晚上10点左右，郭阿良敲了我房子后部底楼浴室的窗户。我透过窗玻璃看见了他。

我当时在浴室里，身上未穿衣服，正从加热洗澡水的炉子里取出燃烧的煤块，并用水将其熄灭。这发生在我进入浴缸之前，浴缸里有我的日本男店员，名叫桑本（Kuwamoto）。因为后门在我伸手可及之处，我便打开门让郭阿良进来。

正当我还在往燃烧的煤块上浇水，且我的日本男店员大声告诉我，如果煤块留在炉子里可能会导致木制浴缸着火时；此时郭阿良告诉我，当他正在数铜板时（他用双手演示了这一动作），他听到了一声爆炸声，他以为是轮胎爆裂，听到爆炸声后，他遇到了三四名中国保姆，她们告诉他一名日本士兵在兵营路（Barrack Road）被杀。我问他是否目睹了这起凶杀案，他说没有。他说他非常害怕。在我看来，他并没有显得过度兴奋，因为他进门时，双臂交叉抱在身前，双手插在夹克的袖子里。

他说完非常害怕后，叫我小心火烛，当他从后门离开时，他说他要回家睡觉了。

由于我正忙于照料炉子，且我的店员正大声对我说话，而郭阿良

pages.en:
-2-

spoke in a quiet tone, my shop assistant did not overhear the
conversation.

Koh Ah Liang has often complained to me that he had pains
in the head.

There is one peculiarity of Koh Ah Liang, whenever he is
walking he folds his arms across the front of his body and places
his hands in the sleeves of his garment. Even if he is not wearing
a garment with long sleeves when he walks he folds his arms across
the front of his body.

signed. Toshiye Matsubara.
pages.zh:
-2-

说话声音很轻，我的店员没有听到这段对话。

郭阿良经常向我抱怨他头痛。

郭阿良有一个特点，每当他走路时，总是将双臂交叉抱在身前，并将双手插在衣服的袖子里。即使他没穿长袖衣服，走路时也会将双臂交叉抱在身前。

签名：松原敏枝。

pages.en:
Statements Forwarded by the Japanese
Gendarmerie Headquarters

Statements made by wife of the proprietor of the Matsubara
Bicycle shop, Mr. Sadaichi Takahashi, proprietor of the Takahashi
Tailor shop, etc.

Mrs. Matsubara made the following statement to a gendarme,-

"On the night of the incident, I cannot recall the exact
time, I heard a knock on the door as I was about to take a bath.
On opening the door I found the watchman Koo Ah Liang (郭阿良) at
the door who entered and told me that as he was counting coppers
in an exchange shop a little while ago he heard a report of a pistol
and, on learning that a Japanese sailor had been murdered, rushed
back immediately. The watchman was highly excited when narrating the
above story. "

(Statement taken down at 10 a.m. on 12/11/35).

In order to verify the above statement, the gendarme interviewed
Mrs. Matsubara at 7.40 p.m. on the same day and it was then ascertained
that her deposition was correct.

Mr. Sadaichi Takahashi, proprietor of the Tea Tailor Shop, a
neighbour of Mr. Matsubara, called at the offices of the gendarmerie
at 4 p.m. on the same day and made a similar statement to that made
by Mrs. Matsubara.

Statement made by T. Yoshida.

(N.B. Yoshida who resides at 12 Sz Ching Road (士慶路)
(12 Sz Ching Li off North Szechuen Road) was formerly employed as
an artisan at the Misutaya, coppers, located in the Foong Leh Li
(豐樂里). Yoshida who happened to be in the vicinity of locus
of the incident stated as follows:-

"At about 7 o'clock on the night of the incident, I called at
the Araki Tatami shop situated in the 8th Lane off the Foong Leh Li
where I remained for about two hours talking on general subjects.
On my way home I pushed the bicycle along the Foong Leh Li, walking
in the direction of North Szechuen Road. When I got as far as the
Matsubara Bicycle shop, I heard a report of shooting. After having
walked several paces farther, I suddenly remembered about the call
pages.zh:
由日本宪兵队总部转交的陈述

松原自行车店店主夫人、高桥裁缝店店主高桥贞一（Sadaichi Takahashi）先生等人的陈述。

松原夫人向一名宪兵作了如下陈述：

“事发当晚，我记不清确切时间，正当我准备洗澡时，听到有人敲门。打开门后，我发现看门人郭阿良（Koo Ah Liang）站在门口，他进来说，刚才他在一家兑换店数铜板时听到了一声枪响，得知一名日本水兵被谋杀后，便立即赶了回来。看门人在讲述上述经过时非常激动。”

（陈述记录于1935年11月12日上午10点）。

为了核实上述陈述，宪兵于当天晚上7点40分再次询问了松原夫人，当时确认她的证词属实。

松原先生的邻居、茶裁缝店（Tea Tailor Shop，原文如此，疑为Takahashi Tailor Shop之误）店主高桥贞一先生于当天下午4点来到宪兵队办公室，作了与松原夫人相似的陈述。

吉田T.（T. Yoshida）之陈述。

（注：吉田居住在士庆路12号（北四川路旁士庆里12号），此前曾在丰乐里的三谷屋（Misutaya）铜器店担任工匠。事发时恰好在附近的吉田陈述如下：

“事发当晚约7点钟，我去了位于丰乐里第8弄的荒木榻榻米店（Araki Tatami shop），在那里停留了约两个小时，聊了一些一般性话题。在回家的路上，我推着自行车沿着丰乐里向北四川路方向行走。当我走到松原自行车店时，听到了一声枪响。又走了几步后，我突然想起我要去拜访一位住在丰乐里9号的中国人，于是立即转身朝达罗克路方向走去。途中，我遇到一名迎面走来的中国人，他正向东行进。这地点位于同一条弄堂第5弄拐角处的一位专攻妇科的中国医生诊所外。他穿着长袍，但由于天色黑暗，我无法清楚辨认颜色。我相信是黑色或棕色，但我肯定不是白色。我不确定那人是否戴着帽子。继续前行时，我在第5弄又遇到另一名中国人。我肯定他是中国人，但我记不清他的衣着和相貌。我花了大约两分钟到达犯罪现场。在达罗克路，我发现几名保姆围在受害者周围，人群中我还看到了Takmeka鞋店的老板。随后我急忙赶往陆战队总部报告此事。当我到达那里时，入口处的哨兵告诉我他们已经接到了关于此事的通知，并感谢我的迅速行动”。

郭阿良（Koo Ah Liang）之陈述，系丰乐里弄堂看门人。

（注：郭阿良，36岁，宁波人，受雇于中国地产公司（China Realty Co.），该公司是丰乐里地区房产的房东。他有两次前科，一次是盗窃罪，一次是收受赃物罪）。

郭阿良在与本宪兵队成员交谈过程中，就1935年11月9日晚约9点07分在达罗克路被不明袭击者击中后脑身亡的一等水兵中山（Nakayama）谋杀案，作了如下陈述：

“事发当晚8点后不久，我离开家，前往达罗克路的广生基兑换店（Kwong Sang Bas Exchange shop，陈鸿道）兑换铜板。拿到铜板后，我将它们放进口袋，双臂交叉抱在身前，进入了

pages.en:
(2)

I had to make on a Chinese residing at 9 Foong Loh Li and immediately
turned back proceeding towards Darroch Road. On the way I met a Chinese
walking towards me proceeding in an easterly direction. This was
outside the premises occupied by a Chinese doctor, specialist in
gynaecology, which is on the corner of the 5th Lane in the same alleyway.
He was wearing a long dress but owing to darkness I am unable to tell
the colour clearly. I believe it was either black or brown but I am
positive that it was not white. I am not sure as to whether the man was
wearing a hat or not. As I went along I met another Chinese at the 5th
Lane. I am positive that he was a Chinese but I cannot recollect as to
what he was wearing and how he looked. It took me about two minutes to
get to the scene of the crime. On Darroch Road I found a couple of amahs
gathered around the victim and among the crowd I also saw the master of
the Takmeka Shoe shop. I then rushed to the Landing Party Headquarters
to report the occurrence. When I arrived there the sentry at the
entrance told me that they had already been notified about the incident
and thanked me for my prompt action".

Statement made by Koo Ah Liang (郭阿良), watchman for the Foong
Loh Li alleyway.

(N.B. Koo Ah Liang who is 36 years of age is a native of Ningpo
and is employed as a watchman by the China Realty Co. who are the
landlords of the property in the Foong Loh Li area. He has two previous
convictions, one for larceny and one for receiving stolen property).

Koo Ah Liang in the course of conversation with a member of this
gendarmerie made the following statement in connection with the murder
of 1st class sailor Nakayama who was shot in the back of the head by
an unknown assailant on Darroch Road at about 9.07 p.m. on November
9, 1935.

"Shortly after 8 p.m. on the night of the incident, I left the
house and proceeded to the Kwong Sang Bas Exchange shop (陳鴻道) on
Darroch Road to change coppers. After having received the coppers I
put same in my pocket and folding my arms in front of me, entered the
pages.zh:
(2)

我不得不向一名居住在丰乐里9号的中国人询问情况，随即折返，朝达罗路（Darroch Road）方向走去。途中，我遇见一名正朝我走来的中国人，他向东行进。当时我正经过一位妇科专科中医的寓所门外，该寓所位于同一条弄堂第五支弄的拐角处。此人身穿长衫，但因天色昏暗，我无法看清颜色。我相信是黑色或棕色，但我能肯定不是白色。我不确定此人是否戴帽。继续前行时，我在第五支弄又遇到另一名中国人。我能肯定他是中国人，但已记不清他的衣着和相貌。我大约花了两分钟到达案发现场。在达罗路上，我发现几名女佣围在受害者周围，在人群中我还看到了德美卡鞋店（Takmeka Shoe shop）的老板。随后，我急忙赶往登陆部队总部报告此事。当我到达那里时，门口的哨兵告诉我，他们已获悉此事，并感谢我的迅速行动。”

此为丰乐里弄堂更夫郭阿良所作的陈述。

（注：郭阿良，36岁，宁波人，受雇于中国地产公司（China Realty Co.）担任更夫，该公司为丰乐里地区房产的业主。他有两次前科，一次为盗窃罪，一次为收受赃物罪）。

郭阿良在与本宪兵队成员交谈过程中，就1935年11月9日晚约9时07分在达罗路被不明袭击者从后脑开枪射杀的一等水兵中山（Nakayama）谋杀案，作了如下陈述：

“案发当晚8点刚过，我离开住所，前往达罗路上的广生钱庄（陈鸿道）兑换铜板。拿到铜板后，我将钱放入口袋，双手抱在胸前，走进了

pages.en:
Foong Loh Li alleyway and walked towards my home, keeping to the
south side of the footpath as I went along. No sooner I got to the
intersection of the 2nd Lane than I heard a sound of explosion but
I thought it was a case of puncture of a bicycle tyre. I looked
around but could find no one in the vicinity. I then went home but
found the iron gate closed so I turned back and proceeded west along
the Foong Loh Li alleyway. When I came as far as the Matsubara Bicycle
shop I saw several amahs coming from the opposite direction who told
me that a Japanese sailor has just been murdered on Barrowh Road and
that his body was still lying there. This was the first report of
the incident I got. The amah disappeared after this and I am unable
to state whether they went towards North Szechuen Road or not.

"I noticed that lights were still on at the Matsubara Bicycle
shop so I knocked at the door and informed the mistress about what
I heard from the amahs. I then entered my house through the back door
and went to sleep.

"At the intersection of the 2nd Lane and the Foong Loh Li
alleyway, I heard a report of explosion and I then looked around but
found nobody in the vicinity. When I got home I repeated to my wife
what I heard from the amahs. Apart from this I did not tell her anything
else".

Statement made by wife of Koo Ah Liang, watchman for the Foong
Loh Li off North Szechuen Road.

In the course of conversation with a member of this gendarmerie,
wife of Koo Ah Liang made the following statement at 10 a.m. on
12/11/35 in connection with the murder of 1st class sailor Nakayama of
the Japanese Naval Landing Forces.

"On the night of the incident I went to bed at about 7 o'clock.
I cannot say exactly what time my husband came back.

"He told me that as he was counting coppers at an exchange
shop he heard a report of pistol and, being alarmed, ran home
immediately."

With regard to the last paragraph of this statement, the
gendarme questioned her three times and asked her whether she was
pages.zh:
丰乐里弄堂，朝我家走去，沿途一直走在人行道的南侧。我刚走到第二弄的交叉口，就听到一声爆炸声，但我以为那是自行车轮胎爆胎的声音。我环顾四周，但在附近没有发现任何人。随后我回家，但发现铁门已关，于是我又折返，沿着丰乐里弄堂向西走去。当我走到松原自行车店（Matsubara Bicycle shop）附近时，看见几名阿妈从对面走来，她们告诉我，一名日本水兵刚刚在巴罗路（Barrowh Road）被谋杀，尸体仍躺在那里。这是我得到的关于该事件的第一份报告。这些阿妈随后消失，我无法说明她们是否朝北四川路方向走去。

“我注意到松原自行车店的灯还亮着，所以我敲门并将我从阿妈们那里听到的情况告知了女主人。然后我从后门进入我家并去睡觉了。

“在第二弄与丰乐里弄堂的交叉口，我听到一声爆炸响，随即环顾四周，但在附近未发现任何人。回到家后，我将我从阿妈们那里听到的情况复述给了妻子。除此之外，我没有再告诉她其他任何事情。”

以上为北四川路丰乐里看门人顾阿良（Koo Ah Liang）之妻所作的陈述。

在与本宪兵队成员交谈过程中，顾阿良之妻于1935年11月12日上午10时就日本海军陆战队一等水兵中山（Nakayama）被谋杀一案作了如下陈述：

“事发当晚，我大约在7点钟上床睡觉。我说不出丈夫确切回来的时间。

“他告诉我，他在一家兑换店数铜板时听到枪声，因受惊吓，立即跑回家。”

关于本陈述的最后一段，宪兵向她询问了三次，问她是否

pages.en:
(4)
positive about this statement and she replied, "Yes". She was
then questioned again in the presence of her husband Koe Ah Liang
and she still adhered to her original deposition.
pages.zh:
(4)
确定该陈述属实，她回答：“是的”。随后在其丈夫顾阿良（Koe Ah Liang）在场的情况下再次对她进行讯问，她仍然坚持原来的供词。

FORM 42
G. 28M 1 35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of. Z.Takaoka living at 90 Darroch Road
native of. Japan taken by me. at Dixwell Rd.Station
at. 1 a.m. on the. 10-11-35 and interpreted by. J.D.S.131 Iguchi

My name is Z.Takaoka. I am a shoe-maker living at 90 Darroch
Road.
At about 9 p.m.9-11-35 I was playing a gramophone at my home
and heard a sound which I thought was that of a m/car tyre
bursting. Immediately afterwards, my Chinese employee named
Woo Ziang Woo (胡祥和) opened the front door of my house from
outside and informed me that a man was lying on the roadway.
Realizing that the sound that I heard was a report of a fire-
arm, I left my house and saw a man lying some distance to the
North of my house. I then approached and found that the man
was a sailor of the Japanese Naval Landing Party whom I knew
by sight. He was lying on his side, his right arm outstretch-
ed, his body was at a slight angle to the edge of the road. His
position was near to the kerb of the west side of the road. He
was groaning, and although I spoke to him there was no reply.
In the meantime, two or three sailors arrived on the scene and
I told them to report the matter to the J.N.L.P.Headquarters.
Two or three Japanese civilians two of whom were dressed in
"Kimono" also came on the scene. I did not know who they were,
but I told one of them who was with a bicycle to report the mat-
ter to the Headquarters.
At the moment I left my house I did not observe any person in
the vicinity.
This is true.
Z.Takaoka.

Taken in the presence of
Japanese Consular Police official S.Kawai,
J.D.S.s Hasuo(D.R.) and Umemoto(K.Q.)
pages.zh:
表格 42
G. 28M 1 35

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警务调查报告。

以下为居住于达罗克路（Darroch Road）90号的日本人 Z.Takaoka 的陈述，由本人于1935年11月10日凌晨1点在狄思威路（Dixwell Rd.）巡捕房录取，由警员编号131井口（J.D.S. Iguchi）翻译。

我叫 Z.Takaoka。我是一名鞋匠，居住在达罗克路90号。
1935年11月9日晚上9点左右，我正在家中播放留声机，听到一种声音，我以为是汽车轮胎爆裂声。紧接着，我的中国雇员胡祥和（Woo Ziang Woo）从外面打开我家前门，通知我路上躺着一个人。意识到我听到的声音其实是枪声，我离开家，看到在我家以北不远处躺着一个人。我走近一看，发现那人是日本海军陆战队的一名水兵，我以前见过他。他侧躺着，右臂伸展，身体与路边成轻微角度。他的位置靠近道路西侧的路缘石。他在呻吟，虽然我对他说话，但他没有回应。与此同时，两三名水兵到达现场，我让他们向日本海军陆战队总部报告此事。还有两三名日本平民也来到现场，其中两人穿着“和服”。我不认识他们是谁，但我让其中一位带着自行车的人向总部报告此事。
在我离开家的那一刻，我没有观察到附近有任何人。
属实。
Z.Takaoka.

在日本领事馆警察官员 S.Kawai，以及警员 Hasuo (D.R.) 和 Umemoto (K.Q.) 在场下录取。

pages.en:
Statement made by Mr. Zenshiro Tanaka, aged 55,
married Shoemaker, residing at 90 Barrock Road,
taken by Japanese Consular Police on the 12/11/36.
--------------------------------------------------

I came to Shanghai about 30 years ago for the first time
and have since been engaged in shoemaking, having removed to
the present address in 1930. My family consists of three persons,
namely, myself, my wife named Kani, aged 48, and a son called
Zennan, who is at present 21 years old. I also have a Chinese
employee popularly known under the name of Siao Mau, aged about
25/6 years. I believe he resides somewhere in Woosung Road.

On November 9, 1936 Siao Mau came to the shop on bicycle
at about 8 a.m. and left about 3 o'clock in the afternoon.

Last night I had my dinner together with the family at about
6 p.m. I then prepared the bath and at the same time I also began
to play gramophone. After having played 3 or 4 records, I suddenly
heard an explosion outside but I did not pay much attention to it
as I thought it was bursting of a bicycle tyre. The report was
fairly loud but I still kept on playing the gramophone. At this
juncture, Voo Xian Voo, who does business with me on commission
basis, knocked on the front door, and peeped into the house with
the door half open and told me in his usual tone that a Japanese
is lying on the road. I immediately stopped the gramophone and
rushed out in my Japanese dress I was wearing at the time and
observed a black object lying on Barrock Road a little over 10 ken
(1 ken is equal to approximately 6 feet) to the north of my shop.
I then recalled the explosion which I heard a little while ago and
fearing that some plain clothes soldiers (Chinese) were in the
vicinity, looked around very carefully and went to the scene. Upon
arrival at the scene I saw a Japanese sailor lying at a slight
angle to the road with his head to the north. His left hand was
resting on his body whilst the right hand was stretched out slightly
at an angle to the body. The sailor was lying on his side and was
bleeding from a swelling measuring 5 or 6 bu. (1 bu is approximately
1.19 inches) above his left eye. I told the sailor not to worry
as the wound was not serious but he simply groaned and made no reply.
pages.zh:
田中善次郎（Zenshiro Tanaka）先生所作陈述，55岁，已婚，鞋匠，居住在巴罗克路（Barrock Road）90号，由日本领事馆警察于1936年11月12日录取。
--------------------------------------------------

我大约30年前第一次来到上海，此后一直从事制鞋业，并于1930年搬至现址。我家共有三口人，即我自己、48岁的妻子加尼（Kani），以及目前21岁的儿子善南（Zennan）。我还有一名中国雇员，俗称小毛（Siao Mau），年龄约25或26岁。我相信他居住在吴淞路某处。

1936年11月9日，小毛大约在上午8点骑自行车来到店里，下午3点左右离开。

昨晚我大约在下午6点与家人共进晚餐。随后我准备洗澡，同时开始播放留声机。在播放了三四个唱片后，我突然听到外面有一声爆炸，但我没有太在意，以为那是自行车轮胎爆胎。响声相当大，但我继续播放留声机。就在这时，与我以佣金方式合作业务的伍祥武（Voo Xian Voo，音译）敲了前门，半开着门向屋内张望，并用他惯常的语气告诉我，一个日本人躺在路上。我立即停止留声机，穿着当时身上的日本服装冲了出去，观察到在我店铺以北十多间（1间约合6英尺）处的巴罗克路上躺着一个黑色物体。我随即想起刚才听到的爆炸声，因担心附近有便衣士兵（中国人），我非常仔细地环顾四周，然后走向现场。到达现场后，我看到一名日本水兵侧躺在路上，头部朝北，身体与道路成轻微角度。他的左手放在身上，而右手略微伸展，与身体成一定角度。水兵侧躺着，左眼上方约五六分（1分约合1.19英寸）处有一个肿胀伤口正在流血。我告诉水兵不要担心，因为伤势不严重，但他只是呻吟，没有回答。

pages.en:
-2-

Soon after my arrival at the scene two Japanese in Japanese
dress and another Japanese whose clothing I cannot recollect came
to the scene. Immediately after their arrival a Japanese sailor
also came but he rushed back because I asked him to report the
occurrence to the Japanese Naval Landing Party. In the meantime one
of the three Japanese left the scene and came back with a bicycle.
I also asked this man to notify the Naval Landing Party to which he
immediately complied. A little later Japanese, foreign and Chinese
policemen arrived on bicycles followed closely by a party of 5 or 6
Japanese blue jackets wearing bullet-proof vests. I think some of
the marines also came in motor cycles but I am not sure on this point.
I was then asked to go to the Dixwell Road Station so I do not know
what happened afterwards.

Q. Did you notice anything peculiar in the manner of Woo Xiang
Woo when he told you about the incident ?

A. There was nothing unusual. He was calm and spoke with a smile.

Q. When you went out of the shop could you tell whether it was a
human body lying on the road ?

A. All I could see was something black lying on the road a little
over 10 kens from where I was and I took it to be the body of
human being as Woo had already told me so.

Q. Who were these Japanese present at the scene of the crime with
you ?

A. I have never met them before so I am unable to say.

Q. When you first saw the victim was he almost at the point of death ?

A. Without doubt I could see that it was hopeless.

Q. How long is it since you began transacting business with Woo ?

A. I could not say the exact time but it was some time last year.
Woo comes to my shop 3 or 4 times a month to collect his commission
but I cannot say when he came to the shop last.

Q. What is your opinion the character of Woo Xiang Woo ?

A. I find him to be of very quiet and retiring disposition.

Q. What is the condition of traffic like on ordinary days outside
your shop ?

A. Few pedestrians are seen on the road after sunset.
pages.zh:
-2-

我到达现场后不久，两名穿着日本服装的日本人和另一名衣着我已记不清的日本人来到现场。他们到达后，一名日本水兵也来了，但我让他向日本海军陆战队报告此事，他便匆匆返回。与此同时，这三名日本人中的一人离开现场，随后骑着自行车回来。我也让此人通知海军陆战队，他立即照办。过了一会儿，日本、外国和中国警察骑自行车到达，紧随其后的是五六个身穿防弹背心的日本蓝衣人（水兵）。我想有些海军陆战队员也骑摩托车来了，但这一点我不确定。随后我被要求前往狄思威路巡捕房，因此我不知道之后发生了什么。

问：当伍祥武（Woo Xiang Woo，音译）告诉你这起事件时，你注意到他的举止有什么异常吗？

答：没有什么不寻常。他很平静，微笑着说话。

问：当你走出店铺时，你能分辨出路上躺着的是人体吗？

答：我只能看到离我十多间远的地方路上有个黑色的东西，既然伍已经告诉过我，我就认为那是人的尸体。

问：和你一起在犯罪现场的那些日本人是谁？

答：我以前从未见过他们，所以无法说出他们的身份。

问：当你第一次看到受害者时，他是否已濒临死亡？

答：毫无疑问，我看出来已经没救了。

问：你开始与伍做生意有多久了？

答：我说不出确切时间，大概是去年某个时候。伍每月来我店里三四次收取佣金，但我说不出他上次来店里是什么时候。

问：你对伍祥武（Woo Xiang Woo，音译）的人品有何看法？

答：我觉得他性格非常安静、内向。

问：平日里你店铺外的交通状况如何？

答：日落后路上很少见到行人。

pages.en:
-3-
Q. Where did those three Japanese that you met at the scene of
crime come from ?
A. They told me that they heard a sound of explosion at the corner
so they came. By "corner" they probably meant either the
entrance of Keeble Gardens or the corner of Darroch Road and
North Szechuen Road.
Q. What is your opinion of this affair ?
A. I was only interested in looking after the victim and therefore
I am unable to express any opinion regarding the murder.

The foregoing statement was read out to the witness who
attested to the veracity of same and consented to sign his name and
also affix his seal.

Taken at the Police Depart. of the Japanese Consulate-General
at Shanghai on 10/11/35.

Chopped and signed: Mr. Z. Tanaka.
pages.zh:
-3-
问：你在犯罪现场遇到的那三个日本人是从哪里来的？
答：他们告诉我，他们在拐角处听到爆炸声，所以就过来了。所谓的“拐角”，他们可能指的是基布尔花园（Keeble Gardens）的入口，或者是达罗克路与北四川路的交叉口。
问：你对这件事有何看法？
答：我只专注于照顾受害者，因此无法对这起谋杀案发表任何意见。

上述陈述已向证人宣读，证人证明其真实性，同意签名并盖章。

1935年11月10日摄于上海日本总领事馆警务部。

盖章并签名：田中 Z. 先生。

My name is Kwah Lee Ss (    ), age 38, native of Ningpo,
married female, residing at No. 10 Feng Loh Li. My husband is
named Kwah Ah Liang (    ) his age is 37 years, also a native
of Ningpo. He is employed as a alleyway cleaner in the South
Feng Loh Li (    ) by Chi Yih (    ) Finance Corporation,
and is also employed by the China Reality Company to supervise
water supply to the North Feng Loh Li. He also keeps a fruit
stall in a vegetable shop at No. 17 South Feng Loh Li.

I was married to him when I was 24 years of age - that is
14 years ago in Shanghai.

I have borne four children by him. I have lived with my
husband for twelve years at No. 10 N. Feng Loh Li. At No. 10
North Feng Loh Li my husband supervises the ARTESIAN well that
supplies the North Feng Loh Li water. I know that my husband
every month accompanies the shroff of South Feng Loh Li, to
collect rents. I have never heard from him that he had any
trouble with any residents of the South and North Feng Loh Li.
On the 14th of the 10th Moon (9/11/35) at about 7 p.m. my
husband left home, I do not know where he went, but I thought
he was going to see our relative named Zung Ming Dau (    )
master of the Yan Zung Siang (    ) Cigarette and Exchange
shop, situated on Darrah Road nearly opposite the Feng Loh Li
(    ) alleyway. The master of this shop is cousin to my
husband. The reason I thought he had gone there was because he
often visits this shop, and whenever my husband wants a letter
written to send to our relatives in the country - the shop master
always writes the letters. I cannot give any other reason why I

以下为 Kwah Lee Ss（    ）的陈述，籍贯宁波，由本人 D.S.I. Crowther 于1935年11月13日在 D.Rd.. Stn.（狄思威路巡捕房）录取，并由 D.S.I. Chu Chi Huang 翻译。

我叫 Kwah Lee Ss（    ），38岁，宁波人，已婚女性，居住在丰乐里10号。我丈夫名叫 Kwah Ah Liang（    ），37岁，也是宁波人。他在南丰乐里（    ）受雇于集益（Chi Yih，音译）钱庄，担任弄堂清洁工，同时也受雇于中国实业公司（China Reality Company），负责监管北丰乐里的供水。他还在南丰乐里17号的一家蔬菜店里摆了一个水果摊。

我24岁时与他结婚，也就是14年前在上海结的婚。

我为他生了四个孩子。我和丈夫在北丰乐里10号住了十二年。在北丰乐里10号，我丈夫监管供应北丰乐里用水的自流井。我知道我丈夫每个月都陪同南丰乐里的收租员去收租金。我从未听他说过他与南丰乐里和北丰乐里的任何居民有过纠纷。
十月十四日（1935年11月9日）晚上7点左右，我丈夫离家，我不知道他去了哪里，但我以为他是去看望我们的亲戚曾明道（Zung Ming Dau，音译），他是位于达腊路（Darrah Road）、几乎正对丰乐里（    ）弄堂的严宗祥（Yan Zung Siang，音译）香烟兑换店的老板。这位店主是我丈夫的表亲。我以为他去那里的原因是因为他经常光顾这家店，而且每当我丈夫想写信给乡下的亲戚时——店主总是代写信件。我举不出其他理由说明为什么我

thought he had gone to this shop.
Shortly after my husband had left my room I went to bed
with my three children - one of the children is in the country.
Later I was awakened by my husband's return - but not one
word was spoken between us. My husband has his own bed. He went
to his bed in the same room as my bed was and then I went to
sleep again.
Later I was awakened by some-one banging at the iron gate
at the mouth of the alleyway. I then heard my neighbour, wife
of the gate keeper of the North Feng Leh Li (        ) asking
what was the matter. I then heard some-one speaking in Chinese
asking for the gate keeper. I then overheard the gate keeper
and his wife going downstairs, they were speaking to one another
- saying who were the men that were banging.
At this time my husband and myself arose from our
respective beds. My husband looked out through the window and
told me that there were many Japanese soldiers outside. He came
from the window and then told me the reason that the soldiers
were there - might be due to the death of a Japanese soldier
who was killed at the rear. I asked him where, and he told me
that he did not witness the killing but that some Chinese maid
servants had told him, whilst he was on his way home in the
Feng Leh Li from our cousin's exchange shop on Barrock Road.
He did not say where he met the Chinese maid servants, but he
told me that he had heard an explosion which he thought to be
the bursting of a ricksha tyre - this explosion he said he heard
after leaving the exchange shop - he did not tell me where he

以为他去了这家店。
在我丈夫离开我的房间后不久，我便带着三个孩子上床睡觉了——其中一个孩子在乡下。
后来我被丈夫的回来惊醒——但我们之间没有说一句话。我丈夫有他自己的床。他去了与我同室的一张床上，然后我又睡着了。
后来我被有人敲击巷口铁门的声音惊醒。接着我听到我的邻居，即北丰乐里（        ）看门人的妻子，询问发生了什么事。随后我听到有人用中文说话，寻找看门人。接着我无意中听到看门人及其妻子下楼，他们彼此交谈——说是谁在敲门。
此时，我和丈夫分别从各自的床上起身。我丈夫透过窗户向外看，并告诉我外面有很多日本士兵。他从窗边回来，然后告诉我士兵在那里的原因——可能是由于一名日本士兵在后部被杀所致。我问他地点在哪里，他告诉我他并未目睹杀人过程，而是有些中国女佣告诉他的，当时他正从巴洛克路（Barrock Road）我们亲戚的兑换店回家，途经丰乐里。他没有说在哪里遇到那些中国女佣，但他告诉我他听到了一声爆炸声，他以为是人力车轮胎爆裂——他说这声爆炸是在离开兑换店后听到的——他没有告诉我他

I then asked him at what time he returned home and he

听到爆炸声时身在何处。
于是我问他何时回家，他告诉我是晚上8点30分左右。
随后我丈夫唤醒了住在我们要房间上方阁楼里的一名更夫，该更夫便下了楼。
这名更夫不久后回到了他的阁楼。
随后我回到床上，我也看到丈夫上了床。
大约十五分钟后，我听到北彭乐里（North Peng Loh Li）看门人的妻子呼唤更夫，接着我听到更夫下楼的声音。
此后我便入睡了，不知道更夫何时回来的。
我丈夫回家后，当晚再也没有离开过我们的房间。
我和丈夫在早上6点左右起床。

Kwoh Lee S. 按指印签名

The following is the statement of Zung Dah Sun ( ), aged 39,
native of Ningpo taken by me Supt. T. Conduit.
at 3.30 a.m. on the 13-11-35 and interpreted by Clerk Li Yung Kau

I reside at 17, Foh Lou Li in the upstairs portions. I
live with my wife and three children aged 17, 8, and 5 respective
ly. I am employed at the Post Office, in North Szechuen Road
Sub-Post office. I also have a Cigarette and General shop at
No. 93 Darroch Road. My wife and I work there also. I have been
in Shanghai 12 years and worked for the Post office for 10 years.
On the 9-11-35 a distance relative of mine named Koh An Liang
came to my shop at about after 8 p.m. to change 40 cents silver
into coppers. My wife served him. I was counting coppers and I
heard him Koh asked my wife if the price of the cigarettes were
higher, my wife told him yes. I did not hear any further conver-
sation, because I turned away to count the coppers. I do not
know what the time was but I should think about after Koh left
I heard an explosion. I thought it was a ricsha tyre. I did not
look out of the window, I was still counting the coppers. I then
wrote in the accounts book the money received during a period
of four days. The first time I knew that shooting had taken
place was when Japanese and Chinese were talking outside my shop.
I understood from their conversation that a Japanese soldier had
been killed. At about 10 p.m. I closed the shop and went home
at 17, Fong Lou Li. My wife remained at the shop. After I was
questioned by the Foreigner, Japanese and Chinese but I know
nothing about the affair. Since I have worked at the Post Office
I only belong to the Post Office Employees Union. I am not a
member of any Communistic society or Anti-Japanese Society. I
have no other interest but that of my Post Office Duties and
looking after my shop.

Thumbprinted, cross marked and signed by
Zung Dah Sun.

以下为 Zung Dah Sun ( ) 之陈述，现年39岁，宁波籍，由本人 T. Conduit 巡官于1935年11月13日凌晨3点30分录取，并由职员 Li Yung Kau 翻译

我居住在佛楼里17号的楼上部分。我与妻子及三个孩子同住，孩子年龄分别为17岁、8岁和5岁。我在四川北路邮政支局工作。我在达罗克路（Darroch Road）93号还有一家香烟杂货店。我和妻子也在那里工作。我在上海已12年，在邮局工作了10年。
1935年11月9日，我的一位远亲 Koh An Liang 在晚上8点后来到我的店里，要将40角银元换成铜板。是我妻子接待的他。我当时正在数铜板，听到 Koh 问我妻子香烟价格是否涨了，我妻子说是的。我没有听到进一步的对话，因为我转身去数铜板了。我不知道具体时间，但我想大约在 Koh 离开后，我听到了一声爆炸声。我以为那是人力车轮胎爆裂。我没有向窗外看，仍在数铜板。随后我在账本上记录了四天内的收款。我第一次知道发生了枪击事件，是当日本人和中国人在我店外谈话时。我从他们的谈话中得知一名日本士兵被杀。晚上10点左右，我关了店，回到佛楼里17号的家。我妻子留在店里。之后我受到外国人、日本人和中国人的询问，但我对此事一无所知。自从我在邮局工作以来，我只属于邮局员工工会。我不是任何共产主义团体或反日团体的成员。除了履行邮局职责和照看店铺外，我没有其他兴趣。

Zung Dah Sun 按指印、画十字并签名。

Japanese. During the 1932 trouble my husband and I with the
children went to live at the Post Office in the Nantouban.
I remember the night of the 9/11/30 I do not remember the time

like a ricksha tyre bursting. I did not give any attention to this
but went on counting the coppers. Later I heard many people
outside talking and saying policemen are coming. I did not know
why the policemen were coming. I was counting my coppers. The
first time I knew that anyone had been shot was when a Chinese
policeman came to my shop and asked me if I knew anything about
the sailor being shot. I told him I did not know anything. I
thought that the report had been caused by the bursting of a
ricksha tyre. My daughter was in the shop at the time. After
that we closed the shop it was about 10 p.m. I did not see any
Japanese sailors quarrelling outside my shop that night and I

The following is the statement of. Koh Ah Liang ( ).
native of Ningpo taken by me Supt. Conduit
at 12.30 a.m. on the 13-11-35 and interpreted by Clerk Li Yang Kae.

My name is Koh Ah Liang, age 37 years, native of Ningpo,
I have been working in the Fong Loh Li for 12 years. I do not
visit any teashops and have no friends in Shanghai. During the
war of 1932, I went to stay in the Tsung Man hotel, Avenue
Edward VII. Whilst I was in the hotel, I telephoned to a
relative of mine named Zung Ming Dau, he works at the Sub-Post
Office, Rue Montauban, he resides now at No. 17 Fong Loh Li and
is the master of a cigarette shop on Darroch Road, shop is called
Van Zung Ziang, it is the same shop that the Police visited
tonight. I went to the cigarette shop just after 8 p.m. on
the 9-11-35. I guessed the time, I have no watch. I went to
change 40 cents silver, i.e. two twenty cent pieces. I changed
the money because I wanted some coppers for change at the
Japanese vegetable shop situated on the ground floor of No. 17
Fong Loh Li. I work there every day, starting at 7 a.m. and
on and off throughout the day. I have another man to help me
clean up the alleyways during the day, he is a wheelbarrow
coolie residing Jeu Ts Li, corner of Dixwell and North Szechuen
Roads. I did not see him in the alleyway on the night of the
9th. When I went to the shop to change the silver, I gave them
to the woman there, her name is Zung Woo Sz. I spoke to her
and told her the price of cigarettes were high and she said
cannot you buy some cheap one. I asked her how much more was
the price of Victory cigarettes, she said one cartoon is 10
cents dearer. I did not buy any. My cousin was there writing,
but I did not speak to him. His wife was counting the coppers.
After receiving the coppers, 96, I counted them once and placed

我叫 Koh Ah Liang，现年37岁，宁波籍，我在丰乐里（Fong Loh Li）工作已有12年。我不去茶馆，在上海也没有朋友。在1932年战争期间，我曾住在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的宗曼旅馆（Tsung Man hotel）。住在旅馆期间，我给一位名叫 Zung Ming Dau 的亲戚打过电话，他在蒙托邦路（Rue Montauban）的邮政支局工作，他现在住在丰乐里17号，是达罗克路一家名为“万中兴”（Van Zung Ziang）香烟店的老板，也就是警方今晚光顾的那家店。1935年11月9日晚上8点刚过，我去了那家香烟店。我是猜测的时间，我没有手表。我去兑换40角银元，即两枚贰角银币。我换钱是因为我想要些铜板作为零钱，用于位于丰乐里17号底层的日本蔬菜店。我每天在那里工作，早上7点开始，全天断断续续工作。白天还有另一个人帮我清理巷道，他是一名独轮车苦力，住在迪克斯威尔路（Dixwell Road）与四川北路交界处的居茨里（Jeu Ts Li）。9日晚上我没有在巷子里看到他。当我去店里兑换银元时，我把钱给了那里的女人，她叫 Zung Woo Sz.。我和她说话，告诉她香烟价格很高，她说你不能买些便宜的吗？我问她胜利牌香烟涨了多少，她说一条贵了10角。我没有买。我的表弟在那里写字，但我没有和他说话。他的妻子在数铜板。收到96个铜板后，我数了一遍，然后把

Road, but I am not sure. When they passed me they went onto

We both got up and went with the Japanese policeman to the
watchman's hut and opened it. Four or five policemen were
there, they went into the hut and inspected it. When they had
finished, the hut was locked up again. We both returned to our
home. I then went to bed. About half hour after the first
visit , and when I had got to bed, we were called again by a
Japanese policeman, who called the watchman to come to the
station. I did not get up. The first time I was called, my
wife asked me what was the matter. I told her that a Japanese
soldier had been murdered on Darroch Road. My wife asked me how
do I know this, I told her I had met several amahs who told me.

路，但我不确定。他们经过我时走上了北四川路。如果我再见到他们，我也无法辨认。当我走进第二条弄堂回家，走到一家日本自行车店后面时，我看见店主妇人在后厨，我敲了敲窗户，告诉那名日本女子，有几个女佣告诉我，一名日本士兵在达罗克路（Darroch Road）被杀。她问我从哪里来，我告诉那名日本女子，我在换了一些铜板后从达罗克路回来。之后我绕进下一条弄堂回到自己家中。随后我便上床睡觉。我的妻子已经睡着了。我有三个孩子。我和两个女儿一起睡，她们分别 11 岁和 6 岁，我妻子和我 4 岁的儿子一起睡。
晚上 11 点左右，一名日本警察敲响了弄堂的铁门。他在呼叫丰乐里（Fong Loh Li）名为狄松林（Dee Sung Ling）的更夫。他和我住在同一栋房子里。我们都起身，随同那名日本警察来到更夫棚并打开了门。那里有四五个警察，他们进入棚内进行了检查。检查完毕后，棚子再次被锁上。我们两人都回到了家中。随后我又上床睡觉。在第一次造访约半小时后，当我已经躺下时，我们又被一名日本警察叫醒，他叫更夫去巡捕房。我没有起床。第一次被叫时，我妻子问我出了什么事。我告诉她，一名日本士兵在达罗克路被谋杀。我妻子问我怎么知道的，我告诉她我遇到了几个女佣，是她们告诉我的。

My wife did not ask anything else.
My wages are $18.00 per month from the China Trading
Corporation and $6.00 from Jien Yih Co. I am a partner in the
Fruit and Vegetable shop at No. 17 Fong Loh Li. We do not share
a profit, owing to many Japanese owing us money. I also receive
$16.00 altogether from 83 houses in the Fong Loh Li. My total
income is $40.00 per month. My house is free. What I have
now stated is true. I know absolutely nothing about the shooting
of the Japanese soldiers
Yesterday afternoon, 11th inst, at about 2 p.m. I was asked
to go to a Japanese house, No. 57 Fong Loh Li, occupied by a
Japanese named Kau Jan. He asked me if I knew the man who
fired the shot that killed the Japanese soldier. I told him
that I did not know. This Japanese spoke to me, another
Japanese was acting as an interpreter, he was from the Military
Headquarters, but I did not know this then & I thought he was
a Chinese, but when I was taken to the Military Headquarters
on the 11th inst. at about 4 p.m., he again acted as an
interpreter and then I knew he was a Japanese. Another
Japanese was also present at No. 57 Fong Loh Li, he was in
uniform. There they struck me on the face. Kau Jan then said,
"do you know where the pistol is hidden ?" I told them I did
not know where it was hidden. Kau Jan told me he had found it
himself behind the hut. At 4 p.m. I was taken to the Japanese
Barracks. I was again questioned with the same questions that
was put to me at No. 57. I told them I did not know anything
about the affair. I was kept there until 9 p.m. when I was

我妻子没有再问其他事情。
我的月薪为从中国贸易公司（China Trading Corporation）获得的 18.00 美元，以及从建益公司（Jien Yih Co.）获得的 6.00 美元。我是丰乐里 17 号果蔬店的合伙人。由于许多日本人欠我们钱，我们不分享利润。我还从丰乐里的 83 户人家那里总共收取 16.00 美元。我的总收入为每月 40.00 美元。我的住房是免费的。我上述所言属实。我对日本士兵被枪击一事绝对一无所知。
昨天下午，即本月 11 日约下午 2 点，我被要求去丰乐里 57 号的一所日本房子，住在那里的是一个名叫 Kau Jan 的日本人。他问我是否知道开枪打死日本士兵的人是谁。我告诉他我不知道。这个日本人对我说话，另一个日本人担任翻译，他来自军事总部，但我当时并不知道这一点，以为他是中国人，但当本月 11 日下午 4 点左右我被带到军事总部时，他再次担任翻译，这时我才知道他是日本人。在丰乐里 57 号还有另一名日本人在场，他身穿制服。在那里他们打了我的脸。Kau Jan 接着说：“你知道手枪藏在哪里吗？”我告诉他们我不知道藏在哪里。Kau Jan 告诉我，他自己在棚子后面找到了手枪。下午 4 点，我被带到日本兵营。我再次受到审问，问题与在 57 号问我的相同。我告诉他们我对这件事一无所知。我一直被关在那里直到晚上 9 点，当时我

again questioned, and I told them I did not know anything about
the affair. Then they released me and I returned home.
At about 8 a.m. on the 12th inst. Kau Jau came to my home
and took the watchman away to No. 57 Fong Loh Li. A little
time afterwards Kau Jau returned and took me to No. 57. I was
first questioned there and then taken to the Military Barracks.
I was again questioned. I again told them I did not know any-
thing. At about 7 p.m. on the same day I was sent to Dixwell
Road Station.
The only reason I can give for Kau Jau wanting to say I
committed the crime is that I assist rent collector every month
and that Kau Jau owes 5 or 6 months house rent.

再次受审，我告诉他们我对这件事一无所知。然后他们释放了我，我回到了家。
本月 12 日上午 8 点左右，Kau Jau 来到我家，把更夫带走去了丰乐里 57 号。过了一会儿，Kau Jau 回来，把我带到了 57 号。我首先在那里受审，然后被带到军营。我再次受审。我再次告诉他们我什么都不知道。当天晚上 7 点左右，我被送到狄思威路（Dixwell Road）巡捕房。
我能给出的 Kau Jau 想要说我犯罪的唯一原因是，我每月协助收租，而 Kau Jau 欠了 5 或 6 个月的房租。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
Koh Ah Liang ( 柯阿良 ).
The following is the statement of
native of Ningpo.
taken by me D.S.I. M.L. Crowther.
at 8.10 p.m. on the 12/11/35. and interpreted by Clerk Li Yang Kae.

My name is Koh Ah Liang, age 37 years, native of Ningpo, residing No. 10 Fong Loh Li, employed by the China Trading Corporation as an alleyway cleaner in the Fong Loh Li. Shortly after 8 p.m. on the 9/11/35, having had my dinner, I went to a cigarette and exchange shop, situated on Darroch Road and Darroch Road Terrace corner to change 40 cents silver into coppers. When I arrived at the shop, I spoke to the wife of the shop master about the business of her husband's shop. The conversation lasted about one minute. To get to the shop I walked West in Fong Loh Li, to Darroch Road, and then across the roadway to the shop. I left the shop and returned by crossing the Darroch Road and gained the Fong Loh Li, in which alleyway I walked in an Easterly direction until I arrived at the second alleyway from the North Szechuen Road entrance. This was passed the watchman's hut. At this point I heard the sound of an explosion, which I thought to be a tyre bursting, so I did not pay any attention. I then walked on until I reached the first alleyway on the North side from the North Szechuen Road entrance and because I saw the iron gate of this alleyway closed, I intended to return to the second alleyway from the North Szechuen Road entrance, also on the North side. I had just turned round and walked a few paces from the first alleyway, when I saw about four Chinese maid servants running towards me. I immediately stopped and when they reached me, I asked them why they were running, they told me that a Japanese soldier had been killed on Darroch Road - at this time they were still running and ran onto the North Szechuen Road where I lost sight of them. I then ran to the second alleyway on the North side

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

柯阿良 ( Koh Ah Liang )。
以下为
籍贯宁波。
由本人 D.S.I. M.L. Crowther 录取。

我叫柯阿良，37 岁，宁波人，居住在丰乐里 10 号，受雇于中国贸易公司，在丰乐里担任弄堂清洁工。1935 年 11 月 9 日晚上 8 点过后不久，吃完晚饭后，我去了一家位于达罗克路和达罗克路露台（Darroch Road Terrace）拐角处的香烟兑换店，将 40 分银币换成铜板。到达店里时，我和店主妻子谈起了她丈夫的生意。谈话持续了大约一分钟。为了去那家店，我从丰乐里向西走到达罗克路，然后穿过马路到店裡。我离开店铺，穿过达罗克路返回，进入丰乐里，在该弄堂里向东走，直到到达距北四川路入口第二条弄堂。此处经过了更夫棚。在此处我听到一声爆炸声，我以为是轮胎爆裂，所以没有在意。然后我继续走，直到到达北四川路入口北侧的第一条弄堂，因为看到这条弄堂的铁门关着，我打算返回北四川路入口北侧的第二条弄堂。我刚转身，离第一条弄堂走了几步，就看见大约四个中国女佣朝我跑来。我立刻停下，当她们跑到我身边时，我问她们为什么跑，她们告诉我一名日本士兵在达罗克路被杀了——此时她们仍在奔跑，跑上了北四川路，我就看不见她们了。然后我跑向北侧的第二条弄堂

of Fong Loh Li from the North Ssochuen Road, which I entered and
walked to my home at No. 10 Fong Loh Li by the first entrance in
this alleyway which runs East, where I went to bed. I told my
wife of what I saw and heard from the maid servants. I took them
to be maid servants from their appearance. I further state, as I
was walking past the back door of a Japanese bicycle shop in
the second alleyway on the North side of Fong Loh Li, I saw the
Japanese mistress whom I have known for a long time - she was
washing the kitchen. The back door was closed and I saw the
mistress through the window. I knocked on the window pane, the
Japanese mistress opened the window. I told her that I had been
told by several Chinese maid servants that a Japanese soldier
had been killed on Darroch Road. The Japanese mistress asked me
where I had come from, I told her that I had come from Darroch
Road where I exchanged some silver pieces at an exchange shop.
I did not notice any other persons in this alleyway other
than the maid servants - I did not pay any attention as only the
maid servants were running.

从北四川路进入丰乐里，我进入该弄堂，通过这条向东延伸的弄堂的第一个入口走到我在丰乐里 10 号的家，随后上床睡觉。我把从女佣们那里看到和听到的事告诉了妻子。我从外表判断她们是女佣。我还要陈述的是，当我走过丰乐里北侧第二条弄堂中一家日本自行车店的后门时，我看到了我认识很久的日本女主人的身影——她正在清洗厨房。后门关着，我透过窗户看到了女主人。我敲了敲窗玻璃，日本女主人打开了窗户。我告诉她，几个中国女佣告诉我，一名日本士兵在达罗克路被杀。日本女主人问我从哪里来，我告诉她我从达罗克路来，在那里的一家兑换店换了一些银元。
除了那些女佣外，我没有注意到弄堂里有其他人——我没有注意，因为只有女佣们在跑。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.
The following is the statement of Li Ong Ping ( 李 翁 平 ) age 33.
native of Tientsin taken by me D.S. Craig
at 3 a.m. on the 13/11/35. and interpreted by Clerk Wong.

My name is Li Ong-ping, age 33, native of Tientsin,
residing at No. 10 Fong Loh Li, employed as a watchman by the
Chung Kuo Trading Co., 290 Kiukiang Road for the past three
months.
My hours of duty are between 6 a.m. and 6 p.m. daily.
When I came off duty at 6 p.m. on 9/11/35 I went to my
home at No. 10 Fong Loh Li cooked some rice and after partaking
of same I retired for the night.
At about 10 p.m. on the 9/11/35 I was aroused from my
sleep by five or six Japanese dressed in foreign style clothing
and told me to come outside as they wanted to look inside the
watchman's hut in the Fong Loh Li. I came outside and went to
the hut, accompanied by the 5 or 6 Japanese and opened the
door of the hut. After searching the hut the Japanese then
questioned me regarding my hours of duty. I told them that I
was on duty from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily. I was further question-
ed whether or not there was a night duty watchman, I replied
that there was not. The Japanese then asked me if I knew that
a man had been killed. I replied, I had no knowledge of anybody
being killed.
After answering the above questions I returned to my
home without meeting anyone in the Fong Loh Li or any of the
other two occupants when I entered my home. After entering my
home I immediately went to bed but was again aroused at about
11 p.m. by one Japanese and one Chinese detectives who brought
me to Dixwell Road Police Station where I was questioned about
my hours of duty and whether I had any knowledge that a

籍贯天津，由本人 D.S. Craig 录取

我叫李翁平，33 岁，天津人，居住在丰乐里 10 号，过去三个月受雇于九江路 290 号的中国贸易公司（Chung Kuo Trading Co.）担任更夫。
我的值班时间是每天上午 6 点到下午 6 点。
1935 年 11 月 9 日下午 6 点下班后，我回到丰乐里 10 号的家中，煮了些米饭，吃完后便上床休息。
1935 年 11 月 9 日晚上 10 点左右，我被五六个穿着西式服装的日本人从睡梦中叫醒，他们让我到外面去，因为他们想查看丰乐里的更夫棚内部。我走到外面，随同这五六个日本人来到棚子前，打开了棚门。搜查完棚子后，日本人询问了我的值班时间。我告诉他们我每天从上午 6 点到下午 6 点值班。他们进一步询问是否有夜间值班的更夫，我回答说没有。接着日本人问我是否知道有人被杀。我回答说，我不知道任何人被杀。
回答完上述问题后，我回到家中，在进入家门时未在丰乐里遇到任何人，也未遇到另外两名住户中的任何一人。进家后我立即上床睡觉，但在晚上 11 点左右再次被一名日本人和一名中国侦探叫醒，他们把我带到狄思威路巡捕房，在那里我接受了关于我的值班时间以及我是否知道有

6 a.m. to 6 p.m. daily and I knew nothing of any man having
been killed. After being questioned I was allowed to leave
Dixwell Road Station to go home, the time being about 2 a.m. on

duty on the 10/11/35 I did not have any conversation with any

10/11/35 and after partaking of my evening meal I went to bed at
about 7 p.m. and slept till about 5.30 a.m. on the 11/11/35 and
went on duty at 6 a.m. As quite a number of tenants had been
removing suitcases from their respective homes in the Fong Loh
Li I asked several of them why they were removing and they
stated that as there was a number of Japanese soldiers patrolling
the vicinity they had become afraid and were removing. At 9.15am
on the 11/11/35 I proceeded to the Chung Kue Trading Co. 290
Kiukiang Road and informed Mr. Chang the accountant that the
majority of the tenants in Fong Loh Li had removed because they
were afraid of the Japanese soldiers who were parading the Fong
Loh Li. Mr. Chang then informed me that he had read in the
newspaper that a Japanese had been killed on Darroch Road near
Fong Loh Li. I was then instructed by Mr. Chang to return to
Fong Loh Li immediately as the Foreign compradore had already
gone there. I returned to Fong Loh Li and heard or saw nothing
until about 2 p.m. 11/11/35 when a Foreigner, name unknown
connected with Chung Kue Food Trading Co. came to Fong Loh Li

and I reported to him as I reported to Mr. Chang earlier in

我向他陈述的内容与我当天早些时候向张先生陈述的一致。我继续执勤至下午6时，随后下班就寝，并于1935年11月12日凌晨5时许起床，于上午6时开始执勤。1935年11月12日上午8时许，我在执勤期间，一名身穿卡其色军服、头戴红帽、佩带军刀的日本士兵，连同两名身穿西式服装的平民，将我带至居住在丰乐里57号的一名日本人高桥（Takahashi）家中。他们就我的执勤时间对我进行了盘问。我告诉他们，我每天的执勤时间为上午6时至下午6时。他们进一步询问我是否知晓有日本士兵被杀一事。我表示对此事并不知情。他们还问我是否知道高阿良（Kau Ah Liang）每天去烟店兑换钱币之事，我予以否认。他们还问我1935年11月11日昨天与我交谈的外国人是谁，我告诉他那是中国贸易公司（Chung Kuo Trading Co.）的一名外籍雇员。1935年11月12日上午9时许，我被允许离开丰乐里57号，随后返回岗位继续执勤。
