statement in Court, otherwise more evidence favourable to
the accused might have been obtained. Pu stated that
upon seeing the shooting, she returned by way of a rt tea
shop. At that time, there were many persons in the shop
and it is strange that the girl did not say a single word
about the incident which had frightened her. Furthermore,
she said that it seemed to her that the culprit was dressed
in black clothing; this does not definitely mean that the
culprit was dressed in black clothing. As regards the
point that no finger prints of Yang Chien Chung have been
found in the book, there is nothing strange in this and it
cannot be used to overthrow the statement of Yang Vung Tao
that Yang Chien Chung had planted the evidence in order to
implicate him falsely, because, although it was Yang Chien
Chung who planted the evidence, it is possible that others
had made the hold in the book. Therefore if Yang's finger
prints are to be found they will be found on the surface
of the book. But the Medico-Legal Laboratory did not find
any of his finger prints on the surface of the book.
The statement of Yang Chien Chung showing his connection.
with Zung Wei Ming (□□□) also proves Yang's connection.
with the murder. Yang Chien Chung had asked a loan from
Zung and it is probable that this was the cause of Yang
Chien Chung's accusation against Yang Vung Tao. Why did
Yang Chien Chung, after learning of the case, flee to
Canton, Nanking, Chinkiang and Hangchow? Because it was
he who planted the evidence. The documents produced by
the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters
and the statements of Chu Kwei Sung and the other culprits
all show that Yih Hai Sung, Yang Vung Tao and Tseu Shou Yong
had nothing to do with the murder of Nakayama. The Medico-
Legal Laboratory has not been able to say definitely that
the book seized is the one that held the pistol seized in
the case. The connection between the pistol seized and
the death of Nakayama requires further evidence. In the
course of their investigations, the Municipal Police came
to the conclusion that the pistol seized beneath the Police
Box had been thrown there by a person with the intention
of falsely implicating Li Hung Ping (□□□), the policeman
in the Police Box. In making a hurried escape, a culprit
could never have concealed the pistol so nicely. This point
is favourable to the accused. Therefore, I request that
the three accused be found not guilty".
Lawyers Wang Shih Chong and Van Kong also
addressed the Court.
When the Court was about to close the argument,
Municipal Advocate Paul Ru spoke in reply to the point
made by lawyer Chang concerning the seizure of the pistol
beneath the Police Box. He requested the Court to look
at the report of the Municipal Police and then said:-
"The report of the Police shows that the pistol was the
weapon used in the murder. The object of casting the
pistol under the Police Box was, as mentioned by lawyer Chang,
to implicate Li Hung Ping, but the Police do not say that
the pistol was not the weapon used in committing the crime".
Presiding Judge Chien then announced that
judgment would be delivered on the afternoon of October 2.

否则可能会获得更多有利于被告的证据。浦称，看到枪击后，她经由一家红茶店返回。当时店里有很多人，奇怪的是，这个女孩对这件令她惊恐的事件只字未提。此外，她说凶手似乎穿着黑色衣服；这并不一定意味着凶手就穿着黑色衣服。关于书中未发现杨建中指纹这一点，这并无奇怪之处，也不能用来推翻杨文道关于杨建中放置证据以虚假陷害他的说法，因为虽然是杨建中放置了证据，但也有可能是其他人在这本书上打了洞。因此，如果要找到杨的指纹，应该会在书的表面找到。但法医实验室并未在书的表面发现他的任何指纹。
杨建中显示其与宗伟明（□□□）有关联的陈述，也证明了杨与谋杀案的关联。杨建中曾向宗借款，这很可能是杨建中指控杨文道的原因。杨建中在得知案情后，为何逃往广州、南京、镇江和杭州？因为是他放置了证据。吴淞上海警备司令部出具的文件以及朱贵生和其他罪犯的陈述均表明，叶海松、杨文道和周守勇与中山谋杀案无关。法医实验室未能明确断定被搜获的书籍就是本案中存放被缴获手枪的那本书。被缴获的手枪与中山之死之间的联系需要更多证据。在市警察局的调查过程中，他们得出结论认为，在警亭下发现的手枪是有人故意扔在那里的，目的是虚假陷害警亭内的警察李宏平（□□□）。罪犯在匆忙逃跑时，绝不可能将手枪藏匿得如此妥当。这一点对被告有利。因此，我请求宣告三名被告无罪”。

律师王士崇和范刚也向法庭发了言。
当法庭即将结束辩论时，市政检察官鲁平就张律师关于在警亭下缴获手枪的观点作了回应。他请法庭查看市警察局的报告，然后说：
“警方的报告显示，该手枪是谋杀所用的凶器。正如张律师所说，将手枪扔在警亭下的目的是陷害李宏平，但警方并未说该手枪不是作案所用的凶器”。
随后，主审法官钱宣布，判决将于10月2日下午宣判。

October 2, 1936. Morning Translation.

KAINICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

The 14th hearing of the
Nakayama case took place at the First Special District
Court before Judge Chen at 2 p.m. yesterday. Municipal
Advocate Paul Ru, Assistant Commissioner Uyehara of
the Special Political Office of the S.P.P., Mr. Shimokawa,
Judicial Consul, Secretary Nakada, of the Japanese
Consulate, Mr. Tajima, officer in charge of the First
Section of the Japanese Consular Police, Mr. Okamoto,
Japanese lawyer, and the Chinese lawyers for the defence
of the accused were present in Court.
At 2.20 p.m. when the three
accused Yang Ven Tao, Lin Hai Sung and Chow Zeu Yong,
were brought into the Court, the Judge ordered the Court
clerk to read the report of the Chenju Medico-Legal
Laboratory on certain exhibits in the case. The report
was as follows:-
"It cannot be ascertained whether the rust
stains on the book are identical with the rust of the
pistol used in the crime. Endeavours were made to identify
the finger prints of Yang Ven Tao and Yang Kien Tsong
with those found in the book, but the finger prints in
the book were not clear enough."
At the close of the reading
of the report the Judge asked Yang Ven Tao whether or not
the book belonged to him.
the
Yang Ven Tao replied in negative.
Municipal Advocate Paul Ru
informed the Court that the statement of Pan Chiu Ying,
the confession of Yang Ven Tao and the book containing
the excavated hole in which to conceal the pistol ----
all this constituted strong evidence against the accused
who should, therefore, be found guilty. The Advocate
further stated that according to the Chenju report,
there were no finger prints of Yang Kien Tsong on the
book. It has been ascertained at previous hearings
that the book belongs to Yang Ven Tao therefore the latter
was responsible for the crime. The Advocate also
explained to the Court that the investigations made by
the Arms Identification Section, the Finger Prints Section
and the Special Political Office had provided indisputable
evidence of the guilt of the accused.

The arguments for the defence

One of the five lawyers for
the defence stated that Yang Ven Tao had remained in

This shows that Yang Ven Tao did not commit the crime and
the statement made by him at the previous hearings to the
effect that the book belongs to him was in his favour,
because he did not commit the crime. In other words, he
would have not admitted ownership of the book had he
admitted the crime. The lawyer further stated that if

《每日新闻》

中山案

中山案第十四次审讯于昨日下午2时在第一特区地方法院由陈法官主持进行。出庭者有：市检察官Paul Ru、上海公共租界警务处特别政治股助理总监Uyehara、司法领事Shimokawa先生、日本领事馆秘书Nakada先生、日本领事警察第一课主管Tajima先生、日本律师Okamoto先生，以及被告的辩护中国律师。

下午2时20分，当三名被告杨文道（Yang Ven Tao）、林海松（Lin Hai Sung）和周祖荣（Chow Zeu Yong）被带上法庭时，法官命令书记官宣读真如法医实验室关于案中某些物证的报告。报告内容如下：

“无法确定书上的锈迹是否与作案所用枪支的锈迹相同。曾试图将杨文道和杨建宗（Yang Kien Tsong）的指纹与书上发现的指纹进行比对，但书上的指纹不够清晰。”

报告宣读完毕后，法官询问杨文道该书是否属于他。

杨文道予以否认。

市检察官Paul Ru告知法庭，潘秋英（Pan Chiu Ying）的证词、杨文道的供词以及藏枪挖孔的那本书——所有这些构成了对被告不利的有力证据，因此应判定其有罪。检察官进一步指出，根据真如方面的报告，书上没有杨建宗的指纹。在之前的审讯中已查明该书属于杨文道，因此后者应对此罪行负责。检察官还向法庭解释，枪械鉴定科、指纹科和特别政治股的调查提供了被告有罪的无可辩驳的证据。

辩护方的论点

五名辩护律师中的一位表示，杨文道虽听闻叶海松（Yah Hai Sung，注：此处原文拼写与前文Yih/Yang略有差异，依上下文指同一人或相关人）被捕的消息，但仍留在上海。这表明杨文道并未犯罪，且他在之前审讯中声称该书属于他的陈述对他有利，因为他没有犯罪。换言之，如果他承认了犯罪，他就不会承认拥有这本书。该律师进一步表示，如果

there were no finger prints of Yang Kien Tsong in the book
there were none of Yang Ven Tao's also. As regards Chow
Zeu Yoong, there was no evidence against him.
Another lawyer for the defence spoke
as follows: "As regards the evidence of the amah, Yih
Hai Sung's confession, and the book, cannot be accepted,
because the amah's statement is untrue for it does not
agree with the reconstruction of the crime given by Yih
Hai Sung; Yih Hai Sung's confession was secured by torture;
the examination of the Chenju Legal Laboratory found no
finger prints of Yang Ven Tao's on the book."
A third lawyer for the defence addressed
the Court as follows: "The amah's statement cannot be
accepted because it does not agree with the statement made
by Yih Hai Sung. Yang Kien Tsong and not Yang Ven Tao
is the central figure in the crime, because Yang Kien
Tsong had been secretly moving about to Canton, Hangchow,
Soochow, and Kashing, fearing arrest. Why should he
have moved from one place to another if he did commit
the crime?"
The 4th lawyer for the defence said:
"Yi Hai Sung is not the kind of person capable of committing
such a crime; furthermore, he does not know how to fire
a pistol."
The 5th lawyer for the defence declared
that he had nothing to say because the other lawyers had
already said everything that he had wanted to say.
Municipal Advocate Ru refuted the
arguments advanced by the defence lawyers by referring
to the evidence produced at the previous hearings.
At this stage, the Judge asked Yih
Hai Sung whether or not he had anything to say.
Yih Hai Sung replied that he was at
the Nanyang Dance Hall with a dancing partner on the
evening of November 9, 1935, and that if it was he who
had committed the murder, he could not have been there.
Chow Zeu Yoong stated that he was
arrested at a dance hall by a policeman of the S.M.P.
to whom he had given his proper name and that if he
had committed such a crime he would not have given his
true name to the police and he would not have remained
in Shanghai.
At this stage, the Judge announced
that a decision would be delivered on October 2.

书上没有杨建宗的指纹，那么也没有杨文道的指纹。至于周祖荣（Chow Zeu Yoong），没有任何针对他的证据。

另一位辩护律师发言如下：“关于女佣的证词、叶海松（Yih Hai Sung）的供词以及那本书，均不能采信，因为女佣的陈述不实，因其与叶海松重构的犯罪过程不符；叶海松的供词是刑讯逼供所得；真如法医实验室的检查未在书上发现杨文道的指纹。”

第三位辩护律师向法庭陈述如下：“女佣的陈述不能采信，因为它与叶海松（Yih Hai Sung）的陈述不符。杨建宗而非杨文道是本案的核心人物，因为杨建宗因害怕被捕而秘密往返于广州、杭州、苏州和嘉兴之间。如果他犯了罪，为何要四处转移？”

第四位辩护律师说：“叶海松（Yi Hai Sung）不是那种能犯下此类罪行的人；此外，他不知道如何开枪。”

第五位辩护律师声明他无话可说，因为其他律师已经说出了他想说的一切。

市检察官Ru引用之前审讯中提出的证据，反驳了辩护律师提出的论点。

此时，法官询问叶海松（Yih Hai Sung）是否有话要说。

叶海松回答说，1935年11月9日晚，他与一名舞伴在南阳舞厅，如果是他犯了谋杀罪，他就不可能在那里。

周祖荣（Chow Zeu Yoong）表示，他是被一名公共租界警务处（S.M.P.）巡捕在舞厅逮捕的，他向该巡报出了真实姓名，如果他犯了此类罪行，他就不会向警方提供真实姓名，也不会留在上海。

此时，法官宣布将于10月2日宣判。

NICHI NICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

At 2 p.m. to-day the i4th
hearing of the Nakayama case will be held at the First
Special District Court. At previous hearings, the
Chinese authorities attempted to resort trickery , but
it was defeated by the scientific and accurate evidence
produced by the S.M.P. Now the case is only awaiting
decision. Japanese are paying close attention to
the connections of other persons with the Nakayama case.

SUSPICIOUS CHINESE ARRESTED

At 9.30 p.m. yesterday a
Japanese noticed a Chinese loitering for more than
two hours on the vacant piece of ground adjoining
Magnolia Terrace, North Szechuen Road and reported
the matter to Dixwell Road Station. The police,
with the assistance of the Japanese Landing Party,
arrested the Chinese in question. The man gave his
name as Chang Yui Ching, age 41. He stated that he
was waiting for his sweetheart, a Chinese girl, who
works in a Japanese house in Magnolia Terrace. The
prisoner is being held for further inquiries.

《日日新闻》

中山案

今天下午2时，中山案第十四次审讯将在第一特区地方法院举行。在之前的审讯中，中国当局企图耍弄花招，但被公共租界警务处（S.M.P.）提供的科学且准确的证据所挫败。现在该案只待判决。日本人正密切关注其他人与中山案的关联。

可疑华人被捕

昨晚9时30分，一名日本人注意到一名华人在北四川路木兰公寓（Magnolia Terrace）旁的一块空地上徘徊了两个多小时，遂将此情况报告给狄思威路捕房。警方在日本登陆部队的协助下，逮捕了该名华人。该男子自称张裕清（Chang Yui Ching），41岁。他表示他在等他的情人，一名在木兰公寓一户日本人家里工作的中国女孩。该囚犯正被羁押以待进一步查问。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Tuesday, September 29, 1936

Nakayama, Kayau
Cases Clearing Up
As Clues Unfold

The three Cantonese held in connection with the killing of Nakayama in Hongkew nearly a year ago may possibly hear their fate when they face the First District Court Thursday afternoon. Judge Duen is to hear arguments by prosecution and defense, and though he may give a verdict, the case will probably be remanded for judgment.

Meanwhile, the Bureau of Public Safety revealed last night that through confessions made by several Chinese arrested in connection with the Kayau case, a personal enemy of Kayau, Li Jui-wu, hired a professional killer, Wang Cheng-sheng, for $300 to murder the Japanese. The deal was done through the aid of two others, Mao Yung-hu and Chao Yung-hung. Wang, Mao and Chao have been arrested in the Chinese City and still being held, as police are making a careful investigation.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1936年9月29日，星期二

随着线索展开，中山、加藤案件逐渐明朗

近一年前在虹口发生的杀害中山案件中，三名被拘留的广东人可能在周四下午面对第一特区地方法院时得知他们的命运。段法官将听取控辩双方的辩论，尽管他可能会作出裁决，但该案可能会还押候判。

与此同时，公安局昨晚透露，通过几名与加藤案有关的被捕中国人的供词，加藤的一名私人仇敌李瑞武（Li Jui-wu）以300美元雇佣了一名职业杀手王成生（Wang Cheng-sheng）谋杀这名日本人。这笔交易是在毛永虎（Mao Yung-hu）和赵永洪（Chao Yung-hung）两人的帮助下完成的。王、毛和赵已在华界被捕，目前仍被羁押，警方正在进行仔细调查。

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Tuesday, September 29, 1936

Nakayama, Torso
Cases Up Thursday
1st Special District Court
Enjoys Holiday Today

When the First Special District
Court resumes tomorrow morning
after a day's holiday of the Moon
Festival, two big cases are sche-
duled to come up for hearing. Of
major importance is the Nakayama
Murder Case, scheduled to come to
an end, while the other is the
Torso Murder Case which will be
brought up for its third hearing.
Owing to the shooting last Wed-
nesday on Yalu Road when one
Japanese bluejacket was killed and
two others wounded, new interest
has been aroused in the Nakayama
Case. It is believed that pleadings
of both the defense and prosecu-
tion will be heard tomorrow and
the case then remanded for judg-
ment.

中山案、碎尸案周四开庭
第一特区地方法院
今日休假

第一特区地方法院在中秋节休假一天后，将于明天上午复庭，两起重大案件预定开庭审理。其中最重要的是中山谋杀案，预计该案将审理终结；另一起是碎尸谋杀案，将进行第三次审讯。由于上周三在鸭绿江路发生的枪击事件导致一名日本水兵死亡、两人受伤，人们对中山案重新产生了兴趣。据信，明天将听取控辩双方的诉辩，随后该案将还押候判。

THE MAKAYAMA CASE: CONSUL-GENERAL WAKASUGI CONFERS
WITH NAVAL ATTACHE SATO

At 4 p.m. September 25 a
conference was held at the Japanese Embassy to consider
the Makayama case/ Consul-General Wakasugi, Naval
Attache Sato and Assistant Naval Attache Okino were
present.

The meeting discussed the attitude
to be adopted regarding the hearing of the Makayama
case which will be held on October 1.

The officers expressed the
opinion that judgement in the case must be delivered

by the First Special District Court and there is no
reason for further delay.

中山案：总领事若杉与海军武官佐藤会谈

9月25日下午4时，在日本大使馆举行会议，讨论中山案。总领事若杉（Wakasugi）、海军武官佐藤（Sato）和海军副武官奥野（Okino）出席。

会议讨论了对于将于10月1日举行的中山案审讯应采取的态度。

军官们表示意见认为，既然第一特区地方法院已完成对该案的审查，就没有理由再拖延，必须对此案作出判决。

September 23, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

MAINICHI

HEARING OF THE NAKAYAMA CASE SET FOR OCTOBER I

Assistant Naval Attache Okino
the other day called on the Commissioner of Police at
Police Headquarters and requested him to urge the Court
to resume the hearing of the Nakayama case and to deliver
a verdict as soon as possible.
The case has already had 13 hear-
ings and there is no reason why the verdict should be
delayed any longer. On September 22 the Court made
an announcement that the next hearing will be held on
October I. This aroused much adverse criticism. The
appearance before the Court of Fan Chiao Ying, the search
for Yang Chien Chung and the presentation of innocent
suspects by the Bureau of Public Safety caused considerable
delay. It is said that the Court may find some excuse
to postpone the hearing set for October I.

NICHI-NICHI

S.M.P TO SUPPRESS CHINESE VAGABONDS WHO THREATEN
PRO-JAPANESE CHINESE

Of late a number of Chinese
vagabonds in Hongkew District connected with certain
anti-Japanese societies have been threatening Chinese
who are pro-Japanese.
At about 3 p.m. September 22
nine Chinese suddenly appeared at a drapery at No. 395
Woosung Road, a shop owned by one name Lin Hang Chi, a
naturalized Japanese subject, and attempted to extort
money from him.
Upon receiving information
of the affair from one of the shop assistants, the
S.M.P. immediately detailed four officers who arrested
four of vagabonds. An investigation conducted by the
police revealed that the leader of the gang is one Li
Hsiao Chi, 46, a native of Fukien Province, staying
at a Chinese hotel on North Haining Road, who is a
professional extortioner and gambler. He is now
undergoing close examination at the hands of the Police.
Members of his gang are reported to be persons who
had been deported from Japan as undesirables and who
had formed themselves into a gang to extort money
from Chinese who deal in Japanese goods and other
Chinese who are on friendly terms with Japanese. Quite
a number of the members of the gang are connected with
a certain assassination gang; they live in Hongkew
District. The S.M.P. are preparing to suppress them so as
to prevent them being utilized by anti-Japanese terrorists.

《每日新闻》

中山案审讯定于10月1日举行

海军副武官奥野日前拜访警察总局总监，请求他敦促法院恢复中山案的审讯并尽快作出判决。

该案已经过13次审讯，没有理由再延迟判决。法院于9月22日宣布下次审讯将于10月1日举行。这引起了诸多负面批评。范乔英（Fan Chiao Ying，音译）出庭、搜寻杨建中（Yang Chien Chung）以及公安局提出无辜嫌疑人，造成了相当大的延误。据说法院可能会找借口推迟原定于10月1日的审讯。

《日日新闻》

公共租界警务处将镇压威胁亲日华人的华人流浪汉

最近，虹口区一些与某些反日社团有关的华人流浪汉一直在威胁亲日华人。

9月22日下午3时许，九名华人突然出现在吴淞路395号的一家布店，该店店主为归化日本籍的林恒基（Lin Hang Chi，音译），他们试图向他勒索钱财。

从一名店员处获悉此事后，公共租界警务处立即派出四名警员，逮捕了四名流浪汉。警方调查显示，该团伙头目为李晓基（Li Hsiao Chi，音译），46岁，福建省人，住在海宁北路的一家中国旅馆，是一名职业勒索者和赌徒。他目前正在接受警方的严密审讯。据报道，其团伙成员是被日本作为不受欢迎者驱逐出境的人，他们结成团伙，向经营日本商品的华人及其他与日本人友好的华人勒索钱财。该团伙中有相当多的人与某个暗杀团伙有关联；他们居住在虹口区。公共租界警务处正准备镇压他们，以防止他们被反日恐怖分子利用。

September 3, 1936.

Lih Pao (立報):

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

In August the Settlement Police raided an important assassination organ and effected the arrest of eight men. As Chang Yui Hwa (張玉華), the principal in the attempted murder of Wang Ching Wei, ex-President of the Executive Yuan, was implicated by the eight accused, the Shanghai Municipal Police requested the Bureau of Public Safety to send a despatch to Nanking for the extradition of Chang Yui Hwa to Shanghai for confrontation with the accused. The request was granted and Chang Yui Hwa was escorted to Shanghai from the Nanking District Court on August 17. He has already been interrogated at the Bureau of Public Safety.
Enquiries made by our reporter reveal that the Municipal Advocate in charge of the case against Yang Vung Tao (楊文道), Yih Hai Sun (葉海生) and Tseu Shou Yong (周守庸), three suspects in the murder of Nakayama, a Japanese marine, had stated at the last hearing that the three accused in question were accomplices of the principal in the attempted murder of the ex-President of the Executive Yuan. As a direct interrogation of the prisoner Chang Yui Hwa by the Court is necessary, the First Special District Court has decided to send a despatch to the Bureau of Public Safety requesting it to send the prisoner to Court and to confront him with Yang Vung Tao, Yih Hai Sun and Tseu Shou Yong.

Sin Wan Pao Evening Edition dated Sept.2:

THE "NEW LIFE WEEKLY" CASE : DOO ZOONG YUAN REQUESTS RELEASE

Doo Zoong Yuan (杜重遠), age 39, native of Liaoyang (遼陽), the former publisher of the "New Life Weekly" (新生活週刊), a returned student from Japan, was sentenced to 14 months' imprisonment on July 9, 1935, by the 2nd Branch of the Kiangsu High Court for publishing an article entitled "Gossip about Emperors" in his magazine on May 4 last year. He was not allowed to file an appeal, and was immediately sent to gaol.
Later, Doo's wife engaged lawyers Yui Chung Lo (俞鍾駱) and Loh Chia Zai (陸家載) to file a petition against the sentence. In September last year, the Supreme Court handed down a ruling permitting Doo to file an appeal and ordered that during the period of appeal Doo be detained in the Second Kiangsu Model Gaol at Tsu Wu Ching (漕河涇). Recently Doo became ill and he is now in a hospital.
Doo Zoong Yuan has been in prison for 13 months and 24 days. Thus his sentence will expire on September 8. Therefore, Doo has requested lawyers Yui and Loh to submit a petition to the 2nd Branch of the Kiangsu High Court requesting that Doo be released on September 8.

1936年9月3日。

《立报》：

中山案

八月间，租界警方突袭了一个重要的暗杀机关，逮捕了八名男子。由于前行政院院长汪精卫遇刺未遂案的主犯张玉华牵涉到这八名被告，上海公共租界工部局警务处请求公安局发函南京，引渡张玉华来沪与被告对质。该请求获准，张玉华于8月17日由南京地方法院押解至上海。他已在公安局接受审讯。
本报记者调查发现，负责起诉日本水兵中山案三名嫌疑人杨文道、叶海生和周守庸的公设辩护人，在上次庭审中表示，这三名被告是前行政院院长遇刺未遂案主犯的共犯。由于法院有必要直接讯问囚犯张玉华，第一特区地方法院决定发函公安局，要求将该囚犯送至法庭，并与杨文道、叶海生和周守庸对质。

9月2日《新闻报》晚刊：

“《新生》周刊”案：杜重远请求释放

杜重远，39岁，辽阳人，前《新生》周刊发行人，留日归国学生，因去年5月4日在其杂志上发表题为《闲话皇帝》的文章，于1935年7月9日被江苏高等法院第二分院判处徒刑14个月。他不许上诉，随即被送入监狱。
后来，杜的妻子聘请律师俞钟骆和陆家载对判决提出申诉。去年9月，最高法院作出裁定，允许杜重远上诉，并命令在上诉期间将杜重远羁押于漕河泾江苏第二模范监狱。近期杜重远患病，现住院接受治疗。
杜重远已入狱13个月零24天。因此，他的刑期将于9月8日届满。故此，杜重远已委托俞、陆两位律师向江苏高等法院第二分院提交请愿书，请求于9月8日释放杜重远。

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

THE NAKAYAMA AND KAYAU MURDER CASES : THE TRIAL OF THE FOUR NEW SUSPECTS

In connection with the Nakayama and Kayau murder cases, the Bureau of Public Safety effected the arrest in August of three suspects named Tsu Kwei Sung (朱貴生), Chen An Ming (陳恩明), and King Tao Chuen (金道椿) at the Chien Tek (積德) Apartment, North Szechuen Road. Chang Sze Ming (張世民) alias Chang Ngoh Hwa (張玉華) alias Chang Vee (張維), principal in the attempted murder of Waung Ching Wei, ex-President of the Executive Yuan, who was known to be the instigator in these murders, was recently extradited to Shanghai from Nanking at the instance of the Bureau of Public Safety. Later, the Shanghai Municipal Police secured the extradition of these four prisoners from the Bureau for investigation.

On the afternoon of September 11, the four accused were brought before the Shanghai First Special District Court for investigation and interrogation. The accused Tsu Kwei Sun, Chen An Ming and Chang Sze Ming only were interrogated.

As there was one more accused named King Tao Chuen left uninterrogated, the Court held a further hearing of the case yesterday morning with Judge Hsiao (蕭) on the Bench. Procurator Tong (唐) was in attendance. King Tao Chuen and three other accused were then brought to the Court.

When interrogated, accused King Tao Chuen made the following statement:- "I am 19 years of age, native of Pao Yin (寶應), Kompo, residing at No. 293 Rue Ratard, French Concession. At one time, I was a petty employee with the Naigai Wata Kaisha, Ltd. I am now unemployed. Chang Sze Ming came to my home on one occasion two years ago. I became acquainted with Tsu Kwei Sum and Chen An Ming one month before my arrest. When the Japanese was murdered, I was living in Robison Road and was employed as a broker with a certain company. Therefore, I have nothing to do with this murder case. In July this year, I was engaged by Hwa Kuh Tse (華克之) to carry out some miscellaneous matters such as conveying messages to various places. Lieu Lao Sze (劉老四), an accomplice of Hwa Kuh Tse, residing in Siao Tao Yuen Loong (小桃源弄), is aged about 28 and speaks words with the accent of Shantung dialect. On the afternoon of July 10, I was at Lieu's home and when it was nightfall, Hwa Kuh Tse came to visit

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

中山案及加藤案：四名新嫌疑人的审判

关于中山案及加藤案，公安局于八月在北四川路积德公寓逮捕了三名嫌疑人，分别为朱贵生、陈恩明和金道椿。前行政院院长汪精卫遇刺未遂案主犯张世民，又名张玉华，又名张维，据悉为这些谋杀案的指使者，近期应公安局要求从南京引渡至上海。随后，上海公共租界工部局警务处从公安局引渡了这四名囚犯进行调查。

9月11日下午，四名被告被提至上海第一特区地方法院接受调查和审讯。仅对被告朱贵生、陈恩明和张世民进行了审讯。

由于还有一名被告金道椿未受审讯，法院昨日上午由萧法官主持再次开庭审理此案。唐检察官出席。金道椿及其他三名被告随后被带至法庭。

受审时，被告金道椿作如下陈述：“我今年19岁，籍贯高邮宝应，现住法租界拉都路293号。我曾一度在内海渡轮株式会社担任小职员。目前失业。两年前，张世民曾来过我家。我在被捕前一个月结识了朱贵生和陈恩明。日本人被杀时，我住在罗宾森路，在一家公司担任经纪人。因此，我与这起谋杀案无关。今年七月，我被华克之雇用，从事一些杂务，如向各处传递消息。华克之的同伙刘老四，住小桃源弄，年龄约28岁，说话带有山东口音。7月10日下午，我在刘家，黄昏时分，华克之前来拜访

September 13, 1936. Morning Translation.

Lieu Lao Sze, carrying a small leather case. Hwa Kuh Tse had a secret conversation with Lieu Lao Sze by the window. I heard only the following sentence from Hwa Kuh Tse: 'It can be loaded with six rounds of ammunition.' I then paid attention to their talk, but I could hear nothing as their conversation was comparatively low. However, I saw Hwa Kuh Tse opening his case and handing over an article to Lieu Lao Sze. The latter concealed it under his coat. I succeeded only in having a peep at the handle of the article, which looked like the handle of a pistol. Hwa Kuh Tse and Lieu Lao Sze then went outside together and the former instructed me not to come to Lieu's home for some days. On the next day, I learned from newspapers of the murder of a Japanese (Kayau) on Chimei Road. Out of curiosity, I took the paper and called at Lieu's home. When I enquired as to whether he had committed this murder, Lieu Lao Sze made no reply, but smiled. His attitude aroused my suspicion and it is probable that the Japanese was murdered by him. On the 20th, Hwa Kuh Tse ordered me to hand a sum of $20 to Tsu Kwei Sun to meet expenses in renting a house and in purchasing necessaries. I became acquainted with Chen An Ming when I was at Tsu's house. On August 3, Hwa Kuh Tse and Tsu Kwei Sun booked a room at the Chien Tek Apartment, North Szechuen Road. I went there too. The reason why Hwa Kuh Tse booked this room was to plan an assassination of a Japanese. At first Hwa decided to carry out the crime on August 8, so on the night of the 7th, he told me to proceed to the Chien Tek Apartment and find out whether or not Tsu Kwei Sung had everything prepared. They arranged that Shih Feng Ding be responsible for the shooting, while Chen An Ming was told to stand aside to render assistance and Tsu Kwei Sung was instructed to keep a watch. At that time Shih Feng Ding said that he would listen to whatever instructions which were given him by his chief (referring to Hwa Kuh Tse) and would start to carry out the commission of the crime whenever instructions had been received from the chief, but Chen An Ming stated that it was not safe to carry out the crime at the selected locality on North Szechuen Road and that another place should be chosen for the commission of the crime. For this reason, the crime was not carried out on the 8th. On the morning of the 8th, I asked Hwa Kuh Tse as to what was his motive for the killing of some Japanese and I was informed that it was intended to incite a Sino-Japanese war. However, Hwa had never mentioned to me either the Nakayama murder case or the Kayau case, nor had Tsu Kwei Sung and Chen An Ming ever spoken of them. For this reason, I really do not know whether or not they were responsible for both of these cases. What I had stated at the Bureau of Public Safety as regards the pistol is all untrue and unreliable. On the morning of the 10th, Hwa again handed me $60 and told me to send it to the Chien Tek Apartment and ask Tsu Kwei Sung, Chen An Ming and Shih Feng Ding whether or not they were willing to carry out the murder. I was also asked to tell them to carry out the deed as early as possible if they were willing to do this. If they were still hesitating in doing this work, I was told not to send the money but bring them back. However, before I had

刘老四，携带一个小皮箱。华克之在窗边与刘老四秘密交谈。我只听到华克之说的以下一句话：‘可以装六发子弹。’我随即注意他们的谈话，但由于他们交谈声音较低，我什么也听不见。然而，我看见华克之打开皮箱，将一件物品交给刘老四。后者将其藏在大衣下。我只瞥见了该物品的把手，看起来像手枪的把手。随后华克之和刘老四一起走到外面，前者吩咐我几天内不要去刘家。第二天，我从报纸上得知一名日本人（加藤）在集美路被杀。出于好奇，我拿着报纸去了刘家。当我询问他是否犯了这起谋杀罪时，刘老四没有回答，只是微笑。他的态度引起了我的怀疑，很可能该日本人是他所杀。20日，华克之命令我交给朱贵生20元，用于支付租房和购买必需品的费用。我在朱家时结识了陈恩明。8月3日，华克之和朱贵生在北四川路积德公寓预订了一个房间。我也去了那里。华克之预订这个房间的原因是为了策划刺杀一名日本人。起初，华决定在8月8日实施犯罪，因此在7日晚，他让我去积德公寓，查明朱贵生是否已准备好一切。他们安排施凤鼎负责射击，陈恩明在一旁协助，朱贵生负责望风。当时施凤鼎说，他会听从其头目（指华克之）的任何指示，并在收到头目指示后立即开始实施犯罪，但陈恩明表示，在北四川路选定的地点实施犯罪不安全，应另选地点实施犯罪。因此，8日并未实施犯罪。8日上午，我问华克之杀害某些日本人的动机是什么，被告知目的是挑起中日战争。然而，华从未向我提及中山谋杀案或加藤案，朱贵生和陈恩明也从未谈论过这些案件。因此，我真的不知道他们是否对这两起案件负责。我在公安局关于手枪的供述全部是不真实且不可靠的。10日上午，华又交给我60元，让我送到积德公寓，询问朱贵生、陈恩明和施凤鼎是否愿意实施谋杀。我还被要求告诉他们，如果愿意做这件事，就尽早动手。如果他们仍在犹豫不做这项工作，我被告知不要送钱，而是把他们带回来。然而，在我尚未

handed over the money at the time of my arrival at the apartment, I was arrested thereat in company with Tsu Kwei Sung and Chen An Ming. Both Tsu and I started tax a removal of our families on August 7 on the instructions of Hwa Kuh Tse."
Upon being questioned by the Court, both Tsu Kwei Sung and Chen An Ming stated that the statements they made at the Bureau of Public Safety implicating Chang Sze Ming were not made at their own initiative.
In reply to the Court, Chang Sze Ming, one of the suspects, said: "I made the acquaintance of Wong Ya Chiao (王亞樵) in the French Concession through the introduction of Hwa Kuh Tse. I met Wang again at Hongkong in the autumn of last year. At that time both Hwa Kuh Tse and Kwoh Feng Ming (郭風鳴) were present. All that was talked during the interview was devoted to the plans to assassinate Waung Ching Wei. Our original aim was intended to murder a certain high government official. We had never had any intention of plotting against the life of some Japanese, nor do I even know Yang Vung Tao (楊文道), Yih Hai Sung (葉海生) and Tseu Shou Yong (周守庸)."
Following the conclusion of the interrogation of the prisoners by the Court, Paul Ru, the Municipal Advocate, made the following statement:-
"The Municipal Police, as a result of their enquiries, are of the opinion that there is no concrete evidence to charge the four suspects for the murder of the Japanese marine Nakayama, and are therefore not intending to file a prosecution against them. The Court is therefore requested to reach a decision on this point."
Upon this, Judge Hsiao announced that since the Municipal Police had declared that they would not file a prosecution against the four suspects, Tsu Kwei Sung, Chen An Ming, King Tao Chuen and Chang Sze Ming, then the writ of detention of the suspects should be cancelled, but as the accused were extradited from the Bureau of Public Safety, they should be detained at the Police Station for the time being before handed back to the Bureau of Public Safety pending the hearing of the case against Yang Vung Tao, etc. The four suspects were therefore brought back for detention at the Police Station after the conclusion of the hearing.
It is learned that the case against Yang Vung Tao, etc. will again come up for hearing at the Court on the afternoon of next Wednesday, September 16, when the four suspects above mentioned will also be arraigned before the Court for interrogation.

在我到达公寓时交出了钱款，我随即与朱贵生（Tsu Kwei Sung）和陈安明（Chen An Ming）一同在此被捕。朱和我二人均称，我们是于8月7日奉华固则（Hwa Kuh Tse）之指示，开始安排家眷撤离。”
经法庭讯问，朱贵生和陈安明均表示，他们在公安局所作的牵涉张思明（Chang Sze Ming）的供词，并非出于他们自己的主动意愿。
作为被告之一的张思明在回答法庭提问时说：“我是经由华固则介绍，在法租界结识王亚樵（Wong Ya Chiao）的。去年秋天，我在香港再次见到王某。当时华固则和郭风鸣（Kwoh Feng Ming）也在场。那次会面所谈内容全是为了刺杀汪精卫的计划。我们最初的目标是谋杀某位政府高官。我们从未有过谋害任何日本人的意图，我也不认识杨文道（Yang Vung Tao）、叶海生（Yih Hai Sung）和周守庸（Tseu Shou Yong）。”
在对囚犯进行讯问结束后，市检察官保罗·鲁（Paul Ru）发表如下声明：
“工部局警务处经调查认为，没有确凿证据指控这四名嫌疑人谋杀日本海军陆战队士兵中山（Nakayama），因此不打算对他们提起公诉。故请法庭就此点作出裁决。”
对此，萧法官宣布，既然工部局警务处已声明不对朱贵生、陈安明、金道权（King Tao Chuen）和张思明这四名嫌疑人提起公诉，则应撤销对嫌疑人的拘留令；但由于被告是从公安局引渡而来，在将案件移回公安局以待审理杨文道等人案件之前，他们应暂时拘押在警察局。因此，庭审结束后，四名嫌疑人被带回警察局羁押。
据悉，针对杨文道等人的案件将于下周三（9月16日）下午再次开庭审理，届时上述四名嫌疑人也将被提堂受审。

September 5, 1936. Morning Translation.
-3-

MAINICHI

UNEASINESS AMONGST LOCAL WHITE RUSSIANS

In connection with the plot for the assassination of Boroshiroff, Commissioner of the People's Military Affairs Committee of the U.S.S.R. Zinovieff and sixteen others have been executed and several thousand persons have been arrested.
There is a tendency of the case becoming aggravated to the extent of a revolution breaking out. Bucharin, editor of the "Izvestia" and Lenin's widow were amongst the persons arrested. The struggle between the left wing group of the Communist Party and the leaders, of which Stalin is the central figure, is being carefully watched by all nations.
The local Soviet Consular Authorities as well as the White Russians are seriously concerned over the matter. Unless the Soviet Authorities stop the arrests and release the suspects it is feared that the outbreak of a revolution will be a certainty.
The "Young Russians League", a local White Russians' cultural organization, recently declared that the time to return to their country is approaching. It seems that a meeting of representatives of the various White bodies will be called to discuss the situation.

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

Developments in the investigation into the four new suspects in custody will be watched with great interest. The case against Chang Sze Min alias Chang Yui Hwa and another suspect was held in camera in the No. 3 room of the Shanghai Special District Court on September 4 at 10.45 a.m. Both accused denied any connection with the Nakayama and Kayau cases. The hearing was adjourned after lasting five minutes. The next hearing will be held on the 10th.
Chang Sze Min, who was the leader in the attempted assassination of Mr. Yang Ching Wei, was arrested on November 14 last year and has undergone an examination at Nanking. As there was suspicion that he had something to do with the Nakayama Case, he was handed over to the Special Political Office of the S.M.P. In reply to questions by the judge, he denied the alleged connection and requested the judge for relief as his physical condition was not good.

《每日新闻》

当地白俄群体中的不安情绪

鉴于刺杀苏联人民军事委员会主席伏罗希洛夫（Boroshiroff）的阴谋，季诺维也夫（Zinovieff）等十六人已被处决，数千人被捕。
该案有加剧之势，甚至可能引发革命爆发。“伊兹维斯蒂亚报”编辑布哈林（Bucharin）和列宁的遗孀均在被捕者之列。各国正密切关注以斯大林为核心的共产党领导层与左翼集团之间的斗争。
当地苏维埃领事当局以及白俄人士对此事深感忧虑。除非苏维埃当局停止逮捕并释放嫌疑人，否则人们担心革命爆发将成为必然。
当地白俄文化组织“青年俄罗斯联盟”最近宣称，返回祖国的时机正在临近。似乎将召开各白俄团体代表会议，以讨论局势。

中山案

人们对羁押中四名新嫌疑人的调查进展将给予极大关注。9月4日上午10时45分，在上海特区法院第三庭秘密审理了针对张思明（又名张裕华，Chang Yui Hwa）及另一名嫌疑人的案件。两名被告均否认与中山案和加藤（Kayau）案有任何关联。庭审持续五分钟后休庭。下次庭审将于10日举行。
张思明是去年企图刺杀汪精卫先生的主谋，于去年11月14日被捕，并在南京接受过审讯。因怀疑他与中山案有关，他被移交给工部局警务处特政股。在回答法官提问时，他否认了所谓的关联，并以身体状况不佳为由请求法官予以宽待。

September 2, 1936. Morning Translation.

MAINICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

The Nanking Government is in a dilemma because of the exposure of its dirty tricks to save the accused in the Nakayama case. The Nanking Government is secretly attempting to evade its responsibility and is not sincerely dealing with the terroristic anti-Japanese incidents taking place frequently at various places.

In The Chengtu incident, the Nanking Government is resorting once more to its customary dirty policy of hiding the facts; furthermore, it obstructed the dispatch of reports on the case. The feelings of the entire body of Japanese residents in China against this dirty policy have reached explosion point. At the 12th hearing of the Nakayama case held on August 19, the Special District Court failed to fix a date for the next hearing and up to the present no announcement has been made.

Another trickery of the Chinese authorities in the Nakayama case has now been exposed and it is likely to give rise to further trouble. The Bureau of Public Safety, shortly before or after August 10, arrested three Chinese suspects in the Nakayama case and took down their statements in which they are said to have made a complete confession. This account was made in an endeavour to save Yang Ven Tao, Yih Hai Sung and Chu Hsia Ying, the three accused in the Nakayama case.

The National Government is exceedingly fearful of its connection with the Nakayama case being exposed by the accused in the case.

It is clear that the Chengtu outrage was committed at the instigation of the National Government. Japanese public opinion in China is strongly demanding that a complete investigation into the dirty tricks played by the Nanking Government in the Chengtu incident and that anti-Japanese activities be resolutely suppressed.

NO DEVELOPMENTS IN KAYAU MURDER CASE

After the murder of Mr. Kayau, a search for the murderer was started by the Chief of the Third Section of the Public Safety Bureau. Results of the search have been reported to the Japanese Consular Police. A certain person has been detained as a suspect but he stubbornly refuses to speak. Enquiries are being made by the Bureau of Public Safety about this suspect.

The attitude of the Court hearing the Nakayama case and the slow progress of the investigations into the Kayau case are being criticized by Japanese whose indignation has been further aroused by the Chengtu outrage committed at the instigation of the Chinese Government.

The Chinese authorities are being severely criticized for their irresponsible attitude in the face of the barbarous and violent acts of anti-Japanese terrorists.

1936年9月2日。晨间译件。

《每日新闻》

中山案

由于掩盖其在中山案中包庇被告的卑劣行径被曝光，南京政府陷入困境。南京政府正试图暗中推卸责任，并未真诚处理各地频繁发生的恐怖反日事件。

在成都事件中，南京政府再次采取其惯用的隐瞒事实的卑劣政策；此外，它还阻碍了有关该案报告的发送。在华全体日本侨民对这种卑劣政策的愤慨已达到爆发点。在8月19日举行的中山案第12次庭审中，特区法院未能确定下次庭审日期，且至今未发布任何公告。

中国当局在中山案中的另一欺诈行为现已暴露，可能会引起进一步的麻烦。公安局在8月10日前后不久，逮捕了三名中山案的中国嫌疑人，并记录了他们的供词，据称他们已完全认罪。此举旨在挽救中山案的三名被告杨文道、叶海生和朱夏英（Chu Hsia Ying）。

国民政府极度害怕本案被告揭露其与中山案的牵连。

显然，成都暴行是在国民政府的唆使下实施的。在华日本舆论强烈要求彻底调查南京政府在成都事件中耍弄的卑劣伎俩，并坚决镇压反日活动。

加藤谋杀案无进展

加藤先生遇害后，公安局第三科科长展开了对凶手的搜捕。搜索结果已报告给日本领事警察。有一人被作为嫌疑人拘留，但他顽固地拒绝开口。公安局正在对该嫌疑人进行调查。

审理中山案的法庭态度以及加藤案调查进展缓慢，正受到日本人的批评，而由中国政府唆使制造的成都暴行进一步激起了他们的愤怒。

中国当局面对反日恐怖分子的野蛮暴力行为所表现出的不负责任态度，正受到严厉批评。

September 12, 1936. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE NAKAYAMA MURDER CASE : THE TRIAL OF THE FOUR NEW SUSPECTS

In August, the Bureau of Public Safety arrested three persons named Tsu Kwei Sung ( 朱貴生 ) and Chen An Ming ( 陳恩明 ), natives of Yangchow ( 揚州 ), and King Tao Chuen ( 金道權 ), native of Kompo. Enquiries revealed that they had some connection with the murder of the Japanese marine Nakayama which took place at Darroch Road on the night of November 9 last year as well as with the murder of a Japanese resident named Kayau on July 10 this year. The arrested persons confessed in their statements that they had committed these murders at the instigation of Chang Sze Ming ( 張世民 ) alias Chang Ngoh Hwa ( 張玉華 ) alias Chang Vee ( 張維 ), the leader in the plot to assassinate Wang Ching Wei at Nanking. The Bureau of Public Safety therefore detailed officers to Nanking to effect the extradition of Chang Sze Ming to Shanghai. Later, the Shanghai Municipal Police secured the extradition of these four prisoners from the Bureau of Public Safety and charged them in the Shanghai First Special District Court.

Yesterday afternoon, the case against the four accused again came up for hearing at the Shanghai First Special District Court before Judge Hsiao Sih Feng ( 蕭實峯 ). Procurator Tong ( 唐 ) was in attendance.
Paul Ru, the Municipal Advocate, made the following statements:-
"The three accused, Chu Kwei Sung, King Tao Chuen and Chen An Ming were arrested by the Bureau of Public Safety. If the Court desires a clear understanding of how they were arrested and what they have stated at the Bureau, the Court could enquire of the Bureau of Public Safety. After these three accused had been handed over to the Municipal Police, they were told to make separate statements at the Police Station. These statements were found to be contradictory to those they had made at the Bureau of Public Safety. For this reason, it is difficult to ascertain which set of statements are true and reliable. The only statements which may be regarded as reliable will be those which are to be secured from them at to-day's hearing. According to the admissions in their statements, they are connected with both the Nakayama and Kayau murder cases, furthermore they were contemplating a third crime. Should the Court, after the interrogation of the accused, come to the conclusion that the accused have no connection with the murder of Nakayama, they will be handed back to the Bureau of Public Safety; otherwise, the Municipal Police will continue their investigations."

Under interrogation by the Court, Chu Kwei Sung, one of the accused, made the following statement: "I arrived in Shanghai from my native place in August of the 22nd Year of the Chinese Republic (1933) and found work in Pootung, but I lost my employment in January in the following year and returned to my native place. In April last year, my friend Sung Vung Tuh ( 孫文柱 )

1936年9月12日。晨间译文。

《新闻报》、《申报》及其他本地报纸：

中山案：四名新嫌疑人的审讯

八月，公安局逮捕了三名人士，分别是扬州籍的朱贵生和陈恩明，以及高邮（Kompo）籍的金道权。调查显示，他们与去年11月9日晚在达罗路（Darroch Road）发生的日本海军陆战队员中山被杀案，以及今年7月10日发生的日侨加藤（Kayau，音译）被杀案均有关联。被捕者在供词中承认，这些谋杀案是在策划南京刺杀汪精卫案的主谋张世民（又名张玉华，又名张维）的指使下实施的。因此，公安局派遣官员前往南京，以便将张世民引渡至上海。随后，上海公共租界工部局警务处从公安局引渡了这四名囚犯，并在上海第一特区地方法院对他们提起诉讼。

昨日下午，针对这四名被告的案件在上海第一特区地方法院再次开庭审理，由萧实峯法官主持。检察官唐氏出庭。
市公廨律师保罗·鲁（Paul Ru）发表如下声明：
“三名被告朱贵生、金道权和陈恩明是由公安局逮捕的。如果法庭希望清楚了解他们是如何被捕以及在公安局作了何种陈述，法庭可以向公安局查询。在这三名被告移交警务处后，警方要求他们在警局分别作出陈述。发现这些陈述与他们在公安局所作的陈述相矛盾。因此，难以确定哪一套陈述是真实可靠的。唯一可被视为可靠的陈述，将是今天庭审中从他们那里获得的陈述。根据他们供述中的自认，他们既与中山案有关，也与加藤案有关，此外他们还在预谋第三起犯罪。如果法庭在讯问被告后得出结论，认为被告与中山谋杀案无关，他们将交回公安局；否则，警务处将继续调查。”

经法庭讯问，被告之一朱贵生作如下陈述：“我于中华民国二十二年（1933年）八月从家乡来到上海，在浦东找到工作，但次年一月失业，便返回家乡。去年四月，我的朋友孙文柱

September 12, 1936. Morning Translation.

wrote promising to find employment for me, whereupon
I again took my family to Shanghai. We lived with this
friend in Foh Tuh Fang (福德坊) alleyway off Hart
Road, because his father-in-law is my intimate friend.
My friend agreed to our staying at his home; moreover
he used to give me $30 every month for living expenses.
Later, I learned that Sung Vung Tuh was an accomplice
of Hwa Kuh Tse (華克之). The money was given to me
by Sung on Hwa's instructions. At that time, my friend
told me that should Hwa Kuh Tse come to Shanghai from
Hongkong, Hwa would be able to secure some employment
for me. About October last year, Sung Vung Tuh began
to cease giving me money. I then made the acquaintance
of Chang Sze Ming at the home of Sung Vung Tuh. Chen An
Ming is a fellow-provincial, who came to Shanghai in
September last year also to find employment. The
statement I made at the Police Station to the effect
that on November 9 last year I had heard whilst I
was staying in the Haining Lodging House (海寧旅館) on
Haining Road, Chang Sze Ming telling Chen An Ming to go
and kill some Japanese marines and that the pistol would
be conveyed there by Shih Feng Ding (石鳳亭), etc.
is exactly the same as what I had stated at the Bureau
of Public Safety after my arrest by the Bureau. I did
not dare to make a different statement at the Police
Station because I really cannot endure sitting in the
'Tiger's Chair' at the Bureau of Public Safety. For
this reason, when I was questioned at the Police Station,
I made the same statement to what I had stated at the
Bureau of Public Safety so as to make the two statements
concide. On the afternoon of November 9 I mailed a
letter home containing bank draft. Later I found that
a mistake had been made in the mailing of the letter, so
I immediately left the Haining Lodging House and
proceeded to the North Szechuen Road Post Office to
rectify the mistake. That was at 6 p.m. When I had
finished with the matter, it was already 7 p.m. As I
was waiting to take a tramcar outside the Post Office,
I met Chen An Ming who had come there from the Haining
Lodging House. Chen told me that Shih Feng Ding had
already gone to attack the Japanese marine. More
information could be obtained by interrogating Chen An
Ming. Shih Feng Ding was also a member of the Hwa Kuh
Tse's party. Hwa Kuh Tse had some connection with
General Chen Min Chu. I was formerly in the employ of
a detective corps and must have made many enemies. I
was expelled from my native place for opium trafficking,
so I took refuge in Shanghai. I was wrongfully involved
in the case by my enemy, Shih Chin Sen (石金山), who
accused me of having participated in the assassination
work of the Assassination Corp organized by Hwa Kuh Tse.
On August 3, Hwa Kuh Tse sent King Tao Chuen to invite
me to a dinner at the Chien Tek (儉德) Apartment, but
they did not succeed in inducing me to co-operate with
them"

The accused Chen An Ming then made the
following statement:- " I came to Shanghai in September
(lunar calendar) last year. I first resided at Tsu Kwei
pages.zh:
1936年9月12日。晨间译文。

写信承诺为我找工作，于是
我再次携家眷前往上海。我们住在赫德路（Hart

是我的密友。我的朋友同意我们住在他家；而且
他每月给我30元作为生活费。后来，我得知孙文柱

我的朋友告诉我，如果华克之从香港来上海，华
就能为我谋得一份工作。大约去年十月，孙文柱开始

明是同乡，也是去年九月来上海找工作的。
我在警局所作的陈述，称去年11月9日
我住在海宁路的海宁旅馆时，听到
张世民让陈安明去杀害几名日本海军陆战队员，并且手枪将由石凤亭送去等情，
这与我在被公安局逮捕后在公安局所作的陈述完全
一致。我不敢在警局作不同的陈述，因为我实在无法
忍受在公安局坐‘老虎凳’。因此，当
我在警局受审时，我作了与在公安局相同的陈述，以使两份陈述
相符。11月9日下午，我寄了一封含有汇票的家信。后来我发现
寄信时出了错，所以我立即离开海宁旅馆，
前往北四川路邮局去纠正这个错误。那是下午6点。当我办完
此事时，已经是晚上7点了。当
我在邮局外等候电车时，遇到了从海宁旅馆来的陈安明。陈告诉我，石凤亭已经
去袭击那名日本海军陆战队员了。更多
信息可以通过讯问陈安明获得。石凤亭也是华克之一伙的成员。华克之与陈敏枢将军有些关系。我以前受雇于一个侦探团，肯定树敌众多。我因贩卖鸦片被逐出家乡，所以避难来到上海。我是被我的仇人石金山诬陷卷入此案的，他指控我参与了华克之组织的暗杀团的刺杀行动。8月3日，华克之派金道权邀请我到俭德公寓吃饭，但他们未能诱使我与他们合作”

被告陈安明随后作如下陈述：“我于去年九月（农历）来到上海。起初我住在朱贵

pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D_______
September 12, 1936.    5    Morning Translation    1—

Sung's house. I met Chang Sze Ming at Tsu's house. He asked me whether I knew how to use a pistol? On November 8, Chang invited me to some entertainment. I later followed him to the Haining Lodging House on Haining Road. Chang talked in a very low voice to Shih Feng Ding; I did not hear anything. That night I slept in the Lodging House. Next day Chang came with a small leather case which he gave to Shih. Tsu was present at the time, and he asked me not to give out the secret. Later, when Tsu went to the Post Office I followed soon after he left and we met at the tram section near the Post Office. I told Tsu that Shih Feng Ding had already gone to carry out the job, but I did not say that Shih had already succeeded. I cannot say whether the Japanese marine was murdered by Shih. According to Shih Chin Sen, Hwa Kun Tse visited Tsu Kwei Sung's house on August 2. Shih also stated that last year a Japanese marine was murdered by Hwa and that Hwa would carry out a similar act this time. Formerly when Shih Ching Sen was a bandit, Tsu Kwei Sung was a detective; they are enemies. On November 10 last year, when Chang Sze Ming saw me wearing thin clothing in cold weather, he gave me $4 to buy a suit. This money had not been repaid."
D.S.I. Crowther of the Dixwell Road Police Station here made a report on the investigations conducted at the Haining Lodging House.
The Judge questioned Chang Sze Ming, the accused who made the following statement:- "I do not know Tsu Kwei Sung and Chen An Ming, but as they have stated that they had seen me before, it may be that this was due to the fact they came from the same place as Hwa Kuh Tse. I know Wong Yia Chiao (王亞樵). I was suspected to have taken part in the attempted murder of Waung Ching Wei, but I have no connection with the present case. I was implicated by the statements made by Tsu Kwei Sung and Chen An Ming. I have been told that my finger prints have been found on the pistol and on the box. I am surprised that witnesses and evidence have been produced against me despite the fact that I knew nothing whatever of the case until I was brought to the Public Safety Bureau in Shanghai. I deny any connection with this case."
Judge Hsiao announced that the case would be remanded till Saturday morning, September 12.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
编号 D_______
1936年9月12日。    5    晨间译文    1—

生家中。我在朱家结识了张世民。他问我是否懂得使用手枪？11月8日，张邀请我去娱乐。后来我随他去了海宁路的海宁旅馆。张低声与石凤亭交谈；我什么也没听见。那晚我睡在旅馆里。第二天张带着一个小皮箱来，把它交给了石。当时朱也在场，他叫我不要泄露秘密。后来，当朱去邮局时，我在他离开后不久也跟去了，我们在邮局附近的电车站相遇。我告诉朱，石凤亭已经去执行任务了，但我没说石已经得手。我不能说那名日本海军陆战队员是否是石所杀。据石金山说，华克之于8月2日访问了朱贵生的家。石还声称，去年一名日本海军陆战队员是被华所杀，而华这次也将实施类似的行动。以前石金山是做土匪的，朱贵生是侦探；他们是仇家。去年11月10日，张世民见我在寒冷天气里衣着单薄，给了我4元钱买一套衣服。这笔钱尚未归还。”
狄思威路警局的克罗瑟（Crowther）副督察在此就海宁旅馆的调查情况提交了报告。
法官讯问了被告张世民，张作如下陈述：“我不认识朱贵生和陈安明，但既然他们说以前见过我，这可能是因为他们和华克之来自同一个地方。我认识王亚樵。我被怀疑参与了刺杀汪精卫未遂案，但我与本案无关。我是被朱贵生和陈安明的供词牵连的。有人告诉我，在手枪和盒子上发现了我的指纹。我感到惊讶的是，尽管我在被带到上海公安局之前对此案一无所知，却仍有证人和证据针对我。我否认与此案有任何关联。”
萧法官宣布，案件延期至9月12日星期六上午审理。

Morning Translation.

September 11, 1936.

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

The trial of the four new
suspects in the Nakayama case who were arrested by the
Bureau of Public Safety which was to have been held
at the Special District Court yesterday has been
postponed. The reason given out for the postponement
was that the confessions of the four suspects had been
procured by means of torture at the hands of the Chinese
authorities who were afraid that the connection of the
Nanking Government with the other three accused named
Yang Vung Tao, Yih Hai Sung and Tseu Show Yong, in the
Nakayama case might be exposed.

Yesterday afternoon, Assistant
Commissioner Uyehara of the Special Political Office of
the S.M.P. opened direct negotiations with the Court
over the Nakayama case. As a result it was decided
to hold a hearing of the Nakayama case at 2.30 p.m.
September 11.

1936年9月11日。

中山案

由公安局逮捕的中山案四名新嫌疑人的审讯原定于昨日在特区法院举行，现已推迟。推迟的理由是，这四名嫌疑人的供词是中国当局通过刑讯逼供获得的，当局担心南京政府与中山案中另外三名被告杨文道、叶海生和周社荣的关联可能会被揭露。

昨日下午，工部局警务处特别政治办公室的上原（Uyehara）助理总监就中山案与法院进行了直接谈判。结果决定于9月11日下午2时30分举行中山案的听证会。

D.7073

September 11, 1931.
Morning Translation.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers:-

TRIAL OF FOUR SUSPECTS IN JAPANESE MURDER CASES

Upon learning that Chang Sze Lin (張世民) alias
Chang Yui Hwa (張玉華), the principal in the plot to assassinate
Tang Ching Pei, ex-President of the Executive Yuan, and three
others named Tsu Kwei Sun (朱貴生), King Tao Chuen (金道權)
and Chen Sze Yin (陳思明) are also connected with both
the Nakayama and Kayau murder cases, the Shanghai Municipal
Police the other day requested the First Special District
Court to send a despatch to the Public Safety Bureau for the
handing over of Tsu Kwei Sun and the two other men to the
Municipal Police for investigation.

The case came up for hearing yesterday. The
Police submitted to the Court the statements made by the four
suspects. As the investigation has not yet been completed,
the Police requested the Court to remand the case.

The Court ordered a remand until September 16.
Later the next hearing was fixed for 2 p.m. to-day.

Information obtained by our reporter from
reliable source shows that the accused Yang Vung Tao (楊文道)
Yin Hai Sun (葉海生) and Tseu Chou Yong (周社榮) will not be
brought into Court to be confronted with the four suspects
at to-day's hearing.

According to information given out by the Police,
sufficient evidence has been obtained against Chang Sze Lin
and three other suspects.

1931年9月11日。
晨间译文。

《立报》及其他本地报纸：

日本谋杀案四名嫌疑人的审讯

获悉策划刺杀前行政院长唐景培（Tang Ching Pei，音译）的主犯张世林（又名张玉华）以及另外三人朱贵孙、金道权和陈思明也与中山案和加藤案有关联后，上海公共租界工部局警务处于日前请求第一特区地方法院向公安局发出公文，要求将朱贵孙及另外两人移交警务处进行调查。

该案昨日开庭审理。警方向法院提交了对四名嫌疑人的讯问笔录。由于调查尚未完成，警方请求法院将案件延期审理。

法院命令将案件延期至9月16日。随后，下一次听证会定于今天下午2时举行。

本报记者从可靠消息来源获悉，被告杨文道、叶海生和周社荣不会在今天举行的听证会上出庭与四名嫌疑人对质。

据警方发布的信息，已获得足以指控张世林及其他三名嫌疑人的充分证据。

September II, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

NICHI-NICHI

UNREASONABLE DELAY IN THE TRIAL OF THE NAKAYAMA CASE

The hearing of the Nakayama
murder case has had 12 sessions. The connection of Yang
Ven Tao and Yih Hai Sung with this case is indisputable
according to the evidence secured.
At the beginning of this month,
the Bureau of Public Safety effected the arrest of two
Chinese named Tsu Kwei Sun and King Tso Chuen, whom
the Chinese authorities claim to be connected with the
murder of Kayau. The Bureau of Public Safety handed
over to the Special Political Office of the S.M.P. these
two persons together with the other two Chinese named
Chen An Hin and Chang Yui Hwa alias Chang Sze Hin arrested
in connection with the attempted assassination of Wang
Ching Wei on the ground that these four men are also
suspected of being concerned in the murder of Nakayama.
The first hearing of the case
against these suspects was held in camera at the Special
District Court on September 4, when it was decided to
hold a public hearing at 10 a.m. September 10, but the
hearing was postponed to September 11.
According to an investigation
made by the S.M.P., they appear to have no connection
with the Nakayama case. One cannot help regarding
the arrest of those suspects as a trick on the part of
the Chinese authorities to protract the trial of the
Nakayama case. It is clear that some secret measures
are being devised to effect the release of Yang Ven Tao.
The S.M.P., it is reported,
will urge the Special District Court to hold the hearing
in a day or two.

NIPPO

THE SCANDAL OF TANG HAI LN AND SOONG TZE LIANG

On September 9 Feng Sui, chief
of the Agriculture and Forestry Bureau of the Canton
Government, was executed for having embezzled government
funds amounting to $2,000,000.
General Chiang Kai Shek is
extremely angry over the fact that Tang Hai Ln and
Soong Tze Liang had each squeezed $3,000,000 at Canton,
according to the confession made by Feng Sui before his
execution.

MEETING OF JAPANESE RESIDENTS CORPORATION

At 6 p.m. yesterday the Council
of the Japanese Residents Corporation held a meeting to
discuss the Chengtu and Pakhoi incidents. All the
councillors expressed strong views over the incidents.
The meeting passed the following

1936年9月11日。下午译件。

《日日新闻》

中山案审理的不合理拖延

中山谋杀案的审讯已进行了12次庭审。根据所获证据，杨文道（Yang Ven Tao）与易海松（Yih Hai Sung）与此案的关联是无可争议的。
本月初，公安局逮捕了两名华人，名为朱桂生（Tsu Kwei Sun）和荆佐全（King Tso Chuen），中国当局声称他们与加奥（Kayau）谋杀案有关。公安局将这两人连同另外两名因汪精卫遇刺未遂案被捕的华人陈安民（Chen An Hin）和张玉华（Chang Yui Hwa，又名张世欣 Chang Sze Hin）一并移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处特别政治股，理由是这四人也涉嫌参与中山谋杀案。
针对这些嫌疑人的首次审讯于9月4日在特区地方法院秘密进行，当时决定于9月10日上午10时公开审理，但庭审被推迟至9月11日。
据上海公共租界工部局警务处调查，他们似乎与中山案无关。人们不禁认为，逮捕这些嫌疑人是中国当局为拖延中山案审判而耍弄的花招。显然，有人正在策划某些秘密措施，以促成杨文道的释放。
据报道，上海公共租界工部局警务处将敦促特区地方法院在一两天内开庭审理。

《日本日报》

唐海琳与宋子良的丑闻

9月9日，广东政府农林局局长冯遂因贪污公款达200万元而被处决。
据冯遂临刑前的供认，蒋介石将军对唐海琳（Tang Hai Ln）和宋子良（Soong Tze Liang）各自在广州勒索300万元一事极为愤怒。

D.7073
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. P. LIBRARY

September 10, 1936.    Morning translation.

THE MAKAYAMA CASE: TRIAL OF FOUR ACCUSED ARRESTED BY
BUREAU OF PUBLIC SAFETY

The first hearing of the case
against the four suspects in the Makayama case who were
handed over to the Special Political Office of the S.M.P.
by the Bureau of Public Safety was held in camera the
other day.

A second hearing of the suspects
will be held at 10 a.m. to-day at the Special District
Court. Close attention is being paid to the hearing
to-day because it will established whether or not they are
responsible for the crime.

The S.M.P. will report on their
investigations. The statements made by the four suspects
are vague and not clear. There is no evidence against
them. Great importance will be attached to what the
suspects will say in Court to-day because it is believed
that their confessions had been made under duress during
their detention at the Bureau of Public Safety. This was
done to evade exposure of the connection of the Nanking
Government with Yih Hai Sung, Yang Vung Tao and Tseu
Shou Yong.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
工部局图书馆

1936年9月10日。上午译件。

中山案：受公安局逮捕的四名被告受审

日前，特区地方法院秘密开庭审理了由公安局移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处特别政治股的四名中山案嫌疑人的案件。

今天上午10时，特区地方法院将对这些嫌疑人进行第二次审讯。今天的审讯备受瞩目，因为它将确定他们是否对该罪行负责。

上海公共租界工部局警务处将报告其调查结果。这四名嫌疑人的供述含糊不清。目前没有针对他们的证据。今天嫌疑人在法庭上的陈述将受到高度重视，因为据信他们的供词是在公安局拘留期间遭受胁迫下作出的。此举旨在掩盖南京政府与易海松、杨文道及周守庸（Tseu Shou Yong）之间的关联。

September 8, 1936. Morning Translation.

MAINICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

Judgement in the Nakayama case
is now being awaited for the evidence produced is sufficient
to establish the guilt of the accused.
The Bureau of Public Safety has
arrested four suspects in the Nakayama and the Kayau
cases. These suspects were handed over to the Special
Political Office of the S.M.P. on September 2. The
Special Political Office is conducting a close examination
of the four prisoners whose names are: Chang Yui Hwa,
Chen An Min, Tsu Kwei Sun, and King Tao Chuen.
There is no evidence against
the prisoners; furthermore at the hearing held in camera
the other day they denied the charge made against them.
The statements made by the
prisoners to the Special Political Office are vague and
not clear. The four prisoners state that they do not
know Yang Ven Tao or Yih Hai Sung but admitted that they
were at the scene of the Nakayama murder on that particular
night.
The four suspects will be tried
on September 10. Great importance is being attached to
their case because the trial of the former three accused
will be held after this hearing. It is expected that the
Court will turn down the charge against the four prisoners
because there is no evidence against them but the trial of
Yang Ven Tao and others will be resumed soon.
The alleged confessions made by
the four prisoners had probably been secured through torture.
Their case is intended to conceal the connection of the
Nanking Government with the murder of Nakayama.

PLOT TO BOMB JAPANESE CONSULATE

A Korean named Kim Shun Ken,
age 23, residing at No. 3 Tai Shing Fong, Route Vallon,
French Concession, was wounded by the explosion of a bomb
which he was manufacturing for use against the local
Japanese Consulate-General. At one time his condition
was reported to be very serious, but he is now making
good progress and is out of danger. The Police interrogated
him a few days ago. It is expected that the prisoner
will make some startling revelations.
pages.zh:
1936年9月8日。上午译件。

《每日新闻》

中山案

目前正等待中山案的判决，因为所提出的证据足以认定被告有罪。
公安局已在中山案和加奥案中逮捕了四名嫌疑人。这些嫌疑人于9月2日被移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处特别政治股。特别政治股正在对这四名囚犯进行严密审查，他们的名字是：张玉华（Chang Yui Hwa）、陈安民（Chen An Min）、朱桂生（Tsu Kwei Sun）和荆道全（King Tao Chuen）。
目前没有针对这些囚犯的证据；此外，在日前举行的秘密审讯中，他们否认了对他们的指控。
囚犯向特别政治股所作的陈述含糊不清。这四名囚犯声称不认识杨文道或易海松，但承认在那天晚上他们在中山谋杀案的现场。
这四名嫌疑人将于9月10日受审。他们的案件受到高度重视，因为在此审讯之后，将对前三名被告进行审判。预计法院将驳回对这四名囚犯的指控，因为没有针对他们的证据，但杨文道等人的审判将很快恢复。
这四名囚犯所谓的供词可能是通过酷刑获得的。此案意在掩盖南京政府与中山谋杀案之间的关联。

阴谋轰炸日本领事馆

一名名叫金顺健（Kim Shun Ken，音译）的23岁朝鲜人，居住在法租界万隆路（Route Vallon）泰兴坊3号，他在制造一枚用于袭击当地日本总领事馆的炸弹时被炸伤。一度有报道称他的情况非常危急，但目前他恢复良好，已脱离危险。警方几天前对他进行了讯问。预计这名囚犯将会做出一些惊人的揭露。

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 1936.
7073
18' 9 36

NAKAYAMA MURDER
CASE ADJOURNED

Four Suspects in Kayau Case
Sent Back to Nantao

After about two hours' inter-
rogation together with the three sus-
pects in the Nakayama murder case.
the four men handed over to the
Settlement authorities by the Bureau
of Public Safety were ordered by
the First Special District Court yes-
terday afternoon to be returned to
the Chinese Police since no charge
had been preferred against any of
them in connection with the case.
The four men were Tseu Kwei-sung.
Ching Tao-chuen. Zung Eng-ming.
arrested by the Chinese Police on
suspicion of being involved in the
murder of Kosaku Kayau, a Japanese
salesman, in Chi Mei Road, Chapei;
and Tsang Yueh-hwa, arrested in
connection with the attempted
murder of Mr. Wang Ching-wei,
former President of the Executive
Yuan, in Nanking last November.
When confronted with the three
suspects in the Nakayama case,
namely Yang Ven-tao, Yih Hai-sun
and Tseu Suu-yoong, all the four
men said they had never seen any
of the trio before. The three sus-
pects also told Judge Siao that the
four were total strangers to them.
After ordering the handing over of
the four men to the Bureau of
Public Safety, Judge Siao adjourned
the hearing of the Nakayama case
pending the conclusion of an ex-
amination by the judicial doctor of
Yang Kyung-chun's finger and palm
prints and those found in a book
used to conceal a pistol. Yang was
alleged by one of the three accused
to have planted the book in his
house so as to implicate him in the
case.
According to Tsang Yueh-hwa,
arrested by the Nanking authorities
in connection with the attempted
murder of Mr. Wang Ching-wei, he
had left Nanking for Shanghai one
day before the attempt. He knew
of a Hsia Ke-tse, alleged to have
plotted the assassination of Govern-
ment officials, but he did not take
part in the crime. He had not sug-
gested the creation of disturbances
in Shanghai neither had he suggest-
ed the murder of Japanese residents.
Yang Wen-tao, one of the three sus-
pects, told the court that he had
never seen or known of Hsia Ke-
tse. He admitted having sent a man
to Hongkong to raise funds for his
club, called Hung Shun Hwei. The
club in Hongkong named Hung Men
Hwei, alleged to have been organized
by Hsia Ke-tse, was an entirely
separate organization. Yang also said
he did not know any of the leaders
identified with the Fukien rebellion.

《字林西报》，1936年9月17日，星期四。
7073
18' 9 36

中山谋杀案
休庭

加奥案中的四名嫌疑人
被遣返南市

在对中山谋杀案的三名嫌疑人以及由公安局移交给租界当局的四人进行了约两个小时的讯问后，第一特区地方法院于昨日下午下令将这四人交还中国警方，因为在该案中没有任何人被正式起诉。
这四人分别是：朱桂生（Tseu Kwei-sung）、荆道全（Ching Tao-chuen）、曾英明（Zung Eng-ming，音译），他们因涉嫌参与闸北集美路日本售货员加奥小作（Kosaku Kayau）谋杀案而被中国警方逮捕；以及张月华（Tsang Yueh-hwa），他因去年11月在南京发生的行政院前院长汪精卫遇刺未遂案而被捕。
当与中山案的三名嫌疑人，即杨文道（Yang Ven-tao）、易海松（Yih Hai-sun）和周守庸（Tseu Suu-yoong）对质时，这四人均表示以前从未见过这三人中的任何一人。这三名嫌疑人也告诉萧法官，他们对这四个人完全陌生。
萧法官在下令将这四人移交给公安局后，宣布中山案的审讯休庭，等待法医对杨庆春（Yang Kyung-chun，音译）的手指和手掌指纹以及在藏匿手枪的书本上发现的指纹进行比对鉴定结束。其中一名被告指控杨庆春将这本书栽赃在他家中，以便将他卷入此案。
据因汪精卫遇刺未遂案被南京当局逮捕的张月华称，他在刺杀企图发生前一天离开南京前往上海。他知道有一个叫夏克哉（Hsia Ke-tse，音译）的人，据称策划了刺杀政府官员的行动，但他没有参与该犯罪活动。他既没有建议在上海制造骚乱，也没有建议谋杀日本居民。
三名嫌疑人之一的杨文道告诉法庭，他从未见过或听说过夏克哉。他承认曾派人去香港为其名为“洪顺会”的俱乐部筹集资金。据称由夏克哉组织的香港名为“洪门会”的俱乐部是一个完全独立的组织。杨还表示，他不认识任何与福建叛乱有关的领导人。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 1936

Suspects In Nakayama Case
To Be Handed Back

Accused In Attempted Assassination Of Wang
Ch ng-wei Found To Have No Connection
With Nakayama And Kayau Slayings

Four Chinese arrested by Chinese authorities in connection with the attempted assassination of Mr. Wan Ching-wei, President of the Executive Yuan in Nanking on November 1, last, and recently handed over to the Settlement Police as suspects in both the Nakayama and Kayau killings, were ordered to be returned to the Bureau of Public Safety by Judge Siao in the First Special District Court yesterday. This order was made after the four men had failed to identify the three suspects held by the Settlement Police in connection with the Nakayama murder and the three suspects failed to recognize the new suspects.

"Hsiao Kwangtung," Yang Wen-tao and Chou, were questioned together with the four men brought over from the Chinese authorities and with Judge Siao accepting the statements of the two groups he ordered the four men to be handed back and remanded the trial of "Hsiao Kwangtung" and the two others, sine die once again, pending the receipt of a report from the Institute of Legal Medicine.

The institute is said to be investigating the palm prints of Yang Wen-tao, the Cantonese accused in whose home the police found a book hollowed out at the centre in which the pistol used in the Nakayama murder was supposed to have been hidden. Yang completely denied this, alleging that trying to trap him, his relative, Yang Gien-chun, had put the book in his home. Yang Gien-chun who was the last witness to turn up also denied Yang Wentao's allegation and therefore his fingerprints are also being examined in order to ascertain the origin of the book.

Separate Statements

The three accused charged with the Nakayama murder were heard separately. Yang Wen-tao denied any knowledge of the Nanking group and said that he did not know Hwa Ka-tze, the alleged leader of the Nanking gang who is at large. He confessed, however, that he knew Chen Fu-tsu, but when the judge raised the question that Hwa Ka-tze was otherwise known as Chen Fu-tsu, Yang said that his friend Chen was a bona fide merchant in Hongkong. He asked the judge to investigate that in Hongkong. He was in no way connected with Wang Ya-chiao, another leader of the Nanking group. If the police found out that he was, he would be willing to be shot, he said.

The other two accused answered practically the same questions in the same way and none of the Nanking quartette knew any one of them. Chang Yu-hwa, alias Chang Shih-min told the court that he knew the motive of the Nanking group in their assassination plot and so he came to Shanghai one day before the attempt on Mr. Wang's life, he said. He denied that he had come to Shanghai to lead a disturbance in Shanghai. He had no intention of plotting against the Japanese.

《上海泰晤士报》，1936年9月17日，星期四

中山案嫌疑人
将被交还

汪精卫遇刺未遂案被告
被发现与中山和加奥凶杀案无关

去年11月1日在南京发生的行政院院长汪精卫遇刺未遂案中，由中国当局逮捕的四名华人，最近作为中山和加奥两起凶杀案的嫌疑人被移交给租界警方，昨日在第一特区地方法院被萧法官下令交还公安局。这一命令是在这四名男子未能指认被租界警方拘押的三名中山谋杀案嫌疑人，且这三名嫌疑人也未能认出这些新嫌疑人之后作出的。

“萧广东”（"Hsiao Kwangtung"，音译）、杨文道和周某与从中国当局带来的四人一起接受讯问，萧法官采信了两组人员的陈述后，下令将这四人交还，并再次无限期推迟对“萧广东”及其他两人的审判，等待法医研究所的报告。

据悉，该研究所正在调查杨文道的手掌指纹。杨是一名广东籍被告，警方在其家中发现了一本中心被挖空的书，据称中山谋杀案中使用的手枪就藏在这本书里。杨完全否认了这一说法，声称是他的亲戚杨建春（Yang Gien-chun，音译）为了陷害他而将书放在他家里的。最后出庭作证的杨建春也否认了杨文道的指控，因此也在检验他的指纹，以确定那本书的来源。

分别陈述

被控犯有中山谋杀罪的三名被告分别接受了聆讯。杨文道否认了解南京团伙的情况，并称他不认识华卡兹（Hwa Ka-tze，音译），据称此人是目前在逃的南京帮派头目。然而，他承认认识陈福祖（Chen Fu-tzu），但当法官提出华卡兹又名陈福祖时，杨说他的朋友陈是香港的一名正当商人。他请法官去香港调查此事。他与南京团伙的另一名头目王亚樵毫无关系。他说，如果警方查出他与此有关，他愿意被枪决。

另外两名被告以相同的方式回答了几乎相同的问题，南京四人组中没有人认识他们中的任何一个。张玉华（Chang Yu-hwa），又名张世民（Chang Shih-min），告诉法庭，他知道南京团伙在刺杀阴谋中的动机，因此他在汪先生遇刺前一天来到上海。他否认来上海是为了在上海领导骚乱。他无意策划针对日本人的行动。

September 5, 1936. Morning Translation.
（印：CRIME BRANCH）

MAINICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE: FOUR SUSPECTS ARRESTED

The Nakayama case has already
had 12 hearings. A case has been established with material
evidence.
The Court has been prolonging
the case in an effort to find a solution to its position.
On September 3 two new suspects
were examined in camera in the No. 3 Court of the First
Special District Court. The names of the suspects are:
Tsu Kwei Sun, 39, a native of Yangchow, and King Tao Chuen,
19, a native of Kompo. As they had admitted being con-
cerned in the Nakayama and Kayau cases, they were handed
over by the Bureau of Public Safety to the Special Political
Office of the S.M.P. on September 2 together with Chang
Tse Ming alias Chang Nyoh Hwa and another suspect.
The hearing was held at 11 a.m.
September 3 and lasted 10 minutes. It was adjourned until
September 10. The two suspects who are of the coolie type
denied the charge. The appearance of these new suspects
at this stage when the case against Yang Ven Tao , Yih
Hai Sung and another has already been established, has given
rise to a belief that their confession had been forcibly
secured because the Chinese authorities fear an exposure
of their connection with the case behind the scenes.
Officers of the Special Political Office are conducting
a through investigation.

THE CHENGTU INCIDENT

After receiving detailed
information regarding the Chengtu incident, various
organizations have held general and emergency meetings
at which strong views were expressed.
The Japanese Residents Corporation
will call an emergency meeting of its councillors at its
office at 5 p.m. to-day.
The meeting will decide the
attitude of the Japanese residents towards the Chengtu
outrage. A copy of th. decision will be handed to Mr.
Kawagoe, Ambassador to China. It may also be telegraphed
to the Foreign, Navy and War Ministers.

NIPPO

Local Japanese Consular Police to be strengthened
to cope with anti-Japanese activities

As anti-Japanese activities
are increasing, the 100 policemen of the local Japanese
Consular Police are insufficient to protect the 30,000
Japanese residents in Shanghai. The Consular authorities
are planning to increase the number of policemen. Mr.
Fukuyama, former officer in charge of the First Section of
the Consular Police, drafted a plan for an increase of 30
policemen. This plan is being considered by the Foreign
Ministry.

1936年9月5日。晨间译稿。
（印：刑事科）

《每日新闻》

中山案：四名嫌疑人被捕

中山案已开庭审理12次。已有物证确立案件事实。
法院一直在延长此案审理，试图为其立场找到解决方案。
9月2日，两名新嫌疑人在第一特区地方法院第三法庭接受秘密审讯。嫌疑人的姓名为：朱桂生（Tsu Kwei Sun），39岁，扬州人；金道权（King Tao Chuen），19岁，高邮（Kompo，音译）人。由于他们承认参与中山案和加藤（Kayau，音译）案，公共安全局于9月2日将他们连同张士民（Chang Tse Ming），又名张义华（Chang Nyoh Hwa）及另一名嫌疑人，移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处特别政治股。
听证会于9月3日上午11时举行，持续了10分钟。休庭至9月10日。这两名属于苦力类型的嫌疑人否认指控。在针对杨文涛（Yang Ven Tao，音译）、易海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）及另一人的案件证据已经确凿的阶段，这些新嫌疑人的出现，使人认为他们的供词是被逼供所得，因为中国当局担心其与案件背后的联系被揭露。
特别政治股警官正在进行彻底调查。

成都事件

在收到关于成都事件的详细情报后，各组织举行了全体大会和紧急会议，会上表达了强烈的观点。
日本居留民团将于今日下午5时在其办事处召开议员紧急会议。
会议将决定日本居留民对成都暴行的态度。决议副本将提交给日本驻华大使川越茂（Kawagoe）先生。也可能电告外务大臣、海军大臣和陆军大臣。

《日日新闻》

当地日本领事警察将加强以应对反日活动

鉴于反日活动日益增加，当地日本领事警察的100名警力不足以保护在上海的30,000名日本居民。领事当局计划增加警察人数。前领事警察第一课负责人福山（Fukuyama，音译）先生起草了一份增加30名警察的计划。该计划正由外务省审议。

September 5, 1936. Morning Translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-

CULPRITS IN ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION OF WAUNG CHING WEI
CONNECTED WITH BOTH NAKAYAMA AND KAYAU CASES

Upon learning that Chen An Min (陈思明), age 32, native of Yangchow (扬州), and Chang Sze Min (张士民) alias Chang Yui Hwa (张义华) alias Chang Vee (张维), age 36, native of Paoying (宝应), the two principals in the attempted assassination of Waung Ching Wei, are also connected with both the Nakayama and Kayau murder cases, the Shanghai Municipal Police the other day requested the First Special District Court to send a dispatch to the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters for the handing over of the two men to the Municipal Police. The two suspects were handed over to the Municipal Police on September 3.

On the morning of September 4, Foreign Detective Inspector Crowther attached to Dixwell Road Police Station and Japanese Detective Inspector Nakamura escorted the two suspects to the First Special District Court where the case was heard by Judge Tsoong Tsing (钟清).

Assistant Municipal Advocate Tsang Sz Tso requested that the two men be detained under Articles 76 and 101 of the Chinese Criminal Procedure Code in order that they might be tried together with Tsu Kwei Sun (朱桂生) and King Tao Chuen (金道权), who were recently arrested by the Municipal Police on suspicion of being connected with both the Nakayama and Kayau murder cases.

The Court ordered that the two men be detained up to September 10 to be tried together with Tsu Kwei Sun. The two men were then removed to the Police Station.

The case was heard in camera and lasted about ten minutes.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-

STUDENTS STAGE PERFORMANCES AT POOTUNG

The Students Dramatic Group (学生剧团) was inaugurated in March this year by local Chinese students. It has some 70 members. The students have staged performances at Tazang (大场), Sungkiang (松江) and Tsingpoo (青浦); everywhere they were welcomed by the people.

At 10 a.m. yesterday, 38 members of the group of both sexes went to Pootung and gave two performances between 4 and 6 p.m. and 7 and 9 p.m. at the Pootung Theatre (浦东大戏院). A large crowd of persons, mostly farmers and labourers, attended. The dramas entitled "A Night in East Charhar" (察哈尔夜) and "The Echo" (回声) were performed.

1936年9月5日。晨间译稿。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

汪精卫遇刺未遂案凶手与中山案及加藤案均有关联

获悉汪精卫遇刺未遂案的两名主犯——陈思明（Chen An Min），32岁，扬州人；以及张士民（Chang Sze Min），又名张义华（Chang Yui Hwa），又名张维（Chang Vee），36岁，宝应人——也与中山案和加藤谋杀案有关后，上海公共租界工部局警务处日前请求第一特区地方法院向淞沪警备司令部发函，要求将这两人移交警务处。两名嫌疑人于9月3日被移交给警务处。

9月4日上午，隶属狄思威路捕房的洋探长克劳瑟（Crowther）和日本探长中村（Nakamura）护送两名嫌疑人前往第一特区地方法院，案件由钟清法官审理。

助理华捕检察官曾子佐（Tsang Sz Tso，音译）请求依据《中华民国刑事诉讼法》第76条和第101条拘留这两人，以便他们与最近因涉嫌参与中山案和加藤谋杀案而被警务处逮捕的朱桂生（Tsu Kwei Sun）和金道权（King Tao Chuen）并案审理。

法院命令将这两人拘留至9月10日，与朱桂生并案审理。随后两人被移送至捕房。

案件秘密审理，持续约十分钟。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

学生在浦东演出

学生剧团于今年三月由本地中国学生创立。该剧团约有70名成员。学生们已在大场、松江和青浦进行演出；所到之处均受到民众欢迎。

昨日上午10时，该剧团男女成员38人前往浦东，于下午4时至6时及7时至9时在浦东大戏院进行了两场演出。大量观众出席，多为农民和劳工。上演了剧目《察哈尔夜》和《回声》。

September 14, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

Tsu Kwei Sung's statement

"I came to Shanghai in October last year to ask Chen Lai Yeu to find some employment for me. Chen is a member of a secret society organized by Wong Yia Chiao. I became a member after my arrival. In November, when Wong Yia Chiao and his gang planned the Nakayama case, I participated in the plot and received $30. The murder was planned by Chen An Ming, Shih Feng Ding, Chang Ngoh Hwa and myself. On or about November 6 last year, four of us rented a room at the Haining Lodging House under the name of Lee Teh Hung. On the evening of November 9, Shih Feng Ding, Chang Ngoh Hwa and I went to Darroch Road, walking along North Szechuen Road. I went there a little later. After a while I heard a shot so I escaped to my house in the French Concession."

Chen An Ming's statement

"I arrived in Shanghai in September last year and joined Wong Yia Chiao's secret society at the request of Shih Feng Ding. I was able to rent a small room in the French Concession at $4 a month, through the arrangement of Shih Feng Ding. I was introduced to Chang Ngoh Hwa and Tsu Kwei Sung in this house. Later I joined in the plot to assassinate a Japanese. On November 9 last year, Shih Feng Ding, Tsu Kwei Sung and others discussed a certain plan. On the following day, upon reading the newspaper, I said to myself, "They have done it." In December last, I returned to my home in Hangchow and came back to Shanghai early this year to find employment. I made the acquaintance of Chen Siao Deu, a follower of Chang Ngoh Hwa, and through his introduction I met King Tao Chuen. In July, three of us discussed a plan to assassinate a Japanese. We were to receive money from King Tao Chuen to purchase a pistol but as no funds were forthcoming the plan was not carried out."

King Tao Chuen's statement

"I joined Wong Yia Chiao's society at the end of December last year. Hwa Kuh Tse rented a room in the French Concession for me. I was appointed secret correspondent in May. I had no connection whatever with the Nakayama Case but I heard that Hwa Kuh Tse was responsible for the murder. There is no question that the assassination of Kayau on July 10 was carried out by Lieu Lau Sze. On that day (July 10) Hwa Kuh Tse handed a pistol to Lieu Lau Sze, whereupon the latter went to Chimei Road on a bicycle. On August 3, I went to the French

1936年9月14日。午后译稿。

朱桂生的供词

“我去年十月来上海，请陈来友（Chen Lai Yeu，音译）为我找份工作。陈是王亚樵组织的秘密社团成员。我到达后加入了该社团。十一月，当王亚樵及其团伙策划中山案时，我参与了阴谋并收到30美元。谋杀由陈安明（Chen An Ming，音译）、施凤鼎（Shih Feng Ding，音译）、张义华（Chang Ngoh Hwa）和我策划。去年11月6日左右，我们四人以李德洪（Lee Teh Hung，音译）的名义在海宁旅社租了一间房。11月9日晚，施凤鼎、张义华和我沿北四川路走到达罗路（Darroch Road）。我稍晚到达。过了一会儿，我听到一声枪响，便逃回我在法租界的住所。”

陈安明的供词

“我去年九月抵达上海，应施凤鼎的要求加入了王亚樵的秘密社团。通过施凤鼎的安排，我在法租界以每月4美元的价格租了一间小房。在这所房子里，我结识了张义华和朱桂生。后来我参与了刺杀一名日本人的阴谋。去年11月9日，施凤鼎、朱桂生等人讨论了一个计划。第二天，看了报纸后，我自言自语道：‘他们干成了。’去年十二月，我回到杭州老家，今年初回到上海找工作。我认识了张义华的追随者陈小斗（Chen Siao Deu，音译），并通过他的介绍结识了金道权。七月，我们三人讨论了刺杀一名日本人的计划。我们将由金道权提供资金购买手枪，但由于没有资金到位，计划未能实施。”

金道权的供词

“我去年十二月底加入了王亚樵的社团。华国兹（Hwa Kuh Tse，音译）在法租界为我租了一间房。五月我被任命为秘密通讯员。我与中山案毫无关系，但我听说华国兹对该谋杀案负责。毫无疑问，7月10日对加藤（Kayau）的刺杀是由刘留四（Lieu Lau Sze，音译）实施的。那天（7月10日），华国兹递给刘留四一把手枪，随后后者骑自行车前往集美路（Chimei Road，音译）。8月3日，我和华

(Continued from September 13)

The hearing of the case against
the four suspects arrested by the Bureau of Public Safety
in connection with the murder of Nakayama and Kayau took
place at the Special District Court at 9.40 a.m. September
12. King Tao Chuen, one of the accused, was interrogated
by the Court.
The Judge: Where was the assassination planned?
The accused: The relations between China and Japan being
strained, the murder of a Japanese at any place would
lead to war.
The accused Tse Kwei Sung was
then interrogated by the Court.
The Judge: Do you know Chen An Ming?
The accused: I know him very well because he is a
fellow-provincial. When I was formerly working as a
detective of the Bureau of Public Safety, he was also
a detective there.
The Court here interrogated
the accused Chang Ngoh Hwa.
The judge: When did you come to Shanghai?
The accused: After the Sino-Japanese hostilities in
Shanghai.
Q: Do you know Yang Vung Tao?
A: I do not know him at all.
Q: Do you know anything about the murder of Japanese
(the Nakayama and Kayau cases)?
A: No.
Mr. Paul Ru, the Municipal
Advocate, then made the following statement:-
"The four suspects have no
connection whatever with the Nakayama Case. The Shanghai
Municipal Police will take no action against them. They
are believed to have some connection with Wong Yia Chiao.
As Yang Vung Tao is also connected with Wong Yia Chiao,
a hearing should be held at which the four prisoners and
Yang Vung Tao will appear together."
It has been decided that Yang
Vung Tao will appear at the next hearing on Wednesday for
a confrontation with Tsu Kwei Sung and other three accused.

Chinese Police Official Says New Suspects Are
Real Murderers

Mr. Wong Hwa, Chief of the
Third Section of the Bureau of Public Safety, called at
the Japanese Consular Police and the Municipal Police on
August 26 and reported that Tsu Kwei Sung, Chen An Ming
and King Tao Chuen were the real murderers of Nakayama
and Kayau. Lieu Lau Sze, the ringleader, had decamped.
Continuing, he said that the
following statements had been made by the three arrested
persons:-

《日日新闻》

中山案：公共安全局逮捕的四名嫌疑人受审

（续9月13日）

针对公共安全局逮捕的四名与中山和加藤谋杀案有关的嫌疑人的听证会，于9月12日上午9时40分在特区地方法院举行。被告之一金道权接受法院讯问。
法官：刺杀计划是在哪里制定的？
被告：中日关系紧张，在任何地方杀害日本人都会导致战争。
随后法院讯问被告朱桂生。
法官：你认识陈安明吗？
被告：我很认识他，因为他是同乡。我以前在公共安全局当侦探时，他也是那里的侦探。
法院随后讯问被告张义华。
法官：你什么时候来上海的？
被告：上海中日战事之后。
问：你认识杨文涛（Yang Vung Tao，音译）吗？
答：我完全不认识他。
问：你对日本人被杀一事（中山案和加藤案）了解多少？
答：不知道。
随后，华捕检察官保罗·鲁（Paul Ru，音译）发表如下声明：
“这四名嫌疑人与中山案毫无关系。上海公共租界工部局警务处不会对他们采取行动。据信他们与王亚樵有关联。由于杨文涛也与王亚樵有关联，应举行一次听证会，让这四名囚犯和杨文涛同时出庭。”
已决定杨文涛将在周三的下一次听证会上出庭，与朱桂生及其他三名被告对质。

中国警方官员称新嫌疑人是真凶

公共安全局第三科科长王华（Wong Hwa，音译）先生于8月26日拜访日本领事警察和警务处，报告称朱桂生、陈安明和金道权是中山和加藤案的真凶。主谋刘留四已潜逃。

September 14, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

MAI: IC:I (12-9-36)

THE NAKAYAMA MURDER. THE CASE AGAINST FOUR NEW
SUSPECTS: CONFESSIONS SECURED BY FORCE: SUBTERFUGE
OF BUREAU OF PUBLIC SAFETY EXPOSED

(Continued from September 12)

Chen An Ming, one of the four
suspects, appears to be a country man. He strongly
maintained that he had no connection with the case and
informed the Court that he was tortured at the Bureau
of Public Safety.

According to the statements
taken from the suspects by the Bureau of Public Safety,
they had met at the Haining Hotel and planned another
assassination of Japanese. As a matter of fact, Chen
had never stayed at this hotel though he had visited
there at the invitation of a friend. He had never
attended any conference held to discuss the assassination.
Chen stated to the Court that he had never stayed in
Shanghai for any lengthy period of time and he was
unable to read the street names because he was illiterate..
He also stated that he confessed that he was an accomplice
of the accused in the Nakayama case after he was tortured
by the Bureau of Public Safety; that he was forced to
place his thumb print on the false document drawn up
by the Bureau of Public Safety although the Bureau had
stated that the document would not incriminate him.

The Judge then interrogated
the two accused Tseu and Chen.
The Judge: Do you know Chang Yui Hwa?
Both accused: We do not know him. We first heard
of him at the Bureau of Public Safety.
Q: Do you know Chang Sze Ming?
A: No. It was at the Bureau of Public Safety that
we first learnt that these two names belonged to one
person.

At this stage, a sectional
chief of the Bureau of Public Safety was noticed to
leave the Court in such a manner that his exit was al-
most unnoticed.

Inspector Growther of Dixwell
Road Station made the following statement to the Court:-
"Taking with me the two accused
named Chen and Tseu, I visited the Haining Hotel on
September 7 to make an investigation. The two suspects
were puzzled when they were asked to point out the
room they had occupied for in the statements taken by
the Chinese authorities it was mentioned that they
had stayed at the hotel. They pointed out a certain
room to me but an inquiry showed that the room in question
had been occupied by a man named Lee Tah Hung on November
9. I then asked the accountant and a room boy of the
hotel to identify the two suspects, but they informed me
that they did not know them. The two suspects informed
me that their statement that they had occupied room No. 78.

MAI: IC:I (1936年9月12日)

中山案。针对四名新嫌疑人的指控：通过刑讯逼供获取口供：公安局的诡计被揭穿

（接9月12日内容）

四名嫌疑人之一的陈安明（Chen An Ming，音译）似乎是个乡下人。他坚决声称自己与本案无关，并告知法庭他在公安局遭受了酷刑。

根据公安局从嫌疑人处取得的供词，他们曾在海宁旅馆会面，并策划另一起刺杀日本人的行动。事实上，陈虽然曾应朋友邀请去过该旅馆，但从未在那里住过。他也从未参加过任何讨论刺杀行动的会议。陈向法庭陈述，他从未在上海长期居住过，且因是文盲，无法辨认路名。他还陈述，他在被公安局刑讯逼供后，才承认自己是中山案被告的同伙；尽管公安局声称该文件不会使他获罪，但他仍被迫在公安局伪造的文件上按下了拇指指印。

随后法官审问了两名被告周（Tseu，音译）和陈。
法官：你们认识张荣华（Chang Yui Hwa，音译）吗？
两名被告：我们不认识他。我们是在公安局第一次听说他的。
问：你们认识张思明（Chang Sze Ming，音译）吗？
答：不认识。正是在公安局，我们才第一次得知这两个名字属于同一个人。

此时，注意到公安局的一名科长以几乎无人察觉的方式离开了法庭。

狄克威路捕房的格罗瑟（Growther，音译）巡官向法庭作了如下陈述：
“我于9月7日带着名为陈和周的两名被告前往海宁旅馆进行调查。当要求这两名嫌疑人指出他们在供词中提到的曾入住的房间时，他们感到困惑，因为中国当局取得的供词中提到他们曾住在该旅馆。他们向我指认了一个房间，但经查询显示，该房间在11月9日由一名叫李达洪（Lee Tah Hung，音译）的人入住。随后我请旅馆的会计和茶房辨认这两名嫌疑人，但他们告知我并不认识这两人。这两名嫌疑人告诉我，他们关于入住房间……

随后在法庭上出示了一封信。这封信是由孔建中（Kong Kien Choong，音译）写给日本海军驻沪办事处的，报告称住在海宁旅馆的李达洪（Lee Tah Hung，音译）是中山谋杀案的凶手。
公安局声称李达洪和周是同一个人。
法官将这封信出示给周，问他是否认得。
周接过信并大声朗读。他宣称自己不是信中提到的那个人。周指控公安局对他提出虚假指控。
公安局第三科科长及其下属像“风吹云散”一样，在未被注意的情况下离开了法庭。
随后法官审讯了张荣华（Chang Yui Hwa，音译），他声称不认识周、陈或金（King，音译），并否认与中山案有任何关联，尽管他承认与汪精卫遇刺案有关联。
