NICHI-NICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE: TRIAL OF FOUR SUSPECTS
ARRESTED BY BUREAU OF PUBLIC SAFETY

At 9.40 a.m. yesterday the
hearing of a charge against four suspects in the Nakayama
and Kayau cases, who were arrested by the Bureau of
Public Safety, was held at the Special District Court.
The Judge questioned King Tao
Chuen: Do you know Chang Yui Hwa?
King Tao Chuen answered: At the
end of last year I paid a visit to his home and therefore
came to know him.
Q: Do you know anything about the Nakayama case?
A. No.
Q: When did you come to know Hwa Keh Tse?
A: I was introduced to him by his sister.
Q: What connection have you with Hwa Keh Tse?
A. I was in a position of managing secret communica-
tions between members and a secret society of which Hwa
Keh Tse was administrating. I learnt of the Kayau case
through newspapers. I do not believe the Kayau murder
was committed by them because their behaviour was very calm
prior to the murder.
Q: Did you hear that they were planning to do
something?
A: In August I heard they were planning something.
The nature of the plan seemed to be the assassination of
a Japanese.
Q: Was any one killed?
A: I believe they could not carry out the plan
because they had not completely prepared for it.
(To be continued)

《日日新闻》

中山案：审理由公安局逮捕的四名嫌疑人

昨日上午9时40分，特区法院开庭审理由公安局逮捕的中山案和高友（Kayau，音译）案四名嫌疑人的指控。
法官询问金道全（King Tao Chuen，音译）：你认识张荣华（Chang Yui Hwa，音译）吗？
金道全回答：去年年底我曾去他家拜访，因此认识了他。
问：你对中山案了解多少？
答：不了解。
问：你何时认识华克兹（Hwa Keh Tse，音译）的？
答：我是通过他的姐姐介绍认识他的。
问：你与华克兹有什么关系？
答：我负责管理成员与华克兹所管理的一个秘密社团之间的秘密通讯。我是通过报纸了解到高友案的。我不相信高友谋杀案是他们所为，因为在谋杀发生前他们的行为非常平静。
问：你听说他们在策划做什么事吗？
答：我在八月份听说他们在策划某事。计划的性质似乎是刺杀一名日本人。
问：有人被杀吗？
答：我相信他们未能实施计划，因为他们尚未完全准备好。
（待续）

September 17, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

MAI:ICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE: YANG VEN TAO AND YIH HAI
SUNG CONNECTED WITH THE 19TH ROUTE ARMY

(Continued from morning translation)

At the 8th hearing held on July
10, Procurator Chang declared the innocence of the accused
and advanced ridiculous arguments for his assertion.
Judge Chien Hung Yih then announced that a decision
would be rendered at 8.30 a.m. July 17.
With the sudden appearance of
Pan Chiou Ying the trial has now been protracted for two
months under the pretext of making a search for Yang Chien
Chung, Now the appearance of the new suspects has
complicated the case. As the examination of Yang Chien
Chung and Pan Chion Ying has already been completed and
as it has been revealed that the statements of the new
suspects had been secured by force, the Court should give
its decision as quickly as possible.
The Pakhoi case was perpetrated
at the instigation and guidance of the 19th Route Army.
The accused Yang Ven Tao and Yih Hai Sung were active
members of the "Special Dare-to-Die Corps" of the 19th
Route Army during the Sino-Japanese hostilities in
Shanghai; they also held important positions in the "Iron
and Blood Corps", directed by General Chen Ming Chu and
Wong Yah Chiao. All this has been clearly established
by the evidence secured by the Municipal Police when they
searched Yang Ven Tao's home. The delay in the
settlement of the Nakayama case is due to the insincerity
of the National Government. An examination of the
evidence found at Yang Ven Tao's home has revealed that
the 19th Route Army had been utilizing Wong Yah Chiao's
Assassination Corps to commit acts directed against the
Government and Japan; that Yang Ven Tao was appointed
Major General of the 55th Army of the Chinese regular
Forces on June 19, 1933; that he took part in the activities
of the "Special Dare-to-Die Corps led by Yih Hai Sung;
that in recognition of his services he was made honorary
staff officer of the 19th Route Army. Yih Hai Sung, who
had 60 subordinates under him, had been submitting reports
to Yang Ven Tao on the movements of the Japanese forces.
The reports were later transmitted to a man of the 19th
Route Army residing in the French Concession.
Public attention has been
drawn to the activities of high Chinese officials who
are attempting to save Yang Ven Tao and Yih Hai Sung
after the exposure of the fact that the accused had planned
the assassination in order to create political disturbances
in Shanghai and are organizers of secret societies.
The Sanhu Association, which
provides professional murderers, the Tung Yih Association,
the Dong Zung Association, the Hung Zung Association
(Yang Ven Tao is the leader of these three organizations),
the Peisan Fellow Provincials Association and the Shanghai
Cantonese Fellow Provincials Association have all been
actively engaged in an endeavour to save the accused.

1936年9月17日。下午译文。

MAI:ICHI

中山案：杨文道（Yang Ven Tao，音译）和易海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）与第十九路军有关联

（接上午译文）

在7月10日举行的第八次庭审中，检察官张宣布被告无罪，并为这一主张提出了荒谬的论据。
随后钱弘义（Chien Hung Yih，音译）法官宣布，将于7月17日上午8时30分作出判决。
随着潘九英（Pan Chiou Ying，音译）的突然出现，审判以搜寻杨建中（Yang Chien Chung，音译）为借口已拖延了两个月。现在新嫌疑人的出现使案件复杂化。鉴于对杨建中和潘九英（Pan Chion Ying，音译）的审讯已经完成，且已揭露新嫌疑人的供词是通过刑讯逼供获得的，法庭应尽快作出判决。
北海案是在第十九路军的唆使和指导下实施的。被告杨文道和易海松在上海中日敌对行动期间是第十九路军“特种敢死队”的活跃成员；他们还在由陈铭枢将军和王亚樵（Wong Yah Chiao，音译）指挥的“铁血团”中担任重要职务。所有这些都已由工部局警务处在搜查杨文道家时获得的证据清楚证实。中山案迟迟未决是由于国民政府缺乏诚意。对杨文道家发现证据的审查显示，第十九路军一直利用王亚樵的暗杀团从事针对政府和日本的行动；杨文道于1933年6月19日被任命为中国正规军第五十五军少将；他参与了由易海松领导的“特种敢死队”的活动；为表彰其功绩，他被聘为第十九路军荣誉参谋。拥有60名下属的易海松一直向杨文道提交关于日军动向的报告。这些报告后来转交给了一名居住在法租界的第十九路军人员。
公众的注意力已被吸引到某些中国高官的活动上，他们在被告策划刺杀以制造上海政治动荡以及他们是秘密社团组织者的事实被揭露后，试图营救杨文道和易海松。提供职业杀手的三合会（Sanhu Association，音译）、同益会（Tung Yih Association，音译）、东纵会（Dong Zung Association，音译）、洪纵会（Hung Zung Association，音译）（杨文道是这三个组织的领导人）、佩山同乡会和上海广东同乡会都积极参与了营救被告的努力。

September 17, 1936. Afternoon Translation No. D

Wong Yah Chiao, Hwa Kuo Tse and Chang Yui Fa are
evidently the masters of the three accused. The
Judges hearing the case are reported to have received
threatening letters from the secret societies. The
Municipal authorities are moving to suppress these lawless
elements.

NIPPO

CHINESE AUTHORITIES ENFORCE EMERGENCY MARTIAL LAW

The Shanghai City Government has
received information to the effect that, taking advantage
of the situation created by the Chengtu and Pakhoi
outrages, anti-Japanese elements are making arrangements
to start rioting on September 18, the anniversary of
the Mukden Incident. The City Government has issued
a notification to the effect that emergency martial
law will be enforced for 4 days from September 17 by order
of the Woosung-Shanghai Defence Commissioner. During
these four days meetings, demonstrations, strikes, and
distribution of handbills are strictly prohibited because
such activities are reliable to lead to a disturbance of
the peace and order. Anybody who violates the order will
be severely dealt with according to law.
The Shanghai District Kuomintang
used to hold meetings to commemorate the September 18
Incident, but this year it will only request the public
to hoist the national flag at half mast. The Woosung-
Shanghai Defence Commissioner's headquarters and the
Bureau of Public Safety are paying close attention to
the movements of important members of the Anti-Japanese
Popular Front Party.

NICHI NICHI

LOCAL JAPANESE NAVAL AUTHORITIES GRAVELY CONCERNED
OVER JUDGMENT IN THE NAKAYAMA CASE

The appearance of four new
suspects in the Nakayama Case caused an unexpected delay
in the trial of the accused Yang Ven Tao and others. As a
result of yesterday's hearing, the latest trickery resorted
to by the Chinese Authorities has been exposed.
Local Japanese Naval Authorities
have patiently endured the Nakayama Case and other incidents
for the sake of peace and order in the Far East. They are
carefully watching developments. In view of the fact that
all these incidents, from the Nakayama Case to the Pakhoi
incident, are due to the anti-Japanese policy of the Chinese,
the Japanese Authorities will take drastic measures should
the National Government show insincerity in the Nakayama
Case. If judgment is not rendered at the next few hearings
and if the Chinese Authorities attempt to drop the case
by unnecessarily protracting the trial, the responsibility
for the consequences of such tactics shall rest solely on
the Chinese.

王亚樵、华国兹（Hwa Kuo Tse，音译）和张玉发（Chang Yui Fa，音译）显然是这三名被告的主谋。据报道，审理此案的法官收到了来自秘密社团的恐吓信。市政当局正在采取行动镇压这些不法之徒。

《日本日报》

中国当局实施紧急戒严令

上海市政府收到消息，反日分子正利用成都和北海暴行造成的局势，安排于9月18日（沈阳事变周年纪念日）发动骚乱。市政府发布通知，奉吴淞上海防卫司令命令，自9月17日起实施为期4天的紧急戒严。在这四天里，严格禁止集会、示威、罢工和散发传单，因为这些活动可靠地会导致扰乱治安。任何违反命令者将依法严惩。
上海地区国民党过去常举行会议纪念九一八事变，但今年仅请求公众降半旗致哀。吴淞上海防卫司令部和公安局正密切关注反日人民阵线党重要成员的动向。

《日日新闻》

日本当地海军当局对中山案判决深感关切

中山案中出现四名新嫌疑人，导致对被告杨文道等人的审判意外延期。由于昨天的庭审，中国当局最新的诡计已被揭穿。
为了远东的和平与秩序，日本当地海军当局一直忍耐着中山案和其他事件。他们正在密切关注事态发展。鉴于从中山案到北海事件的所有这些事件都是由于中国的反日政策所致，如果国民政府在中山案中表现出缺乏诚意，日本当局将采取严厉措施。如果在接下来的几次庭审中仍未作出判决，且中国当局试图通过不必要地拖延审判来撤销此案，则此类策略后果的责任将完全由中国承担。

September 17, 1936. Afternoon Translation.
-3-

The 19th Route Army which
is responsible for the Pakhoi affair is an anti-Japanese
army under General Tsai Ting Kai. Its connection with
the Nakayama case has been exposed. The policy adopted
by the Nanking Government in directing the people to
resist Japan resulted in an outbreak of acts of terrorism
and this gave rise to the present tense and delicate
situation between China and Japan. It may be said that
the ill-advised policy of the Nanking Government in
dealing with the Nakayama Case had brought about the
Kayau Case, the Chengtu incident and the Pakhoi affair.

NICHINICHI

PRESIDENT OF JAPANESE RESIDENTS' CORPORATION
POSTPONES DEPARTURE FOR JAPAN OWING TO SITUATION

It will be recalled that
Mr. Amano, President of the Japanese Residents' Corporation,
had arranged to leave Shanghai for Tokio on September 18
to call at the Foreign Office, etc, to discuss the
Rehabilitation Funds, Educational Grants, selection of a
successor to the former director of the local Japanese
Commercial School, and other matters. As it is feared
that developments in the situation might necessitate
his presence in Shanghai, Mr. Amano has postponed his
departure until such time when the situation shall have
improved.

1936年9月17日。下午译文。
-3-

负责北海事件的第十九路军是蔡廷锴将军麾下的一支抗日军队。其与中山案的联系已被揭露。南京政府指导民众抗日的政策导致了恐怖主义行为的爆发，并由此引发了当前中日之间紧张而微妙的局势。可以说，南京政府在处理中山案上的失策政策导致了嘉尧案、成都事件以及北海事件的发生。

日日新闻

日本居留民团团长
因局势原因推迟赴日行程

兹回顾，日本居留民团团长天野先生原定于9月18日离开上海前往东京，拜访外务省等机构，以讨论复兴基金、教育拨款、当地日本商业学校前任校长的继任人选及其他事项。由于担心局势发展可能需要他留在上海，天野先生已推迟行程，待局势好转后再行出发。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
Date / /

September 17, 1936.    Morning Translation

MAINICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

The hearing of the Nakayama
Case was held by Judge Hsiao at the First Special District
Court at 2.30 p.m. September 16. The following persons
were present: Procurator Tang, Staff Officer Ohsugi of the
Japanese Naval Landing Party, Naval Resident Officer Okino,
Municipal Advocate Paul Hu, Assistant Commissioner Uyehara,
several members of the Special Political Office of the S.M.P.,
Secretary Nakada of the Japanese Consulate, Mr. Tajima,
officer in charge of the First Section of the Japanese
Consular Police, Japanese lawyer Okamoto, the lawyers for
the defence, several officers of the Woosung-Shanghai Defence
Commissioners Headquarters, the Chief of the Third Section
of the Bureau of Public Safety and staff members of the
Peisan Fellow Provincials Association.

Municipal Advocate Paul Hu
asked the Court to examine Yang Ven Tao, Yih Hai Sung and
Tseu Shou Yong, the three accused in the Nakayama Case,
because the examination of the four new suspects arrested
by the Bureau of Public Safety has been completed.

Judge Hsiao requested Municipal
Advocate Paul Hu not to publish in the newspapers the
result of the hearing because it might affect the political
situation.

The Judge then ordered Yih
Hai Sung and Tseu Shou Yong to be taken to another room
and only Yang Ven Tao was left in Court. Yang Ven Tao
was dressed in a blue foreign suit. He was pale; his hair
had been cut short. He frequently bit his lips.

According to the evidence
produced in Court, it has already been ascertained that
he was an organizer of secret societies and that he had
planned an assassination for the purpose of creating
political disturbances in Shanghai. Yang Ven Tao denied
everything except his connection with Hwa Kuo Tse, one of
the important members of Wang Ah Chow's gang and that he
was an advisor to the 55th Division of the Chinese regular
army.

Picking out over ten names
from the list of members of the Hung Zung Mutual Aid
Association who had attended the conferences to discuss
the murder of Nakayama and the names of the persons who are
connected with Wang Ah Chow, the Judge asked Yang Ven Tao
whether he knew them. The accused replied in the negative.

According to the documents
seized at Yang Ven Tao's home by the S.M.P., it is clear
that he is connected with General Chen Ling Chu, General
Tsai Ting Kai and General Li Chi Shen, but Yang Ven Tao
denied all this.

The Judge: Has it not been reported by the
S.M.P. that it was Wang Ah Chow who ordered you to kill
Nakayama?

Yang Ven Tao: I know nothing about it. If the
allegation is true, I shall not complain even should I be
executed.

特别分部登记处。
D号
日期 / /

1936年9月17日。上午译文

每日新闻

中山案

9月16日下午2时30分，萧法官在第一特区地方法院主持了中山案的审讯。出席人员包括：唐检察官、日本海军陆战队参谋大杉（Ohsugi）军官、海军驻在武官奥野（Okino）、工部局公诉人胡保罗（Paul Hu）、上原（Uyehara）副总监、上海公共租界工部局警务处特别政治科的数名成员、日本领事馆书记官中田（Nakada）、日本领事馆警察第一课课长田岛（Tajima）先生、日本律师冈本（Okamoto）、辩护律师、吴淞-上海防卫委员会总部的几名军官、公安局第三科科长以及佩三同乡会的工作人员。

工部局公诉人胡保罗请求法庭审讯中山案中的三名被告杨文道、叶海生和周社荣，因为公安局逮捕的四名新嫌疑人的审讯工作已经完成。

萧法官请求工部局公诉人胡保罗不要在报纸上公布审讯结果，因为这可能会影响政治局势。

随后，法官命令将叶海生和周社荣带至另一房间，仅留杨文道在庭上。杨文道身穿一套蓝色西装。他面色苍白；头发剪得很短。他频繁地咬嘴唇。

根据庭上出示的证据，已查明他是秘密社团的组织者，并且为了在上海制造政治动荡而策划了一起暗杀行动。杨文道否认了一切指控，除了承认与王亚樵帮派的重要成员华克之有关联，以及他曾担任中国正规军第五十五师的顾问。

法官从参加讨论谋杀中山一案的洪顺互助会成员名单以及与王亚樵有关联的人员名单中挑出十多个名字，询问杨文道是否认识这些人。被告予以否认。

根据上海公共租界工部局警务处在杨文道家中搜获的文件，清楚显示他与陈铭枢将军、蔡廷锴将军和李济深将军有联系，但杨文道对此全部予以否认。

法官：工部局警务处的报告难道不是说，是王亚樵命令你杀害中山的吗？

杨文道：我对此一无所知。如果指控属实，即使被处决我也无怨言。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D

September 17, 1936. Morning Translation
-2-

At this stage Chang Yui Hwa
was brought into Court by order of the Judge for
interrogation.
The Judge( indicating Yang Ven Tao with his finger):
Chang Yui Hwa, do you know that man?
Changs No.
Q: When did you come to Shanghai?
A: Just one day prior to the Sixth Plenary Session
was held.
Q: Why did you come to Shanghai?
A: Because it was dangerous for me to stay in
Nanking. I was arrested two weeks later. I have no
connection with the Nakayama case. Please finish with
my trial as quickly as possible.
At this stage, Tseu Kwei Sung
was brought in for interrogation.
The Judge(indicating Yang Ven Tao with his finger):
Tseu Kwei Sung, do you know this man?
Tseu: No.
The Judge: Have you ever stayed at the Haining Hotel?
Tseu: Never.
At this stage, Yih Hai Sung
was brought into Court.
The Judge addressing Tseu Kwei Sung: Do you know
this man( indicating Yih Hai Sung)?
Tseu: No.
Tseu Shou Yong was then brought
into the Court.
The Judge addressing Tseu Kwei Sung: Do you know
this man(indicating Tseu Shou Yong)?
Tseu: No.
Tseu Shou Yong also denied
knowing Tseu Kwei Sung.
Chang Yui Hwa was then brought
into Court.
In reply to the Judge, Chang
Yui Hwa stated that he did not know any of the three
accused Yang Ven Tao Yih Hai Sung, and Tseu Shou Yong.
These three also denied knowing Chang Yui Hwa.
King Tao Chuen and Chen An Min
were questioned by the Judge but they also stated that
they did not know them.
At this stage, the Judge ordered
Tseu Kwei Sung, Chen An Min, King Tao Chuen to stand
behind Yang Ven Tao, Yih Hai Sung and Tseu Shou Yong.
He then ordered that the four suspects arrested by the
Bureau of Public Safety/returned to the Bureau because
they are not connected with the Nakayama case.
The Court adjourned at 3.30 p.m.
after announcing that the case would be heard by Judge Chien
after Yang Ven Tao's(? Yang Chen Chung's) finger prints
had been examined by the Chenju Medico-legal Laboratory.

(to be continued)

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
D号

1936年9月17日。上午译文
-2-

此时，张钰华奉法官命令被带上法庭接受讯问。
法官（用手指着杨文道）：
张钰华，你认识那个人吗？
张：不认识。
问：你何时来到上海？
答：就在六中全会召开的前一天。
问：你为何来上海？
答：因为留在南京对我很危险。两周后我被捕。我与中山案没有任何关系。请尽快结束对我的审判。
此时，朱贵生被带入接受讯问。
法官（用手指着杨文道）：
朱贵生，你认识这个人吗？
朱：不认识。
法官：你是否曾在海宁旅馆住宿过？
朱：从未住过。
此时，叶海生被带上法庭。
法官对朱贵生说：你认识这个人吗（指着叶海生）？
朱：不认识。
随后周社荣被带上法庭。
法官对朱贵生说：你认识这个人吗（指着周社荣）？
朱：不认识。
周社荣也否认认识朱贵生。
随后张钰华被带上法庭。
回答法官提问时，张钰华表示他不认识杨文道、叶海生和周社荣这三名被告中的任何一人。这三人也否认认识张钰华。
金道权和陈恩明受到法官讯问，但他们也表示不认识这些人。
此时，法官命令朱贵生、陈恩明、金道权站在杨文道、叶海生和周社荣身后。
随后，他命令将公安局逮捕的四名嫌疑人送回公安局，因为他们与中山案无关。
下午3时30分，法庭宣布在真如法医实验室检验杨文道（? 杨建忠）的指纹后，本案将由钱法官继续审理，随后休庭。

（待续）

3.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D
September 17, 1936. Morning Translation. Date / /
Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-
THE NAKAYAMA AND KAYAU MURDER CASES : FOUR NEW SUSPECTS
HANDED BACK TO PUBLIC SAFETY BUREAU
At noon yesterday, Judge Hsiao Sih Feng (蕭慶芬)
of the First Shanghai Special District Court held a further
hearing of the case in which Yang Vung Tao (楊文道), Yih
Hai Sung (葉海生) and Tseu Shou Yong (周社榮) are charged
with the murder of Nakayama. The four new suspects named
Tsu Kwei Sung (朱貴生), Chen An Ming (陳恩明), King Tao
Chuen (金道權) and Chang Sze Ming (張世民) alias Chang
Ngoh Hwa (張玉華) alias Chang Vee (張維) arrested by the
Public Safety Bureau in connection with both the Nakayama
and Kayau murder cases were also present.
Assistant Municipal Advocate Paul Ru made
the following statement :- "The Police have declared that
they will not prosecute Tsu Kwei Sung and the other three
suspects handed over by the Public Safety Bureau. The
four suspects are now in Court for confrontation with Yang
Vung Tao and the others".
In reply to Judge Hsiao, Yang Vung Tao said:-
"I do not know Wong Ya Chiao (王亞) or Hwa Kuh Tse (華克之),
or Li Foh Ts (李福之) or Li Foh Tsoo (李福初). I have
a friend named Chen Foh Tsoo (陳福初), who is the manager
of the Foh Min Sundry Goods Company (福明百貨公司) in Hongkong.
Chen came to Shanghai between April and May last year.
The expression 'whether or not the matter would be successful'
contained in the letter sent to me by him, which was seized
in my home, referred to commercial dealings; it had no
political meaning".
Q:- Li Foh Tsoo, Chen Foh Tsoo and Li Foh Ts are the aliases
of Hwa Kuh Tse. Do you know this?
A:- No.
Q:- What was your object in forming the Hung Zung (洪順),
the Dong Nyi (同義) and the Dong Jen (同仁) Associations?
Was any of these three associations connected with any
labour union or party?
A:- My object in forming these associations was to unite
the members; they had no connection with any party.
Q:- Did you send men to Hongkong in 1931?
A:- No. After the January 28 Incident, Shiang Chien Hai
(向乾海) proceeded to New York, America, as a represen-
tative of the Hung Zung Association to solicit contributions
for the free school of the Association.
Q:- According to the statement made by accused Wang Te Min
(王德民) in another case, the associations managed by
you have branches in Kwangtung, Kwangsi and Amoy, and
the murder of Nakayama was carried out on the orders
of Wong Ya Chiao.
Yang Vung Tao flatly denied this. He declared
that he was willing to face execution by shooting should
the allegation be found to be true.
Chang Ngoh Hwa was then brought up and
questioned. Both Yang Vung Tao and Chang Ngoh Hwa declared
that they did not know each other.
Chang also denied knowing Li Foh Tsoo or
Foh Ts or Dah Fah (大發) or Tse Ya (志亞), and said:-

3.
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处。
D号
1936年9月17日。上午译文。日期 / /
《大公报》及本地其他报纸报道：
中山案与嘉尧谋杀案：四名新嫌疑人移交回公安局
昨日中午，上海第一特区地方法院法官萧庆芬对杨文道、叶海生和周社荣被控谋杀中山一案进行了进一步审讯。公安局因涉及中山案和嘉尧谋杀案而逮捕的四名新嫌疑人——朱贵生、陈恩明、金道权和张世民（又名张玉华，又名张维）——也出庭受审。
助理工部局公诉人胡保罗发表如下声明：“警方声明不会起诉由公安局移交的朱贵生及其他三名嫌疑人。这四名嫌疑人现在出庭是为了与杨文道等人进行对质”。
回答萧法官提问时，杨文道说：“我不认识王亚樵或华克之，也不认识李福之或李福初。我有一位名叫陈福初的朋友，他是香港福明百货公司的经理。陈去年四五月间来到上海。在他寄给我并被在我家中搜获的信中提到的‘事情能否成功’一词，指的是商业交易；它没有政治含义”。
问：李福初、陈福初和李福之都是华克之的别名。你知道吗？
答：不知道。
问：你组建洪顺、同义和同仁协会的目的是什么？这三个协会中是否有与任何工会或政党有关联的？
答：我组建这些协会的目的是团结成员；它们与任何政党都没有关联。
问：你在1931年派人去过香港吗？
答：没有。一·二八事变后，向乾海作为洪顺协会的代表前往美国纽约，为协会的自由学校募集捐款。
问：根据另案中被告王德民的供词，由你管理的协会在广东、广西和厦门设有分支机构，且谋杀中山是奉王亚樵之命执行的。
杨文道断然否认了这一点。他宣称，如果指控属实，他愿意面对枪决。
随后张玉华被带上庭接受讯问。杨文道和张玉华均声称互不相识。
张玉华还否认认识李福初、李福之、大发或志亚，并称：

pages.en:
4.
September 17, 1936. Morning Translation.

"I left Nanking on November 1 last year for Shanghai and lived at No. 105 Carter Road. Hwa Kuh Tse returned to Nanking before my arrival. At that time they discussed plans to assassinate Waung Ching Wei, but I opposed it and suggested that a few shots be fired as a warning to Waung Ching Wei. Later I was arrested at the Meng Yuen Hotel (孟淵旅館) in Shanghai."
When questioned by the Judge as to whether he gave a sum of $100 to Chang Ts Lien (張子廉) of the San Sin Cotton Weaving Factory (三新) on August 7, 1934, Chang replied in the negative.
Tsu Kwei Sung was next interrogated. He stated that he did not know Yang Vung Tao. He denied any participation in the Nakayama and the Kayau murder cases.
The Judge asked him what kind of man Shih Feng Ding was?
He replied that Shih was a northern dialect speaking man of more than thirty years of age. He and Chen An King had seen Shih twice only.
When Yih Hai Seng and Tseu Shou Young were interrogated, they both declared that they did not know Tsu, while Tsu stated that he did not know them.
Asked as to whether the Hung Zung Association had sent any person to Hongkong in the 20th year of the Chinese Republic, Yih Hai Seng replied in the affirmative, and added that men were sent to Hongkong and other places to collect funds for the school.
Chang Ngoh Hwa was then asked whether he knew Yih Hai Seng or Tseu Shou Young. Both sides denied knowing each other.
King Tao Chuen was then asked whether he knew Yih Hai Seng, Tseu Shou Young and Yang Vung Tao. Both sides declared that they did not know each other. King further stated that he was a worker in the Nagai Cotton Mill and that he knew nothing about Nakayama case.
After referring to some documents, the Judge asked King Tao Chuen why had made a statement to the Public Safety Bureau to the effect that the murder had been committed by Hwa Kuh Tse?
King denied having made such a statement. He said that he had knowledge of the Kayau case but he had no part in the murder.
Chen An Ming was then interrogated. He stated that he did not know Yang Vung Tao and the others.
As the case was very clear, Judge Hsiao ordered that Tsu Kwei Sung, King Tao Chuen, Chen An Ming and Chang Sze Ming be returned to the Public Safety Bureau for detention because the Police had filed no accusation against them. A date would be fixed for the further hearing of the case against Yang Vung Tao and others, after the finger prints of Yang Chien Chung (楊建忠) had been examined by the Chenju Medico-Legal Institute.
The Police then sent Tsu and the three others to the Public Safety Bureau with a certain document. Yang Vung Tao and two others were detained at the Police Station.
pages.zh:
4.
1936年9月17日。上午译文。

“我于去年11月1日离开南京前往上海，住在卡特路105号。华克之在我到达之前已返回南京。当时他们讨论了刺杀汪精卫的计划，但我反对该计划，建议放几枪作为对汪精卫的警告。后来我在上海的孟渊旅馆被捕。”
当法官问及他是否在1934年8月7日给了三新棉织厂的张子廉100美元时，张玉华予以否认。
接下来讯问朱贵生。他表示不认识杨文道。他否认参与中山案和嘉尧谋杀案。
法官问他施凤鼎是什么样的人？
他回答说，施是一个讲北方方言、三十多岁的人。他和陈恩明只见过施两次。
在讯问叶海生和周社荣时，两人都声称不认识朱，而朱则声称不认识他们。
当被问及洪顺协会是否在民国二十年派人去过香港时，叶海生给予了肯定回答，并补充说派人去香港和其他地方为学校募集资金。
随后问张玉华是否认识叶海生或周社荣。双方均否认互相认识。
接着问金道权是否认识叶海生、周社荣和杨文道。双方均宣称互不相识。金道权进一步陈述他是 Nagai 纱厂的一名工人，对中山案一无所知。
法官查阅了一些文件后，问金道权为何向公安局作出供述，称谋杀是华克之所为？
金道权否认曾作过此类供述。他说他知道嘉尧案，但他并未参与谋杀。
随后讯问陈恩明。他表示不认识杨文道等人。
鉴于案情已非常清楚，萧法官命令将朱贵生、金道权、陈恩明和张世民送回公安局拘留，因为警方未对他们提出指控。在真如法医研究所检验杨建忠的指纹后，将确定日期继续审理杨文道等人的案件。
随后，警方凭一份文件将朱某及其他三人送往公安局。杨文道及另外两人被拘押在警察局。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. M. P. RECORDS.
No. D 7073
Date 12 / 9 / 36

September 12, 1936. Morning Translation.

NIPPO

FINDING OF TWO DEAD BODIES: IS IT A CASE OF A
COMMUNIST MURDER?

A post-mortem examination
of the two dead bodies of a man and woman found under the
floor of the Hongkew Hospital, No. 290 Chaupoong Road, will
be held at the Fearon Road Mortuary on the afternoon of
September 11. The result of the inquest will to a certain
extent solve the mystery. Detectives attached to ayside
Police Station are endeavouring to locate the whereabouts
of Liang Nyo Mei, who is reported to have left the premises
accompanied by a man who is believed to be her lover.
Neighbours, when questioned
at the Station, have stated that a rumour is current to the
effect that Liang and her lover are Communists. It is
believed that Communists are responsible for the murder of
these two persons. According to a statement made at the
Station by one Wong, a maid-servant employed by Liang,
telephone calls were received on September 8 and 9 respective-
ly from Liang asking, "Anything happened?".
The Police Authorities are
investigating the case with a belief that Liang is still alive.

NICHINICHI

EDITOR OF THE "TA KUNG PAO" PROSECUTED BY THE
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

In publishing a translation
of an article appearing in the September 11 issue of the
"Ta Kung Pao" concerning the prosecution of the editor of
the newspaper by the Shanghai Municipal Police, the Nichi-
Nichi states that attention is being paid to the judgement
to be given by the Court on September 17 as it will constitute
a precedent for future procedure.

MAINICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE: HEARING OF FOUR SUSPECTS: CONFESSION
MADE BY FORCE; SUBTERFUGE OF BUREAU OF PUBLIC SAFETY
EXPOSED

At 2.30 p.m. September 11 the
second hearing of the four suspects in the Nakayama case,
who were arrested by the Bureau of Public Safety, was held
at the First Special District Court. The hearing was held
in camera. Yesterday's hearing was watched with special
interest as it would prove whether the confessions of the
four accused had been obtained by torture at the hands of the
Chinese authorities, who are afraid to expose the connection
of the Nanking Government with Yang Ven Tao, Yih Hai Sung
and Chou Tsu Yong, the three accused in the Nakayama case.
The Court was amazed when it was announced that there was
no evidence to substantiate a charge against the suspects
as : confessions had been obtained by the use of torture.
The Court adjourned at 5.10 p.m.

工部局警务处档案。
编号 D 7073
日期 1936年9月12日

1936年9月12日。晨间译件。

《日本日报》（NIPPO）

发现两具尸体：是否为共产党谋杀案？

将于9月11日下午在斐伦路（Fearon Road）殓房对在乍浦路290号虹口医院地板下发现的一男一女两具尸体进行尸检。验尸结果将在一定程度上解开谜团。隶属于爱赛德（ayside，原文如此，疑为Avenue或某巡捕房名音译）巡捕房的侦探正努力寻找梁纽梅（Liang Nyo Mei，音译）的下落，据报她已与一名被认为是其情夫的男子一同离开住所。
邻居们在巡捕房接受询问时表示，目前流传着一种说法，称梁及其情夫均为共产党员。人们相信这两人被杀系共产党人所为。据梁雇用的一名女佣黄氏（Wong，音译）在巡捕房所作的陈述，梁分别于9月8日和9日打来电话，询问：“出什么事了吗？”
警方当局正在调查此案，并认为梁仍然活着。

《日日新闻》（NICHINICHI）

《大公报》编辑遭上海公共租界工部局警务处起诉

《日日新闻》在刊登一篇关于上海公共租界工部局警务处起诉该报编辑的译文（该文见于9月11日出版的《大公报》）时指出，人们正关注法院将于9月17日作出的判决，因为该判决将为今后的诉讼程序树立先例。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

中山案：四名嫌疑人受审：供词系刑讯逼供所得；公安局的诡计被揭穿

9月11日下午2时30分，第一特区法院对由公安局逮捕的中山案四名嫌疑人进行了第二次审讯。审讯不公开进行。昨天的审讯受到特别关注，因为它将证实这四名被告的供词是否系中国当局刑讯逼供所得；中国当局因害怕暴露南京政府与中山案三名被告杨文道（Yang Ven Tao，音译）、易海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）和周祖庸（Chou Tsu Yong，音译）之间的联系而不敢公开真相。
当宣布没有证据支持对嫌疑人的指控，因为供词是通过酷刑获取时，法庭感到震惊。法庭于下午5时10分休庭。

when King Tao Chuen will be examined.
Naval Resident Officer Okino,
Assistanɡ Commissioner Uyehara of the Special Political
Office of the S.M.P., Mr. Iieu, Assistant Municipal
Advocate, Mr. Tanaka, Secretary and Inspector Okumura of
the Japanese Consulate, Mr. Okamoto, lawyer, and a
lawyer for the defence, attended the hearing. Three
suspects named Chen An Min, Tsu Kwei Sung and Chang Yui
Hwa were brought before the Court.
Assistant Municipal Advocate Lieu
stated as follows:-
"The statements made by the
four accused are different when compared with the statements
made to the Bureau of Public Safety. According to an
examination conducted by the Bureau of Public Safety,
the suspects are involved in the Nakayama and Kayau
cases and that they are planning to commit a similar
offence. As a result of . investigations made
by the Special Political Office of the S.M.P. it has been
ascertained that they are not concerned with the cases.
The S.M.P. has made an investigation into the Nakayama
case and found that the suspects are not connected with
the Nakayama case. Mr. Lieu requested the Judge to
return the suspects to the Bureau of Public Safety after
examination. The Judge then examined Tsu, after
Chen and Chang had been escorted out of the Court.
Tsu came to Shanghai in August,
the 22 year of Republic of China and went back to his
native place in January, in the 23 year of Republic of China.
He came to Shanghai again in April, the 24 year of Republic
of China.. When questioned by the Judge whether he
was acquainted with Chang Yui Hwa and Chen An Min, Tsu
replied that he knew them by sight, as they lived in the
same village. He further stated that on November 9,
1935 he had visited the Post Office in order to send
money to his native village. In connection with this
statement the S.M.P. has made an inquiry and found it to
be true. Tsu also stated to the Court that he had been
tortured and had been forced to place his thumb print
on a document written by representatives of the Bureau
of Public Safety. (To be continued)

1936年9月12日。    晨间译件
-2-

昨日已进行审讯，并定于今日上午9时继续审讯，届时将对金道全（King Tao Chuen，音译）进行讯问。
海军驻在官奥野（Okino）、工部局警务处特别政治股副督察长上原（Uyehara，音译）、助理市检察官刘氏（Lieu，音译）、日本领事馆秘书田中（Tanaka）及 inspector 奥村（Okumura，音译）、律师冈本（Okamoto，音译）以及辩护律师出席了审讯。三名名为陈安民（Chen An Min，音译）、朱桂松（Tsu Kwei Sung，音译）和张玉华（Chang Yui Hwa，音译）的嫌疑人被带上法庭。
助理市检察官刘氏陈述如下：
“四名被告所作的陈述与他们在公安局所作的陈述不同。根据公安局进行的审讯，嫌疑人卷入了中山案和嘉友（Kayau，音译）案，并且正策划实施类似的犯罪。经工部局警务处特别政治股调查，已查明他们与这些案件无关。工部局警务处对中山案进行了调查，发现嫌疑人与中山案无关。刘氏请求法官在讯问后将嫌疑人交还公安局。随后，在陈和张被带出法庭后，法官讯问了朱。
朱于中华民国二十二年八月来到上海，并于中华民国二十三年一月返回家乡。他于中华民国二十四年四月再次来到上海。当法官问他是否认识张玉华和陈安民时，朱回答说他们住在同一个村子，所以面熟。他还陈述说，1935年11月9日，他曾去邮局向家乡汇款。就此陈述，工部局警务处进行了查询，发现属实。朱还向法庭陈述，他遭受了酷刑，并被迫在公安局代表撰写的一份文件上按下了拇指指印。（待续）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 2073
Date ' / 9 / 36

September I, 1936.    Morning Translation.

MAINICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

On August 28 the Kashing Road
Police arrested a Chinese for the attempted murder of a
Chinese woman. Subsequent inquiries revealed that he was
a member of a secret society conducted by Yang Wen Tao, one
of the three accused in the Nakayama case, and that the
Chinese woman was the wife of Lung Ping San, an important
witness in the Nakayama case.
The secret society to which
the prisoner belonged seems to be attempting to murder
several witnesses in the case in an effort to save Yang
Ven Tao. The examination of the prisoner may bring to
light further facts regarding the Nakayama case.
The attitude of the Chinese
Government and high officials is being watched closely
because the former seems powerless to suppress anti-Japanese
organizations, while the officials are supporting those
secret societies which resort to terroristic action.

NIPPO

SUPPRESSION OF ANTI-JAPANESE MOSQUITO PAPERS
DEMANDED

China's anti-Japanese policy
has been made clear by the Chengtu incident. Furthermore,
it has been exposed by the action of the Chinese authorities
in obstructing the dispatch of newspaper reports from
Chengtu.
The "Shanghai Pao", a mosquito
paper which has a wide circulation, published the following
articles:-
"It is to be hoped that a calm attitude will be
adopted by the Japanese Government and the Japanese
public. Japanese residents in China should make every
effort to improve their business. Their excitement
will only bring great loss to their business and create
ill-feeling among Chinese. The Van Pao San incident
and the massacre of Chinese in Korea five years ago
resulted in great loss to innocent people. If they
realize this they would not resort to violent action."
Another mosquito paper known
as the "Holmes" published the following comment:- "
"The Chengtu incident was not unexpected. It had a
cause. It was a natural measure taken by the people
who could not tolerate Japan's invasion any longer.
However, the Nanking Government has issued a 'good
neighbour order again to show its sincerity. For this
reason, it is to be hoped that the Japanese Government
will adopt a mild attitude so as to minimize the incident.
The Chengtu incident is a great lesson to us, Chinese.
China is now struggling for her existence. The Chinese
people do not wish to become slaves. Resentment, anger
and noise making are useless. Only by fighting can
the humiliations received in the past be wiped off!"
The Chinese authorities have taken
no action against publications containing such inflammatory
expressions. Public opinion demands that the Chinese
Government should take drastic action against papers
publishing anti-Japanese articles.

特别分部登记处。
编号 D 2073
日期 ' / 9 / 36

1936年9月1日。    晨间译件。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

中山案

8月28日，嘉兴路巡捕房逮捕了一名涉嫌谋杀一名中国妇女未遂的中国人。随后的调查显示，他是中山案三名被告之一杨文道所主持的一个秘密社团的成员，而该名中国妇女是中山案重要证人龙平三（Lung Ping San，音译）的妻子。
囚犯所属的秘密社团似乎正企图谋杀该案的多名证人，以挽救杨文道。对该囚犯的审讯可能会揭示有关中山案的更多事实。
中国政府和高官的态度正受到密切监视，因为前者似乎无力镇压反日组织，而高官们则在支持那些采取恐怖行动的秘密社团。

《日本日报》（NIPPO）

要求取缔反日“蚊媒”报刊

成都事件使中国的反日政策明朗化。此外，中国当局阻碍从成都发送新闻报道的行为也暴露了这一点。
发行量广泛的“蚊媒”小报《上海报》发表了以下文章：
“希望日本政府和日本公众保持冷静态度。在华日本人应尽力改善其业务。他们的激动情绪只会给其业务带来巨大损失，并在中国人中造成恶感。万宝山事件和五年前朝鲜屠杀华人事件导致无辜民众遭受巨大损失。如果他们意识到这一点，就不会诉诸暴力行动。”
另一份名为《霍尔姆斯》（Holmes，音译）的“蚊媒”小报发表了以下评论：“
“成都事件并非意外。事出有因。这是无法再容忍日本侵略的人民所采取的自然措施。然而，南京政府再次发布‘睦邻令’以示诚意。因此，希望日本政府采取温和态度，以最小化事件影响。成都事件对我们中国人是一个巨大的教训。中国现在正为生存而奋斗。中国人民不愿成为奴隶。怨恨、愤怒和喧闹是无用的。只有战斗才能洗刷过去受到的耻辱！”
中国当局未对包含此类煽动性言论的出版物采取任何行动。舆论要求中国政府对刊登反日文章的报纸采取严厉行动。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
L.C. No. D
Date

August 6, 1936. Morning Translation.

MAINIGHT

THE NAKAYAMA MURDER CASE

The 11th hearing of the Nakayama case was held at the Special District Court at 2 p.m. yesterday. The Court dealt with the motive of the crime and the political connections of the accused, as submitted to the Court by the S.M.P. and requested the Police to make arrangements so that the persons arrested for the attempted murder of Wang Ching Wei, who are now detained at Nanking, may identify, from photographs, the accused in the Nakayama case as members of the gang responsible for the attempted murder of Wang Ching Wei.

The accused in the Nakayama case, in their statements, declared that their aim was to create a disturbance of the peace and order in Shanghai if their plots to kill Chiang Kai Shek and Wang Ching Wei should fail. Yang Ven Tao, who has been denying everything, admitted that he was the President of the Dong Nyi Association and advisor to the 55th Army (Anti-Japanese army). This shows that the crime was one of political significance.

Yesterday the following officers and lawyers were present in Court:- Senior Staff Officer Osugi of the Japanese Naval Landing Party, Resident Naval Officer Okino, Municipal Advocate Bryan, Assistant Municipal Advocates Ru and Li, Assistant Commissioner Nyehara, officers of the Special Political Office of the S.M.P., Secretary Tanaka of the Japanese Consulate, Tajima, officer in charge of the First Section of the Japanese Consular Police, Aoyagi, officer in charge of the Second Section of the Japanese Consular Police, Lawyer Okamoto and the lawyers for the defence, except Lawyer Kuh. Judges Siao and Chien were on the Bench with Procurators Tang and Chang in attendance.

In opening the proceedings, Assistant Municipal effect Advocate Ru said that the statement made by Yang Ven Tao to the that Yang Kien Choong had implicated him in the Nakayama case was groundless as no evidence had been produced to support the statement. He said that the whereabouts of Yang Kien Choong was unknown. He would produce four important witnesses. He then handed in as an exhibit a copy of a Chinese newspaper of March 31 containing a report of the hearing of the Wang Ching Wei case which was found in the possession of one of the witnesses as well as the registration book of the Moon Palace Hotel.

One of the lawyers for the defence rose and stated that the S.M.P. should produce Yang Kien Choong.

The Judge then asked the lawyer for the address of Yang Kien Choong.

The lawyer replied that Yang Kien Choong was in Hangchow at the beginning of the hearing of this case but lately he was reported to be in Canton. The lawyer further stated that an investigation into the whereabouts of Yang Kien Choong should be made by the S.M.P. and not by the defence. To this the Judge paid no attention.

The Judge then ordered the Court Clerk to read out the Report on the reconstruction of the crime made by Pu Chiao Ying. At the close of the reading the three
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
L.C. 编号 D
日期

1936年8月6日。晨间译件。

《每日新闻》（MAINIGHT，原文拼写错误，应为MAINICHI）

中山谋杀案

中山案第十一次审讯于昨日下午2时在特区法院举行。法庭处理了工部局警务处提交的犯罪动机及被告的政治联系问题，并要求警方作出安排，以便目前拘押在南京的因刺杀汪精卫未遂而被捕的人员，可以通过照片辨认中山案被告是否为负责刺杀汪精卫未遂的团伙成员。

中山案被告在供词中宣称，如果其刺杀蒋介石和汪精卫的阴谋失败，他们的目标是在上海制造骚乱，破坏和平与秩序。一直否认一切指控的杨文道承认，他是东义协会（Dong Nyi Association，音译）会长兼第五十五军（抗日军队）顾问。这表明该犯罪具有政治意义。

昨日出席法庭的官员和律师如下：日本海军陆战队高级参谋大杉（Osugi，音译）、海军驻在官奥野（Okino）、市检察官布莱恩（Bryan）、助理市检察官鲁氏（Ru，音译）和李氏（Li，音译）、副督察长尼哈拉（Nyehara，音译）、工部局警务处特别政治股官员、日本领事馆秘书田中（Tanaka）、日本领事警察第一课负责人田岛（Tajima，音译）、日本领事警察第二课负责人青柳（Aoyagi，音译）、律师冈本（Okamoto）以及除顾律师（Lawyer Kuh，音译）外的辩护律师。肖法官和钱法官坐堂，唐检察官和张检察官列席。

在开庭时，助理市检察官鲁氏说，杨文道所作关于杨建中（Yang Kien Choong，音译）在中山案中牵连他的陈述毫无根据，因为没有提出证据支持该陈述。他说杨建中的下落不明。他将传唤四名重要证人。随后，他作为证物提交了一份3月31日的中文报纸副本，其中包含汪精卫案审讯的报道，该报纸是在一名证人处发现的，此外还有月宫饭店（Moon Palace Hotel）的登记簿。

一名辩护律师起身陈述，工部局警务处应交出杨建中。

法官随即向该律师询问杨建中的地址。

律师回答说，在此案审讯开始时杨建中在杭州，但最近据报道他在广州。律师进一步陈述，对杨建中下落的调查应由工部局警务处进行，而非由辩护方进行。法官对此未予理会。

法官随后命令书记官宣读卜娇英（Pu Chiao Ying，音译）所作的犯罪重建报告。宣读结束时，三名

pages.en:
August 6, 1936.
-2-
Morning Translation.

accused were asked to express their views on the report of
the reconstruction. Two of the accused declared that
they had nothing to say, but Yih Hai Sung stated that the
Amah could have had no time to return to the scene to see
the marine killed if she had run into her master's home as
soon as she heard the pistol shot.
At this moment, one of the lawyers for the defence
asked the Court to produce Yang Kien Choong in Court to
prove the accused innocent, but the Judge did not take up
the request. The Judge then ordered Yang Ven Tao to be
taken to a separate room while he questioned the new witnesses.
After finishing the examination of the witnesses, the Judge
called Yang Ven Tao and questioned him.
Q. What was your position in the Pei San Fellow Countrymen's
Association?
A. I was a member.
Q. Do you know these two letters from the Association?
(Two letters are shown to him.)
A. These letters referred to estate matters in my native
place.
Q. How have the seven persons mentioned in the letter
assisted you?
A. As I was not familiar with conditions at my native place,
these seven persons guided me in dealing with a trouble
at my native place.
Q. One letter mentions "only a few thousand dollars". What
does it mean?
A. Yang Ven Hsiang misappropriated more than $100,000 at
my native place, but "only few thousand dollars" was
mentioned in the letter.
Q. In what kind of political activities were you engaged?
A. I have never been engaged in any kind of political
activities, but in affairs of my native place.
Q. What position did you hold in the 19th Route Army?
A. I held no position and I was not engaged in any political
affair.
Q. Did you know any person in the 19th Route Army?
A. Nobody.
Q. How could you become an advisor to the 55th Army without
being connected with any political affairs.
A. The appointment was made by the 55th Army.
Q. Who was the commander of the 55th Army?
A. I do not know.
Q. And you were appointed advisor without knowing the name
of the Commander?
A. I did not know anything about the appointment because my
friend recommended me to the Army.
Q. Do you know where the 55th Army was stationed?
A. Formerly it was at Paotow in Suiyuan, but I do not know
where it is at present.
Q. How did you communicate with the 55th Army?
A. I never communicated with the army because the Commander
of the army has been changed.
Q. When was the Commander of the army changed?
A. One or two months after my appointment.
Q. In what year?
A. It was probably in June, the 22nd Year of the Republic.
pages.zh:
1936年8月6日。
-2-
晨间译文。

被告被要求就重建报告发表意见。其中两名被告表示无话可说，但叶海松（Yih Hai Sung）称，如果女佣一听到枪声就跑回主人家中，她根本不可能有时间返回现场目睹那名海军陆战队员被杀。

此时，一名辩护律师请求法庭传唤杨建中（Yang Kien Choong）出庭以证明被告无罪，但法官未予采纳。随后，法官命令将杨文涛（Yang Ven Tao）带至另一房间，同时讯问新证人。

在完成对证人的讯问后，法官传唤杨文涛并进行讯问。
问：你在北三同乡会中担任什么职务？
答：我是会员。
问：你认识这两封来自该会的信件吗？
（向他出示两封信件。）
答：这些信件涉及我家乡的地产业务。
问：信中提到的七人是如何协助你的？
答：由于我不熟悉家乡的情况，这七人在处理我家乡的一起纠纷时给予了我指导。
问：其中一封信提到“仅数千元”。这是什么意思？
答：杨文祥（Yang Ven Hsiang）在我家乡侵吞了十万余元，但信中只提到“仅数千元”。
问：你参与了何种政治活动？
答：我从未参与任何政治活动，只处理家乡事务。
问：你在第十九路军中担任什么职务？
答：我未担任任何职务，也未参与任何政治事务。
问：你认识第十九路军中的任何人吗？
答：不认识。
问：既然与任何政治事务无关，你怎么会成为第五十五军的顾问？
答：该任命是由第五十五军作出的。
问：第五十五军的军长是谁？
答：我不知道。
问：你连军长的名字都不知道就被任命为顾问？
答：我对这次任命一无所知，因为是我的朋友向军队推荐了我。
问：你知道第五十五军驻扎在哪里吗？
答：以前驻扎在绥远包头，但我不知道现在驻扎在哪里。
问：你是如何与第五十五军联络的？
答：我从未与该军联络，因为军长已经更换。
问：军长是什么时候更换的？
答：在我受任后的一两个月。
问：哪一年？
答：大概是民国二十二年六月。

pages.en:
August 6, 1936. Morning Translation.

Q. What did you do at Amoy?
A. Nothing.
At this stage, the Judge ordered Yih Hai Sung
to be removed to a separate room, and after this had been
done he continued questioning Yang Ven Tao.
Q. Do you know Chang Yue Hwa?
A. No, I do not know him.
Q. Do you know Lee Foo Tze?
A. No.
Q. You must know Lee Foo Tze because he is a member of the
Dong Nyi Association.
A. There is no such person in the Dong Nyi Association. It
must be the United Fellow Countrymen's Associations.
Q. Is Lee Ven Chi a member of the Dong Nyi Association?
A. No, he is not.
Q. What about Kao Ting?
A. There is no such person in the Fellow Countrymen's Association
or the Dong Nyi Association.
Q. Do you know Chun Loh Ih?
A. No.
Q. Is Chun Loh Ih not a member of the Dong Zung Association?
A. No.
Q. Are Feng Zung, Feng Nyi Wei and Feng Zung Ngoo members
of the Dong Zung Association?
A. No.
Q. Yih Hai Sung has stated that you became a leader when you,
Yih Hai Sung, Feng Zung, Feng Nyi Wei had a meal together.
Is this true?
A. Yih Hai Sung's statement about my leadership is unreliable;
Q. It is said that you, Lee Foo Tze, Yih Hai Sung, Chu Ven
Ying and Kuo Hung had held conferences and organized an
Iron and Blood Association. What happened afterwards?
A. It is untrue. I never tried to organize any association
with Kuo Hung because his views do not agree with mine.
Q. Did you hold a second conference on September 13 to plan
the murder of a Japanese marine?
A. We have nothing to do with Japan, so there was no need for
us to do such a thing.
Q. Did you decide to murder a Japanese marine that night?
A. No, we did not.
Q. Have you ever organized a big body to assassinate high
officials?
A. No.
Q. Are you the leader of the Assassination Corps?
A. No.
Q. When did you return to Shanghai?
A. In November, 25th Year of the Republic.
Q. You made three important plans:- (1) to murder General
Chiang Kai Shek, (2) to attack Wang Ching Wei and (3) to
create disorder. Do you know anything about these matters?
A. No, I know nothing about them.
Q. When was the Dong Zung Association organized?
A. In March, 24th Year of the Republic.
Q. For what object was the organization formed?
A. The organization was formed for the purpose of relief work.
Q. Was the organization registered?
A. Yes.
pages.zh:
1936年8月6日。晨间译文。

问：你在厦门做了什么？
答：什么都没做。
在此阶段，法官命令将叶海松带至另一房间，随后继续讯问杨文涛。
问：你认识张月华（Chang Yue Hwa）吗？
答：不，我不认识他。
问：你认识李福兹（Lee Foo Tze）吗？
答：不认识。
问：你一定认识李福兹，因为他是东义协会的会员。
答：东义协会中没有这个人。一定是各同乡会联合会。
问：李文吉（Lee Ven Chi）是东义协会的会员吗？
答：不，他不是。
问：高廷（Kao Ting）呢？
答：在同乡会或东义协会中都没有这个人。
问：你认识陈洛义（Chun Loh Ih）吗？
答：不认识。
问：陈洛义不是东宗协会的会员吗？
答：不是。
问：冯宗（Feng Zung）、冯义伟（Feng Nyi Wei）和冯宗伍（Feng Zung Ngoo）是东宗协会的会员吗？
答：不是。
问：叶海松称，当你、叶海松、冯宗、冯义伟一起吃饭时，你成为了领袖。这是真的吗？
答：叶海松关于我担任领袖的说法不可靠；
问：据说你、李福兹、叶海松、朱文英（Chu Ven Ying）和郭宏（Kuo Hung）曾举行会议并组织了一个铁血团。后来发生了什么？
答：这不属实。我从未试图与郭宏组织任何团体，因为他的观点与我不合。
问：你们是否在9月13日举行了第二次会议，策划谋杀一名日本海军陆战队员？
答：我们与日本毫无关系，因此没有必要做这种事。
问：那晚你们决定谋杀一名日本海军陆战队员吗？
答：不，我们没有。
问：你是否曾组织大型团体刺杀高官？
答：没有。
问：你是暗杀团的团长吗？
答：不是。
问：你何时回到上海？
答：民国二十五年十一月。
问：你制定了三项重要计划：(1) 谋杀蒋介石将军，(2) 袭击汪精卫，以及 (3) 制造混乱。你对这些事有所了解吗？
答：不，我对此一无所知。
问：东宗协会是何时成立的？
答：民国二十四年三月。
问：该组织成立的目的是什么？
答：该组织的成立旨在进行救济工作。
问：该组织是否注册？
答：是的。

pages.en:
4
August 6, 1936. Morning Translation.

Q. When was the Dong Nyi Association formed?
A. The preparations for the formation of the Dong Nyi
Association were started in March in the 24th Year of
the Republic, and the preparatory work is still going on.
Q. What measures were used to secure members?
A. Drives for membership started from the preparatory
period to the formation of the Association.
Q. Why did you organize the Dong Nyi Association besides
the Dong Zung Association?
A. Because the opinion of some members of the Dong Zung
Association did not agree.
Q. When were the preparations for the formation of the Dong
Zung Association started?
A. The preparations were started prior to my return to
Shanghai.
Q. When was that?
A. It was about July or August in the 23rd Year of the
Republic.
Q. When was the Dong Nyi Association reorganized?
A. In February or March this year.
Q. Why was it dissolved?
A. For financial reasons.
Q. Has the Dong Zung Association three offices at different
places?
A. Yes, but the office from Sung Shing Fong, Range Road,
was removed to Tien Fch Lee, Range Road and after two or three
months it was again removed to Young Chi Lee because the
office in Tien Foh Lee was too large.
Q. Do you know that a room in the Moon Palace Hotel was
engaged in the name of Hsia Chun Ki?
A. No.
Q. Did you know that Room No.9 in the Moon Palace was
engaged?
A. I do not know the name Hsia Chun Ki nor the name of the
Moon Palace Hotel.

(To be continued)
pages.zh:
4
1936年8月6日。晨间译文。

问：东义协会是何时成立的？
答：东义协会的筹备工作始于民国二十四年三月，目前筹备工作仍在进行中。
问：采取了哪些措施来招募会员？
答：从筹备期到协会成立期间，一直开展招募会员的活动。
问：除了东宗协会外，你为什么还要组织东义协会？
答：因为东宗协会部分会员的意见不一致。
问：东宗协会的筹备工作是何时开始的？
答：是在我回到上海之前开始的。
问：那是什么时候？
答：大约是民国二十三年七月或八月。
问：东义协会是何时重组的？
答：今年二月或三月。
问：为何解散？
答：因财务原因。
问：东宗协会在不同地点设有三个办事处吗？
答：是的，但位于虹口路（Range Road）宋兴坊（Sung Shing Fong）的办事处已迁至虹口路天福里（Tien Fch Lee），两三个月后又迁至永吉里（Young Chi Lee），因为天福里（Tien Foh Lee）的办事处太大。
问：你知道夏春基（Hsia Chun Ki）名义下在月宫饭店预订了一个房间吗？
答：不知道。
问：你知道月宫饭店9号房被预订了吗？
答：我既不知道夏春基这个名字，也不知道月宫饭店这个名字。

（待续）

July 31, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

NICHI-NICHI

THROWING OF STONES AT JAPANESE

Yesterday a Japanese lady named
Suwa Tamura, age 34, residing at No. 8 Tsai Ching Fong,
Dixwell Road, appeared at the Japanese C r Police
office and reported that she had been □□□ by a Chinese
at the corner of Woosung Road and Haining Road near the
Japanese Hankow Bank at about 11 a.m. July 28. The
Consular Police reported the matter to the Hongkew Police
and requested them to suppress this stone throwing.

MAINICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

Acting on instructions of the
Nanking Government the Presidents of the First Special
District Court, the Second Special District Court and the
Kiangsu High Court held a secret conference some time
before July 17 and decided that the hearing of Nakayama
case on that date be adjourned to July 31.
On July 17 the Court suddenly
announced an adjournment of the hearing on the pretext
that a further examination of a witness was necessary.
The hearing of July 31 was cancelled at a secret hearing
held the other day. The Court is considering further
continuous adjournments of the case under the pretext of
examining witnesses. For this reason, Japanese
residents have become highly indignant and are demanding
an early decision. The S.M.C. has already opened
negotiations with the Court for a speedy judgement.
The Japanese naval authorities are determined to bring
this about also.

CHINESE POLICEMEN IN PEIPING ASSAULT JAPANESE STUDENT

A Taido telegram from Peiping
reports that on the morning of July 30 Mr. Okamura, a
third Class Secretary of the Japanese Embassy, called on
the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Charhar-Hopei
Political Council and lodged a protest against the
assault on a Japanese student named Ando, age 19, by a
number of Chinese policemen in Peiping on the evening
of July 28 and demanded an apology, the payment of
compensation to the boy, the punishment of the persons
responsible and a guarantee that such incidents will not
occur again.

Assault of a Japanese by 29th Army soldiers

A Taido telegram from Peiping
reports that in spite of the pledge given by the Chinese
authorities when settling the Fengtai incident that there
would be no recurrence of assaults on Japanese by Chinese

1936年7月31日。午后译文。

《日日新闻》

日本人遭投石袭击

昨日，一名名叫Suwa Tamura、34岁、居住于狄思威路（Dixwell Road）蔡庆坊8号的日本女士，出现在日本领事警察局报案，称其于7月28日上午11时许，在吴淞路与海宁路交汇处、靠近日本横滨正金银行附近，被一名中国人□□□（原文不清）。领事警察将此案报告给虹口捕房，并要求他们制止这种投石行为。

《每日新闻》

中山案

奉南京政府指示，第一特区地方法院院长、第二特区地方法院院长及江苏高等法院院长于7月17日前不久举行秘密会议，决定将该日审理的中山案延期至7月31日。
7月17日，法庭突然宣布休庭，借口是需要进一步讯问证人。前几日举行的秘密听证会取消了7月31日的庭审。法庭正考虑以讯问证人为借口，对该案进行进一步的连续延期。为此，日本侨民极为愤慨，要求尽早作出判决。工部局已与法庭展开谈判，要求迅速判决。日本海军当局也决心促成此事。

北平中国警察袭击日本学生

据北平电通社电讯报道，7月30日上午，日本大使馆三等秘书Okamura先生拜访了察哈尔-河北政治委员会外交委员会，就7月28日晚北平多名中国警察袭击一名名叫Ando、19岁的日本学生一事提出抗议，并要求道歉、向该少年支付赔偿、惩办责任人以及保证此类事件不再发生。

第二十九军士兵袭击日本人

据北平电通社电讯报道，尽管中国当局在解决丰台事件时曾承诺不会再发生中国人袭击日本人的事件，但……

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. & R. REGISTRY.
No. D 7073
July 31, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

ALLEGATIONS AGAINST FRENCH POLICE OFFICERS.

At 4 p.m. yesterday, the Executive Committee of the Shanghai Second Special District Citizens Federation held a meeting at its office in Rue Auguste Boppe. Huang Shiang Koh(黃香谷) presided.
The following resolutions were discussed and passed :-
(1) A report has been received from Chu Tseu Sz(朱周氏) stating that her niece, Wong Ai Dee(王愛弟), has been tortured and injured by detectives of the French Police.
Resolved: That letters be sent to the French Consul-General and the Chief of the French Police drawing their attention to the complaint.
(2) The 4th Branch Office requests the Federation to continue the protest with the authorities of the French Concession over the unreasonable shooting of a Chinese resident by Chinese detective Sung Chi Van (孫啓萬) of the French Police.
Resolved: That the matter be dealt with as requested.
(3) The 8th Branch Office transmits a report made by Tsang Sao Ching(張少卿) and Koo Vung Ming(顧文明), stall-keepers at the market on Rue Remi, stating that they have been defrauded over a matter of licences by Chinese detective Lee Yoong Khaung(李永康) of the French Police, and requesting that the detective be severely dealt with according to law and that the money extorted be refunded to them.
Resolved: That letters be sent to the French Consul-General and the Chief of the French Police.

Sin Wan Pao:-

A COMPARISON OF MACADAMIZED ROADS.

Most of the roads in the Foreign Settlements of Shanghai are macadamized because such roads are clean and present a fine appearance and can be easily repaired. However, in a hot summer, the tar begins to melt causing much inconvenience to pedestrians.
Strange to relate, macadamized roads in the Civic Centre at Kiangwan are never affected in this way. According to the Stores Department of the Bureau of Public Works, the tar used is subjected to various processes and is afterwards cooled before it is applied to the surface of a road. That is why the roads in the Civic Centre have not been affected by the recent heat.

"Iron News"(鐵報) :-

THE NAKAYAMA CASE.

The Court is exercising special care in the trial of the case against the three men charged with the murder of Nakayama. It has already conducted three reconstructions of the crime. People are saying that if the deceased had been any other but a Japanese subject, much trouble could have been avoided.
We hope that in future the Court will hear other cases in the same careful manner.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别调查科登记处。

1936年7月31日。午后译文。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

指控法国警官。

昨日下午4时，上海第二特区市民联合会执行委员会在其奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue Auguste Boppe）办公室举行会议。黄香谷主持。
讨论并通过以下决议：
(1) 收到朱周氏报告，称其侄女王爱弟遭受法国捕房侦探刑讯致伤。
决议：致函法国总领事及法国捕房总监，提请其注意该投诉。
(2) 第四分部请求联合会就法国捕房华籍侦探孙启万无理枪击一名中国居民一事，继续向法租界当局提出抗议。
决议：按请求处理此事。
(3) 第八分部转呈雷米路（Rue Remi）市场摊贩张少卿和顾文明的报告，称他们遭到法国捕房华籍侦探李永康在执照事宜上的欺诈，请求依法严惩该侦探，并退还勒索款项。
决议：致函法国总领事及法国捕房总监。

《辛闻报》：

柏油路之比较。

上海公共租界的大部分道路均为柏油路，因为此类道路清洁、美观且易于修补。然而，在炎热的夏季，柏油开始融化，给行人带来诸多不便。
奇怪的是，江湾市中心区的柏油路从未受到此种影响。据工务局物料处称，所使用的柏油经过多种工序处理，并在铺设于路面之前进行冷却。这就是为什么市中心区的道路未受近期高温影响的原因。

《铁报》：

中山案。

法庭在审理三名被控谋杀中山的男子案件时格外谨慎。已进行了三次犯罪现场重建。人们议论说，如果死者不是日本臣民，本可避免许多麻烦。
我们希望法庭今后能以同样谨慎的态度审理其他案件。

August 1, 1936.    Morning Translation.

NIPPO

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

In connection with the Nakayama case, the Special District Court yesterday afternoon issued a notice to the effect that the hearing of the case would be resumed at 2 p.m. August 5.
On August 5 the Japanese authorities will wait to see whether the Court will fix the date when judgement will be delivered and in case no announcement is made they are determined to take a certain course of action.

The Nippo publishes the following leading article:-
Yesterday the Court announced that the next hearing of the Nakayama case would be held on August 5. It is to be hoped that at that hearing the Court will fix the date for the delivery of judgement. The Court has examined all the witnesses and exhibits relating to the case and there is nothing left for further examination. For this reason, it is only natural for the Japanese authorities to take definite action should the Court again adjourn the hearing.

NICHI-NICHI

In November, 1933 acting on instructions from General Chen Ming Chu and General Tsai Ting Kai, the accused Yih Hai Sung and Yang Ven Tao planned disturbances to the rear of the Nanking Government army during the revolutionary movement in Fukien. Yang Ven Tao and Yih Hai Sung established secret organs at Nanking, Wenchow, Hangchow and Hsiang-chow to assassinate high officials of the Nanking Government, to destroy the positions of the Central Government forces and to wreck the lines of the Nanking-Shanghai Railway and the Shanghai-Hangchow Railway, but their plans failed because the revolutionary movement ended within two months.
At II p.m. January 3, 1934 Yih Hai Sung together with several members of his gang was arrested by the Shanghai-Woosung Defence Commissioner at the Moon Palace Hotel, North Szechuen Road, for holding a secret meeting. Upon learning of this , Yang Ven Tao, who was in Hongkong at that time, made every effort to influence the Shanghai City Government and the Nanking Government through members of the Cantonese Fellow Countrymen's Association to release Yih Hai Sung. His efforts succeeded. After being saved from execution by Yang Ven Tao, Yih Hai Sung proceeded to Hongkong in July, 1934, where he was received by Wang Ah Shao, the principal in the attempted murder of Wang Ching Wei, and joined the anti-Nanking Party. In October, 1934 Yih Hai Sung returned to Shanghai and an Iron and Blood National Salvation Association was organized by the

1936年8月1日。晨间译件。

《日日新闻》（NIPPO）

中山案

关于中山案，特区地方法院昨日下午发布公告，称该案审理将于8月5日下午2时恢复进行。
8月5日，日本当局将观望法院是否确定宣判日期，若未作宣布，他们决心采取某种行动。

《日日新闻》发表如下社论：——
昨日，法院宣布中山案的下次听证将于8月5日举行。希望在此次听证中，法院能确定宣判日期。法院已讯问与本案有关的所有证人并查验所有物证，已无进一步审查之必要。因此，若法院再次延期审理，日本当局采取果断行动也是理所当然的。

《日日新闻》（NICHI-NICHI）

1933年11月，被告易海松（Yih Hai Sung，音译）和杨文道（Yang Ven Tao，音译）奉陈铭枢将军和蔡廷锴将军之指令，计划在福建革命运动期间扰乱南京政府军队后方。杨文道和易海松在南京、温州、杭州和湘州（Hsiang-chow，音译）设立秘密机关，意图刺杀南京政府高官，破坏中央政府部队阵地，并毁坏京沪铁路和沪杭铁路线路，但因革命运动在两个月内结束，其计划未能得逞。
1934年1月3日晚11时，易海松及其团伙数名成员因在北四川路月宫饭店举行秘密会议，被上海吴淞警备司令逮捕。杨文道当时身在香港，获悉此事后，竭力通过广东同乡会成员影响上海市政府和南京政府，以释放易海松。其努力获得成功。易海松经杨文道营救免于一死后，于1934年7月前往香港，在那里受到刺杀汪精卫未遂案主犯王亚樵（Wang Ah Shao，音译）的接待，并加入了反南京党派。1934年10月，易海松返回上海，由东亚协会（Dong Nyi Association，音译）成员组织成立了铁血救国会。他出席了该新协会的成立仪式，杨文道、朱霞英（Chu Hsia Ying，音译）、李农（Li Nung，音译）、李应金（Li Ying Chin，音译）、郭宏利（Kuo Hung Li，音译）和Foo Tz（音译）等人也出席了仪式。

members of the Dong Nyi Association. He attended the
inauguration of the new association at which Yang Ven
Tao, Chu Hsia Ying, Li Nung, Li Ying Chin, Kuo Hung Li
and Foo Tz were also present. The aim of the
Association was the assassination of two high Japanese
naval officials. Cutting a finger in the presence
of all those present as proof of his loyalty to the
Association, Yih Hai Sung attended a conference to
consider plans of assassination. In September, 1935
Yih Hai Sung went to Tsingtao to find a job, but
returned to Shanghai as he could not find work. He
occupied house No. 13 in San Sin Lee, Jukong Road, near
the Moon Palace Hotel and resided there with his
sweetheart named Chen Kwi Tseng. After the Nakayama
incident, he removed his sweetheart to a certain place
in the French Concession. On Nov. 30, Yih went to Tsingtao
at the invitation of the Hollywood Cabaret there. On
December 14, Yih Hai Sung returned to Shanghai in order
to engage dancing partners for the Vienna Dance Hall
of which he was the proprietor. Ostensibly Yih Hai
Sung was the manager but in reality he had bought the
hall for $1,500 after the murder of Nakayama and made
his sweetheart as the owner of the hall. Yih Hai
Sung spent more than $700 after his return to Shanghai.
He was in possession of several bank deposit books
for various amounts totalling over $600. One month
prior to the Nakayama murder he was destitute. How
did he come into possession of such a large amount of
money in such a short period of time? It is clear
that Yih Hai Sung had been paid $600 by General Chen
Ming Chu to kill high Japanese naval officials and that
after the Nakayama murder he was paid a further sum
of $10,000.

该协会的目标是刺杀两名日本海军高官。易海松在所有在场人员面前割指以示对协会的忠诚，随后参加了一场商讨刺杀计划的会议。1935年9月，易海松前往青岛找工作，但因找不到工作而返回上海。他居住在靠近月宫饭店的菊康路（Jukong Road，音译）三辛里（San Sin Lee，音译）13号房屋，并与名为陈桂珍（Chen Kwi Tseng，音译）的情妇同住。中山事件发生后，他将情妇转移至法租界某处。11月30日，易海松应青岛好莱坞歌舞厅之邀前往青岛。12月14日，易海松返回上海，为其所有的维也纳舞厅招募舞伴。表面上易海松是经理，但实际上他在中山遇刺后以1,500美元买下了该舞厅，并让其情妇成为舞厅所有者。易海松回到上海后花费了700多美元。他持有数本银行存款折，总金额超过600美元。在中山遇刺前一个月，他还身无分文。他是如何在如此短的时间内拥有如此巨款的？显然，易海松曾收受陈铭枢将军支付的600美元，用于刺杀日本海军高官，且在中山遇刺后又收到了10,000美元的款项。

August 1, 1936. Morning translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers:-

NAKAYAMA MURDER CASE TO BE RESUMED AUGUST 5

It is learned that in order to expedite the hearing of the Nakayama murder case, the First Shanghai Special District Court has decided to resume the hearing at 2 p.m. August 5.

Approached by our reporter, Tang Wei Chuin (唐懷), one of the lawyers for the defence, made the following statements:- "Article 108 of the Code of Criminal Procedure stipulates: 'Detention of an accused may not exceed three months during trial; however, if it is necessary to extend the period of detention, the Court may do so by a ruling, prior to the expiration of the period. Each extention of the period of detention must not exceed two months'. Therefore, the Court has now extend the period of detention of the three accused. The next hearing will be on August 5.

"On July 31, a certain evening newspaper reported that as the Court had decided to hear the case again, the report of an extention of the period of detention of the accused for two months could not be believed. This is due to a misunderstanding of the law. Up to the present, I have not yet received a notice from the Court regarding the next hearing of the case."

1936年8月1日。晨间译件。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：——

中山谋杀案将于8月5日恢复审理

据悉，为加快中山谋杀案的审理进度，上海第一特区地方法院决定于8月5日下午2时恢复审理。

本报记者采访辩护律师之一唐怀琴（Tang Wei Chuin，音译，原文注：唐懷），其发表如下声明：——“《刑事诉讼法》第108条规定：‘审判期间对被告的羁押不得超过三个月；但如有必要延长羁押期限，法院可在期限届满前以裁定方式延长。每次延长羁押期限不得超过两个月’。因此，法院现已延长三名被告的羁押期限。下次听证将于8月5日进行。

“7月31日，某晚报报道称，鉴于法院决定再次审理此案，关于延长被告羁押期限两个月的报道不可信。这是对法律的误解。截至目前，我尚未收到法院关于下次案件听证的通知书。”

August 2, 1936. Morning Translation.

MAINICHI

KUOMINTANG PROTECTS SECRET ORGANIZATIONS

The activities of the various
secret organizations on behalf of Yang Ven Tao and Yih
Hai Sung, two of the accused in the Nakayama case, have
already been exposed. Great interest is being attached
to the hearing of the Nakayama case on August 5. The
Central Kuomintang and the District Kuomintang are reported
to be giving indirect protection to a secret organization
known as "Hung Shing" whose object is to plan assassinations
and anti-Japanese movements. Not long ago the District
Kuomintang directed an anti-Japanese play. Li Dah Chao
and William Gockson, members of the City Government,
are reported to have attended a conference held by representa-
tives of various secret societies to consider ways and
means to save the accused in the Nakayama case. Sino-
Japanese rapprochement never can be realized so long as
the District Kuomintang is giving indirect protection to
such secret organizations whose aim is to carry out
assassinations and anti-Japanese activities.

THE KAYAU CASE

Three weeks have elapsed since
the murder of Kayau on Chi Mei Road and no arrests have
yet been effected by the Chinese Police. Most of the
reward posters that had been put up on walls by the Chinese
authorities have been torn off. The Chinese police have
not found a single clue.
Mr. Liang, officer in charge
of the North Railway Station Branch of the Bureau of Public
Safety, is said to be considering his resignation.
The Chinese authorities have not
conducted any investigation into the various secret organiza-
tions and have paid no heed to the secret information
secured in connection with the Nakayama case. The Chinese
authorities do not seem to be sincerely investigating the
Kayau case.

NIPPO

ANTI-JAPANESE BOYCOTT MOVEMENT OF CHINESE
MIDDLE SCHOOL STUDENTS

It is reported that the students
of 16 Chinese middle schools in Shanghai have organized
a National Products Encouragement Association to carry out
an anti-Japanese boycott movement for 10 days as from
July 30.
Five groups of students are
to carry out propaganda on Nanking Road; six groups will
operate in the Eastern District and Wayside district; five
groups will visit the Old West Gate district.
pages.zh:
1936年8月2日。晨间译件。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

国民党庇护秘密组织

中山案两名被告杨文道和易海松所属各秘密组织的活动已被揭露。人们对8月5日中山案的审理极为关注。据报道，国民党中央党部和区党部正在间接保护一个名为“洪兴”（Hung Shing，音译）的秘密组织，该组织旨在策划刺杀和开展反日运动。不久前，区党部指导了一出反日戏剧。据报道，市政府成员李大钊（Li Dah Chao，音译）和William Gockson（音译）出席了由各秘密社团代表举行的会议，商讨营救中山案被告的方法。只要区党部继续间接保护这些以实施刺杀和从事反日活动为目的的秘密组织，中日亲善就永远无法实现。

加尧案

自加尧（Kayau，音译）在集美路（Chi Mei Road，音译）被杀以来，三周时间已过，中国警方仍未实施任何逮捕。中国当局张贴在墙上的大部分悬赏告示已被撕毁。中国警方未发现任何线索。
据称，公安局北站分局负责人梁警官（Mr. Liang，音译）正考虑辞职。
中国当局未对各秘密组织进行任何调查，也未重视在中山案中获取的秘密情报。中国当局似乎并未真诚地调查加尧案。

《日日新闻》（NIPPO）

中国中学生反日抵制运动

据报道，上海16所中国中学的学生组织了一个国货促进会，自7月30日起开展为期10天的反日抵制运动。
五组学生将在南京路进行宣传；六组将在东区和路边区（Wayside district，音译）活动；五组将前往老西门区。

August 5, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

MAINICHI

THE NAKAYAMA CASE

The Mainichi publishes the
following leading article:-
The IIth hearing of the Nakayama
case will be held to-day. The S.M.P. have submitted
very detailed evidence.
Yih Hai Sung at one time admitted
the crime but later denied it. Yang Ven Tao denied any
connection with the crime. It is natural for an accused
to deny a crime even in the face of so much material evidence.
The crime had been planned by a secret society.
Should a Judge handle a case
like this by simply relying upon the declaration of the
accused, he would be abusing his authority. It is generally
known that members of a secret society will never confess
a crime committed by the society and no Court has the
power to make the accused confess. In such cases, the
Court has to rely upon the evidence only. We wish to
bring this point to the attention of the Court. The lawyers
for the defence are maintaining that Vang Ven Tao is an
upright man and that Yih Hai Sung is as timid as a girl.
But no person has appeared in Court to prove this; instead,
all the friends of Yang Ven Tao ran away soon after his
arrest. One of the lawyers for the defence at one time
stated in Court that a man named Yang Kien Choong had framed
Yang Ven Tao, but Yang Kien Choong was never produced in
Court. Furthermore, the lawyers for the defence have
produced no evidence to support this.
The hearing to be held to-day
will fix the date for final judgement as the Court has
examined the evidence produced by the prosecution and the
lawyers for the defence have produced no evidence for
examination.

NIPPO

THE ANTI-JAPANESE BOYCOTT ACTIVITIES OF THE CHINESE
CUSTOMS

Of late, the Shanghai Customs
has adopted anti-Japanese boycott measures by oppressing
the importation of Japanese goods. About a week ago, the
Customs adopted oppressive measures against even British,
American and other foreign traders dealing in Japanese
goods by discriminatory treatment against them. The action
gave rise to much dissatisfaction among foreign traders
and as a result the International Chamber of Commerce in

following firms are reported to be affected by the policy

Fragen & Co., Reuter, Brochelmann & Co. Moler Grenail & Co.,
Dunlop Rubber Co., Imperial Chemical Industries, Harvie,
Cooke & Co., Andersen, Meyer Co. and Tenton Chemical Factory.
Besides the European firms,
many Japanese merchants have also suffered. The following

1936年8月5日。午后译件。

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

中山案

《每日新闻》发表如下社论：——
中山案第11次听证将于今日举行。工部局警务处提交了非常详尽的证据。
易海松一度承认犯罪，但后来予以否认。杨文道否认与犯罪有任何关联。面对如此多的物证，被告否认犯罪是自然之事。
该犯罪是由一个秘密社团策划的。
如果法官仅凭被告的供词来处理此类案件，那就是滥用职权。众所周知，秘密社团成员绝不会承认社团所犯罪行，任何法院也无权强迫被告招供。在此类案件中，法院只能依靠证据。我们提请法院注意这一点。辩护律师声称杨文道是正人君子，而易海松胆小如鼠。但无人出庭证明这一点；相反，杨文道的所有朋友在其被捕后不久便逃跑了。一名辩护律师曾在法庭上称，一名叫杨建中（Yang Kien Choong，音译）的人诬陷了杨文道，但杨建中从未被传唤出庭。此外，辩护律师也未提供证据支持这一说法。
鉴于法院已审查控方提供的证据，而辩护律师未提供证据供审查，今日的听证将确定最终判决日期。

pages.en:
August 8, 1936. Morning Translation.

NIPPO :

MERITORIOUS WORK OF SPECIAL POLITICAL OFFICE,
S.M.P., IN NAKAYAMA CASE.

The Nakayama case, at one time,
seem fated to be placed in the list of unsolved crimes,
but thanks to the fine work performed by the Special
Political Office of the S.M.P. it is now about to be
cleared up.

The Special Political Office
courageously tackled the Red Pang (a clique which had
never been attacked before) and effected the arrest of
Yang Ven Tao and Yih Hai Sung. The Nakayama case is the
biggest case that has been handled by the Shanghai
Municipal Police. The success of the Special Political
Office has enhanced the reputation of the Shanghai Municipal
Police.

The Special Political Office
was established by the S.M.P. on November 15, 1935,
immediately after the Nakayama case, for the sole purpose
of conducting the investigation into the case and to deal
with anti-Japanese activities. After six months of hard
work, the Office effected the arrest of Yang Ven Tao and
Yih Hai Sung, two of the accused in the Nakayama case.

When the Office was established,
Mr. Robertson, Assistant Commissioner of Police, was in
charge, but when Mr. Robertson was appointed Officer-in-
charge of the Special Branch of the S.M.P., Mr. Uyehara,
another Assistant Commissioner of Police, took over the
Special Political Office.

The Office has the following
staff: Mr. Uyehara, Assistant Commissioner of Police,
Detective Inspector Nakamura, Detective Sub-Inspector
Umemoto, Detective Sergeants Iguchi and Hasuo, Detective
Constable Tanaka and Clerical Assistant Kawashima. The
Office is given the special privilege of securing the
service of foreign or Chinese constables whenever it is
required.

The Special Political Office has
performed meritorious work with its well disciplined staff.
Inspector Nakamura and Detective
Tanaka arrested Yih Hai Sung at the Vienna Dance Hall at
Tsingtao. The report of the difficulties they encountered
in effecting Yih Hai Sung's arrest is still fresh in our
memory.

Detective Sergeant Hasuo and
Detective Osano worked three days and nights continuously
without rest to bring about the arrest of Yang Ven Tao, a
man who has 4,000 followers.

Clerical Assistant Kawashima, with
his excellent knowledge of English, translated 400 pages of
Japanese documents into English in one evening, April 8.

Detective Sergeant Iguchi is now
on sick leave owing to his hard work in the Nakayama case.
Such hard work can be done by Japanese only.
pages.zh:
1936年8月8日。晨间译件。

《日日新闻》：

上海公共租界工部局警务处特别政治股在中山案中的卓著功绩。

中山案一度似乎注定要列入未破案件之列，但得益于上海公共租界工部局警务处特别政治股的出色工作，该案即将告破。

特别政治股勇敢地着手对付“红帮”（一个此前从未受到打击的帮派），并成功逮捕了杨文道和叶海生。中山案是上海公共租界工部局警务处处理过的最大案件。特别政治股的成功提升了上海公共租界工部局警务处的声誉。

特别政治股由上海公共租界工部局警务处于1935年11月15日成立，紧接在中山案发生之后，其唯一目的是对该案进行调查并处理反日活动。经过六个月的艰苦工作，该股成功逮捕了中山案的两名被告杨文道和叶海生。

该股成立时，由副巡官罗伯逊先生（Mr. Robertson）负责，但当罗伯逊先生被任命为上海公共租界工部局警务处特别部主任时，另一位副巡官上原先生（Mr. Uyehara）接管了特别政治股。

该股人员配置如下：副巡官上原先生、警探长中村（Nakamura）、副警探长梅本（Umemoto）、警佐井口（Iguchi）和长尾（Hasuo）、警员田中（Tanaka）以及文书助理川岛（Kawashima）。该股享有特权，可根据需要随时调派外籍或华籍警员协助工作。

特别政治股凭借其纪律严明的职员队伍，建立了卓著功绩。警探长中村和警探田中在青岛的维也纳舞厅逮捕了叶海生。他们在逮捕叶海生过程中所遭遇困难的报告，至今仍让我们记忆犹新。

警佐长尾和警探大曾野（Osano）连续三天三夜不眠不休地工作，促成了拥有四千名追随者的杨文道的被捕。

文书助理川岛凭借其出色的英语知识，在4月8日的一个晚上将400页日文文件翻译成英文。

警佐井口因在中山案中过度劳累，目前正在病假中。如此艰苦的工作只有日本人才能完成。

August 8, 1936. Morning Translation.

- 2 -

On April 9 the investigation into
the case was completed and a report was submitted to Major
Gerrard, Commissioner of Police. The Commissioner was
pleasantly surprised at the rapid work achieved by the
officers.
The meritorious work of the Special
Political Office will make the public have a better
appreciation of the S.M.P.
Yang Ven Tao and Yih Hai Sung are
members of the Red Pang. Even the Chinese Police have
never tackled the Red Pang, but the Special Political Office,
which is organized with a Japanese staff, attacked it and
arrested the ringleaders. The Special Political Office
also deals with anti-Japanese activities and the Kayau case.
It has also examined the members of the Iron and Blood Corps
who were arrested the other day.

1936年8月8日。晨间译件。

4月9日，对该案的调查结束，并向警务处处长杰拉德少校（Major Gerrard）提交了报告。处长对警官们迅速完成的工作感到惊喜。

特别政治股的卓著功绩将使公众更好地认可上海公共租界工部局警务处。

杨文道和叶海生是“红帮”成员。甚至中国警察也从未对付过“红帮”，但由日本职员组成的特别政治股对其进行了打击，并逮捕了其头目。特别政治股还处理反日活动及加藤案（Kayau case）。它还审讯了日前被捕的铁血团成员。
