3
1936年6月17日。晨间译件。

大中华酒楼举行仪式庆祝母亲生日的说法不可靠。考司脫寄给叶的介绍信中指出，杰克是他们的特别朋友。这表明叶与杰克关系密切。去年冬天抵达青岛时，叶衣着光鲜，并频繁光顾舞厅。这表明叶在杀害日本海军陆战队员后有钱财。关于叶平日里的行为，月宫舞厅经理宓保生将作证称，叶是一个与帮派有牵连的坏人”。
随后，市政律师提交了两张显示中山受伤情况的照片供参考，以及两名名为“尤因”（Yeu Yin，音译）和“狄克生”（Dickson，音译）的外籍职员提交的报告，他们受工部局警务处指派前往陈诸法医实验室，与其他官员一同进行检查。
回答萧法官的提问时，叶海生说：-
那套西装和照片是我的财产。我不记得照片中展示的那条裤子是否是我当时所穿。在我姐夫家搜获的那封信，是去年六月考司脫和一个姓李的人写给我的，将我介绍给杰克。后来，杰克在青岛的一家舞厅拜访了我。因我未予款待，故他对我怀恨在心。因担心杰克日后可能加害于我，我将信放在姐夫家保管。因此，杰克拿出了这封信作为证据。如果我是与杰克一起杀害了日本海军陆战队员，我姐夫难道不会销毁这封信吗？信中说杰克是我们特别好的朋友。这是考司脫和杰克说的。我不知道杰克为何去青岛。
法官随即询问叶，被扣押的请柬和协议是否属于他。
叶予以肯定，并继续说道：-
“关于开设舞厅一事，起初我承诺入股1,000元，因为我打算找人入股。最终，我只支付了250元。这笔钱由我的妻子莊桂宗从交通银行取出，并汇往青岛”。
法官询问警方是否已向交通银行查询。
巡官克劳瑟：奉法庭指示，我于5月8日前往交通银行查询存款人莊桂宗的情况。有两个莊桂宗；一个住在同山路。今年3月17日，此人存入定期存款300元，4月23日，此人以该定期存款为抵押从该行贷款250元。另一名存款人居住在吴淞路藏安里18号，是老客户，与该行业务往来已有数年。目前该存款人有存款258.20元，但在过去八个月内，没有大额资金存入或提取。
经萧法官讯问，叶海生说：-
“我妻子住在藏安里，很可能就是这个人”。

pages.en:
June 17, 1936.
Morning Translation.

Yih Hai Sung's lawyer here stood up and stated that he had two points to explain. The letter of introduction produced by the Police had not only failed to prove the connection between Yih Hai Sung and Jack, but showed that Yih and Jack were unknown to each other in the beginning, otherwise an introduction would not have been necessary.

Asked by the Court as to when the photo seized in Tsingtao was taken, Yih Hai Sung replied that it was taken in February or March of this year.

Lee Hung Ping(李鴻賓), native of Tientsin, the watchman of Foong Loh Li(丰樂里), gave the following evidence:- "I am on duty at 6 a.m. and off at 6 p.m. every day. On the night of the murder of the Japanese marine, I was already fast asleep. Some persons woke me up. They opened the police box in the alleyway and after taking a look inside the box they went away. There were Japanese among them."

Judge Hsiao: "Did you know at that time whether anybody had thrown a pistol into your box?"
Lee: "I did not know."

The second witness called was Yao Soong Ding (姚松庭), native of Yangchow, a private detective of the Nanyang Dance Hall(南洋舞廳), who testified as follows:- "The Nanyang Dance Hall has closed and re-opened for business three or four times. It was also known as the Nanyang Kung Kee Dance Hall. The dance hall was re-opened on one occasion on November 8 last year, as per the letter of appointment addressed to me by the dance hall and which has been handed over to the Police for safe-keeping. Many patrons attended the dance hall on the opening day and I cannot remember whether Yih Hai Sung was present or not."

Addressing Yih Hai Sung, Judge Hsiao asked :- "You have stated that you were present at the opening of the Nanyang Dance Hall on the 9th and that you had no part in the murder of the Japanese marine. However, according to the evidence of this witness, the dance hall was opened on the 8th. Which is the actual date?"

Yih Hai Sung:- "I cannot remember the date, but I was actually present on the opening day. On that day Yui Wei Ming(余偉民) and I assaulted a dancing partner and Yao Soong Ding came up to mediate."

Judge Hsiao then again asked Yao Soong Ding :- "Is Chang Zai Yuan(張財源) an employee of the Nanyang Dance Hall?"

Yao Soong Ding replied that he did not know.

Mih Pao Sung(宓保生), manager of the Moon Palace Dance Hall, then gave the following evidence :- "I know Yih Hai Sung, Tseu Shou Yong and the Korean named Jack. They came to dance frequently. I do not know whether Yih was present at my place on the night of November 9. Later, I heard patrons say that Yih Hai Sung and Jack had robbed somebody of $20,000 and that Yih had received a share of $5,000. In February, Proprietor Kao (高) of the King Sing Dance Hall(金星舞場), accompanied by officers of the Japanese Military Headquarters, came to my place and asked me whether Jack had ever been in possession of a pistol and created trouble in my dance hall, and whether he was frequently in the company of certain Cantonese at ordinary
pages.zh:
1936年6月17日。
晨间译稿。

叶海生的律师起立陈述，称有两点需要说明。警方出示的介绍信不仅未能证明叶海生与杰克（Jack）之间存在关联，反而表明叶与杰克起初互不相识，否则便无需介绍。

法庭询问在青岛查获的照片拍摄于何时，叶海生回答说，拍摄于今年二月或三月。

丰乐里更夫、天津人李鸿宾提供如下证词：“我每日早上6点上岗，晚上6点下班。在日本海军陆战队员被杀的那晚，我早已熟睡。有人将我唤醒。他们打开了弄堂里的警亭，向里面看了一眼后便离开了。其中也有日本人。”

萧法官问：“当时你是否知道有人将手枪扔进了你的警亭？”
李答：“我不知道。”

传唤的第二位证人是南洋舞厅的私家侦探、扬州人姚松庭，其证词如下：“南洋舞厅曾停业并重新开业三四次。该舞厅也被称为南洋公记舞厅。根据舞厅发给我并已交由警方保管的聘书，舞厅曾于去年11月8日重新开业。开业当天有许多顾客光顾，我不记得叶海生是否在场。”

萧法官对叶海生说：“你声称你在9日出席了南洋舞厅的开业典礼，且未参与杀害日本海军陆战队员一事。然而，根据这位证人的证词，舞厅是在8日开业的。究竟哪一天是确切日期？”

叶海生说：“我不记得具体日期，但我确实在开业当天在场。那天，余伟民和我殴打了一名舞伴，姚松庭前来调解。”

萧法官随即再次询问姚松庭：“张财源是否是南洋舞厅的雇员？”

姚松庭回答说不知道。

月宫舞厅经理宓保生随后提供如下证词：“我认识叶海生、周守庸以及名叫杰克的韩国人。他们常来跳舞。我不知道11月9日晚叶海生是否在我处。后来，我听顾客说，叶海生和杰克抢劫了某人20,000元，叶海生分得了5,000元。今年二月，金星舞场的高老板陪同日本军方总部的人员来到我处，问我杰克是否曾持有手枪并在我舞厅闹事，以及他平时是否经常与某些广东人在一起

pages.en:
5.
June 17, 1936. Morning Translation.

times. I replied that I did not know and that Jack had never created any trouble. About ten days later, Yih Hai Sung came to Shanghai from Tsingtao. One day he came to the Moon Palace Dance Hall and I told him about this. The same evening Yih again came accompanied by Chang Pah Sung (張伯森). Yih invited me to take food at the Hoong Tien Restaurant(紅天酒家) on the opposite side of the street. Yih stated that he had received a telephone message from Chang Zai Yuan saying that the Police were about to arrest him and telling him to make his escape quickly! Yih asked me whether I knew anything about it and also insisted upon knowing what questions Proprietor Kao and his party had asked when they came to make an enquiry. I then told him that I knew nothing about it."
Judge Hsiao then asked Yih Hai Sung about this incident.
Yih replied :- "This was exactly what happened. I felt it was very strange at the time because on returning to the Yangtsze Hotel, I again received a telephone message from Chang Zai Yuan. As I had not committed any unlawful act, so I and Chang Pah Sung called on Mih Pao Sung to ask him for information. If I had killed the Japanese marine, I would not have dared to go there. A week later, I went back to Tsingtao."
Here Assistant Municipal Advocate Li requested the Court to ask Chang Zai Yuan whether Yih Hai Sung had given him $30 to keep the matter secret.
Chang Zai Yuan denied the allegation.
Yao Ah Ng(姚阿五), wife of Tseng Yuan(曾元), giving evidence, stated that as she did not know Yang Chien Chung(楊建中), she could not have pointed him out to Chang Tsun(張琛).
Judge Hsiao then asked Tseng Yuan, the informer in this case, whether the document that was intended to implicate Chen Hung Pih(陳鴻璧), a female teacher of the Kwangtung Primary School, had actually been written by him.
Tseng Yuan :- "Yes, but I wrote it on the instructions of Chang Tsun and I did not know what it was intended for."
The Judge then indicated to Chang Tsun (張琛) the intention of Tseng Yuan in writing this document.
Chang Tsun said: "As the Japanese Landing Party Headquarters did not believe Tseng Yuan and Zung Wei Ming, Tseng Yuan asked me to request my cousin Ying Ku Tseu (邢克周), who was also working as a teacher in the Kwangtung Primary School, to inform Miss Chen in the hope of pleasing Miss Chen."
Referring to the strange letter which was later received by Miss Chen Hung Pih, the Court asked Chang Tsun whether he knew who wrote that letter.
Chang Tsun replied that he did not know.
Chang Tsun was then ordered to write some characters to enable the Court to compare the handwriting.
Addressing lawyer Chang Ts Zing (張志靖), Judge Hsiao said: "According to the written reports of the Police, the marks of injuries on the lips of Yih Hai Sung, which were pointed out to you by Yih during your interview with him, had been self-inflicted. Yih has also stated to you that he once saw three or four pistols belonging to Yang Vung Tao in a godown of Butterfield & Swire. Is this
pages.zh:
5.
1936年6月17日。晨间译稿。

交往。我回答说我不知道，且杰克从未惹过麻烦。大约十天后，叶海生从青岛来到上海。有一天他来到月宫舞厅，我将此事告诉了他。当晚，叶海生再次偕同张伯森前来。叶海生邀请我到街对面的红天酒家吃饭。叶海生称，他接到张财源的电话留言，说警方即将逮捕他，让他赶快逃跑！叶海生问我是否知情，并坚持要知道高老板及其随行人员前来查询时问了哪些问题。于是我告诉他，我对此一无所知。”
萧法官随即就此事询问叶海生。
叶海生回答说：“情况确实如此。我当时觉得很奇怪，因为回到扬子饭店后，我又接到了张财源的电话留言。由于我没有犯法，所以我和张伯森去拜访宓保生以获取信息。如果我杀了那名日本海军陆战队员，我就不敢去那里了。一周后，我回到了青岛。”
此时，助理市检察官李请求法庭询问张财源，叶海生是否给了他30元以保守秘密。
张财源否认了这一指控。
曾元之妻姚阿五作证称，因她不认识杨建中，故不可能向张琛指认他。
萧法官随后询问本案告密者曾元，那份旨在诬陷广东小学女教师陈鸿璧的文件是否确由他所写。
曾元说：“是的，但我是奉张琛之命写的，我不知道其用途。”
法官随即向张琛指出曾元撰写此文件的意图。
张琛说：“由于日本登陆部队总部不相信曾元和宗伟明，曾元便请我请求我的表亲邢克周（也在广东小学任教）去通知陈小姐，希望能讨好陈小姐。”
关于陈鸿璧后来收到的那封奇怪信件，法庭询问张琛是否知道是谁写的。
张琛回答说不知道。
法庭随即命令张琛书写一些字，以便法庭比对笔迹。
萧法官对律师张志靖说：“根据警方的书面报告，叶海生在与你面谈时向你指出的其嘴唇上的伤痕，系自残所致。叶海生还曾向你表示，他曾在太古洋行的仓库里看到过属于杨文道的三四支手枪。这是否

true?"
The lawyer replied: "Yes, it is true, but in view of the fact that it was only until recently that Yih Hai Sung drew attention to the hardships to which he had been subjected at the Police Station, his allegations, therefore, were of no value."
Wang Shih Chung (王士宗), Yih Hai Sung's lawyer, here stated: "It was several years ago that Yih Hai Sung saw the pistols belonging to Yang Vung Tao."
In answer to the Court, Yih Hai Sung said: "I saw three or four pistols in the room of Liang Chi ( ) of No. 13 godown of Butterfield & Swire during the January 28 Incident. According to Liang, these pistols belonged to Yang Vung Tao, but the latter flatly denied being the owner of these weapons."
Here, the Assistant Municipal Advocate Li Tse San informed the Court that Zung Yung Sung, who was arrested by the Police with Yang Vung Tao but was later released when the Police withdrew the charge against him, was present in Court. The Municipal Advocate further stated that Zung could testify to having seen the book (which was seized in connection with this case) at the home of Yang Vung Tao, and that it was he who picked it out from amongst a number of other books at the Police Station.
Upon being questioned by the Court on this point, Zung stated that he once saw a book at the home of Yang Vung Tao but it was an English book. He further stated that as the colour of the book which he had pointed out at the Police Station was similar to that of the book belonging to Yang Vung Tao, he made a mistake in the identification.
Assistant Municipal Advocate Li: "Yih Hai Sung was once arrested by the Bureau of Public Safety on February 24 in the 23rd Year of the Chinese Republic at Room No. 56 of the Moon Palace Hotel on suspicion of being a reactionary and the leader of an 'Axe Gang'. This shows that Yih is not a law-abiding person."
Yih Hai Sung: "There were in all eleven persons all of whom were arrested at the same time, but they were later all released for lack of evidence to show that they had committed any unlawful acts."
Tang Wei Chiung (唐煒群), lawyer for the defence of Tseu Shou Yung (周守庸), said: "During the two or three days prior to and after November 9 of last year, Tseu Shou Yung was every day at the Shanghai District Court, where he was endeavouring to induce lawyers to secure the release of his brother who was then under arrest. This can be ascertained at the Shanghai District Court."
Judge Hsiao ordered that a statement giving the nature as well as the record number of the case in the Shanghai District Court be submitted.
Judge Hsiao then asked Tseu Shou Yung: "According to the documents in the Liang Soo Chi (梁蘇池) case of the Dah Loh Cabaret, it was on May 1 that you appeared in Court to act as a witness in connection with this case."

属实？”
律师回答说：“是的，属实，但鉴于叶海生直到最近才提及他在警察局遭受的苦难，因此他的指控没有价值。”
叶海生的律师王士宗此时陈述：“叶海生看到属于杨文道的手枪已是几年前的事。”
回答法庭询问时，叶海生说：“在一·二八事变期间，我在太古洋行第13号仓库梁吉（原文不清）的房间里看到了三四支手枪。据梁吉说，这些手枪属于杨文道，但后者断然否认是这些武器的所有者。”
此时，助理市检察官李子山告知法庭，宗永松与杨文道一同被警方逮捕，但在警方撤销对其指控后被释放，此人目前在庭。市检察官进一步陈述，宗永松可以作证曾在杨文道家中见过本书（即本案查获之物），并且是他在警察局从众多书籍中将其挑出。
经法庭就此点讯问，宗永松陈述，他曾在杨文道家中见过一本书，但那是一本英文书。他进一步陈述，由于他在警察局指认的那本书的颜色与杨文道所有的书相似，因此他在辨认时出了错。
助理市检察官李说：“叶海生曾于民国二十三年二月二十四日因涉嫌为反动分子及‘斧头帮’头目，在月宫饭店56号房间被公安局逮捕。这表明叶海生并非守法之人。”
叶海生说：“当时共有十一人被捕，但因缺乏证据证明他们有任何违法行为，后来全部被释放。”
周守庸的辩护律师唐煒群说：“在去年11月9日前后的两三天内，周守庸每天都在上海地方法院，试图促使律师们设法释放当时被捕的其兄。这一点可在上海地方法院查证。”
萧法官命令提交一份说明上海地方法院案件性质及案号的陈述。
萧法官随后询问周守庸：“根据大乐舞厅梁苏池案的文件，你是在5月1日出庭就该案作证的。”

June 8, 1936. Morning Translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-
THE NAKAYAMA MURDER CASE : MEDICO-LEGAL LABORATORY TO
EXAMINE EVIDENCE

As it is necessary to ascertain whether the
bullet that was discovered in the Nakayama murder case
had ever penetrated a human body and whether the traces
of rust in the hollow of the book in which the pistol
was kept were natural traces or had been artificially
produced, Presiding Judge Chien of the First Shanghai
Special District Court remanded the case against Yang
Vung Tao (楊文道), Yih Hai Sung (叶海生) and Tseu Shou
Yong (周社荣), the three accused, charged in connection
with the murder, pending a report on these points to be
submitted by the Medico-Legal Laboratory.
According to information secured from a
certain source, there are no blood stains on the bullet
produced to the Court by the Municipal Police. The
examination to determine whether or not the bullet had
penetrated a human body is very complicated. It is
comparatively easy to decide whether or not the traces
of rust in the hollow of the book had been artificially
produced. The Medico-Legal Laboratory will probably
submit a report after one week.
Tang Van Jin (唐懷輝), the lawyer defending
Tseu Shou Yong, one of the accused, made the following
statement to our reporter yesterday :- "The lawyers
for the defence of Yang Vung Tao, Yih Hai Sung and Tseu
Shou Yong have produced counter-evidences. The lawyers
have not drafted their statements of defence because the
result of the examination by the Medico-Legal Laboratory
is still unknown. Furthermore, the Court is investigating
the counter-evidence".

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-
MEETING OF HOT WATER SHOP-KEEPERS' ASSOCIATION

Mou Yung Tang (毛永堂) and other members of
the Readjustment Committee of the Shanghai Municipality
Hot Water Shop-Keepers' Association held an informal
meeting yesterday and passed the following resolutions :-
1) That the thirteen members of the Readjustment Committee
of the Association advance money, to pay the expenses
of the Association for the timebeing.
2) That when the members of the Readjustment Committee
of the Association have assumed office, a demand for
a reduction in the water charge be made.
3) That the members of the Committee assume their office
on June 8; that the superior authorities be requested
to send deputies to supervise the function.

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：
中山谋杀案：法医实验室检验证据

鉴于有必要查明在中山谋杀案中发现的子弹是否曾穿透人体，以及存放手枪的书本凹槽中的锈迹是自然形成还是人为制造，上海第一特区地方法院主审法官钱氏将对涉及谋杀案的三名被告杨文道、叶海生和周社荣的案件延期审理，以待法医实验室就上述要点提交报告。
据某方面获得的消息，市警察当局呈堂展示的子弹上没有血迹。检验子弹是否曾穿透人体非常复杂。而判定书本凹槽中的锈迹是否为人造则相对容易。法医实验室可能在一周后提交报告。
被告之一周社庸的辩护律师唐怀辉昨日对本报记者发表如下声明：“杨文道、叶海生和周社庸的辩护律师已提出反证。由于法医实验室的检验结果尚未知晓，律师们尚未起草辩护状。此外，法庭正在调查反证”。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：
热水店店主协会会议

上海市热水店店主协会调整委员会成员毛永堂等人昨日举行非正式会议，并通过以下决议：1) 由协会调整委员会的十三名成员垫资，暂时支付协会费用。
2) 待协会调整委员会成员就职后，提出降低水费的要求。
3) 委员会成员于6月8日就职；请求上级当局派遣代表监督就职仪式。

June 8, 1936. Afternoon Translation.

The Great Daily News (大日報) published the following article
on June 7 :-

SOME CONSOLATION TO YIH HAI SUNG

Yih Hai Sung (叶海生), one of the suspects
in the Nakayama murder case, once stated in Court that he
had received no advanced information of the affair nor had
he any knowledge of the circumstances of the case. He also
stated that he had been tortured by having water poured into
his nose and his chest rubbed to cause the water to flow
into his system and that his lips had been burned with two
lighted cigarette tips. For this reason, he declared that
he swallowed two keys and a brass chain in order to put an
end to his life so that his ghost might avenge his innocence
upon his accuser.
At another hearing of the case, he stated
that his home was well furnished and that he lived a life
of leisure, therefore it would have been foolish of him to
murder the Japanese marine, thereby bringing trouble upon
himself.
Whether Yih Hai Sung took the principal
or a small part in this murder, we are not in a position
to say, but it seems to us unlikely that he should have
told a lie as regards the torture to which he had been subjected.
Furthermore, the Court doctor, as a result of his examination,
has stated that he (Yih) had sustained some slight injuries.
Whether or not he is concerned in the murder, he does not
deserve such torture. But he has been tortured. Everybody
is now saying: "Alas! Yih Hai Sung!" But be patient, Yih
Hai Sung, although you are now suffering some hardships,
you will one day be compensated for these sufferings. Yih
Hai Sung, happiness is awaiting you, be patient!

The Diamond (金鋼鑽) dated June 7 :-

The Nakayama Murder Case
(Concluded from June 5.)

The sentences imposed by Presiding Judge
Chien are severe but at times he is also very lenient.
Therefore, I believe that when the verdict in the Nakayama
murder case is rendered, it will be certainly well received
by the public. I am not acquainted with Judge Chien, but
since his transfer to Shanghai, I have attended several tens
of cases heard by him, all of which have been dealt by him
fairly. Furthermore, Judges Fang (方) and Siao (蕭)
are also very careful when hearing a case. Judge Fang was
transferred to Shanghai long before the organization of the
Provincial Court, while Judge Siao was transferred here from
Hupeh. These two Judges always show some regard for the
legal as well as the human side in a case. When these first
class jurists sit together, as in the case of the murder of
Nakayama, the result will naturally be satisfactory. The law
is fair and we should trust the Court and the Police to
handle the case in an impartial manner.

《大日報》于6月7日刊登如下文章：

给叶海生的一点安慰

中山案嫌疑人之一叶海生（Yih Hai Sung）曾在法庭上陈述，他对此事未获任何事先消息，亦不了解案情。他还称，自己遭受了灌水入鼻并揉搓胸部以使水进入体内的酷刑，且嘴唇被两支点燃的烟头烫伤。为此，他声称吞下两把钥匙和一条铜链以自尽，好让他的鬼魂向指控者昭雪冤屈。
在另一次庭审中，他陈述其家境殷实，生活闲适，因此谋杀日本海军陆战队员从而给自己惹来麻烦是愚蠢之举。
叶海生在此谋杀案中是主犯还是从犯，我们无从置喙，但在他看来，关于其所受酷刑的说法似乎不太可能是谎言。此外，法医经检查后表示，他（叶）受了一些轻伤。无论他是否卷入谋杀案，他都不应遭受此类酷刑。但他确实受了酷刑。现在人人都在说：“唉！叶海生！”但请耐心些，叶海生，虽然你眼下正遭受一些苦难，但终有一日这些痛苦会得到补偿。叶海生，幸福在等待着你，请耐心些！

6月7日的《金鋼鑽》报：

中山谋杀案
（续自6月5日。）

钱庭长所判处的刑罚严厉，但有时也非常宽仁。因此，我相信当中山谋杀案的判决作出时，必定会受到公众的欢迎。我不认识钱法官，但自从他调任上海以来，我旁听了他审理的数十起案件，所有案件他都处理得公正无私。此外，方（Fang）法官和萧（Siao）法官在审案时也非常谨慎。方法官在省高等法院成立之前很久就调到了上海，而萧法官则是从湖北调来的。这两位法官在审理案件时总是兼顾法理与人情。当这些一流的法官共同坐堂审案，如中山谋杀案这般，结果自然令人满意。法律是公平的，我们应该信任法院和警方以公正的方式处理此案。

Sin Wan Pao (Tientsin telegram) :-
ARSENALS FOR EAST HOPEI.
Acting on secret instructions from a certain party, Yin Ju Keng(殷汝耕) is organizing two arsenals at Tung Hsien(通縣). Machinery has been landed there from Osaka. Various kinds of munitions and gas will be manufactured.

Sin Wan Pao (Nanking telegram):
NO CANTONESE TROOPS IN HUNAN
In a telegram on June 6, Ho Chien, Chairman of the Hunan Provincial Government, reported that the province of Hunan was quiet and that the report to the effect that the Kwangtung Army had entered the territory of Hunan is unfounded.

Up to the evening of June 6, the various parties at Nanking had not received any reports of military movements by the South West authorities.
Owing to the fact that the communist bandits have been suppressed, only a small army has been maintained on the borders between Yunan, Kweichow, Hunan, Kiangsi, Fukien and the provinces of Kwangtung and Kwangsi. The Central authorities have not mobilized any troops to proceed to these borders.
The news distributed by radio stations secretly established at Hongkong by certain foreign nationals are mostly unfounded, and are intended to upset the world. Various members of the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang at Nanking and those at Kwangtung and Kwangsi have been keeping in close touch with one another. The real situation will be completely disclosed in a few days.

Holmes (福尔摩斯) dated June 6:
YIH HAI SUNG'S ALLEGATIONS OF TORTURE:
SARCASTIC COMMENTS
At the 5th hearing of the Nakayama murder case, Yih Hai Sung (葉海松), one of the suspects, made the following statement in Court: "They blindfolded me and secured me to a bench. Water was poured into my nose and they rubbed my chest with their hands so that the water flowed into my system. Two short lighted cigarette tips were used and injured my nose and lips."
While he was making the statement, he wept. It was owing to these circumstances that he swallowed the keys and a brass chain (? a piece of brass).
It seems, however, that Yih is most unreasonable for such treatment is most civilized and polite. Yih has been treated quite well. If there are no civilized persons from civilized countries, Yih would not have been treated so well. Yet Yih is saying that he has been tortured and injured!

6月6日的《福尔摩斯》报：
叶海生指控受刑：
讽刺评论
在中山谋杀案的第五次庭审中，嫌疑人之一叶海生（葉海松）在法庭上作了如下陈述：“他们蒙住我的眼睛，将我绑在长凳上。水被灌入我的鼻子，他们用手揉搓我的胸部，使水流进我的体内。两支点燃的短烟头被用来弄伤我的鼻子和嘴唇。”
他在作此陈述时哭了。正是由于这些情况，他才吞下了钥匙和一条铜链（？一块黄铜）。
然而，叶似乎极不讲理，因为这种待遇是最文明、最礼貌的。叶受到了很好的对待。如果没有来自文明国家的文明人，叶不会受到如此好的对待。然而叶却说自己受了酷刑和伤害！

Shun Pao, Lih Pao, Ta Kung Pao, China Times and newspapers:
THE NAKAYAMA MURDER CASE : YESTERDAY'S COURT PROCEEDINGS
The fifth hearing of the case against Yih Hai Sung (葉海生) alias Siao Kwangtung (小廣東), Yang Vung Tao (楊文道) and Tseu Shou Yong (周社榮), who are charged with the murder of the Japanese marine Hideo Nakayama, took place in the First Special District Court yesterday afternoon before Presiding Judge Chien Hung Nieh (錢鴻業), Judges Feng Shih Teh (馮世德) and Siao Sih Fun (蕭士芬), Procurator Chang Chung Shih (張崇儒) and Court Clerk Ting Chung Nan (丁重南) were in attendance.
The Court was strongly guarded as before. Officials of the Shanghai City Government, Public Safety Bureau and the Japanese Consulate were present. Shortly before 2 p.m. the three accused were brought into Court by foreign and Japanese policemen and detectives. Tseng Yuan (曾元) and his wife and Chang Zai Yuan (張財源), who supplied the information to the Police which led to the arrest of the accused, arrived at the same time. At previous hearings the Police were represented by Municipal Advocates Bryan and Paul Ru, but the former was absent yesterday and his place was taken by Municipal Advocate Lee Tse Sai (厲志山).
The accused were asked their names, ages and nativities. They all appeared pale and in low spirits.
Addressing the Court, Advocate Paul Ru said,
"In compliance with an order of the Court given at the last hearing, Yih Hai Sung was removed to the Municipal Hospital and examined by a doctor of the hospital on the same day. On the following day, Yih was again examined by the Municipal doctor in company with the Court Doctor and a doctor detailed by Japanese officials. The examination consisted of:
1) X-ray Examination -- Yih Hai Sung had stated at the last hearing that he had swallowed some metal piece detached from his clothing and also two keys. If this is true, there may have been negligence on the part of the Police. Therefore an X-ray examination was made because this would have detected all foreign matters in a person's body.
2) External Examination by Scientific Methods -- This was done because Yih had stated that he was suffering from injury and pain in his body. A report has probably been made to the Court by the Court Doctor on the results of the examination. What has been found by the examination is, however, not exactly what had been stated by Yih.
After the examination, reports were made by the doctor in charge of the X-ray department of the Municipal Hospital and Assistant Superintendent "Jang-S-Ton" (章士登) of the hospital. In the reports it is stated that no keys or any other kind of metal object were found in the stomach of Yih Hai Sung. Although there is a pink mark of a wound on the upper lip of Yih Hai Sung, the reports say that it could not be certified whether the accused had been tortured. However, the Police are taking a serious view of this matter and have made discreet investigations among the officers who

《申报》、《立报》、《大公报》、《字林西报》及各报馆：
中山谋杀案：昨日庭审情况
昨天下午，在第一特区地方法院进行了对叶海生（葉海生，别名小廣東）、杨文道（Yang Vung Tao）和周社荣（Tseu Shou Yong）涉嫌谋杀日本海军陆战队员中山秀雄（Hideo Nakayama）一案的第五次庭审。主审法官钱鸿业（Chien Hung Nieh），法官冯世德（Feng Shih Teh）和萧士芬（Siao Sih Fun），检察官张崇儒（Chang Chung Shih）及书记员丁重南（Ting Chung Nan）出庭。
法庭如往常一样戒备森严。上海市政府、公安局和日本领事馆的官员出席。下午2点前不久，三名被告由外籍和日本警察及侦探带入法庭。曾元（Tseng Yuan）及其妻子和张财源（Chang Zai Yuan）同时到达，正是他们向警方提供线索导致了被告被捕。在前几次庭审中，警方由公派律师布莱恩（Bryan）和保罗·鲁（Paul Ru）代表，但前者昨日缺席，由公派律师厉志山（Lee Tse Sai）接替其位。
被告被询问姓名、年龄和籍贯。他们均面色苍白，情绪低落。
保罗·鲁律师向法庭陈述道：
“遵照上次庭审时法庭的命令，叶海生于当日被送往市立医院并由该院医生进行检查。次日，叶又在市医官陪同下，会同法院法医及日本官员指派的一名医生再次接受检查。检查内容包括：
1) X光检查——叶海生在上次庭审中称，他吞下了从衣服上脱落的一些金属片以及两把钥匙。如果属实，警方可能存在疏忽。因此进行了X光检查，因为这能探测出人体内的所有异物。
2) 科学方法的外部检查——这是因为叶声称身体受伤并感到疼痛。法院法医可能已就检查结果向法院提交了报告。然而，检查发现的情况与叶所述并不完全一致。
检查结束后，市立医院X光科主任和医院助理主管“章士登”（Jang-S-Ton）提交了报告。报告中指出，在叶海生的胃中未发现钥匙或任何其他金属物体。虽然叶海生的上唇有一处粉红色的伤痕标记，但报告称无法证实被告是否遭受了酷刑。不过，警方对此事持严肃态度，并在有机会讯问叶海生的警官中进行了审慎调查

pages.en:
2.
June 4, 1936. Morning Translation.

had occasion to question Yih Hai Sung. Furthermore, written reports have been obtained from all police officers, from Assistant Commissioner Robertson down to the detectives of the lowest rank who are connected with the case. These reports are herewith produced to the Court. From these reports it can be seen whether the Police had applied punishment (? torture).
"A further remand of this case is requested because officers sent to Tsingtao and Canton to make enquiries have not yet returned."
Presiding Judge announced that the Court had already received the report of the Court Doctor, and ordered Court Clerk Ting to read out the report.
The report read: "None of the articles said to have been swallowed by Yih Hai Sung were found in his stomach. The 6th, 7th and 8th ribs bore marks of bruises done by soft articles. There was a red coloured mark of a wound on the upper lip; the mark was without skin. The wound was one of more than two or three weeks old. It was quite regular in shape and size."
After the Court Clerk had read out this report, Presiding Judge Chien questioned Yih Hai Sung as follows :-
Q:- On what date did you swallow the keys?
A:- I swallowed the keys at the Police Station on the night of the day before I first confessed in Court that I had murdered the Japanese marine. (This means the night of April 30.)
Q:- On what date did you swallow the piece of brass?
A:- I swallowed it during the period of remand of the case for two weeks after I had confessed to the murder on the second occasion. As the swallowing of the keys had no result, I swallowed the brass. The keys and the piece of brass were not found in the examination, and it is possible that they had been discharged from the bowels.
Q:- In your 6th, 7th and 8th ribs, there are traces of injuries caused by soft articles. How were you injured?
A:- The injuries were caused with the fists of Police officers. Two or three days after the second hearing when the case was remanded for two weeks, Police officers bound up my eyes and secured me to a bench. Water was poured into my nose and they rubbed my breast with their hands so that the water flowed into my system. Two short lighted cigarette tips were used and injured my nose and lips.
While making these replies, Yih Hai Sung lowered his head and wept.
Addressing Yang Vung Tao, the Judge said:
"You stated that the book (a book on Practical Physics) was changed by Yang Chien Chung (楊建中) with the intention of making a false charge against you, but in the statements made by witnesses Chang Tsun (張孫) and others, no person bearing the surname of Yang was mentioned. You said that Yang Chien Chung wanted to harm you. Has he any connection with this case?"
Yang Vung Tao replied that Yang Chien Chung had falsely accused him.
Q:- Did you ever see this book at the Police Station?
A:- I did not see the book on the first occasion. When I returned from the Court, the Police showed me the book.
Q:- Did you touch the book with your hands?
A:- No.

2.
1936年6月4日。上午译件。

此外，还从所有与该案有关的警务人员，从助理总监罗伯逊（Robertson）到最低级别的侦探，均获得了书面报告。现将这些报告呈交法庭。从这些报告中可以看出警方是否实施了惩罚（？酷刑）。
“请求将此案进一步延期审理，因为派往青岛和广州进行调查的警官尚未返回。”
主审法官宣布法庭已收到法院法医的报告，并命令书记员丁宣读该报告。
报告宣读如下：“在叶海生胃中未发现其声称吞下的任何物品。第6、7和第8肋骨上有软物造成的淤痕。上唇有一处红色伤痕标记；该处表皮缺失。伤口已有两周以上历史。形状和大小相当规则。”
书记员宣读完这份报告后，钱主审法官讯问叶海生如下：
问：你是哪一天吞下钥匙的？
答：我是在第一次当庭供认谋杀日本海军陆战队员的前一天晚上，在警察局吞下钥匙的。（意指4月30日晚。）
问：你是哪一天吞下那块黄铜的？
答：是在第二次供认谋杀后，案件延期审理的两周期间吞下的。由于吞下钥匙没有产生结果，我便吞下了黄铜。检查中未发现钥匙和黄铜块，它们可能已通过肠道排出。
问：在你的第6、7和第8肋骨处，有软物造成伤害的痕迹。你是如何受伤的？
答：伤是由警官的拳头造成的。在第二次庭审后两三天，案件被延期两周，警官蒙住我的眼睛，将我绑在长凳上。水被灌入我的鼻子，他们用手揉搓我的胸部，使水流进我的体内。两支点燃的短烟头被用来弄伤我的鼻子和嘴唇。
在回答这些问题时，叶海生低下头哭泣。
法官对杨文道说：
“你陈述说，那本书（一本《实用物理学》）被杨建中（Yang Chien Chung）调换，意图诬陷你，但在证人张孙（Chang Tsun）等人的证词中，并未提及姓杨的人。你说杨建中想害你。他与本案有关联吗？”
杨文道回答说杨建中诬告了他。
问：你在警察局见过这本书吗？
答：第一次我没见过这本书。当我从法庭回来时，警察给我看了这本书。
问：你用手碰过这本书吗？
答：没有。

pages.en:
3.
June 4, 1936. Morning Translation.

Chang Tse Siang (張志), a lawyer assigned by the Court to defend Yih Hai Sung, said: "When I interviewed Yih Hai Sung at the Police Station, Yih said that he had swallowed certain keys and other articles. Therefore, I requested that Yih be sent to hospital for examination. At that time, Yih was suffering from nausea and diarrhoea. It is possible that the keys and other articles had already been discharged from the bowels. The examination can only prove that there were no keys or other articles in Yih's stomach; it cannot settle the point as to whether or not Yih had swallowed these things. The most important points are whether Yih's injuries were caused by torture.
"The report of the Court doctor states that there are traces of injuries to Yih's ribs caused by the rubbing of soft articles. Yih stated that the injuries were caused by fists. This is in accord. The report reveals that Yih bore traces of injuries to his upper lip. Yih said that the injuries were caused by lighted cigarettes. This is also in accord. It is possible that the injuries were caused by lighted cigarettes. It is now clear as to whether Yih has been injured or whether Yih's statement is reliable. I do not think that the present place where Yih is being detained is suitable. The object of my request at the last hearing that Yih be sent to a hospital was not simply to enable Yih to undergo an examination. As Yih's spirit is exceedingly low, it is essential that he should be placed in a hospital for treatment".
The other lawyer appearing for Yih Hai Sung said: "Yih is at present still detained in the Police Station; this is against the intention of the Court which had ordered Yih's removal to hospital. I therefore request the Court to appoint a suitable place of detention or to order the Police to transfer Yih Hai Sung to the Court Detention Room. The Police may detail additional officers to assist in keeping watch, supervising interviews, etc. The Police may suggest a better means, if they have any, so that no corrupt practices may be possible."
Presiding Judge Chien said: "There is no Criminal Detention Room in this Court. If the accused has been threatened in the Police Station, the Police still can remove him back to the Station from time to time even if he is detained in this Court. Police officers handling the case will be held responsible if torture has been inflicted. The request for Yih's detention in this Court is therefore over-ruled."
Lawyer Tang Wei Chung (唐衛忠): "At the last hearing the Court ordered that Yih Hai Sung be sent to hospital the same day, but on the same evening Yih was still detained in the Police Station and was not removed to hospital until the following morning."
Assistant Municipal Advocate Paul Ru stood up and replied: "Regarding this point, lawyer Tang may be under some misunderstanding. Upon receipt of the Court's order, the Police on the same day sent Yih to the S.M.C. Hospital where he was examined by a doctor. He was again sent there on the following day for joint examination by the Court doctor. As no metal objects were found in his stomach, he was brought back to the Police Station. Yih Hai Sung will be sent to hospital again for treatment only when a doctor's certificate is produced showing that Yih is really suffering from some disease."
pages.zh:
3.
1936年6月4日。晨间译稿。

法院指派为叶海生辩护的律师张志（Chang Tse Siang）称：“我在巡捕房讯问叶海生时，叶称其吞下了若干钥匙及其他物品。因此，我请求将叶送医检查。当时，叶正遭受恶心和腹泻之苦。钥匙及其他物品可能已经随粪便排出。检查只能证明叶的胃中没有钥匙或其他物品；无法断定叶是否曾吞下这些东西。最关键的问题在于，叶的伤势是否由刑讯造成。
“法院医生的报告指出，叶的肋骨上有因柔软物体摩擦造成的伤痕痕迹。叶称这些伤痕是拳头所致。二者相符。报告显示，叶的上唇有伤痕痕迹。叶称这些伤痕是由点燃的香烟所致。这也相符。伤痕确有可能由点燃的香烟造成。现在清楚的是，叶确实受了伤，且叶的陈述是可信的。我认为目前羁押叶的场所并不适宜。我在上次庭审中请求将叶送医，目的不仅仅是为了让叶接受检查。由于叶的精神状态极度低落，必须将其安置在医院进行治疗。”
另一位代表叶海生出庭的律师称：“叶目前仍被羁押在巡捕房；这违背了法院命令将叶移送医院的本意。因此，我请求法院指定一个合适的羁押场所，或命令警方将叶海生移送至法院拘留室。警方可以增派警员协助看守、监督会见等。如果警方有更好的办法以防止舞弊行为，也可以提出。”
钱主审法官称：“本院没有刑事拘留室。如果被告在巡捕房受到威胁，即使将其羁押在本院，警方仍可随时将其带回巡捕房。若存在刑讯逼供，办案警员将承担责任。因此，驳回将叶羁押于本院的请求。”
唐卫忠（Tang Wei Chung）律师称：“在上次庭审中，法院命令于当日将叶海生送医，但当晚叶仍被羁押在巡捕房，直到次日早晨才被送往医院。”
副市政检察官保罗·鲁（Paul Ru）起身回答：“关于这一点，唐律师可能存在误解。接到法院命令后，警方于当日将叶送往工部局医院，由医生进行了检查。次日又将其送往该院，由法院医生进行联合检查。由于其胃内未发现金属物体，故将其带回巡捕房。只有当出具医生证明表明叶确实患有某种疾病时，才会再次将叶海生送医治疗。”

pages.en:
June 4, 1936.
4
Morning Translation.

Presiding Judge Chien addressing Kuh
Chao Chi (葛肇基), the lawyer defending Yang Vung Tao:
"A petition has been received from Yang Wong Sz (楊王氏),
the wife of Yang Vung Tao, stating that her husband is
also suffering from injuries and requesting that he be sent
to hospital to be examined. As Yih Hai Sung said in Court
at the last hearing that all the statements he had previously
made had been secured by force (? torture), the Court ordered
that Yih be sent to hospital for examination. But as Yang
Vung Tao had never made a statement admitting the crime,
there is no necessity to send him to hospital."
The Court then asked whether the Japanese
detective who had effected the arrest of Yang Vung Tao had
received the information from Yang Chien Chung.
Assistant Municipal Advocate Paul Ru
replied: "The Japanese detective has gone to Tsingtao and
has not been back. But as I had already asked him a similar
question on a previous occasion, I can give evidence on his
behalf and state that it is not true that Yang Vung Tao was
arrested on information given by Yang Chien Chung. The
Japanese detective will be instructed to make a written
report as soon as he returns to Shanghai."
Presiding Judge Chien then asked the
Police whether the Korean named Jack was in Court.
After asking an official of the Japanese
Consulate, Assistant Municipal Advocate Paul Ru replied:
"According to the Japanese Consulate, Jack cannot be brought
here as the investigations have not yet been completed."
Addressing the witness Chang Tsun, the
Court asked: "Zung Wei Ming (曾偉民) and Li Yao (李耀)
and others were the informers who made a report to the
Japanese detective implicating Yang Vung Tao. Was any of
the informers named Yang Chien Chung?"
Chang Tsun replied: "I do not know Yang
Chien Chung. However, I once went to the home of Zung Wei
Ming for money in company with the wife of Tseng Yuan and
she pointed out to me a man who was waiting in the parlor
and said that he was Yang Chien Chung. Later Yang Chien
Chung and Zung Wei Ming went out together on some business."
At the close of the interrogation, the
Presiding Judge stated that a further remand of the case
was necessary because the Court had forwarded the bullet,
the pistol and the book in which a hole had been made to
conceal the pistol, to the Medico-Legal Laboratory at Chenju
for examination in regard to the following points:-
(1) Whether or not the bullet in question
was the one which had penetrated the body and whether or not
it has any blood stains. If it was the bullet that had
penetrated the body, would any blood stains remain on the
bullet? And if there had been blood stains on the bullet,
and the blood stains were later wiped off, was there any way
to ascertain this by means of scientific examination?
(2) There are traces of rust in the hole
excavated in the book for the purpose of concealing the
pistol. How long does it take to produce these traces of
rust? Were these traces of rust produced naturally or had
they been produced through human manipulation?
(3) For how long have those blue pencil
marks been in the hole of the book?
pages.zh:
1936年6月4日。
4
晨间译稿。

钱主审法官对杨文道的辩护律师葛肇基（Kuh Chao Chi）说：
“收到杨文道之妻杨王氏（Yang Wong Sz）的一份请愿书，称其丈夫也受了伤，请求将其送医检查。鉴于叶海生在上一轮庭审中称，他此前所作的所有供述均是通过武力（？刑讯）获取的，法院命令将叶送医检查。但由于杨文道从未作出认罪供述，因此没有必要将其送医。”
法院随后询问，实施逮捕杨文道的日本侦探是否从杨建中（Yang Chien Chung）处获得了情报。
副市政检察官保罗·鲁回答：“该日本侦探已前往青岛，尚未返回。但由于我之前曾向他问过类似的问题，我可以代他作证并声明，杨文道是因杨建中提供的情报而被捕的说法不属实。待该日本侦探回到上海后，将指示其提交书面报告。”
钱主审法官随后询问警方，名为杰克（Jack）的朝鲜人是否在法庭。
在询问日本领事馆官员后，副市政检察官保罗·鲁回答：“据日本领事馆称，由于调查尚未完成，杰克无法被带到这里。”
法院向证人张尊（Chang Tsun）问道：“曾伟民（Zung Wei Ming）、李耀（Li Yao）等人是向日本侦探举报并牵连杨文道的线人。线人中是否有名叫杨建中的人？”
张尊回答：“我不认识杨建中。不过，我曾与曾元（Tseng Yuan）的妻子一起去曾伟民家取钱，她指给我看一位在客厅等候的男子，说他就是杨建中。后来杨建中和曾伟民一起外出办事。”
讯问结束时，主审法官表示，本案需要进一步延期审理，因为法院已将子弹、手枪以及为藏匿手枪而挖洞的书本送至真如（Chenju）法医实验室，就以下几点进行检验：-
(1) 该子弹是否为射入体内的子弹，以及其上是否有血迹。如果是射入体内的子弹，子弹上是否会残留血迹？如果子弹上曾有血迹，而后血迹被擦除，是否有办法通过科学检验查明此事？
(2) 书中为藏匿手枪而挖掘的孔洞内有锈迹。产生这些锈迹需要多长时间？这些锈迹是自然形成的，还是人为制造的？
(3) 书中的孔洞内的蓝色铅笔标记存在了多久？

pages.en:
5.
June 4, 1936. Morning Translation.

Continuing, the Presiding Judge said: "The doctor in charge of the Chenju Medico-Legal Laboratory has stated that these points can be established by examination, but that the examination would take a long time. Therefore this case must be remanded pending the arrival of the report of the examination from the Laboratory."
Lawyer Tang Wei Chung here rose and said: "On the day before his arrest, accused Tseu Shou Yung appeared in this Court as a witness in connection with the case of the Dah Loh Dance Hall(大陸舞廳). This shows that he is honest and has nothing to hide. He had made up his mind to surrender to the Police upon learning of the present case after reading the newspapers the next morning, but was arrested on the night of that day. As he had been busily engaged for several days in effecting the release of his brother who was arrested by the Bureau of Public Safety on November 5 last year, he could not have taken part in the planning of the murder of the Japanese marine that took place on November 9."
The Presiding Judge stated that as the case of the Dah Loh Dance Hall had been heard by this Court, the documents relating to the case could be procured for examination.
Lawyer Chang Tse Siang here requested the Court to give a ruling regarding the place of Yih Hai Sung's detention.
To this, Paul Ru, the Assistant Municipal Advocate, said: "This case was unearthed and handled by the Dixwell Road Police Station, but as a matter of precaution, Yih Hai Sung was sent to the Chengtu Road Police Station for detention, while Yang Vung Tao and Tsou Shou Yung were taken to the Central Police Station. Detectives of Dixwell Road Police Station could not go to Central Police Station (? Chengtu Road Station) to punish (? torture) the accused. If Yih Hai Sung is certified to be sick by a doctor, he can be detained in hospital or even be handed over to his lawyer. Unless certified in this manner, Yih Hai Sung is not entitled to different treatment, because he is an offender like the other accused. Furthermore, whilst he was detained at the Police Station, he was well treated; he was allowed choice of food and was even permitted to smoke cigarettes, especially the latter privilege which is unprecedented at a Police Station. Is this to be regarded as ill-treatment?"
Upon hearing this, the Presiding Judge Chien ordered that Yih Hai Sung be sent to the Central Police Station for detention in company with Yang Vung Tao and the other accused, and that the case be remanded for further hearing. It was already half past three when the Court rose.
pages.zh:
5.
1936年6月4日。晨间译稿。

主审法官继续说道：“真如法医实验室的主管医生表示，这些问题可以通过检验查明，但检验需要很长时间。因此，本案必须延期，等待实验室的检验报告到达。”
唐卫忠律师此时起身说道：“被告周守勇（Tseu Shou Yung）在被捕前一天，曾作为‘大陆舞厅’（Dah Loh Dance Hall）一案的证人出现在本院。这表明他是诚实的，没有什么可隐瞒的。他在次日早上读报得知本案后，已下定决心向警方自首，但在当晚即被捕。由于他在过去几天里忙于营救去年11月5日被公安局逮捕的兄弟，他不可能参与策划11月9日发生的杀害日本海军陆战队士兵的案件。”
主审法官表示，由于‘大陆舞厅’一案已由本院审理，可以调取该案相关文件以供查阅。
张志律师此时请求法院就叶海生的羁押地点作出裁决。
对此，副市政检察官保罗·鲁说：“本案由狄思威路巡捕房侦破并处理，但出于谨慎考虑，叶海生被送往成都路巡捕房羁押，而杨文道和周守勇则被带往中央巡捕房。狄思威路巡捕房的侦探无法前往中央巡捕房（？成都路巡捕房）惩罚（？刑讯）被告。如果叶海生经医生证明患病，他可以羁押在医院，甚至移交给其律师。除非有此证明，否则叶海生无权享受不同待遇，因为他与其他被告一样是罪犯。此外，他在巡捕房羁押期间受到了良好待遇；他被允许选择食物，甚至被允许吸烟，尤其是后者这一特权在巡捕房是前所未有的。这能被视为虐待吗？”
听罢此言，钱主审法官命令将叶海生与杨文道及其他被告一同移送至中央巡捕房羁押，并将本案延期进一步审理。休庭时已是三点半。

June 3, 1936.    Morning Translation.    7073

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE NAKAYAMA MURDER CASE : FURTHER HEARING TO-DAY

When, the case against Yang Vung Tao (楊文道),
Yih Hai Sung (叶海生) and Tseu Shou Yong (周守勇), charged
in connection with the murder of Nakayama, was heard last
Wednesday (May 27), Yih Hai Sung wept and stated that he
had swallowed two keys during his detention in the Police
Station in an attempt to commit suicide. He asked that
an examination of his body be made as the keys were still
in his stomach.
Presiding Judge Chien then ordered that Yih
Hai Sung be removed to the S.M.C. Hospital to undergo an
examination.
On the morning of last Thursday, Wei Lih Kung
(魏立功), Chief Doctor of the 1st Shanghai Special District
Court, in company with a doctor from the S.M.C. Hospital,
examined every part of Yih Hai Sung's body. An X Ray
apparatus was used. The Japanese authorities had also
detailed a doctor of Foh Min Hospital (福民醫院) to
participate in the examination.
The result of the examination is being kept
secret. The Chinese, Foreign and Japanese doctors who
participated in the examination have each submitted to their
respective superiors a report on the result of the examination.
Last Saturday, the Chinese Court doctor submitted his report
to the 1st Special District Court. Presiding Judge Chien
has ordered that the report be kept on record.
At about 2 p.m. June 1, Chang Tse Siang (張志),
a lawyer assigned by the Court to defend Yih Hai Sung,
visited the Court and read the report made by the Chinese
Court doctor. The lawyer took extracts from the report.
He declined to give out any information regarding the report.
According to information secured by our
reporter, no keys were found in Yih's stomach and it could
not be said whether the keys had already been discharged
from the bowels. It is true that slight injuries were
found on his body. Although Yih is not suffering from
any nervous diseases, his spirit is exceedingly weak.
Wong Sz Chung (王士崇), Yih's lawyer, informed
our reporter that Yih has several witnesses, some of whom
are at Hongkong and others at Tsingtao and that it is
difficult to summon them in so short a time. Wong added
that he would request the Court to summon these witnesses.
The case will come up for further hearing
at 2 p.m. to-day. The Chinese, Foreign and Japanese
doctors who had examined Yih's body will give evidence.

《大公报》及本地其他报纸：-

中山谋杀案：今日继续审理

上周三（5月27日）审理涉及杨文道（Yang Vung Tao）、叶海生（Yih Hai Sung）和周守勇（Tseu Shou Yong）被控谋杀中山一案时，叶海生哭泣并称，其在巡捕房羁押期间吞下两把钥匙企图自杀。他要求对其身体进行检查，称钥匙仍在胃中。
钱主审法官随即命令将叶海生移送至工部局医院接受检查。
上周四上午，上海第一特区地方法院首席医生魏立功（Wei Lih Kung）会同一名工部局医院医生，对叶海生的全身各部位进行了检查。使用了X光设备。日本当局也派遣了一名福民医院（Foh Min Hospital）的医生参与检查。
检查结果保密。参与检查的中、外、日医生已分别向其各自上级提交了检查结果报告。
上周六，中国法院医生向第一特区地方法院提交了报告。钱主审法官已命令将该报告存档。
6月1日下午2时许，法院指派为叶海生辩护的律师张志（Chang Tse Siang）访问法院，阅读了中国法院医生所作的报告。该律师摘录了报告内容。他拒绝透露有关报告的任何信息。
据本报记者获得的消息，叶的胃中未发现钥匙，也无法断定钥匙是否已随粪便排出。其身体确有轻微伤痕，这是事实。虽然叶未患任何神经性疾病，但其精神状态极度虚弱。
叶的律师王士崇（Wong Sz Chung）告知本报记者，叶有几名证人，部分在香港，部分在青岛，短时间内难以传唤。王补充说，他将请求法院传唤这些证人。
本案将于今日下午2时继续审理。曾检查叶身体的中、外、日医生将出庭作证。

June 2, 1936.

Lih Pao (立報) :-

THE NAKAYAMA MURDER CASE

The fifth hearing of the case against the men charged with the murder of Japanese marine Hideo Nakayama will be held in the 1st Special District Court at 2 p.m. June 4.

Of the three accused, Yih Hai Sung (葉海生) is being detained in the Municipal Hospital, while Yang Vung Tao (楊文道) and Tseu Shou Yong (周社榮) are being held in Central Police Station, Foochow Road.

It is learnt that the other day Yang Tang Sz (楊唐氏), wife of Yang Vung Tao, sent a petition to the Criminal Division of the 1st Special District Court requesting that, in view of the pallid complexion and low-spirit of her husband at the last hearing, a doctor be sent by the Court to the Police Station to examine her husband and also that her husband be allowed to be removed to the Municipal Hospital for treatment as has been done in the case of Yih Hai Sung.

The Korean named Jack, an important figure in the murder case, has not yet made an appearance in the Chinese Court. It is said that the Court has again instructed the Police to notify the Japanese Consular Police to send Jack to the Court for questioning at the next hearing. It is believed that if Jack appears in Court on June 4, his statement will shed much light upon the case.

Sin Hwa (星華) Magazine, Vol. I, Issue 1, dated May 29, published the following brief comment :-

In connection with the murder of a Japanese marine on North Szechuen Road, all the accused were taken to the scene of the crime at 2 p.m. May 28 (?) and ordered to reconstruct the crime.

We regret having missed the "reconstruction". Probably it was a "brilliant" affair. Supposing that the accused failed to "reconstruct" what had actually occurred, supposing that they did not know what to reconstruct, I wonder whether the "true facts" will ever be "brought to light".

Shun Pao :-

TWO POLITICAL SONGS TO BE BROADCASTED TO-DAY.

(1) Song on making war with a certain nation (by Tseu Ying 周瑛).
(2) Enemy Resisting Song (by Chueh Feng 菊芬).

《立报》：

中山秀雄谋杀案

被控谋杀日本海军陆战队士兵中山秀雄（Hideo Nakayama）一案的第五堂审讯，将于6月4日下午2时在第一特区地方法院开庭。

三名被告中，叶海生现羁押于市立医院，而杨文道和周社荣则羁押于福州路中央捕房。

据悉，日前杨文道之妻杨唐氏向第一特区地方法院刑事庭递交呈文，称其夫在上次出庭时面色苍白、精神萎靡，故请求法院派医生前往捕房为其夫检查，并参照叶海生之先例，准许将其夫移送市立医院接受治疗。

在该谋杀案中具有重要地位的朝鲜人杰克（Jack），迄今尚未在中国法庭露面。据说，法院已再次指令警方通知日本领事馆警察，在下次开庭时将杰克送交法庭接受讯问。据信，若杰克于6月4日出庭，其供词将对本案真相大有裨益。

5月29日出版的《星华》杂志第一卷第一期发表如下短评：

关于四川北路日本海军陆战队士兵被杀一案，所有被告均于5月28日（？）下午2时被带往犯罪现场，并被责令重演犯罪经过。

我们遗憾未能目睹此次“重演”。想必那是一场“精彩”的戏码。假如被告未能“重演”实际发生的情形，假如他们不知该如何重演，我怀疑那些“真实情况”是否真能“大白于天下”。
